en.description: All segments strongly mark the uppercase letter sequence SA. It appears in varied positions, including email addresses and headers, parenthetical abbreviations, and organization or company names; surrounding characters and semantic domains are not fixed.

patterns.name: SA uppercase sequence
patterns.context: The letter sequence SA itself is strongly marked, often appearing as an uppercase sequence in abbreviations, proper names, or addresses; adjacent characters are not fixed.
patterns.domain: Across email, web, legal documents, encyclopedias, and academic texts

patterns.name: SA in email headers
patterns.context: Appears in recipient, CC, or organization-path fields in Enron email metadata.

patterns.name: SA in abbreviations
patterns.context: SA is part of a longer abbreviation, adjacent to Q, EC, or FTA; parenthetical or abbreviation-definition contexts are prominent.
patterns.domain: Technical Q&A, encyclopedia entries, academic discussion

patterns.name: SA in company or organization names
patterns.context: SA occurs within the name of a company, organization, or entity; surrounding characters can cross word boundaries, and spellings and meanings vary.
patterns.domain: Business email, news, case law, encyclopedias

4_49.description: 所有段都强烈标记大写字母序列 SA；它出现在邮件地址与抬头、括号缩写、机构或公司名称等多种位置，前后字符和语义领域不固定。

patterns.name: SA 大写序列
patterns.context: 字母序列 SA 本身被强烈标记，常处于缩写、专名或地址中的大写字符序列；相邻字符并非固定。
patterns.domain: 跨邮件、网页、法律文书、百科及学术文本

patterns.name: 邮件抬头中的 SA
patterns.trigger: «SA»10 位于邮件地址/抄送字段，如 «/SA»10«/»1«Enron»、«@»1«west»1lb；以及 «Luiz Maurer/«SA»9/»
patterns.context: 出现在 Enron 邮件元数据中的收件人、抄送人或组织路径内。

patterns.name: 缩写中的 SA
patterns.context: SA 是较长缩写的一部分，分别与 Q、EC、FTA 相邻；括号或缩写定义语境较明显。
patterns.domain: 技术问答、百科条目、学术论述

patterns.name: 公司或机构名称中的 SA
patterns.context: SA 出现在公司、机构或实体名称的内部；周围字符可跨词边界，拼写与词义各异。
patterns.domain: 商务邮件、新闻、判例、百科

en.description: Primarily activates on the uppercase letter sequence SA, found in organization abbreviations, name/email fields, academic abbreviations, and QSA; there are also sporadic activations on quoted sentence-initial We, exec in execs, and a subword fragment in Stray.

patterns.name: SA letter sequence
patterns.context: SA appears as a contiguous uppercase substring in abbreviations, name/address fields, or parenthetical labels; in segment 10, it follows Q.
patterns.domain: Organization names and abbreviations, email metadata, academic texts, technical Q&A

patterns.name: Sentence-initial We
patterns.context: A direct quote in quotation marks begins with We, followed by an abbreviation or auxiliary-verb construction.
patterns.domain: Quotes in news or web text

patterns.name: In-word fragment in execs
patterns.context: In business execs, execs is segmented into exec and a plural suffix.

patterns.name: In-word fragment in a word for light
patterns.context: The word Stray is split into two tokens, appearing sentence-initially and modifying light.

4_49.description: 主要对大写字母序列 SA 激活，见于组织缩写、姓名/邮件字段、学术缩写和 QSA；另对引语句首 We、execs 的 exec、Stray 的分词片段有零星激活。

patterns.name: SA 字母序列
patterns.context: SA 作为连续大写字母子串出现在缩写、姓名/地址字段或括号内标记中；段 10 中位于 Q 后。
patterns.domain: 机构名称与缩写、邮件元数据、学术文本、技术问答

patterns.name: 句首 We
patterns.context: 引号中的直接引语以 We 起始，后接缩写或助动词结构。

patterns.name: execs 词内片段
patterns.context: business execs 中的 execs 被拆分为 exec 与复数词尾。

patterns.name: 光线词内片段
patterns.context: 单词 Stray 被拆分为两个 token，位于句首并修饰 light。
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术，光学说明

en.description: The most prominent recurring trigger is the uppercase character sequence SA, appearing across email routing fields, organization proper names, and medical abbreviations; there are also two quotes beginning with We and a one-off ray in stray. Other highlights are sporadic and difficult to summarize.

patterns.name: SA substring/character sequence
patterns.context: The uppercase character sequence SA; in email addresses it is often a routing or department field, while in proper names or abbreviations it is simply part of a name. It triggers across different contexts.
patterns.domain: Enron email, encyclopedia entries, medical texts

patterns.name: Quotes beginning with We
patterns.context: First-person plural conversational quotes in quotation marks beginning with We; the two examples are followed by different predicate constructions.
patterns.domain: Direct quotes in news or online text

patterns.name: ray substring
patterns.context: Appears in the word “stray,” followed by light, describing stray light entering a lens.

patterns.name: Word activations in other fragments
patterns.context: Common words adjacent to the quotes in segments 6 and 7; these two segments alone do not reveal which words form stable trigger conditions.

patterns.name: Other sporadic highlights
patterns.context: Occur separately in email timestamps, encyclopedia entries, medical phrases, and business email, without a consistent cross-segment context pattern.
patterns.domain: Email, encyclopedias, medical and business texts

4_49.concept: 包含 SA 字符序列
4_49.description: 最明显的重复触发是大写 SA 字符序列，跨邮件路由字段、组织专名和医学缩写出现；另有 We 开头的两条引语及单例 stray 中的 ray。其他高亮分散，难以归纳。

patterns.name: SA 子串／字符序列
patterns.trigger: «SA»，尤其出现在人名、邮箱或组织名中，如“/«SA»10/”“(EC«SA»10)”“(«N»2«SA»9«IDs»2)”
patterns.context: 大写 SA 字符序列；在邮件地址中常为路由或部门字段，在专名或缩写中则只是名称的一部分。不同上下文中均会触发。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件、百科条目、医学文本

patterns.name: We 开头的引语
patterns.context: 引号中以 We 开始的第一人称复数口语引语；两个例子紧接不同的谓语结构。
patterns.domain: 新闻或网络文本中的直接引语

patterns.name: ray 子串
patterns.context: 出现在单词“stray”中，词后接 light，描述进入镜片的杂散光。

patterns.name: 其他片段中的字词激活
patterns.context: 与第6、7段引语相邻的常见词；仅凭这两段难以判断哪些词构成稳定触发条件。
patterns.domain: 网络文本中的口语引语

patterns.name: 其他零散高亮
patterns.context: 分别散见于邮件时间戳、百科条目、医学短语及商务邮件，缺乏跨段一致的上下文模式。
patterns.domain: 邮件、百科、医学与商务文本

en.description: All segments activate on the same token “Though” at the beginning of a sentence or new sentence; the following content and domains vary, with no stable topic or semantic condition.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial concessive/contrastive connective Though
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of a sentence or new sentence, followed by varied concessive, supplementary, or contrastive content; what follows is not fixed.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain text: email, encyclopedias, forums, news, literature, Q&A, and web text

4_49.description: 所有段都在句首或新句开头激活同一 token“Though”；其后内容和领域多样，没有稳定的主题或语义条件。

patterns.name: 句首让步/转折连接词 Though
patterns.context: 在句首或新句开头，后接不同类型的让步、补充或转折内容；后续内容不固定。
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本：邮件、百科、论坛、新闻、文学、问答及网页文本

en.concept: Sentence-initial They after a plural subject (local main pattern)
en.description: The main visible trigger is sentence-initial They after an introduction of a plural subject; there are also mon in a medical long word, Immun/ost fragments, and scattered activations on line breaks, words, and punctuation, with no condition that unifies all local triggers.

patterns.name: Consonant-cluster fragments at the beginning or within English words
patterns.context: Activation falls on specific subword fragments in English compounds or longer technical terms; visible fragments include word-initial mon and Immun/ost in a word for immunostaining.

patterns.name: They at the beginning of a paragraph
patterns.context: The preceding text introduces a plural subject (a sports team, band, fruit-picking messengers, or people/institutions under discussion), then a new sentence or paragraph begins with They; the marked token is the pronoun They.

patterns.name: Other locally highlighted fragments
patterns.context: These trigger points are scattered across different text positions; some are adjacent to line breaks or paragraph boundaries, while others are proper names, common words, or punctuation, with no shared and stable local semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Various styles, including encyclopedias, medical texts, email, and forums

4_49.concept: 复数主体后的句首 They（局部主模式）
4_49.description: 主要可见触发是复数主体介绍后句首的 They；另有医疗长词中的 mon、Immun/ost 片段，以及分散的换行、词语和标点激活，未见能统一解释所有局部触发的条件。

patterns.name: 英文词首或词内的辅音簇片段
patterns.context: 激活落在英文复合词或较长专业词的特定子词片段上；可见片段包括词首 mon 和免疫染色词中的 Immun/ost。

patterns.name: 段落句首的 They
patterns.context: 前文先介绍一个复数主体（球队、乐队、果品信使，或讨论中的人/机构），随后以 They 开始新句或新段；标记落在代词 They。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、论坛讨论、邮件

patterns.name: 其他局部高亮片段
patterns.context: 这些触发点分散在不同文本位置；有的紧邻换行或段落边界，有的是专名、普通词或标点，缺乏共同且稳定的局部语义条件。
patterns.domain: 百科、医学、邮件、论坛等多种文体

en.description: Activations are scattered across in-word substrings in multilingual text: medical terms and names, Italian word forms, Latin scientific names, and personal or place names; there is no stable shared meaning, word-initial position, or genre condition.

patterns.name: Split fragments within medical proper names
patterns.context: Activation often falls within English medical terms, drug names, disease names, or experimental subjects; some fragments are word-initial and others medial, and they cannot be reduced to a common root.
patterns.domain: PubMed abstracts and medical-related encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: In-word Italian fragments
patterns.context: Falls within words in Italian parliamentary speeches or formal statements, occurring at different positions in word forms; the fragments themselves have no clear unified meaning.

patterns.name: Word fragments in Italian IRC conversations
patterns.context: Appears within words in Italian IRC logs containing usernames, line breaks, and informal conversation; trigger points are distributed within words.

patterns.name: Fragments in encyclopedia titles or proper names
patterns.context: Activates on fragments of Latin scientific names in encyclopedia article titles and repeated names in the body text.

patterns.name: Name fragment in a biography
patterns.context: Falls within the name Hanneli, near a fashion blogger biography.

patterns.name: Proper-name fragments for people and places
patterns.context: Falls within the Indian place name Doddaballapur, near a narrative about a theater and business career.

4_49.description: 激活分散在多语种文本中的词内子串：医学术语与名称、意大利语词形、拉丁学名及人物或地点专名；没有稳定共享的词义、词首位置或文体条件。

patterns.name: 医学专名内部的切分片段
patterns.context: 激活常落在英文医学术语、药名、疾病名或实验对象的词内；部分片段是词首，部分是词中，无法归结为一个共同词根。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要及医学相关百科条目

patterns.name: 意大利语词内片段
patterns.context: 落在意大利语议会发言或正式陈述的词内，跨词形位置出现；片段本身没有明显统一词义。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 意大利语议会文本

patterns.name: 意大利语 IRC 对话中的词片段
patterns.context: 出现在带用户名、换行和非正式交谈的意大利语 IRC 记录中，触发点分布于词内。

patterns.name: 百科词条名或专名片段
patterns.context: 在百科条目标题及其重复的正文名称中，对拉丁学名片段激活。

patterns.name: 人物传记中的名字片段
patterns.context: 落在人物姓名 Hanneli 的词内，附近是时尚博主简介。
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 人物传记/网络简介

patterns.name: 人物与地点专名片段
patterns.context: 落在印度地点名 Doddaballapur 内，附近为剧院与商业经历叙述。

en.description: The most stable pattern is we all, especially followed by know or have, often expressing collective consensus or shared experience; there are also uses of all modifying a noun. Several sporadic activations on words, subword fragments, line breaks, punctuation, and numbers lack a unified explanation.

patterns.name: Collective-consensus phrase
patterns.context: We is followed by all, often continuing to express shared agreement, knowledge, or experience; all is the main trigger, and subsequent words sometimes also activate.
patterns.domain: Forum comments, parliamentary text, web articles, etc.

patterns.name: General use of the quantifier all
patterns.context: All modifies a plural or uncountable noun without we as the subject and without clearly expressing collective consensus.

patterns.name: Weak triggers other than “all”
patterns.context: Activation falls on nearby function words or subword fragments, with no stable independent semantic condition.

patterns.name: Residual activations across token boundaries
patterns.context: Activation occurs on split subword fragments or near line breaks and code formatting; its relation to the main clause meaning is unclear.
patterns.domain: Parliamentary text, forum posts, code snippets

patterns.name: Sporadic word activations beyond all
patterns.context: Individual words activate in specific contexts, but these examples do not establish a shared trigger condition.
patterns.domain: News commentary, entertainment news, parliamentary text, forums, and web pages

patterns.name: Number and punctuation activations
patterns.context: Low-intensity activations occur near numbers, percent signs, hyphens, or periods, with no stable cross-segment pattern.

4_49.description: 最稳定的模式是 we all，尤其接 know、have 等，常用于集体共识或共同经历；另有 all 修饰名词的用法。若干零散词、词片、换行、标点及数字激活缺乏统一解释。

patterns.name: 集体共识短语
patterns.context: we 后接 all，常继续表达共同认同、已知或共同经历；all 是主要触发词，后续词有时也激活
patterns.domain: 论坛评论、议会文本、网页文章等

patterns.name: 数量词 all 的一般用法
patterns.context: all 修饰复数名词或不可数名词，不需要 we 作主语，也未明显表达集体共识

patterns.name: “all”以外的弱触发
patterns.trigger: “«As» we all know”“«even» if”“«for» my group chats”等
patterns.context: 激活落在邻近的功能词或分词片段上，未见稳定的独立语义条件

patterns.name: 跨 token 边界的残片激活
patterns.context: 激活出现在被切分的词片段或换行、代码格式附近；与主体句意关系不明确
patterns.domain: 议会文本、论坛帖子、代码片段

patterns.name: all 之外的零散词语激活
patterns.context: 个别上下文中的独立词语激活，无法从这些例子确定共同触发条件
patterns.domain: 新闻评论、娱乐新闻、议会文本、论坛及网页

patterns.name: 数字与标点激活
patterns.context: 数字、百分号、连字符或句号附近出现低强度激活，缺少跨段稳定规律

en.description: The strongest reproducible pattern is “more” modifying degree or manner in research contexts, often followed by an adverb or adjective; the remaining activations are scattered across name, terminology, and citation fragments in philosophy, medicine, law, and physics texts, without a shared context.

patterns.name: Degree/manner supplement introduced by “more”
patterns.context: Often appears after to, meaning to a greater degree or more effectively; also appears in “more extensive.”
patterns.domain: Research papers, medical/biological studies, and project descriptions

patterns.name: Word fragment in a philosophical citation
patterns.context: Embedded in book titles, philosophers’ names, and editor citations, with no evident shared syntactic condition.
patterns.domain: Academic philosophy texts and bibliographic citations

patterns.name: Fragment in an author name
patterns.context: Appears in an author byline after an algorithm discussion in a paper.

patterns.name: Fragment in a medical term/name
patterns.context: Appears in a person’s name or a subtype name after a statistical analysis description.

patterns.name: Name and place fragments in legal citations
patterns.context: Appears in dates, lawyers’ names, and location information in bankruptcy court rulings.

patterns.name: Name fragment in a physics literature citation
patterns.context: Appears in a literature citation in a quantum magnetism research paper.

4_49.description: 最强且可复现的模式是科研语境中“more”修饰程度或方式，常接副词或形容词；其余激活分散在哲学、医学、法律和物理文本的人名、术语及引文词片中，缺乏共同语境。

patterns.name: “more”引出的程度/方式补充
patterns.context: 常出现在 to 后，表示以更高程度或更有效的方式；也出现于“more extensive”中
patterns.domain: 科研论文、医学/生物学研究及项目说明

patterns.name: 哲学引文中的词片
patterns.context: 嵌在专著标题、哲学家姓名及编者引文中，没有明显共同句法条件
patterns.domain: 哲学学术文本及书目引文

patterns.name: 作者姓名中的词片
patterns.context: 出现在论文算法讨论后的作者署名行

patterns.name: 医学术语/名称中的词片
patterns.context: 出现在统计分析描述后的人名或分型名称中

patterns.name: 法律引文中的姓名与地名词片
patterns.context: 出现在破产法院判决的日期、律师姓名及地点信息中

patterns.name: 物理文献引文中的姓名词片
patterns.context: 出现在量子磁性研究论文的文献引用中

en.description: Activations occur on in-word subword fragments, words within common words and phrases, “Imitation” in two work titles, and a line break after a forum quote; these patterns span domains and have no unified semantic explanation.

patterns.name: In-word subword fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on subwords or fragments within words, often in proper names, technical terms, citation identifiers, and segmented words; the fragments themselves have no obvious unified meaning.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain text: philosophy, forums, mathematics papers, music reviews, biomedicine, culinary history, etc.

patterns.name: Common words in phrases
patterns.context: The marked token is a word in a common word or phrase, especially in collocations and sentence-pattern fragments; the examples lack stable specific semantic or syntactic conditions.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain prose, forum dialogue, and academic writing

patterns.name: Title The Imitation Game
patterns.context: Appears in a work title; the two examples are an album title and a film title.

patterns.name: Marked line break
patterns.context: Activation is marked at a line break after a forum quote separator, following “------”.

4_49.description: 激活分布在词内子词片段、普通词和短语中的词，以及两个作品标题里的“Imitation”和论坛引用后的换行；这些模式跨领域，未见统一语义解释。

patterns.name: 词内子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在词内部的子词或片段上，常见于专名、术语、引文标识符及被切分的词；片段本身没有明显统一语义。
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本：哲学、论坛、数学论文、音乐评论、生物医学、餐饮史等

patterns.name: 短语中的常见词
patterns.context: 标记落在普通词或短语中的词上，尤其是搭配与句式片段；各例之间缺少稳定的特定语义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: 跨领域散文、论坛对话及学术写作

patterns.name: 《模仿游戏》标题
patterns.trigger: «Imitation»（“Imitation of Life”与“The Imitation Game”中的词）
patterns.context: 出现在作品标题中；两例分别是专辑名和电影名。

patterns.name: 标记换行符
patterns.context: 激活标在论坛引用分隔线后的换行处，出现在“------”之后。

en.description: Activations concentrate on local in-word fragments, often in long words, proper names, and segmented words; they occur across interdisciplinary texts, with no stable topic or semantic category.

patterns.name: Specific subword fragments within English words
patterns.context: Activation falls on token fragments within words; word forms and positions are not fixed, and fragments occur across technical terms, names, and common words.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain text, including papers, parliamentary records, email, patents, medical literature, literary texts, and legal texts.

patterns.name: Fragments in names or proper nouns
patterns.context: Appears in author, person, or company names, or case names, often adjacent to punctuation and citation formatting.
patterns.domain: Academic citations, contact lists, literary catalogs, legal cases.

patterns.name: Word fragments near line breaks or text boundaries
patterns.context: Words are split or marked, or affected by line breaks and citation punctuation; the activated fragments do not necessarily correspond to complete words.
patterns.domain: Patent, medical abstract, list, and citation-formatted texts.

patterns.name: Fragments in German word forms
patterns.context: Fragments are embedded in German words, surrounded by German grammar and parliamentary discussion context.

4_49.description: 激活集中于词内局部片段，常见于长词、专名及被切分的词；跨学科文本均出现，未见稳定的主题或语义类别。

patterns.name: 英文词内部的特定子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在词内部的 token 片段；词形和位置并不固定，片段可跨专业术语、姓名及普通词出现。
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本，包括论文、议会记录、邮件、专利、医学文献、文学和法律文本。

patterns.name: 姓名或专名中的片段
patterns.context: 出现在作者、人物、公司或判例名称中，常与标点及引文格式相邻。
patterns.domain: 学术引文、联系人名单、文学目录、法律判例。

patterns.name: 断行或文本边界附近的词片段
patterns.context: 词被拆分、标记或受换行和引文标点影响；激活片段未必对应完整词。
patterns.domain: 专利、医学摘要、名单及引文排版文本。

patterns.name: 德语词形中的片段
patterns.context: 片段嵌在德语词中，周围有德语语法和议会讨论语境。

en.description: Activations mostly fall on subword fragments of cross-lingual proper names, German words, and English words, but the fragments vary widely in meaning and position. Sporadic activations also occur on line breaks and common words, with no stable shared condition observed.

patterns.name: Letter fragments in proper names
patterns.context: Trigger fragments are embedded within proper names, especially Chebyshev (including variant tokenizations); some activations fall on different subword fragments of the name.

patterns.name: Fragments within German words
patterns.context: Fragments occur inside continuous German words or near affix boundaries; they do not have a fixed meaning in isolation, and activation positions are scattered.

patterns.name: Fragments within English words
patterns.context: English personal names or common words are split into subwords, and the fragments themselves have no clear shared semantics.
patterns.domain: Patent backgrounds, papers, medical literature, and forum posts

patterns.name: Fragments in other names or labels
patterns.context: Occur near people’s names, album layout labels, or usernames/URLs; there is no stable lexical or syntactic condition.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia music production credits, HackerNews posts, and links

patterns.name: Sporadic subwords in technical terms
patterns.context: Occur in technical texts such as quantum experiments or microscopy; activations are distributed across common words, abbreviations, and place names, with no unified semantics.
patterns.domain: Physics and biomedical papers (ArXiv, PubMed Central)

patterns.name: Unexplained sporadic subword activations
patterns.context: Occur in acknowledgments, paper body text, or title separators; context does not suggest a stable connection to other patterns.

4_49.description: 激活多落在跨语言专名、德语词及英文词的子词片段上，但片段语义与位置差异大；另有换行及普通词的零散激活，未见稳定共同条件。

patterns.name: 专名中的字母片段
patterns.context: 触发片段嵌在专名内部，尤其是 Chebyshev（及变体分词拼写）中；部分激活落在名字的不同子词片段上。

patterns.name: 德语词内片段
patterns.context: 片段出现在连续德语词的内部或词缀边界附近；单独看并非固定词义，且激活位置分散。

patterns.name: 英文词内片段
patterns.context: 英文人名或普通词被切分成子词，片段本身没有明显共同语义。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、论文、医学文献与论坛帖子

patterns.name: 其他名称或标签中的片段
patterns.context: 在人员姓名、专辑版面标签或用户名/网址附近出现；缺少稳定的词义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 音乐制作名单、HackerNews 帖子及链接

patterns.name: 技术词语中的零散子词
patterns.context: 出现在量子实验或显微成像等技术文本中；激活分布于普通词、缩写和地名，未见统一语义。
patterns.domain: 物理与生物医学论文（ArXiv、PubMed Central）

patterns.name: 未解释的零散子词激活
patterns.context: 出现在致谢、论文正文或标题分隔处，无法从上下文推断与其他模式有稳定联系。

en.concept: Responses to specific within-word subword fragments
en.description: Most activations fall on within-word fragments of Weibull, involving surnames or distribution terms; the rest are scattered across internal, initial, or boundary fragments of different words, with no consistent semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Within-word fragments of Weibull
patterns.context: Activations fall on letter fragments of the proper name or term Weibull; the word is split by tokenization, and fragment positions vary.
patterns.domain: Personal surnames, probability distributions, and failure distributions; encyclopedias, academic papers, and medical abstracts

patterns.name: Other within-word fragments
patterns.context: Activations occur on internal subword fragments of common words, personal names, place names, or compounds, with no stable lexical meaning or positional condition.
patterns.domain: Folk musician profiles, banking news, railway encyclopedias, album credits, parliamentary speeches, medical papers

patterns.name: Possible word-initial or boundary fragments
patterns.context: Marked fragments occur in incomplete text or text that may cross word boundaries; the fragments alone do not establish a shared trigger condition.
patterns.domain: Forum discussions and other general text

4_49.concept: 对特定词内子词片段的反应
4_49.description: 多数段在 Weibull 的词内片段上激活，涉及姓氏或分布术语；其余激活散落于不同词的内部、词首或边界片段，未显示一致语义模式。

patterns.name: Weibull 词内片段
patterns.trigger: «We»«ib»«ull»（跨段呈现为 «We»、«ib»、«ull» 等被标记的词内片段）
patterns.context: 激活落在专名或术语 Weibull 的字母片段上；词被分词拆开，片段位置不固定。
patterns.domain: 人物姓氏、概率分布与失效分布等；百科、学术论文及医学摘要

patterns.name: 其他词内片段
patterns.trigger: «Houghton»中的 «H»«a»«vers»；«Sheop»中的 «op»；«Gemünd»中的 «ünd»；«Henszel»中的 «ens»；以及 «Fr»«ab»、«K»、«Gill»«mor»、«Wack»、«H»«ens»«el»、«T»«ages» 等
patterns.context: 激活出现在普通词、人名、地名或复合词的内部子词片段中，未见稳定的词义或位置条件。
patterns.domain: 民谣人物介绍、银行新闻、铁路百科、专辑署名、议会发言、医学论文

patterns.name: 疑似词首或边界片段
patterns.context: 标记片段分别出现在不完整或可能跨词边界的文本中；仅凭片段无法确定共同触发条件。
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论及其他一般文本

en.description: High activations fall on within-word fragments in several languages: biomedical hemostasis, Dutch toekomst, German weiterhin, and English co- compounds; two proper-name fragments also appear. The trigger conditions are not uniform.

patterns.name: English hemostasis ending
patterns.context: In NIH biomedical text, activation falls on the within-word fragment «most» in hemostasis; the context concerns normal hemostasis, thrombosis, or coagulation mechanisms.

patterns.name: Within-word fragment in Dutch toekomst
patterns.context: In Dutch parliamentary text, activation falls on the within-word fragment «ek» in toekomst (future), near expressions such as plannen and vooruitzichten that discuss future plans or prospects.

patterns.name: Within-word fragment in German weiterhin
patterns.context: In German parliamentary speeches, activation falls on the middle segment «iter» of weiterhin; here it means that a topic remains on the agenda.

patterns.name: Hyphen in English co- compounds
patterns.context: The hyphen occurs in English co- compounds; one example concerns a film co-director, and another concerns co-evolutionary optimization.
patterns.domain: Online reviews and computational materials science papers

patterns.name: Fragment «ens» in a proper name
patterns.context: Activation falls within the surname of photographer Scott Hensel; no ordinary-word trigger condition can be confirmed.

patterns.name: Fragment «bys» in a proper name
patterns.context: Activation falls within the surname of mathematician Chebyshev; no ordinary-word trigger condition can be confirmed.

4_49.description: 高激活落在若干不同语言的词内片段：生物医学 hemostasis、荷兰语 toekomst、德语 weiterhin，以及英文 co-复合词；另见两个专名片段。触发条件不统一。

patterns.name: 英语 hemostasis 词尾
patterns.context: 在 NIH 生物医学文本中，激活落在 hemostasis 的词内片段 «most»；语境涉及正常止血、血栓或凝血机制。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文与资助申请

patterns.name: 荷兰语 toekomst 词内片段
patterns.context: 在荷兰语议会文本中，激活落在 toekomst（未来）的词内片段 «ek»，与 plannen、vooruitzichten 等谈论未来计划或展望的表达相邻。

patterns.name: 德语 weiterhin 词内片段
patterns.context: 在德语议会发言中，激活落在 weiterhin 的中段 «iter»；此处表示某主题仍在议程上。

patterns.name: 英文 co- 复合词连字符
patterns.context: 连字符位于英文 co- 复合词中；一例是电影共同导演，另一例是共进化优化。
patterns.domain: 网络评论与计算材料科学论文

patterns.name: 专名中的片段 «ens»
patterns.context: 激活落在摄影师姓名 Scott Hensel 的姓氏中；缺少可确认的普通词义触发条件。

patterns.name: 专名中的片段 «bys»
patterns.context: 激活落在数学家 Chebyshev 的姓氏中；缺少可确认的普通词义触发条件。

en.concept: Within-word fragments with no shared semantics
en.description: Activations are scattered across internal fragments of various English words: pt, or, gem, ens, en, etc. They occur in medical terms, personal names, statistical methods, social science terms, and colloquial words, with no consistent semantic or domain condition.

patterns.name: English subword fragment hept
patterns.context: Embedded in the medical term heptamer, describing apoptosome structure.

patterns.name: Instrument word ending or
patterns.context: Occurs in spindle whorls, describing handcrafted objects.

patterns.name: Liver-related word fragment pt
patterns.context: Embedded in hepatocytes, in a context discussing alcohol, liver iron storage, and oxidative environments.

patterns.name: Word-stem fragment in hegemony
patterns.context: Occurs in a discussion of social order and the power of industrial leaders.

patterns.name: Variant of hegemony
patterns.context: Occurs in a discussion of masculinity and its cultural dominance.

patterns.name: Statistical term fragment ens
patterns.context: Occurs in the Mantel-Haenszel test or method name; used in survival analysis or meta-analysis.

patterns.name: Name fragment in a legal citation
patterns.context: Embedded in the case-citation name Hensley, near references to courts and case-citation formats.

patterns.name: or in an interjection
patterns.context: Embedded in the colloquial exclamation hooray, in social-media-style text.

patterns.name: Taxonomic name fragment en
patterns.context: Embedded in the name of the author Guénée in a moth taxonomy entry.

4_49.concept: 无共同语义的词内片段
4_49.description: 激活分散在多种英语词的内部片段：pt、or、gem、ens、en等；分别见医学术语、人名、统计方法、社会科学词及口语词，未显示一致语义或领域条件。

patterns.name: 英语子词片段 hept
patterns.context: 嵌在医学术语 heptamer 中，描述凋亡小体结构。

patterns.name: 器物词尾 or
patterns.context: 出现在描述手工制作物品的 spindle whorls 中。

patterns.name: 肝脏相关词片段 pt
patterns.context: 嵌在 hepatocytes 中，周围讨论酒精、肝脏铁储存及氧化环境。

patterns.name: hegemony 词干片段
patterns.context: 出现在社会秩序与工业领袖权力的讨论中。

patterns.name: hegemony 变体
patterns.context: 出现在关于男性气质及其文化主导作用的讨论中。
patterns.domain: 社会科学／心理健康论文

patterns.name: 统计术语片段 ens
patterns.context: 出现在 Mantel-Haenszel 检验或方法名称中；用于生存分析或荟萃分析。

patterns.name: 法律引文中的人名片段
patterns.context: 嵌在判例引用的人名 Hensley 中，附近还有法院与判例引文格式。

patterns.name: 感叹语中的 or
patterns.context: 嵌在口语化感叹词 hooray 中，出现在社交媒体式文字。

patterns.name: 分类学名称片段 en
patterns.context: 嵌在蛾类分类条目中的命名者姓名 Guénée。

en.description: Activations mainly fall on short within-word letter fragments (ens, gem, or), and also on hyphens in different formats and a colon in an email field; contexts span legal, medical, social, code, font-description, and email text, with no unified semantic theme.

patterns.name: Within-word “ens” fragment
patterns.context: The letter sequence ens occurs within a proper name or statistical method name, often adjacent to capital H; the marked fragment may occur after a word-initial segment or word-medially.
patterns.domain: Legal citations, personal names, and medical statistical terms

patterns.name: Within-word “gem” fragment
patterns.context: In the forms hegemony / hegemonic, activation falls on the internal letter sequence gem; preceding text often concerns social dominance or gender norms.

patterns.name: Hyphen in a URL
patterns.context: The hyphen occurs in a URL domain, connecting parts of the domain name.

patterns.name: Hyphen in a font name
patterns.context: The hyphen connects two parts of a font descriptor.

patterns.name: Hyphen in a name
patterns.context: The hyphen connects the two parts of a compound surname.
patterns.domain: Proper names related to font design

patterns.name: “or” within an interjection
patterns.context: Activation occurs inside the colloquial exclamation hooray; the context discusses expressing excitement about something.

patterns.name: Punctuation in an email address field
patterns.context: The colon follows an email header field label; the marker occurs in a recipient-field format.

4_49.description: 激活主要落在词内短字母片段（ens、gem、or），也见于不同格式中的连字符和邮件栏冒号；上下文跨法律、医学、社会话题、代码、字体说明与邮件，未呈现统一语义主题。

patterns.name: 词内“ens”片段
patterns.context: 字母序列 ens 出现在专有名词或统计方法名称内部，常邻接大写 H；标注的片段可处于词首后或词中。
patterns.domain: 法律引文、人名及医学统计术语

patterns.name: 词内“gem”片段
patterns.context: 词形 hegemony / hegemonic 中，激活位于词内 gem 字母序列；前文常涉及社会主导地位或性别规范。

patterns.name: 网址连字符
patterns.context: 连字符位于网址域名中，连接域名的组成部分。

patterns.name: 字体名称中的连字符
patterns.context: 连字符连接字体描述词的两部分。

patterns.name: 名字中的连字符
patterns.context: 连字符连接复合姓氏的两部分。

patterns.name: 感叹词内的“or”
patterns.context: 激活出现在口语感叹词 hooray 内部；上下文讨论对某事的兴奋表达。

patterns.name: 邮件地址栏标点
patterns.context: 冒号用于邮件头字段标签之后；标记出现在收件人栏格式中。

en.description: Several activations fall within terms related to hept-/hepat- and within bremsstrahlung; the rest are widely scattered across within-word fragments in multiple languages and proper names, making it difficult to infer a unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Specific subword fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall within biomedical or astronomical terms containing these letter fragments: hepatocytes, heptamer, heptavalent, heliocentric; however, in [2] only some spellings overlap

patterns.name: Bremsstrahlung term
patterns.context: Occurs within the word bremsstrahlung, discussing it as a radiation contribution or a mechanism for X-ray emission from galaxy clusters

patterns.name: Specific within-word fragments
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across English, German, Bulgarian, and proper names, often falling on short letter fragments within words; the fragments themselves show no apparent unified semantics across these contexts
patterns.domain: Multilingual parliamentary, encyclopedic, popular-science, and academic texts

4_49.description: 若干激活落在hept-/hepat-相关术语及bremsstrahlung内部；其余广泛分散于多语种词内片段和专名，难以归纳为统一语义模式。

patterns.name: 特定子词片段
patterns.trigger: «hept»（[1] 的 «pt»、[3] 的 «pt»、[6] 的 «pt»）；«helio»相关片段 «li»«oc»（[2]）
patterns.context: 激活落在包含这些字母片段的生物医学或天文学术语内部：hepatocytes、heptamer、heptavalent、heliocentric；但在 [2] 中只有部分拼写重合

patterns.name: 轫致辐射术语
patterns.context: 出现在 bremsstrahlung 一词内部，讨论其作为辐射贡献或星系团 X 射线发射机制

patterns.name: 特定词内片段
patterns.context: 激活分散在英语、德语、保加利亚语及专名中，常落在词内的短字母片段；片段本身在这些上下文间没有显见统一语义
patterns.domain: 多语种议会文本、百科、科普及学术文本

en.concept: Within-word fragment recognition, primarily biased toward hemostasis
en.description: Activations mainly occur on the within-word fragment most in hemostasis/hemostatic terms related to hemostasis; other activations occur on Hoosiers, German within-word fragments, astrophysical heli- terms, and different fragments in hooray, with no clear semantic link between these secondary patterns and the primary one.

patterns.name: hemostasis stem
patterns.context: The trigger fragment is embedded in hemostasis or hemostatic; it refers to blood coagulation, hemostasis, or related pathology.
patterns.domain: Biomedical science, hematology, and thrombosis research

patterns.name: Within-word fragment in Hoosiers
patterns.context: Occurs in the film title Hoosiers, with nearby mentions of Indiana, Tennessee, and the film’s stars.

patterns.name: German within-word fragments
patterns.context: These markers occur separately inside German words or phrases such as Ausschuss, Antwort, begrüße, weiterhin, and der Tagesordnung; there is no apparent biomedical semantics.

patterns.name: Astrophysical heli- word family
patterns.context: The trigger fragment occurs in astronomical terms beginning with heli-, in contexts discussing heliocentric configurations, the solar convection zone, or helioseismology.

patterns.name: Within-word fragment in hooray
patterns.context: Occurs in the colloquial exclamation hooray, in a context mentioning cheat day.

4_49.concept: 词内片段识别，主偏 hemostasis
4_49.description: 主要在止血相关 hemostasis/hemostatic 的词内片段 most 上激活；另对 Hoosiers、德语词内片段、天体物理 heli- 术语及 hooray 中的不同片段激活，未见这些次要模式与主模式有明确语义联系。

patterns.name: hemostasis 词干
patterns.context: 触发片段嵌在 hemostasis 或 hemostatic 中；指血液凝固、止血过程或相关病理。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、血液学与血栓研究

patterns.name: Hoosiers 词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在电影名 Hoosiers 中，周围提及印第安纳州、田纳西州及电影主演。

patterns.name: 德语词内片段
patterns.context: 这些标记分别落在德语词或词组内部，如 Ausschuss、Antwort、begrüße、weiterhin、der Tagesordnung；没有明显生物医学语义。

patterns.name: 天体物理 heli- 词族
patterns.context: 触发片段位于以 heli- 开头的天文学术语中，语境谈及日心构型、太阳对流区或日震学。

patterns.name: hooray 词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在口语感叹词 hooray 中，语境提及 cheat day。
patterns.domain: 网络帖子或非正式文本

en.concept: Specific within-word fragments and formatting markers
en.description: Activations mainly fall on «ur» in forms of heuristics and «most» in the hemostasis word family; sporadic triggers also occur on German within-word fragments, hyphens, URL/citation markers, proper names, and JSON punctuation, with no unified semantic condition observed.

patterns.name: Forms of heuristics
patterns.context: Activation falls within heuristics; it can refer to a heuristic method or be part of a project or directory name.
patterns.domain: Computer science, algorithm papers, and code documentation

patterns.name: Forms of hemostasis
patterns.context: Activation falls within the hematological terms hemostatic/hemostasis, in contexts discussing hemostasis, coagulation, or related experiments and mechanisms.
patterns.domain: Biomedical science, hematology, and clinical imaging

patterns.name: German within-word fragments
patterns.context: All markers are embedded within German words and occur in formal parliamentary speeches; the words differ in meaning and form.

patterns.name: Hyphen
patterns.context: Activation falls on a hyphen, which connects compound modifiers in one case and parts of a URL domain in another; the contexts differ.

patterns.name: Punctuation in a GitHub domain
patterns.context: The marker is a domain separator in a URL; the fragment also contains a project path and JSON text.

patterns.name: ref in a citation marker
patterns.context: Activation falls within a structured marker for a paper figure citation, rather than a body-text word.
patterns.domain: PubMed Central papers and figure-caption markup

patterns.name: Fragment within a proper name
patterns.context: The fragment occurs in the album title “Uptown”; no semantic or structural condition shared with other patterns is apparent.

patterns.name: Formatting character in a table/record
patterns.context: Activation falls on the left brace at the beginning of a JSON-style record; the fragment is short, so a more specific trigger condition cannot be determined.

4_49.concept: 特定词内片段与格式标记
4_49.description: 激活主要落在 heuristics 词形的 «ur» 和 hemostasis 词族的 «most»；另有德语词内片段、连字符、URL/引用标记及专名、JSON 标点等零散触发，未见统一语义条件。

patterns.name: heuristics 词形
patterns.context: 激活落在 heuristics 词内；可指启发式方法，也可作为项目或目录名称的一部分。
patterns.domain: 计算机科学、算法论文及代码说明

patterns.name: hemostasis 词形
patterns.context: 激活落在血液学术语 hemostatic/hemostasis 内，讨论止血、凝血或相关实验与机制。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、血液学和临床影像

patterns.name: 德语词内片段
patterns.context: 标记均嵌在德语词内部，出现在正式议会发言中；这些词义和词形并不相同。

patterns.name: 连字符
patterns.context: 激活落在连字符上，分别连接复合修饰语和网址域名中的词段；出现环境不同。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文与网页/代码数据

patterns.name: GitHub 域名标点
patterns.context: 标记的是 URL 中域名分隔符，片段同时含项目路径和 JSON 文本。
patterns.domain: 代码托管链接、软件说明

patterns.name: 引用标记中的 ref
patterns.context: 激活落在论文图像引用的结构化标记内，而非正文词汇。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 论文及图注标记

patterns.name: 专名内的片段
patterns.context: 片段出现在专辑名 “Uptown” 内，未见与其他模式相同的语义或结构条件。
patterns.domain: 音乐唱片目录、百科条目

patterns.name: 表格/记录中的格式字符

en.description: Markers are scattered across the string man in multiple languages, English function words, code identifiers, and numbers and punctuation; French word forms, place names, and isolated webpage words also occur. There is no single stable semantic pattern.

patterns.name: man string and its word forms
patterns.context: The character sequence man is marked; in paragraphs 5 and 7 it occurs within Italian words, in paragraph 8 at the beginning of maniera, and in paragraph 10 at the beginning of mano.

patterns.name: English noun phrases
patterns.context: English function words are marked in ordinary English sentences across paper abstracts, forum help posts, and code comments; the marked words do not always belong to the same category.
patterns.domain: Academic text, forum text, code comments

patterns.name: Code identifiers and API names
patterns.context: Some tokens in camelCase class names, function names, or API identifiers are marked.

patterns.name: Numbers and punctuation in structured sequences or proper names
patterns.context: Numbers, slashes, commas, or separators are marked near formulas, version strings, or text boundaries.

patterns.name: Possible word-final fragments
patterns.context: Two adjacent line-initial words are marked, but there is not enough context to determine their semantics or shared lexical condition.

patterns.name: French word-form fragments
patterns.context: In continuous French prose, markers fall on split word-form fragments; no broader semantic trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: English proper names and place names
patterns.context: A place-name fragment is marked in an encyclopedia account of Sonoma, California, and its wine industry.

patterns.name: Fragments without a clear shared trigger
patterns.context: Multiple markers occur near the identifier FakeAutoscalingV2beta1, but the fragment does not reveal how it relates to other patterns.

4_238.description: 标记散落于跨语种的 man 字符串、英文功能词、代码标识符及数字标点；另见法语词形、地名和孤立网页词。没有单一稳定语义模式。

patterns.name: man 字符串及其词形
patterns.context: 字符序列 man 被标记；在第5、7段出现在意大利语单词内部，在第8段位于 maniera 的开头，在第10段位于 mano 的开头。
patterns.domain: 意大利语及其他多语种文本

patterns.name: 英文名词短语
patterns.context: 英文功能词在普通英文句子中被标记，分布于论文摘要、论坛求助帖和代码注释；标记并不总是出现在同一类词上。
patterns.domain: 学术文本、论坛文本、代码注释

patterns.name: 代码标识符与 API 名称
patterns.context: 驼峰命名的类名、函数名或 API 标识符中部分 token 被标记。

patterns.name: 结构化序列或专名中的数字/标点
patterns.context: 数字、斜线、逗号或分隔符处于公式、版本字符串或文本边界附近时出现标记。

patterns.name: 疑似词尾片段
patterns.context: 两个相邻行首词被标记，缺少足够上下文判断其语义或共同词法条件。

patterns.name: 法语词形片段
patterns.context: 法语连续散文中，标记落在被分词拆开的词形片段上；更广的语义触发条件不明显。

patterns.name: 英语专名与地名
patterns.context: 加州索诺玛及其葡萄酒产业的百科叙述中，地名片段被标记。

patterns.name: 未见清晰共同触发的片段
patterns.context: FakeAutoscalingV2beta1 标识符附近出现多个标记，但无法从片段确定其与其他模式的关系。

en.description: Responds to Python import statements and code identifiers, as well as Laravel authentication symbols, LaTeX coordinate notation, HTTP API names, and webpage links; no single surface trigger form explains all fragments.

patterns.name: Python import statements
patterns.context: Module import statements in Python source code; strong activations often fall on `import` or the imported symbol that follows.

patterns.name: PHP/Laravel authentication code
patterns.context: Laravel-style PHP namespaces, trait usage, and class declarations; activations involve authentication identifiers and controller declarations.

patterns.name: LaTeX mathematics and coordinate symbols
patterns.context: Variables, coordinates, or instrument labels enclosed in dollar signs within prose.

patterns.name: YouTube links
patterns.context: A YouTube video URL appears in a Markdown link; activations are distributed across the domain, path, and fragments of the video ID.

patterns.name: HTTP Action Context API
patterns.context: Documentation describes setting a context when submitting events to populate request and user information.

patterns.name: External blog link
patterns.context: A blog post link follows text about a suspended Firefox process.

4_238.concept: 代码与结构化文本标记
4_238.description: 响应 Python 导入语句及代码标识符，也响应 Laravel 认证符号、LaTeX 坐标记号、HTTP API 名称和网页链接；没有单一表面触发形式能解释全部片段。

patterns.name: Python 导入语句
patterns.trigger: `import`、`from ... import`，尤其是导入名或 `import` 后的内容，如 «import»10、« import»9、« import»6
patterns.context: Python 源码中出现模块导入语句；强激活常落在 `import` 或其后的导入符号上。

patterns.name: PHP/Laravel 认证代码
patterns.context: Laravel 风格 PHP 命名空间、trait 使用和类声明；激活涉及认证标识符及控制器声明。

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学与坐标符号
patterns.context: 正文中夹有美元符号括起的变量、坐标或仪器标记。

patterns.name: YouTube 链接
patterns.context: Markdown 链接中出现 YouTube 视频网址；激活分布在网址的域名、路径及视频 ID 字符片段上。

patterns.name: HTTP Action Context API
patterns.context: 文档描述提交事件时设置上下文，以填充请求和用户信息。

patterns.name: 外部博客链接
patterns.context: 关于挂起的 Firefox 进程的文字后附博客文章链接。

en.description: Activations are distributed across code identifiers, place names, sports proper names, cooking terms, and URL fragments. Most are local matches to specific strings or proper names, with no shared semantics or stable stylistic condition.

patterns.name: Controller in code

patterns.name: Proper name Louisiana

patterns.name: Sports team names and regional fragments

patterns.name: Cook word form
patterns.context: Occurs in cooking-show or chef-title contexts, followed by «ing» or «Canon»

patterns.name: System-call name fragments in test code

4_238.description: 激活分散于代码标识符、地名、体育专名、烹饪词及 URL 片段；多为特定词串或专名的局部匹配，未见统一语义或稳定文体条件。

patterns.name: 网址字符与域名片段

en.description: Activations occur in heterogeneous text about refund permissions, legal proceedings, novels, private emails, code, mathematics papers, medical disclaimers, and user complaints. Common markers include pronouns, articles, and relative clauses; local semantics involving requesting or providing things and procedural remedies also appear. There is no sufficiently consistent single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Function words and personal pronouns
patterns.context: Common function words appear in sentences or clauses; these words are marked in multiple passages, but neighboring words and syntactic positions vary

patterns.name: Relative clauses and reference
patterns.context: Refers to a person or thing mentioned earlier, or links events through relative or conditional clauses

patterns.name: Obtaining, providing, or requesting something
patterns.context: Describes asking for, obtaining, providing, or applying for an item, assistance, refund, or legal remedy; the specific trigger words vary across examples
patterns.domain: E-book license text, novels, legal documents, online discussions

patterns.name: Rights and procedures in legal or license text
patterns.context: Involves refund conditions, court applications, injunctions, or procedural rights; common function words such as “the” and “her” are also marked

patterns.name: Technical names and code structure
patterns.context: An example URL is followed by ASP.NET route attributes and a controller class definition; activations fall on code markers and identifier fragments

patterns.name: Mathematical expressions and the Dirichlet problem
patterns.context: A weak-form or test-function formula is followed by the introduction of a harmonic-function boundary-value problem; marked words include “C,” “Dirichlet,” “problem,” and “functions”

patterns.name: Family visits and personal relationships
patterns.context: An email discusses spending time with the recipient, visiting parents, and family news

patterns.name: Medical disclaimer and seeking professional advice
patterns.context: A website states that its information is not intended for diagnosis or treatment and recommends consulting a doctor; markers concentrate on words such as “information” and “advice”

patterns.name: Magical objects in a narrative
patterns.context: In a fantasy plot, a character hands over a magic spell or an old wand; “her” and narrative connectives also activate

patterns.name: Warranty service and credit-card documents
patterns.context: A user recounts contacting Google without getting help and therefore being unable to obtain the documents needed to replace a phone

4_238.description: 激活分布在退款许可、法律程序、小说、私人邮件、代码、数学论文、医疗免责声明及用户投诉等异质文本中。常见标记包括代词、冠词和关系从句，也出现请求或提供物品、程序救济等局部语义；没有足够一致的单一语义模式。

patterns.name: 虚词与人称代词
patterns.context: 句子或从句中出现常见功能词；多段中这些词被标记，但邻近词和句法位置不一致

patterns.name: 关系从句与指代

patterns.context: 指代前文的人或事物，或通过关系从句、条件从句连接事件

patterns.context: 描述索取、获得、提供或申请某项物品、帮助、退款或法律救济；各例中的具体触发词并不一致
patterns.domain: 电子书许可文本、小说、法律文书、网络讨论

patterns.name: 法律或许可文本中的权利与程序
patterns.trigger: “the person you got it from”“plaintiff”“application”“temporary injunction”“status quo”
patterns.context: 涉及退款条件、法院申请、禁令或程序性权利；常见“the”“her”等功能词也被标记

patterns.name: 技术名称及代码结构
patterns.context: 示例 URL 后给出 ASP.NET 路由属性和控制器类定义；激活落在代码标记和标识符片段上

patterns.name: 数学表达与 Dirichlet 问题
patterns.context: 弱形式或测试函数公式后引入调和函数边值问题；标记词包含“C”“Dirichlet”“problem”“functions”

patterns.name: 家庭探访与个人关系
patterns.trigger: “spend some leisurely days with you”“Mum and Dad’s”“her yacht”
patterns.context: 邮件中谈及与收件人共度时光、拜访父母及家人的近况

patterns.name: 医疗免责声明与寻求专业意见
patterns.trigger: “provided for educational purposes only”“Always seek the advice of your physician”
patterns.context: 网站声明信息不用于诊断或治疗，并建议咨询医生；标记集中在“information”“advice”等词

patterns.name: 叙事中的魔法物品
patterns.context: 奇幻故事情节中角色交付魔法咒语或旧魔杖；“her”及叙事连接词也有激活

patterns.name: 保修服务与信用卡文件
patterns.trigger: “credit card’s warranty service extension program”“documents I needed”
patterns.context: 用户叙述联系 Google 未获帮助，因而无法取得更换手机所需文件

en.description: Strong activation appears in Controller, routes, and function parentheses in Web code, as well as the internal m in the Dutch word “sommige”; isolated words and phrases such as it, probable cause, and effect also trigger activation across programming, dialogue, legal, and patent contexts.

patterns.name: Controller class names and routes
patterns.context: In Web framework code such as C# and Java, class names end in Controller or route attributes contain the controller placeholder; often near class declarations.
patterns.domain: Web development code and programming Q&A

patterns.name: Method-call parentheses
patterns.context: An empty parameter list follows a function or method name, especially in function declarations; general method calls or definitions also occur.

patterns.name: Miscellaneous code structures and punctuation
patterns.context: Near braces, semicolons, or angle brackets in code snippets; these local triggers show no shared condition more specific than code context.

patterns.name: Internal fragment in a Dutch word
patterns.context: In continuous Dutch text, the subword fragment m occurs inside “sommige” (some); the word appears in both passages, but the surrounding topics differ.

patterns.name: Local context for English it
patterns.context: In English dialogue, the pronoun it occurs between got and right, expressing a colloquial confirmation of “whether I understand correctly.”

patterns.name: Legal term cause
patterns.context: Paired with probable in legal discussion to form probable cause; the passages also discuss searches and evidence.

patterns.name: Repeated occurrence of effect
patterns.context: Patent background text discusses whether a light fixture can produce an effect similar to fireworks; the same word occurs twice in adjacent contexts.

4_238.description: 强激活见于 Web 代码中的 Controller、路由与函数括号，也见于荷兰语“sommige”的词内 m；另有 it、probable cause、effect 等孤立词句触发，覆盖多种编程、对话、法律和专利语境。

patterns.name: Controller 类名与路由
patterns.context: C#、Java 等 Web 框架代码中，类名以 Controller 结尾，或路由属性包含 controller 占位符；常出现在类声明附近。
patterns.domain: Web 开发代码与编程问答

patterns.name: 方法调用括号
patterns.context: 函数或方法名之后紧接空参数括号，尤其处于函数声明处；片段中也有一般方法调用或定义。
patterns.domain: 源代码注释与函数定义

patterns.name: 若干代码结构与标点
patterns.context: 代码片段中的花括号、分号或尖括号附近；这些局部触发未显示出比代码语境更具体的共同条件。

patterns.name: 荷兰语词内片段
patterns.context: 荷兰语连续文本中，子词片段 m 出现在“sommige”（一些）的词内；虽两段都出现该词，周围主题不同。

patterns.name: 英语 it 的局部上下文
patterns.context: 英语对话中代词 it 位于 got 与 right 之间，表达“我是否理解正确”的口语确认。

patterns.name: 法律术语 cause
patterns.context: 法律论述中与 probable 搭配，构成 probable cause；片段还讨论搜查与证据。

patterns.name: effect 的重复出现
patterns.context: 专利背景文本讨论灯具能否产生类似烟花的效果；同一词在相邻语境中两次出现。

en.concept: Understanding expressions and code method structures
en.description: Activation is most prominent in “get the idea” and similar expressions of understanding, and also appears in code method names, empty parameter lists, and braces. Other sporadic activations include pronouns, punctuation, place names, and code snippets, with no single unifying rule.

patterns.name: “get the idea” expression
patterns.context: In English narratives or discussions, the precedes idea, often expressing understanding, explanation, or an example; idea itself and neighboring words are marked.
patterns.domain: Forums, comments, and general English text

patterns.name: Pronouns such as it / this and syntactic elements
patterns.context: Pronouns, determiners, and ordinary syntactic elements are distributed across English sentences; some occur near phrases such as get and customer decisions, but not consistently.

patterns.name: PHP method definitions, parentheses, and braces
patterns.context: In class method declarations, the get method name and the immediately following empty parameter list, newline/indentation, or left brace are activated.

patterns.name: Java empty-object construction and methods
patterns.context: Java code constructing the EMPTY constant and the getEmpty() method; marking spans identifier fragments, parentheses, and braces.

patterns.name: Other code symbols and identifier fragments
patterns.context: Semicolons, newlines, object properties, types, and method-name fragments in code are marked; they do not fully overlap with the specific method patterns above.

patterns.name: Sporadic activation on word fragments and punctuation
patterns.context: Activation falls on place names, subword fragments within words, or parentheses, without sufficiently consistent semantic context.
patterns.domain: Template text, place-name lists, and forum text

patterns.name: right / got it in conversational contexts
patterns.context: In forum replies, it/right are activated next to each other when confirming whether something was understood correctly; semantically similar to “get the idea” but worded differently.

4_238.concept: 理解表达及代码方法结构
4_238.description: 激活最显著地出现在“get the idea”及相近的理解表达，也出现在代码方法名、空参数括号和花括号；另有代词、标点、地名与代码片段等零散激活，不能归为单一规则。

patterns.name: “get the idea”表达
patterns.context: 在英语叙述或讨论中，idea 前有 the，常表达理解、说明或举例；idea 本身及其前后词被标记。
patterns.domain: 论坛、评论和一般英语文本

patterns.name: it / this 等代词及句法成分
patterns.context: 代词、限定词和普通句法成分散布于英语句子中；部分与 get、客户决策等短语相邻，但并不总是如此。

patterns.name: PHP 方法定义及括号、花括号
patterns.context: 类方法声明中，get 方法名及紧随其后的空参数括号、换行/缩进或左花括号受到激活。

patterns.name: Java 空对象构造与方法
patterns.context: Java 代码中 EMPTY 常量的构造和 getEmpty() 方法；标记横跨标识符片段、括号和花括号。

patterns.name: 其他代码符号和标识符片段
patterns.context: 代码中分号、换行、对象属性、类型及方法名片段被标记；与上述特定方法模式不完全重合。

patterns.name: 单词片段及标点的零散激活
patterns.context: 激活落在地名、单词内部子词片段或括号等局部 token 上，没有足够一致的语义上下文。
patterns.domain: 模板文本、地名列表及论坛文本

patterns.name: 会话语境中的 right / got it
patterns.context: 论坛回复中，表达确认是否正确理解时，it/right 相邻受激活；与“get the idea”语义相近但措辞不同。

en.description: Activation covers several local patterns: bron/chi subwords in pulmonary terminology; the hn’s spelling fragment in Crohn’s; mathematical equation names and equation; C# empty parameter lists, keywords, and test markers; as well as s in Results markers and EE in sample code HEE.

patterns.name: Bronchial / pulmonary terminology
patterns.context: Trigger words occur in contexts involving lung-lobe anatomy, airways, pulmonary examinations, or ventilation; token boundaries may fall within subwords such as bron and chi.
patterns.domain: Medicine, pulmonary anatomy, and respiratory physiology

patterns.name: Crohn’s disease spelling fragment
patterns.context: In the name Crohn’s disease, activation concentrates on the cross-subword spelling fragment hn’s; the same passage may mention inflammatory disease or transcription-factor associations.

patterns.name: Periodic solutions and equation names
patterns.context: Occurs in discussion of equations such as Korteweg–de Vries, Sine-Gordon, and nonlinear Schrödinger, and their periodic or quasi-periodic solutions.

patterns.name: C# method-call parentheses
patterns.context: An empty parameter list immediately follows a method name; code may also contain a method body, return value, or thrown exception.

patterns.name: Test attributes and test class names
patterns.context: Occurs in Angular integration test class names and test fixture attributes.

patterns.name: Capital S in results headings
patterns.context: Occurs in section-like anchors or formatting markers following a paper’s Results heading; the marker itself contains several numbers.

patterns.name: Code keywords and structural symbols
patterns.context: Occurs in C# method definitions and method bodies; these markers also appear alongside the empty parameter list in segment 3.

patterns.name: Fragment in the name of a reporting institution
patterns.context: Occurs in a sample-code prefix, near PCR, BAL, and public-health institution information.

4_238.concept: 局部子词与代码标记触发
4_238.description: 激活覆盖多个局部模式：肺部术语中的 bron/chi 子词；Crohn’s 的 hn’s 拼写片段；数学方程名与 equation；C# 空参数列表、关键字及测试标记；另有 Results 标记中的 s 和样本号 HEE 中的 EE。

patterns.name: 支气管／肺部术语
patterns.context: 触发词出现在肺叶解剖、气道、肺部检查或通气等上下文；分词边界会落在 bron、chi 等子词上。
patterns.domain: 医学、肺部解剖与呼吸生理

patterns.name: Crohn’s disease 拼写片段
patterns.trigger: «hn»«s»，位于 Cro«hn»’«s» 或 Cro«hn»"«s» 中
patterns.context: Crohn’s disease 名称中，激活集中在 hn’s 的跨子词拼写片段；同段还出现炎症性疾病或转录因子关联语境。

patterns.name: 周期解及方程名称
patterns.context: 出现在 Korteweg–de Vries、Sine-Gordon、非线性 Schrödinger 等方程及其周期或准周期解的讨论中。

patterns.name: C# 方法调用括号
patterns.context: 方法名后紧接空参数列表括号；代码中还可见方法体、返回值或异常抛出。

patterns.name: 测试属性与测试类名
patterns.context: 出现在 Angular 集成测试类名和测试夹具属性中。

patterns.name: 结果标题中的大写 S
patterns.trigger: «s»，位于大写 Results 后的花括号标题标记中
patterns.context: 出现在论文 Results 标题后的类似章节锚点或格式标记里，标记本身含有多个数字。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文排版文本

patterns.name: 代码关键字与结构符号
patterns.context: 出现在 C# 方法定义及方法体中；这些标记也与段3的空参数列表共同出现。

patterns.name: 报告机构名称片段
patterns.context: 出现在样本编号前缀中，邻近 PCR、BAL 和公共卫生机构信息。

en.description: Primarily responds strongly to internal fragments of bronchi, Sobolev, and Chagas; also activates on Ecuadorian, Mugabe, the digit 1, and various sporadic words. Some triggers may depend on subword boundaries or incidental context.

patterns.name: bronchi segmentation fragment
patterns.context: Activation falls inside the segmented word bronchi; occurs in respiratory contexts involving bronchoalveolar lavage samples, RSV/bronchiolitis, bronchi, and bronchioles.
patterns.domain: Biomedical text, respiratory physiology, and patent background

patterns.name: Sobolev terminology fragment
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on Sobolev and the immediately following space(s), in mathematical formulas and definitions of function spaces.
patterns.domain: Mathematical papers, especially analysis and partial differential equations

patterns.name: Internal fragment in Chagas
patterns.context: Activation is an internal suffix fragment of the disease name Chagas, occurring in antigen detection or infection research contexts.

patterns.name: Internal fragment in a personal name
patterns.context: Occurs only in the name of former Zimbabwean leader Robert Mugabe; there is no evidence of a general response to the person or political context.

patterns.name: Internal fragment in Ecuadorian
patterns.context: Activation falls on the ending of the nationality adjective Ecuadorian, next to the name of a public-health institution.

patterns.name: Mathematical symbol fragment
patterns.context: Activation falls on the number 1 in a mathematical formula; its trigger differs from the other activated word fragments and may be due to symbol form or local formula context.

patterns.name: Isolated marker at the beginning
patterns.context: Occurs only at the beginning of a passage, marking the letter a and a period; visible context is insufficient to determine its meaning or a stable trigger condition.

patterns.name: Other sporadic fragments
patterns.context: Scattered across institution abbreviations, common function words, general narrative, and project descriptions; no consistent local word-form or contextual pattern is evident.

4_238.concept: 词片段与局部词形探测器
4_238.description: 主要对被拆分的 bronchi、Sobolev 和 Chagas 词内片段强响应；另在 Ecuadorian、Mugabe、数字1及多种零散词上激活，部分触发可能依赖词片段边界或偶然上下文。

patterns.name: bronchi 分词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分的 bronchi 词内部；出现于肺泡灌洗样本、RSV/细支气管炎、支气管和细支气管等呼吸道语境。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、呼吸生理学与专利背景

patterns.name: Sobolev 术语片段
patterns.context: 激活集中于 Sobolev 一词及其后紧邻的 space(s)，位于数学公式和函数空间定义中。
patterns.domain: 数学论文，偏分析与偏微分方程

patterns.name: Chagas 词内片段
patterns.context: 激活是疾病名称 Chagas 的词内后缀片段，出现在抗原检测或感染研究语境。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、寄生虫病研究

patterns.name: 人名词内片段
patterns.context: 仅在 Zimbabwe 前领导人 Robert Mugabe 的姓名中触发；没有证据表明对该人物或政治语境普遍响应。

patterns.name: Ecuadorian 词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在国籍形容词 Ecuadorian 的词尾，紧邻公共卫生机构名称。

patterns.name: 数学符号片段
patterns.trigger: «1»，出现在“floor”定义中的“√{1 + |x|²}”及积分表达式“1/p”中
patterns.context: 激活落在数学公式里的数字 1；触发条件和其他激活词片段不同，可能是符号形态或局部公式上下文。

patterns.name: 开头孤立标记
patterns.context: 只出现在片段开头，标记对象是字母 a 和句点；可见上下文不足以判断其语义或稳定触发条件。

patterns.name: 其他零散片段
patterns.trigger: «P»、«and»、«was»、«evaluated»、«patients»、«writer»、«in»、«are»、«the»、«goals» 等原文中带标记的片段
patterns.context: 分别散见于机构缩写、常用功能词、一般叙述及项目介绍；未显示一致的局部词形或上下文模式。

en.concept: Recognition of terminology and internal word fragments
en.description: Activation is mainly on internal fragments of terms in medicine and biology, especially disease names, anatomical terms, and enzyme names; sporadic patterns also include code punctuation/identifiers, function words in license text, and fragments of author names.

patterns.name: Word endings in disease or medical terminology
patterns.context: Activation falls on internal or ending fragments of medical terms, disease names, or anatomical terms; most words are split at subword boundaries.
patterns.domain: Medical and biomedical text, and disease names

patterns.name: Internal fragments of biomedical terminology
patterns.context: Occurs in biomolecules, enzyme names, or medical-device terms; activation concentrates on internal subword fragments rather than stable whole words.
patterns.domain: Biomedical text, experimental research, and medical technology text

patterns.name: Code punctuation and identifier fragments
patterns.context: Activation occurs near Java import statements, their newlines and semicolons, and class names.

patterns.name: Function words in e-book license text
patterns.context: Pronouns, demonstratives, and related words are marked in license terms describing refunds, time limits, and how to obtain text.

patterns.name: Internal fragments in names or proper nouns
patterns.context: A fragment at the end of a name in an author list is activated; a single instance does not establish a more specific condition.

4_238.description: 激活以医学、生物学术语中的词内片段为主，尤其疾病名、解剖词及酶名；另有代码标点/标识符、许可文本功能词和作者姓名片段等零散模式。

patterns.name: 疾病或医学术语中的词尾
patterns.context: 激活落在医学、疾病名称或解剖术语的词内/词尾片段；多数词在子词边界处被拆分。
patterns.domain: 医学、生物医学文本及疾病名称

patterns.name: 生物医学术语的内部片段
patterns.context: 出现在生物分子、酶名或医疗器械词中，激活集中于术语内部的子词片段，而非稳定的完整词。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、实验研究及医学技术文本

patterns.name: 代码标点与标识符片段
patterns.context: Java 导入语句及其换行、分号和类名附近出现激活。

patterns.name: 电子书许可文本中的功能词
patterns.context: 说明退款、期限及获取文本方式的许可条款中，代词、指示词和相关词语被标记。
patterns.domain: Gutenberg 电子书许可/法律说明

patterns.name: 姓名或专名内部片段
patterns.context: 作者名单中的人名末尾片段被激活；无法从单例判断更具体条件。

en.concept: Poincaré and varied local word fragments
en.description: Most passages mention Poincaré in mathematical papers; two other passages activate on the phrase there are, while the rest involve local fragments in Sharpe, Prussian blue, and federal trademarks, with no unified meaning.

patterns.name: Poincaré terminology
patterns.context: The name occurs in mathematical papers, especially near mathematical terms such as “-Hopf Theorem,” “disk model,” “exponent,” and “polynomial”

patterns.name: English there are construction
patterns.context: “There are ...” introduces a quantity or options in prose or documentation; activation falls on are

patterns.name: Sharpe name
patterns.context: In the title or introductory text for the person or work Sharpe’s Rifles

patterns.name: Prussian blue staining
patterns.context: Appears as a detection method in a description of cellular uptake experiments; activation concentrates on “ian”

patterns.name: Federal trademarks in a registered-trademark context
patterns.context: In a narrative describing a product or trademark registration history, activation falls on “federal”

4_238.description: 多数段落在数学论文中提及 Poincaré；另有两段激活于 there are 句式，其余分别落在 Sharpe、Prussian blue 的局部词片及 federal trademarks，缺少统一词义。

patterns.name: Poincaré 术语
patterns.context: 数学论文中出现该人名，尤其与“-Hopf Theorem”“disk model”“exponent”“polynomial”等数学术语相邻

patterns.name: 英文 there are 句式
patterns.context: 正文或文档中使用“there are ...”引出数量或选项；激活落在 are 上
patterns.domain: 网页说明文字、代码文档

patterns.name: Sharp(e) 名称
patterns.context: 人名或作品名 Sharpe’s Rifles 的标题、介绍文字中
patterns.domain: 百科条目／电视节目介绍

patterns.name: Prussian blue 染色
patterns.context: 细胞摄取实验描述中，作为检测方法出现；激活集中在“ian”

patterns.name: 注册商标语境中的联邦商标
patterns.context: 介绍产品或商标注册历史的叙述中，激活落在“federal”

en.description: Most passages mark the first item in a sequence, set, or dynasty after “first of.” Other examples include a first case and an initial difficult instance. Some activations fall on classification terms, proper nouns, and fragments of medical terminology, and are difficult to incorporate into the main pattern.

patterns.name: Ordinal first of followed by a set
patterns.context: “first of” indicates the first item in a series, set, or succession; often preceded by an article or determiner.

patterns.name: Ordinal in a classification template
patterns.context: An entry introduction uses a fixed template to specify an item’s position in a series of works, competitions, or products.

patterns.name: Person categories and entity names
patterns.context: Occurs near category lists, titles, or proper nouns at the end of biographical entries; aside from “of,” there is no clear shared first of construction.

patterns.name: Dynasties and rulers
patterns.context: Describes a ruler’s order within a dynasty; nearby text mentions dynastic succession and royal titles.

patterns.name: First case in a disease context
patterns.context: Describes the first confirmed case in a location; first modifies case rather than a series of works or objects.

patterns.name: Proper nouns or technical fragments in medical text
patterns.context: Activation falls on segmented fragments of proper nouns or technical terms, with no direct syntactic connection to the first of series expression.

patterns.name: First instance of a ship-design difficulty
patterns.context: first refers to the beginning of a series of similar difficulties; preceding text discusses ship gun design and displacement.

patterns.name: Other isolated fragments
patterns.context: Occurs only in local passages, with insufficient evidence that these form an independent, stable pattern.

4_238.description: 多数段落在“first of”后标记序列、集合或王朝中的首个；另有首例病例和首个困难实例。若干激活落在分类、专名及医学术语碎片上，难以并入主模式。

patterns.name: 序数 first of 后接集合
patterns.trigger: «first»、«of»及后续数量或集合，如“first of «10»”“first of «9»”
patterns.context: “first of”表示某系列、集合或一连串事物中的首个；周围常有冠词或限定词。

patterns.name: 分类模板中的序数词
patterns.context: 条目导语中以固定模板说明作品、赛事或产品在某个系列中的位置。

patterns.name: 人物分类与实体名称
patterns.trigger: «Earl»、«Earls»等头衔及其附近的分类标记
patterns.context: 出现在人物条目末尾的类别列表、头衔或专名附近；除“of”外没有明显共享的 first of 结构。

patterns.name: 王朝与统治者叙述
patterns.context: 描述统治者在某王朝中的先后地位，附近提及王朝更替和王室称号。

patterns.name: 疾病病例中的首例
patterns.context: 说明某地首次确认的病例，first 修饰病例而非系列作品或物件。

patterns.name: 医学文本中的专名或术语碎片
patterns.trigger: «No»、«Fall»附近的医学专名，以及«LT»、«C»附近的生化术语
patterns.context: 激活落在被切分的专名或技术词片段上，未见与 first of 系列表达直接相连的句法关系。

patterns.name: 船舶设计困难的首个实例
patterns.context: first 指一连串类似困难中的开端；前文谈船舶火炮设计与位移。

patterns.name: 其他孤立词片段
patterns.context: 只在局部文本中出现，缺乏足够证据表明它们构成独立稳定模式。

en.concept: Leukotriene-related word fragments with heterogeneous triggers
en.description: Primarily responds to fragments of proper names for leukotrienes and related inflammatory lipid mediators; also activates on rare proper-name spellings, mathematical symbols, Portuguese word forms, and timeline entries in several texts, with no clear shared semantics.

patterns.name: Leukotrienes and lipid mediators
patterns.context: Names of leukotrienes, arachidonic acid metabolites, or other lipid mediators, often appearing with inflammation, antagonism, measurement, or enumeration

patterns.name: Rare spelling fragments in proper nouns
patterns.context: Rare letter combinations in personal or place names; the specific semantic connection is unclear

patterns.name: Function words and surrounding mathematical symbols
patterns.context: Symbols, formulas, and adjacent connectives in mathematical or physics texts; no clear connection to the biomedical pattern

patterns.name: Portuguese word-form fragments
patterns.context: Internal substrings of words and common short words in Portuguese parliamentary text; trigger locations are scattered

patterns.name: English dates and occupation entries
patterns.context: Entries in historical timelines listing people, nationalities, occupations, and birth/death years in parentheses

4_238.concept: 白三烯相关词片段，兼有异质触发
4_238.description: 主要响应白三烯及相关炎症脂质介质的专名片段；另在若干文本中激活于罕见专名拼写、数学符号、葡萄牙语词形和年表条目，彼此缺少明确共同语义。

patterns.name: 白三烯及脂质介质
patterns.context: 白三烯、花生四烯酸代谢物或其他脂质介质的名称，常与炎症、拮抗作用、测量或列举并现

patterns.name: 专名中的稀有拼写片段
patterns.context: 人名或地名中包含罕见字母组合；具体语义联系不明
patterns.domain: 医学病例叙述、百科年表

patterns.name: 形式词及数学符号周边
patterns.context: 数学或物理文本中的符号、公式以及相邻连接词；未见与生物医学模式的明确联系

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语词形片段
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语议会文本中的词内子串及常见短词，触发位置分散

patterns.name: 英语日期与职业条目
patterns.context: 历史年表中人物、国籍、职业及括号内生卒年份的条目

en.concept: Scattered internal word fragments and terminology
en.description: Activation falls on internal fragments of various proper nouns or domain terms, and also appears in titles, identity terms, and code resource words. The Heisenberg model recurs across passages; other triggers are scattered and difficult to group under a single semantic or word-form rule.

patterns.name: Specific endings within names or entities
patterns.context: Activation falls on endings or subword fragments of proper nouns or their components, often in personal names, place names, ethnic names, or taxonomic names; many words are segmented into subwords in the corpus.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic, news, medical, and taxonomic text

patterns.name: Titles and identity terms
patterns.context: Occurs in descriptions of a person’s position or identity, such as “Lieutenant Governor” and “green card”; the trigger words themselves do not share a meaning.

patterns.name: Heisenberg model terminology
patterns.context: In mathematical physics contexts involving matrices, quantum many-body systems, or the Heisenberg model; related terminology recurs in two passages.

patterns.name: Bond proper noun
patterns.context: Occurs in the proper noun James Bond, appearing twice in the same passage, which discusses Q Branch, agents, and equipment.

patterns.name: Article, route, and editing code
patterns.context: Occurs in URL routes and Python/Django-style code, referring to article resources and their editing operations.

patterns.name: Julia linear algebra context
patterns.context: Julia REPL code involves LinearAlgebra, matrices, and the identity matrix; «Al» and «gebra» jointly segment Algebra.

patterns.name: Group noun in a title
patterns.context: Occurs in the title of a paper about teacher tobacco use in a region; no clear repeated cue is evident in the same passage.

4_238.concept: 分散的词内片段与术语
4_238.description: 激活落在多类专名或领域术语的词内片段上，也出现在职衔、身份词及代码资源词中。Heisenberg 模型跨段复现；其余触发分散，难以归为单一语义或词形规则。

patterns.name: 姓名或实体词内部的特定词尾
patterns.context: 激活落在专名或专名构成部分的词尾、子词片段上，常见于人名、地名、族名或分类学名称；其中不少词在语料里被拆成子词。
patterns.domain: 百科、新闻、医学及分类学文本

patterns.name: 职衔与身份词
patterns.context: 出现在人物职务或身份描述中，如“Lieutenant Governor”和“green card”；触发词本身语义并不相同。

patterns.name: Heisenberg 模型术语
patterns.context: 处于矩阵、量子多体系统或 Heisenberg 模型的数学物理语境；相关术语在两个片段中重复出现。

patterns.name: Bond 专名
patterns.context: 出现在 James Bond 这一专名中，两次出现于同一段，周围谈及 Q Branch、特工及装备。

patterns.name: 文章、路由与编辑代码
patterns.context: 出现在 URL 路由和 Python/Django 风格代码中，指文章资源及其编辑操作。

patterns.name: Julia 线性代数语境
patterns.context: Julia REPL 代码涉及 LinearAlgebra、矩阵及单位矩阵；«Al»和«gebra»共同拆出 Algebra。

patterns.name: 标题中的人群名词
patterns.context: 出现在关于某地区教师烟草使用的论文标题中；未见同段的明确重复线索。

en.description: Activation is scattered across code, mathematical formulas, chemical and medical terminology, Dutch word forms, and news proper nouns. Apart from some local recurrence among medical and chemical fragments, the passages show no clear shared semantic or stylistic trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Fragments of the number 1/1.5
patterns.context: The number 1 occurs in mathematical formulas, expressions, or decimals/ranges; sometimes nearby punctuation or formula syntax contributes to the trigger.
patterns.domain: Mathematical papers, formulas, and technical text

patterns.name: Article-related word forms
patterns.context: article(s) appears as a model/route name in code; surrounding text concerns Django URL configuration and a question about editing articles.

patterns.name: Fragments in chemical names
patterns.context: A complex chemical name is split into multiple tokens, followed by descriptions of precipitation, filtration, and NMR characterization.

patterns.name: COVID-19 case description
patterns.context: Describes patient referral, ICU admission, and confirmed cases.

patterns.name: Medicinal chemistry and leukotrienes
patterns.context: Patent background describes indole compounds and their antagonism of leukotriene-related pharmacological effects; elsewhere, leukotrienes and their isomers appear.
patterns.domain: Medicinal chemistry patent, medical chemistry abstract

patterns.name: Dutch word-form fragments
patterns.context: These fragments are embedded in words in Dutch parliamentary text discussing measures, committees, and WTO negotiations.

patterns.name: Medical statistical terminology
patterns.context: Reports baseline indicators and area under the ROC curve after patient mortality data.

patterns.name: English proper nouns and their internal fragments
patterns.context: Local news describes the sale of lava land in an irrigation district and neighbors’ concerns; activation falls on proper nouns and their internal tokens.

4_238.description: 激活分散在代码、数学公式、化学与医学术语、荷兰语词形及新闻专名中。除若干医学化学片段有局部复现外，各段没有清晰共享的语义或文体触发模式。

patterns.name: 数字 1/1.5 的片段
patterns.context: 数字 1 出现在数学公式、表达式或小数/范围中；有时相邻标点或公式语法共同构成触发条件。
patterns.domain: 数学论文、公式及技术文本

patterns.name: 文章相关词形
patterns.context: article(s) 作为代码中的模型/路由名出现；周围是 Django URL 配置与编辑文章的问题。

patterns.name: 化学名称中的片段
patterns.context: 复杂化学物质名称被拆分成多个 token，随后描述沉淀、过滤及 NMR 表征。

patterns.name: COVID-19 病例描述
patterns.context: 叙述患者转诊、ICU 收治及确诊病例。
patterns.domain: 医学论文/疫情病例报告

patterns.name: 药物化学与白三烯
patterns.context: 专利背景中描述吲哚类化合物及其对白三烯相关药理作用的拮抗；另一处出现白三烯及其异构体。
patterns.domain: 药物化学专利、医学化学摘要

patterns.name: 荷兰语词形片段
patterns.context: 这些片段嵌在荷兰语议会文本的词语中，谈及措施、委员会及 WTO 谈判。

patterns.name: 医学统计术语
patterns.context: 患者死亡数据之后报告基线指标及 ROC 曲线下面积。

patterns.name: 英文专名及其内部片段
patterns.context: 地方新闻叙述灌溉区出售熔岩地及邻居的担忧；激活落在专名及其内部 token 上。

en.description: Activation is clearest on declaration (including medical declarations and function declarations) and the in-word ust fragment; the rest is scattered across medical terms, code, email names, news headlines, and patient ages, with no shared trigger condition.

patterns.name: Fixed phrase “declaration of”
patterns.context: Appears in expressions such as “St. Vincent declaration,” “declaration of Helsinki,” and “The declaration was…”; it does not require any particular following content.

patterns.name: In-word fragment -ust-
patterns.context: The trigger occurs inside a word; [6] is the English adjective Robust, and [8] is the Slovenian word ustavni.

patterns.name: Local fragments in medical terms
patterns.context: Activation falls on specific word fragments in medical titles or abstracts, but these terms have no shared root or clear common meaning.

patterns.name: Word structure and code syntax declarations
patterns.context: In a code template description, the phrase “generator function declaration” refers to a function declaration; activation concentrates on the abbreviated fragment decl in declaration.

patterns.name: Near the English letter sequence «...ar...»
patterns.context: Located in the word parental in a genetics abstract; this segment has no clear contextual correspondence to the other patterns.

patterns.name: In-word fragments in English news terms
patterns.context: Appears in the headline “... Has Deadly Consequences”; declaration also appears in the same passage, but this fragment itself is an in-word activation.

patterns.name: Age-word fragment in a title
patterns.context: Appears in a pediatric case title describing the patient's age; no other passage shows the same trigger.

patterns.name: Character fragment in an email address name
patterns.context: Located in Gustafson in an email forwarding header; the content concerns urging payment, but the activated characters have no clear connection to the topic.

4_705.description: 激活最清楚地落在 declaration（含医学宣言与函数声明）及词内 ust 片段；其余分散于医学词、代码、邮件姓名、新闻标题和病例年龄等，缺少共同触发条件。

patterns.name: 固定短语“declaration of”
patterns.context: 出现在“St. Vincent declaration”“declaration of Helsinki”“The declaration was…”等表达中；不要求后接特定内容。

patterns.name: 词内片段 -ust-
patterns.trigger: «ust»，分别嵌在 «Rob»«ust»（Robust，[6]）和 «ust»…«ni»（ustavni，斯洛文尼亚语“宪法的”，[8]）中
patterns.context: 触发位置在词内部；[6]是英语形容词 Robust，[8]是斯洛文尼亚语词 ustavni。
patterns.domain: 医学科研、欧洲议会文本

patterns.name: 医学词语中的局部片段
patterns.context: 激活落在医学标题或摘要中的特定词片段，但这些词并无共同词根或明确共同语义。

patterns.name: 词语结构及代码语法声明
patterns.context: 代码模板的描述中，词组“generator function declaration”指函数声明；激活集中在 declaration 的缩写片段 decl。

patterns.name: 英文字母序列「...ar...」附近
patterns.context: 位于遗传学摘要的 parental 一词中；该段没有与其他模式明显对应的上下文。

patterns.name: 英文新闻词语内部片段
patterns.context: 出现在标题“... Has Deadly Consequences”中；同段另有 declaration，但此片段本身是词内激活。

patterns.name: 标题中的年龄词片段
patterns.context: 出现在儿科病例标题中，描述患者年龄；未见其他段落出现相同触发。

patterns.name: 邮件地址姓名中的字符片段
patterns.context: 位于邮件转发头部的姓名 Gustafson 中；内容涉及催促付款，但激活字符本身与主题无明确联系。

en.description: Activation is distributed across multiple domains and word classes: in-word fragments (especially ust), disease and age terms, proper nouns and Path, as well as declaration, technical terms, and common email words; no stable semantic pattern covers all fragments.

patterns.name: In-word subword fragment ust
patterns.context: Activation falls on the contiguous subword fragment ust within words; word beginnings, endings, and surrounding meanings vary, with no consistent semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Medical papers, email, Slovenian parliamentary texts

patterns.name: In-word fragment in a disease name
patterns.context: In the medical term neurocysticercosis, activation is located on an in-word fragment.

patterns.name: Age word in a pediatric title
patterns.context: The case title describes a six-month-old boy; activation concentrates on old, and related words also activate.

patterns.name: Name ending in a headline
patterns.context: Activation appears in names of people and places in a news dispatch lead, especially strongly on Delhi.

patterns.name: Path in a name or term
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of the name “Pathology Core” in institutional funding text.

patterns.name: Medical ethics declaration names
patterns.context: Refers to St. Vincent declaration and Declaration of Helsinki, respectively; the same word also appears in a political news context.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts and main text of medical papers

patterns.name: declaration in political text
patterns.context: Refers to a condemned statement and appears in political reporting about the Islamization of Europe and the Turkish president.

patterns.name: has and thanks in email
patterns.context: An informal payment-chasing email mentions someone hiding money and ends with thanks; activation is scattered across ordinary words.

patterns.name: Inverse-problem expression
patterns.context: A technical expression in the title of an optical scattering study.

4_705.description: 激活分布在多种领域与词类上：既有词内片段（尤其 ust）、疾病与年龄词、专名和 Path，也有 declaration、技术术语及邮件常用词；未见能覆盖全部片段的稳定语义模式。

patterns.name: 词内子词片段 ust
patterns.context: 激活落在词中连续的子词片段 ust；词首/词尾及周围词义不同，没有一致的语义条件。
patterns.domain: 医学论文、邮件、斯洛文尼亚议会文本

patterns.name: 疾病名称中的词内片段
patterns.context: 在神经系统囊虫病这一医学术语中，激活位于词内片段。

patterns.name: 儿科标题中的年龄词
patterns.context: 病例标题描述一个六个月大的男孩；激活集中在 old，相关词也有激活。

patterns.name: 标题中的专名词尾
patterns.context: 新闻电讯导语的人名和地名中出现激活，尤以 Delhi 较强。

patterns.name: 名称或术语中的 Path
patterns.context: 出现在机构资助文本的“Pathology Core”名称开头。

patterns.name: 医学伦理宣言名称
patterns.context: 分别指 St. Vincent declaration 与 Declaration of Helsinki；同一词在新闻政治语境中也出现。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要与医学论文正文

patterns.name: 政治文本中的 declaration
patterns.context: 指一项受到谴责的声明，出现在关于欧洲伊斯兰化及土耳其总统的政治报道中。

patterns.name: 邮件中 has 与 thanks
patterns.context: 非正式催款邮件中提到某人藏有钱，并以 thanks 结束；激活分散在普通词上。

patterns.name: 逆问题表达
patterns.trigger: «inverse»，处于“Robust solution to the inverse problem”
patterns.context: 光学散射研究标题中的技术表达。

en.description: Activation concentrates on emphatic expressions, especially “remarkably” modifying a following description; the rest is distributed across phrases being discussed or highlighted and one rhetorical question at the end of a quotation, with no unified lexical category.

patterns.name: Emphatic use of remarkably
patterns.context: Used as a degree adverb modifying a subsequent evaluative or descriptive expression; sometimes activates together with the following text.

patterns.name: Highlighted words in quotations or discussions
patterns.context: In dialogue or technical text, marks locally emphasized, explained, or discussed phrases; trigger words vary.
patterns.domain: Forum discussions, Q&A, and academic texts

patterns.name: Rhetorical question punctuation at the end of a quotation
patterns.context: A quotation of a saying ends with a question mark, with activation near the end of the quotation; may relate to a rhetorical question or quotation boundary.

4_705.description: 激活集中于强调性表达，尤其是修饰后续描述的“remarkably”；其余分布在被讨论或突出的词组，以及一处引语反问末尾，未显示统一词汇类别。

patterns.name: remarkably 的强调用法
patterns.context: 作程度副词，修饰后续评价性或描述性表达；有时与后文一同构成激活片段。
patterns.domain: 学术论文（天体物理、生物医学）

patterns.name: 引述或讨论中的突出词语
patterns.context: 在对话或技术文本中，标记局部被强调、解释或讨论的词组；触发词并不统一。
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论、问答及学术文本
