patterns.name: 引语末尾的反问标点
patterns.context: 引用一句格言后以问号收尾，激活落在引语末端附近；可能与反问或引语边界有关。

en.description: The most stable trigger is because, often in causal or explanatory clauses and across multiple genres. There is also email header formatting and a few contexts describing differences, asymptomatic disease, or concern; passage topics are not consistent.

patterns.name: Causal conjunction because
patterns.context: Appears in clauses explaining causes, motives, or system errors; its local syntactic position varies, and it often introduces a reason or condition.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: email, academic abstracts, news discussions, forums, and software error text

patterns.name: Describing differences and variation
patterns.context: Discusses differences in results, characteristics, or group conditions, or expresses concern about something; passage 2 is clearest, and passage 7 may also be related.
patterns.domain: Biomedical paper abstracts; quotes in news reports

patterns.name: Email formatting and recipient fields
patterns.context: Appears near email headers and body boundaries; the body concerns requests, correspondence, or personal communication.

patterns.name: Other uses in causal explanations
patterns.context: Explains preceding text by citing a specific event or state; topics vary and cannot be grouped into a more specific common topic.
patterns.domain: Work emails, personal emails, historical discussions, trading emails, and software error messages

4_705.description: 最稳定的触发是 because，常出现在原因或解释从句中，横跨多种文体。另有邮件头格式，以及少量描述差异、疾病无症状或担忧的语境；各段主题并不统一。

patterns.name: 因果连词 because
patterns.trigger: «because»（多段中为强激活点，常见上下文如“specified you as their”“he stands to”“the people who”“couldn’t be removed because”）
patterns.context: 出现在解释原因、动机或系统错误的从句中；局部句法位置不固定，常引出原因或条件说明。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：邮件、学术摘要、新闻讨论、论坛及软件错误文本

patterns.name: 描述差异与变异
patterns.trigger: «remarkably»« variable»；“extremely diverse”“no signs of disease”“some concern”
patterns.context: 谈论结果、特征或群体状况存在差异，或对某事表示关注；段2最明确，段7也可能相关。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文摘要；新闻报道引语

patterns.name: 邮件格式与收件人字段
patterns.context: 邮件头及正文边界附近出现，正文涉及请求、往来或个人交流。

patterns.name: 其他原因说明用法
patterns.trigger: «because» 前后的具体原因片段，如“switched PC”“excited just to think”“got sick of it”“if there isn’t a terriost”“don’t have permission”
patterns.context: 以具体事件或状态解释前文；主题各异，无法进一步归为同一细分主题。
patterns.domain: 工作邮件、私人邮件、历史讨论、交易邮件及软件报错

en.concept: Electrostatic-related vocabulary and miscellaneous academic text
en.description: The most stable cue is electrostatic and collocations involving fields and interactions, spanning physics, DNA, and patent texts; other activations are scattered across abstract headings, some, civil rights history, treatment, and tumor research, with no unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Electric fields or electrostatic interactions
patterns.context: In descriptions of electric fields, electrostatic effects, or interactions between charged particles, especially near «fields», «interaction», or «interactions».
patterns.domain: Physics, materials science, molecular biology, polyelectrolyte research, patent technology

patterns.name: Introduction or abstract structure marker
patterns.context: Used as a section or abstract heading in academic text, marking the start of the main text.

patterns.name: Local use of the quantifier some
patterns.context: some modifies a plural or singular noun in academic prose or a quoted news report; in passage 3, the trigger occurs within a parenthetical term explanation.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, news quotes, computer science

patterns.name: civil rights and historical period
patterns.context: Describes the role of Black physicians in the American South around the period before and after the Civil Rights Act.
patterns.domain: Medical history, U.S. civil rights history

patterns.name: Chemotherapy patients and combined treatments
patterns.context: After patients, describes patients undergoing chemotherapy and/or ionizing radiation.

patterns.name: Tumor nutrition and oxygen supply description
patterns.context: Describes how tumor angiogenesis, blood flow, and oxygen consumption affect tumor nutritional status and oxygen delivery.

patterns.name: Chemical structures and molecular-change terms
patterns.context: Describes deformation of graphene structure or changes in groove geometry after DNA methylation; the two topics differ.

patterns.name: General academic argumentation and theoretical language
patterns.context: Abstract theoretical explanations or academic introductions to research topics and their challenges; the listed trigger words do not form a single stable phrase.
patterns.domain: Theoretical computer science, biology paper introductions

patterns.name: Degree or effect verbs in research abstracts
patterns.context: Each appears in a different context, describing increased interaction, tumor nutritional status, and social concern, respectively; they cannot currently be grouped under a common trigger condition.

patterns.name: Food compliance and religious dietary practices
patterns.context: A news spokesperson discusses concerns related to halal products.
patterns.domain: News reports, food and religious dietary practices

4_705.concept: 静电相关词汇及杂项学术文本
4_705.description: 最稳定的线索是 electrostatic 及其字段、相互作用等搭配，横跨物理、DNA与专利文本；其余激活分散在摘要标题、some、民权史、治疗和肿瘤研究等局部语境，未显示统一语义模式。

patterns.name: 电场或静电相互作用
patterns.context: 在电场、静电作用或带电粒子相互作用的描述中，尤其是邻近 «fields»、«interaction» 或 «interactions»。
patterns.domain: 物理、材料科学、分子生物学、聚电解质研究、专利技术

patterns.name: 引言或摘要结构标记
patterns.context: 学术文本中用作章节或摘要标题的结构标签，标记后紧接正文。

patterns.name: 量词 some 的局部用法
patterns.context: some 修饰复数名词或单数名词，出现在学术正文或报道引语中；第3段的触发处在括号中的术语解释内。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、新闻引语、计算机科学

patterns.name: civil rights 及历史时期
patterns.trigger: «Civil»9 «Rights»6 Act；«period»6 leading up to the Civil Rights Act；«South»5
patterns.context: 描述美国南方黑人医生在民权法案前后历史时期的角色。

patterns.name: 化疗患者及治疗并列
patterns.context: patients 后描述正在接受化疗和/或电离辐射的患者。

patterns.name: 肿瘤营养与氧供描述
patterns.context: 描述肿瘤血管生成、血流、氧消耗如何影响肿瘤营养状态和氧输送。
patterns.domain: 肿瘤学、生理学研究计划描述

patterns.name: 化学结构与分子变化词
patterns.context: 描述石墨烯结构变形，或 DNA 甲基化后沟槽几何结构改变；前者与后者主题不同。

patterns.name: 一般学术论证与理论语言
patterns.context: 抽象理论说明或对研究课题及其难点的学术介绍；所列触发词并未形成单一稳定短语。
patterns.domain: 计算机科学理论、生物学论文引言

patterns.name: 科研摘要中的突出程度或效应动词
patterns.context: 各自处于不同语境，分别描述相互作用增强、肿瘤营养状态和社会关注，暂无法归为共同触发条件。
patterns.domain: 分子生物学、肿瘤学、新闻报道

patterns.name: 食品合规与宗教饮食
patterns.context: 新闻发言人谈及清真产品相关关注。
patterns.domain: 新闻报道、食品与宗教饮食

en.concept: Noun phrase initial words after articles
en.description: All activated words appear after a or the, at the beginning of a noun phrase, and function as modifiers or nouns; meanings and domains vary, with repeated instances of calming, receiving, and jump.

patterns.name: Noun phrase initial words after articles
patterns.context: The activated word is at the beginning of a noun phrase introduced by a or the; it can be an adjective or noun and is often followed by a noun.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: biomedicine, technology, commentary, email, etc.

patterns.name: Repeated calming token
patterns.context: Appears before a noun as a modifier describing an environment or effect; both instances follow an article.

patterns.name: Repeated receiving token
patterns.context: Used as a pre-nominal modifier, forming one party in communication and a circuit component, respectively; both instances follow an article.

patterns.name: Repeated jump token
patterns.context: One instance is used in jumpy (split into «jump»«y»), and another is the noun jump; both follow an article.

4_705.concept: 冠词后的名词短语起始词
4_705.description: 所有激活词都出现在 a 或 the 之后、名词短语开头，后续作修饰语或名词；词义和领域多样，calming、receiving、jump 各有重复实例。

patterns.name: 冠词后的名词短语起始词
patterns.context: 激活词位于 a 或 the 引出的名词短语开头；词性可为形容词或名词，后续常接名词。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：生物医学、科技、评论、邮件等

patterns.name: calming 词项重复
patterns.context: 出现在名词前作修饰语，描述环境或效果；均位于冠词之后。
patterns.domain: 个人叙述、消费品／健康报道

patterns.name: receiving 词项重复
patterns.context: 作名词前修饰语，分别构成通信中的一方和电路元件；均位于冠词之后。

patterns.name: jump 词项重复
patterns.context: 一处用于 jumpy（拆分为 «jump»«y»），一处作名词 jump；均位于冠词之后。
patterns.domain: 商业评论、语言／软件讨论

en.description: Strong activations occur on technical terms related to switching/switch, in-word fragments of humming and mantling, and expressions with highly followed by a property word; these word forms and contexts span multiple domains, with no unified semantic or syntactic pattern.

patterns.name: switching and related words
patterns.context: Appears in technical contexts involving switching nodes in communications networks, switches in industrial controllers, circuit/material layers, optoelectronic components, etc.; passage 7 also contains «switching↵costs», referring to migration costs.
patterns.domain: Patent technology, physics/materials papers, network discussions

patterns.name: Participle fragment of hum
patterns.context: The trigger is fragment «ming»9 split from humming; one instance describes the sound of a spinning gyroscope, while the other depicts a thriving scene formed by oil tanks and pipelines, which may not express sound.

patterns.name: Participle fragment of mantling
patterns.context: Appears in “mantling layer,” in the context of an ice or sediment layer.

patterns.name: Adjective after highly
patterns.context: «highly» modifies a following property word; instances describe gene evolution/reconstruction methods and cultural characteristics, respectively. The trigger may focus on highly or its neighboring combination.

4_705.description: 强激活分布在 switching/switch 相关技术词、humming 与 mantling 的词内片段，以及 highly 后接性质词的表达；这些词形和语境跨领域，未见统一语义或句法模式。

patterns.name: switching 及其相关词
patterns.context: 出现于通信网络的交换节点、工业控制器中的开关、电路/材料层、光电元件等技术语境；段 7 另出现「switching↵costs」，指迁移成本。
patterns.domain: 专利技术、物理/材料论文、网络讨论

patterns.name: hum 的分词片段
patterns.context: 触发点是 humming 被拆分后的片段 «ming»9；一处描述陀螺旋转发声，另一处描写油罐与管道构成的繁盛景象，未必表达声音。

patterns.name: mantling 的分词片段
patterns.context: 出现在「mantling layer」一词中，指冰层或沉积层的上下文。

patterns.name: highly 后的形容词
patterns.context: «highly»修饰后续性质词；分别描述基因演化/重建方式，以及文化特征。触发可能集中于 highly 或邻近组合。
patterns.domain: 科研摘要、社会科学研究

en.description: Strong activation mainly falls on subword fragments inside several different words, especially me and on; the rest appears in not, all, and kind. Domains and semantic contexts are inconsistent, making it difficult to infer a single semantic theme.

patterns.name: me- prefix boundary
patterns.context: Activation falls on the subword fragments me or them; following letters and context complete the full word. The fragment may be word-initial or occur within a word.
patterns.domain: Housing descriptions, biology, archaeology, war narratives, medical papers; multiple genres

patterns.name: In-word fragment on
patterns.context: The activation marker occurs inside a complete word beginning with on; meanings and contexts vary.

patterns.name: In-word fragment not
patterns.context: not appears in a negation structure modifying previously described.

patterns.name: In-word fragment all
patterns.context: all appears in the emphatic phrase all As student.

patterns.name: In-word fragment kind
patterns.context: kind appears in a phrase referring to a type of reaction.

4_705.description: 强激活主要落在若干不同词的内部子词片段上，尤以 me、on 为突出；其余散见于 not、all、kind。跨领域与语义语境均不一致，难以归纳为单一语义主题。

patterns.name: me-词缀边界
patterns.trigger: « me» 后接词根或片段，如 «me»10«zz»（mezzanine）、«me»10«iotic»（meiotic）、«me»10«gal»（megalithic）、«me»9«le»（mêlée）、«them»9«atic»（thematic）
patterns.context: 激活落在 me 或 them 的子词片段上；后续字母与上下文补全完整词。片段可能是词首，也可能位于词内。
patterns.domain: 房屋描述、生物学、考古、战争叙述、医学论文；多种文体

patterns.name: on-词内片段
patterns.context: 激活标记位于 on 开头的完整词内部；词义和语境各不相同。

patterns.name: not-词内片段
patterns.context: not 在否定结构中，修饰 previously described。

patterns.name: all-词内片段
patterns.context: all 位于强调性短语 all As student 中。

patterns.name: kind-词内片段
patterns.context: kind 出现在指称某类反应的短语中。

en.concept: one-compound expressions and sporadic word forms
en.description: The main response is to expressions formed by one plus a hyphen and a time, duration, or dimension unit; other sporadic triggers include many-body, possessive s, an in-word fragment of contingency, US, specific, and sense, distributed across technical, academic, and online texts.

patterns.name: one-compound expressions
patterns.context: “one” is followed by a hyphen and a time, duration, or dimension unit, expressing one-time, one-year, or one-dimensional; also includes expressions such as “one time event”
patterns.domain: Education and training, academic papers, research funding descriptions, technical documentation

patterns.name: many-body expression
patterns.context: many combines with body via a hyphen to form the compound term describing many-body effects

patterns.name: Possessive ending s
patterns.context: s follows “their” to form “theirs”; the passage discusses ownership of content

patterns.name: In-word fragment of contingency
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on an internal subword fragment of contingency, which refers to contingency arrangements in funding
patterns.domain: Personal experiences, funding and work discussions

patterns.name: Expressions related to the abbreviation US
patterns.context: US/U.S. appears in geographical or employment contexts, referring to the United States or being based in the US
patterns.domain: Remote employment and international payroll discussions

patterns.name: specific negotiation
patterns.context: Describes a particular negotiation and its temporal and social context

patterns.name: sense and defiant discussion
patterns.context: In the gloss “ordinary sense of the term,” discusses the usual meaning of the word defiant

4_705.description: 主要响应 one 与连字符、时间/年限/维度单位构成的表达；另有 many-body、所有格 s、contingency 内部片段、US、specific 和 sense 等零散触发，分布于技术、学术及网络文本。

patterns.name: one-复合表达
patterns.context: “one”后接连字符及时间、年限或维度单位，表示一次性、为期一年或一维；也包括“one time event”这类表达
patterns.domain: 教育培训、学术论文、科研资助说明、技术文档

patterns.name: many-body表达
patterns.context: many 与 body 构成带连字符的复合术语，描述多体效应

patterns.name: 所有格词尾 s
patterns.context: “their”后接 s 构成“theirs”，此处讨论内容归属

patterns.name: contingency词内片段
patterns.context: 激活集中在 contingency 的内部子词片段，句中表示资金安排中的应急条件
patterns.domain: 个人经历、资金与工作讨论

patterns.name: US缩写相关表达
patterns.context: 地理或雇佣语境中出现 US/U.S.，指美国或以美国为基地
patterns.domain: 远程雇佣与国际薪资讨论

patterns.name: specific negotiation
patterns.context: 描述某一具体谈判及其所处的时间流与社会情境

patterns.name: sense与defiant讨论
patterns.context: “ordinary sense of the term”这一释义表达中，讨论 defiant 一词的通常含义

en.concept: one constructions and sporadic word fragments
en.description: The strongest common pattern is one and its following constructions, including one-way, one-time, one-fold, and the one of; other sporadic activations include many-body, a possible proper-noun subword, the dot before code all(), and an in-word fragment of outing.

patterns.name: one and following complements/phrases
patterns.context: one appears in structures such as is a one..., than a one..., and the one of...; activation falls on one, and the following complement contains time, way, fold, or of.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain narratives, papers, email, medical abstracts, and training texts

patterns.name: many in many-body
patterns.context: many combines with a hyphen and body to form the compound term many-body effect.

patterns.name: Subword in me...lé
patterns.context: A possible foreign word or proper noun in a historical narrative; activation spans the subword fragments me and le, and the full word form and meaning are unclear.

patterns.name: all in code
patterns.context: In Django/Python code, the all() method is called on a queryset after a dot; strong activation is on the dot, with a weaker marker on all.

patterns.name: In-word fragment in outing
patterns.context: outing means publicly revealing or exposing someone's email address; activation is on the in-word fragment ing.

4_705.concept: one 构式及零散词片段
4_705.description: 最强的共同规律是 one 及其后续构式，涵盖 one-way、one-time、one-fold 和 the one of；另有 many-body、疑似专名子词、代码 all() 点号及 outing 词内片段等零散激活。

patterns.name: one及后续补语/词组
patterns.trigger: « one»10（另见« one»10«-»4«time»2、« one»10« way»2、« one»10«-»3«fold»3）
patterns.context: one 出现在 is a one...、than a one...、the one of... 等结构中；激活落在 one，后续补语含 time、way、fold 或 of。
patterns.domain: 跨领域叙述、论文、邮件、医学摘要及培训文本

patterns.name: many-body中的many
patterns.context: many 与连字符及 body 构成复合术语 many-body effect。
patterns.domain: 干涉仪与物理研究论文

patterns.name: me...lé中的子词
patterns.context: 历史叙述中的疑似外语或专名，激活跨越 me、le 子词片段；其完整词形及语义不明。

patterns.name: 代码中的all
patterns.context: Django/Python代码中，点号后调用 queryset 的 all() 方法；强激活标在点号，all 也有较弱标记。

patterns.name: outing中的词内片段
patterns.context: outing 表示公开或曝光某人的电子邮件地址；激活位于词内 ing 片段。

en.description: The strongest and most stable activation falls on one, often followed by a hyphen or forming a compound expression. Strong activation also appears on ing in words such as resulting, convening, and parting; preceding stem fragments may activate more weakly.

patterns.name: one collocations and following structures
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on one; sometimes the hyphen also activates. The following word forms a compound expression or noun phrase, such as one-to-many, one-fold, one-time, one-dimensional, one potential step.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: technical discussions, medical papers, law, training articles, encyclopedias, etc.

patterns.name: Word-internal boundary in resulting
patterns.context: Activation falls on the word-internal ing in resulting, while the preceding stem result also activates more weakly; the word modifies video and accident, respectively.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragments in specific words
patterns.context: High activation falls on the word-final ing, and the stem fragment is also marked; the contexts are convening authority, a legal term, and a parting exclamation in narrative prose.

4_705.description: 强激活最稳定地落在 one，常接连字符或构成复合表达；另有 resulting、convening、parting 等词中 ing 的强激活，前置词干片段也可较弱激活。

patterns.name: one 的搭配与后续结构
patterns.context: 激活集中在 one；有时连字符也激活，后续词构成复合表达或名词短语，如 one-to-many、one-fold、one-time、one-dimensional、one potential step。
patterns.domain: 跨领域；技术讨论、医学论文、法律、培训文章、百科等

patterns.name: resulting 的词内边界
patterns.context: 激活落在 resulting 的词内 ing 部分，前面词干 result 也有较弱激活；分别修饰 video、accident。

patterns.name: 特定词的词内片段
patterns.context: 高激活落在词尾 ing，且词干片段也被标记；上下文中分别为法律术语 convening authority 和叙述性文字中的 parting exclamation。

en.description: Most passages activate in compounds formed with one and a hyphen. Suffixes cover quantity, duration, dimension, time, and electronic processes; activation in functioning's -ing and a fragment of thematic is harder to fit into the same rule.

patterns.name: one-compounds
patterns.context: The numeral one combines with a hyphen to form compound modifiers or time expressions; activation does not depend on a single suffix.
patterns.domain: Academic abstracts, philosophical discussion, and general expository prose

patterns.name: Word-internal -ing
patterns.context: The word-final -ing appears as a word-internal part; in this example it occurs in “functioning” after a line break.

patterns.name: Fragment in thematic
patterns.context: Activation falls on a tokenized word fragment, not a one- structure; the context is a thematic analysis framework.

4_705.description: 多数段落在 one 与连字符构成的复合表达中激活，后缀涵盖数量、时长、维度、时间和电子过程；另有 functioning 的 -ing 及 thematic 的词片激活，难以归入同一规则。

patterns.name: one-复合词
patterns.context: 数词 one 与连字符组成复合修饰语或时间表达；触发不依赖单一后缀。
patterns.domain: 学术摘要、哲学论述及一般说明文

patterns.name: 词内 -ing
patterns.context: 词尾 -ing 作为词内部分出现；本例位于换行后的“functioning”。

patterns.name: thematic 的词片
patterns.context: 激活落在被切分的词片上，而非 one- 结构；上下文是主题分析框架。

en.description: Activation is distributed across varied word-internal fragments, inflectional or derivational suffixes, hyphenated numeric expressions, and a few line breaks. Thematic word forms and one-numeric expressions recur, while other triggers are sporadic and cannot be adequately explained by a single semantic or stylistic factor.

patterns.name: Participial or word-internal fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on suffixes or word-internal parts that form words across tokens, especially -ing, -ly, and -ity; not all such examples can be grouped under the same suffix.
patterns.domain: Ordinary text across domains, legal writing, and academic writing

patterns.name: Word forms related to “thematic”
patterns.context: Appears in contexts such as “thematic integration” and “a thematic framework,” discussing research organization or an analytical framework.

patterns.name: one before a number
patterns.context: In numerical expressions, one is followed by a hyphen and a unit or quantity word.

patterns.name: Numeric ordinals in combat narratives
patterns.context: A numeric ordinal is embedded in a military unit name, followed by unit numbers.

patterns.name: Line-break token
patterns.context: A line break or formatting separator in the text is marked; this is especially noticeable at line breaks in legal texts, though other passages also contain unmarked line breaks.

patterns.name: utter-ly in a location-search webpage
patterns.context: Quotes a developer discussing the importance of searching for business locations; modifies crucial.

patterns.name: Fragment within a specific biomedical term
patterns.context: Appears in the neuroscience research facility name “Tract Tracing Core”.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in a personal pronoun
patterns.context: Located in the initial fragment of “Them-atic,” not an independent pronoun.

4_705.description: 激活分布在多种词内片段、屈折或派生词尾、连字符数字表达及少量换行处；主题词形和 one-数字表达重复出现，其余触发分散，不能由单一语义或文体充分解释。

patterns.name: 分词或词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在跨 token 拼成词语的后缀或词内部分上，尤其是 -ing、-ly、-ity 等；并非所有此类例子都能归为同一后缀
patterns.domain: 跨领域的普通文本、法律及学术写作

patterns.name: 「主题」相关词形
patterns.context: 出现在“thematic integration”“a thematic framework”这类谈论研究组织或分析框架的语境中
patterns.domain: 研究计划、医学康复研究

patterns.name: 数字前的 one
patterns.context: 数值表达中，one 后接连字符及单位或数量词

patterns.name: 战斗叙事中的数字序数
patterns.context: 数字序数嵌入军事单位名称，后续列出部队编号

patterns.name: 换行 token
patterns.context: 文本中换行或格式分隔处被标记；伴随法律文本中的断行时尤其明显，但其他段也有换行而未标记

patterns.name: 位置查询网页中的 utter-ly
patterns.context: 引述开发者谈业务地点查询的重要性，修饰 crucial

patterns.name: 特定生物医学词内部片段
patterns.context: 出现在神经科学研究设施名称“Tract Tracing Core”中

patterns.name: 人称代词词内片段
patterns.context: 位于“Them-atic”的词首片段，而非独立代词

en.description: Activation is distributed across word-internal fragments, capitalization changes, underscores or hyphen delimiters, short function words, line breaks, and punctuation in varied texts. It is common in code identifiers, links, and titles, but also occurs in ordinary sentences and foreign words, with no unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Uppercase build identifiers separated by underscores
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments within uppercase words and build variables, especially CMake variables joined by underscores.

patterns.name: Punctuation and fragments in links and URLs
patterns.context: Activation often appears on hyphens, line breaks, short words, and split word fragments in URLs, Markdown links, or link text; it often accompanies escaped punctuation or truncated text.

patterns.name: Function words or suffixes in English sentences
patterns.context: In ordinary comment sentences, activation falls on line breaks, word-internal fragments, function words, and phrase boundaries, with no clear consistent semantic topic.

patterns.name: Capitalized word fragments in book or chapter titles
patterns.context: In all-caps titles or chapter names, activation falls on word-internal fragments and title punctuation; titles are separated by line breaks and spaces.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragments and URL markers in technical text
patterns.context: A technical explanation is followed by an example URL; activation involves both words in the main text and word fragments, hyphens, and punctuation in the URL.

patterns.name: Aviation abbreviations and French word fragments
patterns.context: In a military aviation narrative, activation falls within uppercase abbreviations and on an internal fragment of a French word with a diacritic.

4_705.description: 激活分布于多种文本的词内片段、大小写变化、下划线或连字符分隔符、短功能词、换行及标点；常见于代码标识符、链接和标题，但也见于普通句子与外语词，缺乏统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 下划线分隔的大写构建标识符
patterns.context: 激活落在大写单词及构建变量中间的子词片段，尤其是由下划线连接的 CMake 变量。

patterns.name: 链接与网址中的标点及碎片
patterns.context: 激活多出现在 URL、Markdown 链接或链接文字中的连字符、换行、短词及被拆分的词片段；常伴随被转义的标点或截断文本。

patterns.name: 英文句子中的功能词或词尾
patterns.context: 普通评论句中，激活落在换行、词内片段、功能词及短语边界；无明显一致的语义主题。

patterns.name: 书名或章节标题中的大写词片段
patterns.context: 在全大写标题或章节名中激活词内片段和标题标点，标题由换行及空格分隔。

patterns.name: 技术文本中的词内片段与 URL 标记
patterns.context: 一段技术说明后接示例网址；激活既涉及正文词语，也涉及 URL 的词片段、连字符和标点。

patterns.name: 航空缩写与法语词片段
patterns.context: 军事航空叙述中，激活落在大写缩写内部，以及带重音符号的法语词中间片段。

en.description: Activation is distributed across varied internal subword fragments: French santé, English much more, medical terminology, and code identifiers; it also appears in hyphenated URLs and the legal word functioning. There is no clear semantic or syntactic pattern shared across passages.

patterns.name: CMake identifier fragments
patterns.context: Near compiler configuration, toolchain variables, or code identifiers; activation is distributed across identifiers and their subword fragments.

patterns.name: Internal fragment in French “santé”
patterns.context: The French text contains “santé” (health), in discussion of public health, environmental hazards, or protecting human health.

patterns.name: much more construction
patterns.context: In English, “a much more …” introduces a degree or comparative description; activation mainly falls on much and more.

patterns.name: Hyphenated URL fragments
patterns.context: In webpage links or URL paths, especially article titles, phrases, and slugs separated by hyphens; activation strength varies across individual fragments.

patterns.name: Functional participial fragment
patterns.context: In a legal sentence, “functioning” is followed by “of agreements,” describing the operation or implementation of agreements.

patterns.name: Syllabic fragments in medical vocabulary
patterns.context: In a medical abstract on adrenal cortex zones and development, activation falls on internal fragments of technical terms.

4_705.description: 激活分布在多种内部子词片段：法语 santé、英语 much more、医学术语及代码标识符；另在连字符网址和法律词 functioning 中出现。没有跨段统一的明确语义或句法模式。

patterns.name: CMake 标识符片段
patterns.context: 编译器配置、工具链变量或代码标识符附近；激活分散在标识符及其子词片段上

patterns.name: 法语“santé”内部片段
patterns.context: 法语正文中出现“santé”（健康），可处于公共卫生、环境危害或保护人类健康的论述中

patterns.name: much more 结构
patterns.context: 英语中以“a much more …”引出程度或比较描述；激活主要落在 much、more 上

patterns.name: 连字符网址片段
patterns.context: 网页链接或网址路径中，尤其是以连字符分隔的文章标题、词组和 slug；个别片段激活强弱不一

patterns.name: 功能性分词片段
patterns.context: 法律语句中“functioning”后接“of agreements”，描述协议的运作或实施

patterns.name: 医学词汇中的音节片段
patterns.context: 肾上腺皮质分区及发育的医学摘要中，激活落在专业词内部片段

en.description: The activation pattern is dominated by specific word-form fragments, especially cross-token nascent in adrenal, fiber, and RNA contexts. Other activations are scattered across confidentiality, judicial terms, omnipotent, database abbreviations, gene names, code identifiers, and sidelines.

patterns.name: nascent word form and adrenal/fiber contexts
patterns.context: Triggered by the cross-token spelling of “nascent”; contexts include fetal adrenal cortex zonation and hollow fiber formation during spinning.

patterns.name: confidentiality word form
patterns.context: In Enron emails, discusses confidentiality and information about market participants; the trigger word is marked as split tokens.
patterns.domain: Energy company emails, regulatory or legal matters

patterns.name: Judicial trial language
patterns.context: Describes comments by judges and prosecutors during a trial; activation concentrates on word-form fragments in presiding.

patterns.name: omnipotent word form
patterns.context: “omnipotent being” in a title is marked as split tokens, surrounded by a question-link about an all-powerful being.
patterns.domain: Webpage title, religious or philosophical topic

patterns.name: 3D ASN.1 notation
patterns.context: A database description contains “3D-structure” and “ASN.1”; activation falls on numeric, alphabetic, and abbreviation fragments.

patterns.name: vole in a gene name
patterns.context: Appears in the name vole vasopressin 1a receptor, with activation on the final part of vole.

patterns.name: Code identifier fragment n
patterns.context: At the end of the self.latest_svn identifier in Python/Qt code; nearby code punctuation also activates more weakly.

patterns.name: Repeated sidelines word form
patterns.context: In a narrative about coal-fired power being sidelined in the energy industry, the same word appears twice in a sentence and activates again.

patterns.name: Antitermination complex and RNA complementarity
patterns.context: Describes assembly of a transcription antitermination complex and its specific interaction with nascent RNA; besides nascent, several other words in the phrase also activate.

4_705.description: 激活模式以特定词形片段为主，尤其是跨 token 的 nascent（肾上腺、纤维、RNA语境）；其余分散于保密、司法、omnipotent、数据库缩写、基因名、代码标识符和 sidelines 等。

patterns.name: nascent 词形及肾上腺/纤维语境
patterns.context: 触发跨 token 拼写的“nascent”；上下文分别是胎儿肾上腺皮质分区和纺丝形成中空纤维。

patterns.name: confidentiality 词形
patterns.context: 在 Enron 邮件中谈论保密性及市场参与者信息；触发词被拆分标记。
patterns.domain: 能源公司邮件、监管或法律事务

patterns.name: 司法审判表述
patterns.context: 描述审判过程中法官及检方评论；激活集中于 presiding 一词的词形片段。

patterns.name: omnipotent 词形
patterns.context: 标题中的“omnipotent being”被拆分标记，周围是关于全能存在者的问句链接。
patterns.domain: 网页标题、宗教或哲学话题

patterns.name: 3D ASN.1 标记
patterns.context: 数据库说明中出现“3D-structure”和“ASN.1”，激活落在数字、字母及缩写片段。
patterns.domain: 分子生物学数据库介绍

patterns.name: 基因名中的 vole
patterns.context: 出现在 vole vasopressin 1a receptor 的名称中，激活位于 vole 的末段。

patterns.name: 代码标识符片段 n
patterns.context: Python/Qt 代码中的 self.latest_svn 标识符末尾；其他相邻代码标点也有较弱激活。

patterns.name: sidelines 词形重复
patterns.context: 煤电发电被边缘化、处于 sidelines 的叙述中，同一词在句内重复出现并再次激活。
patterns.domain: 能源行业邮件、行业评论

patterns.name: 抗终止复合体及 RNA 互补关系
patterns.context: 描述转录抗终止复合体组装及其与新生 RNA 的特异相互作用；除 nascent 外，短语中若干词也有激活。

en.description: The clearest pattern is the split subword fragments of nascent, appearing in scientific contexts that describe newly formed structures or processes. Other activations are scattered across word fragments in terms and code from multiple domains, with no unified semantics.

patterns.name: “nascent” word form and continuation
patterns.context: The word nascent is split into subword tokens; it appears before nouns, describing newly formed or developing entities, such as hollow fiber, zona, rRNA, and synapses.
patterns.domain: Patents, biomedical papers, and research plans

patterns.name: Subword fragments inside English words
patterns.context: Activation falls on internal fragments of complete English words, often words split by the tokenizer; the meanings have no clear connection to nascent or newly formed things.
patterns.domain: Online chat, news/webpages, medical text, software code

patterns.name: Other multi-token splits and common word fragments
patterns.context: Activation is scattered across initial, internal, or complete word forms; no stable syntactic position or consistent semantic condition is apparent.
patterns.domain: Mixed corpora including patents, biomedicine, and chat

4_705.description: 最清楚的模式是 nascent 的拆分子词片段，出现在描述新形成结构或过程的科研语境。其余激活散布于多领域词语和代码中的子词片段，未呈现统一语义。

patterns.name: “nascent”词形与延续
patterns.context: 词语 nascent 被拆分为子词 token；出现在名词前，描述新形成或正在发展的对象，如 hollow fiber、zona、rRNA、synapses。
patterns.domain: 专利、生物医学论文及研究计划

patterns.name: 英文词中间的子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在完整英文词的内部片段，常见于被 tokenizer 拆分的词；词义与“nascent”及新生事物无明显共同点。
patterns.domain: 在线聊天、新闻/网页、医学文本、软件代码

patterns.name: 其他多词元拆分与常见词片段
patterns.context: 激活分散在不同词的词首、词中或完整词上；未见稳定的句法位置或一致语义条件。
patterns.domain: 专利、生物医学、聊天等混合语料

en.description: Activation mainly falls on internal or final subword fragments in various words: settlement, words containing ash, sidelines, anodizing, and foothills. Apart from settlement recurring in multiple formal titles, there is little shared semantics or stable context.

patterns.name: Tokenized fragments of settlement
patterns.context: In uppercase or ordinary-case settlement / settlements, activation concentrates on internal fragments, especially LE; appears in agreement titles, legal documents, and historical book-style titles.
patterns.domain: Legal and business documents, written titles

patterns.name: Internal ash fragment
patterns.context: Activation appears on internal fragments of words containing ash, with widely varying meanings and contexts; in torpedoes, it also accompanies the final oes.
patterns.domain: Narrative text, webpage URLs, military discussion

patterns.name: Word-final idelines
patterns.context: Activation falls on the final part of sidelines, in a context where natural gas generation pushes coal-fired power to the sidelines of the energy industry.

patterns.name: Word-final an
patterns.context: Activation falls on an internal fragment of anodizing, in a discussion of anodized layer thickness and spring action.

patterns.name: Word-final foothills
patterns.context: Activation falls on the final fragment of foothills, describing the foothills location of a real estate project.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic geography and real estate description

4_705.description: 激活主要落在多种词的内部或词尾子词片段：settlement、含 ash 的词、sidelines、anodizing、foothills。除 settlement 在多种正式标题中的重复外，缺乏共同语义或稳定上下文。

patterns.name: settlement 的分词片段
patterns.context: 在大写或普通大小写的 settlement / settlements 中，激活集中于词内片段，尤其 LE；出现在协议标题、法律文件及历史书名式标题里。
patterns.domain: 法律、商业文件及书面标题

patterns.name: 词内 ash 片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在包含 ash 的词内片段，词义与上下文差异很大；在 torpedoes 中还伴随词尾 oes。
patterns.domain: 叙事文本、网页 URL、军事讨论

patterns.name: 词尾 idelines
patterns.context: 激活落在 sidelines 的词尾部分，语境是煤电在能源行业中被天然气发电挤到一旁。

patterns.name: 词尾 an
patterns.context: 激活落在 anodizing 的词内片段，讨论阳极氧化层厚度及弹簧作用。

patterns.name: 词尾 foothills
patterns.context: 激活落在 foothills 的末尾片段，描述地产项目所在的山麓位置。

en.description: Activation is scattered across texts from multiple domains, often falling on internal substrings, abbreviations/proper names, and code punctuation; hyphenated URLs and ordinary words also activate. No stable semantic or syntactic theme is evident; the pattern may primarily reflect word forms or tokenization boundaries.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragments across word boundaries
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on parts of words or continuous morpheme fragments; no complete word recurs consistently across passages, and fragments often occur in different word forms or proper names.
patterns.domain: Mixed domains: news, code, email, forums, medical and academic texts

patterns.name: Punctuation and separators in code
patterns.context: Appears in Python/PyTorch and Qt code, as well as nearby punctuation, line breaks, and indentation; activation sometimes falls inside identifiers.

patterns.name: Fragments in hyphenated URLs
patterns.context: Triggered by URL path or domain fragments joined by hyphens, especially Cloudflare-related URLs.

patterns.name: Internal fragments of proper names, abbreviations, or rare word forms
patterns.context: Appears in proper names, abbreviations, or longer low-frequency words; available examples are insufficient to confirm a specific semantic category as the trigger.
patterns.domain: News, entertainment encyclopedias, legal emails, and life science/astronomy papers

patterns.name: Fragments in ordinary words and common phrases
patterns.context: Ordinary words also activate in a few passages, with no consistent syntactic or semantic condition.

4_705.description: 激活分散在多领域文本中，常落于词内子串、缩写/专名及代码标点；另有连字符网址和普通词激活。未见稳定的单一语义或句法主题，可能主要反映词形或分词边界。

patterns.name: 跨词边界的词内片段
patterns.trigger: 词内部被标记的子串，如 «enc»«amp»«ment»、«s»«igm»«oid»、«settle»«ment»、«conform»«ations»、«IS»«Os»
patterns.context: 激活集中在单词的一部分或连续词素片段上；没有一个跨段稳定重复的完整词，且片段常处于不同词形或专名中。
patterns.domain: 多领域混合：新闻、代码、邮件、论坛、医学与学术文本

patterns.name: 代码中的标点与分隔符
patterns.context: 在 Python/PyTorch、Qt 代码及其周边标点、换行和缩进处出现；激活有时落在标识符内部。
patterns.domain: GitHub 与 StackExchange 编程内容

patterns.name: 连字符网址中的片段
patterns.context: 触发于由连字符连接的 URL 路径或域名片段，尤其是 Cloudflare 相关网址。

patterns.name: 专名、缩写或稀有词形的内部片段
patterns.context: 出现在专名、缩写或较长的低频词中；现有例子不足以确认特定语义类别是触发条件。
patterns.domain: 新闻、娱乐百科、法律邮件及生命科学/天文学论文

patterns.name: 普通词及常见短语片段
patterns.context: 少数段落中普通词也有激活，未见一致的句法或语义条件。

en.concept: Distributed sensitivity to word-internal subword fragments
en.description: All passages show sporadic subword activation within words, identifiers, or hyphenated strings. settlement in legal documents and sigmoid in machine-learning code recur, but other segmentations are scattered and difficult to group under a unified semantic theme.

patterns.name: Specific letter strings in tokenized spellings
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments within words or identifiers; many examples involve cross-boundary concatenation, mixed case, or unusually segmented fragments. There is no obvious shared meaning or fixed local context.
patterns.domain: Across news, code, legal documents, technical documents, and biomedical texts

patterns.name: Possible settlement / agreement strings
patterns.context: In uppercase legal document titles, words in amended settlement agreements or settlement proposals are marked in chunks; both passages contain something like “REVISED SETTLEMENT”.

patterns.name: sigmoid-related code fragments
patterns.context: In machine-learning code, the function name sigmoid is marked as split tokens; nearby context includes tensors, neural networks, or mask operations.

patterns.name: Concatenated -cloudflare- fragments in strings/identifiers
patterns.context: In hyphen-separated slugs in Cloudflare blog URLs, marking appears within words and near hyphens; the latter part also contains fragments such as smash and VPN.
patterns.domain: Hacker News links and webpage titles

patterns.name: Internal fragment in file-pointer terminology
patterns.context: A technical explanation of kernel file descriptors and fget_light(); marking falls within terms related to file pointers.

patterns.name: Tokenized fragments in Entrez/MMDDB biomedical names
patterns.context: In a biomedical database introduction, proper names, compounds, and format names are marked as split tokens.

patterns.name: Scattered ordinary word fragments in a news sentence
patterns.context: A news comment discussing an adjudication outcome and the rulemaking process; several ordinary words or suffixes activate separately, with no single continuous trigger phrase.

patterns.name: Sporadic fragments in a news report
patterns.context: Reports on a coach who experienced violence; people discuss putting it behind them and speak before reporters. Fragments are distributed across different words.

patterns.name: PyQt signal names and property fragments
patterns.context: In PyQt code, connects signals and slots involving signal names such as latest_update and previous message; marking is distributed within the library name and identifiers.

4_705.concept: 对词内子词片段的分布式敏感性
4_705.description: 全部段落都在词内、标识符内或连字符拼接处出现零散子词激活；法律文书中的 settlement、机器学习代码中的 sigmoid 有重复，但其余切分分散，难归为统一语义主题。

patterns.name: 分词拼写中的特定字母串
patterns.context: 激活落在单词或标识符内部的子词片段；不少例子是跨边界拼接、大小写混杂或以不寻常方式切分的片段。没有显而易见的统一词义或固定局部语境。
patterns.domain: 跨新闻、代码、法律文件、技术文档与生物医学文本

patterns.name: 疑似 settlement / agreement 字符串
patterns.context: 大写法律文书标题中，修订版和解协议或和解提案的词被分块标记；两段都出现近似“REVISED SETTLEMENT”。

patterns.name: sigmoid 相关代码片段
patterns.context: 机器学习代码中，sigmoid 函数名被拆分标记；周边包含张量、神经网络或掩码操作。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 与 Github 的编程讨论/代码

patterns.name: 字符串/标识符中的 -cloudflare- 拼接片段
patterns.context: Cloudflare 博客 URL 的连字符分隔 slug 中，词内部及连字符附近出现标记；后半还包含 smash、VPN 等片段。
patterns.domain: Hacker News 链接与网页标题

patterns.name: 文件指针术语的内部片段
patterns.context: 关于内核文件描述符和 fget_light() 的技术说明；标记落在 file pointer 相关词语的内部。

patterns.name: Entrez/MMDDB 生物医学名称的分词片段
patterns.context: 生物医学数据库介绍中，专名、复合词和格式名被拆分标记。
patterns.domain: NIH 生物医学数据库说明

patterns.name: 新闻句中分散的普通词片段
patterns.context: 讨论裁决结果及规则制定进程的新闻评论；多个普通词或词尾分别激活，没有单一连续触发短语。

patterns.name: 新闻报道中的零散片段
patterns.context: 报道教练遭遇暴力后，人物谈到把事情抛在身后，并在记者面前发言；片段分布在不同词语。

patterns.name: PyQt 信号名与属性片段
patterns.context: PyQt 代码中连接信号与槽，涉及 latest_update、previous message 等信号名；标记分布在库名及标识符内部。

en.description: Strong activation occurs on opening curly braces in code blocks, sun in sunlight contexts, microstructure in medicine, and the number 4, variable a, and the term sunflowers in mathematical/formal text. The pattern spans domains and has varied triggers.

patterns.name: Braces in code blocks
patterns.context: Activation falls on an opening curly brace, near a function call, object/parameter block, or the start of a code block; not all braces in code trigger it.
patterns.domain: StackExchange programming Q&A, JavaScript, Dart, and other code

patterns.name: The term sun
patterns.context: The term sun appears in natural-language contexts describing materials, surfaces, or objects exposed to sunlight.
patterns.domain: Everyday explanatory text in Pile-CC; sunflowers also appears in ArXiv mathematical text, but sun is not marked

patterns.name: Microstructure terminology
patterns.context: A medical term in a review's list of items, discussing the microscopic structure of tissue.

patterns.name: The number 4 in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: The number 4 in a formula string appears near an exponent or power; the context is insufficient to determine more specific conditions.

patterns.name: a in formal notation
patterns.context: Appears as part of formal mathematical/cryptographic notation in a database expression.
patterns.domain: ArXiv theoretical computer science or cryptography papers

patterns.name: The combinatorial structure sunflowers
patterns.context: Sunflowers is a term for a family of sets in mathematics; strong activation is marked only on the substring sun, possibly related to the sun-term pattern, though the semantic context differs.

4_864.description: 强激活分布于代码块左花括号、阳光语境中的 sun、医学 microstructure，以及数学/形式化文本中的数字4、变量a和术语sunflowers；模式跨领域且触发形式不一。

patterns.name: 代码块中的花括号
patterns.context: 激活落在左花括号上，周围是函数调用、对象/参数块或代码块的开头；并非所有代码中的花括号都触发。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 编程问答，JavaScript、Dart 等代码

patterns.name: sun 词项
patterns.context: 词项 sun 出现在描述材料、表面或物件受到阳光照射的自然语言语境中。
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 日常说明文字；ArXiv 数学文本中另有 sunflowers 一词，但未标记 sun

patterns.name: 微结构术语
patterns.context: 作为综述列举项目中的医学术语，讨论组织的微观结构。

patterns.name: 数学公式中的数字 4
patterns.context: 公式字符串中数字 4 位于指数或幂次位置附近；本例上下文不足以判断更具体条件。

patterns.name: 形式化记号中的 a
patterns.context: 作为形式化数学/密码学记号的一部分，出现在数据库表示式中。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 理论计算机科学或密码学论文

patterns.name: sunflowers 组合结构
patterns.context: sunflowers 是数学中的集合族术语；强激活只标在该词的 sun 子串上，可能与 sun 词项模式有关，但语义语境不同。

en.description: Activation shows several sporadic patterns: subword segmentation within words, references to research or training programs, code identifiers and comment structures, and microstructure in medical or materials contexts. There is no stable shared semantics or clear unified trigger across passages.

patterns.name: Within-word subword segmentation
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments or adjacent fragments within words; fragments may correspond to common suffixes, stems, or irregular segmentation, with no consistent meaning.
patterns.domain: Mixed: mathematics, medical papers, web text

patterns.name: Program-related references
patterns.context: Program refers variously to a training plan or research plan; trigger positions vary, and program itself is not always marked.

patterns.name: Identifiers and structures in code
patterns.context: Code snippets contain class names, identifiers, comments, or punctuation; activation concentrates on identifier fragments, parentheses, and comment openings.

patterns.name: Microstructure terminology
patterns.context: Microstructure of materials or tissue appears in discussions of medical histology or the properties of recording-media materials.

4_864.description: 激活呈现多种零散模式：单词内部子词切分、研究或培训 program 表述、代码标识符与注释结构，以及医学或材料语境中的 microstructure。不同段落间缺少稳定的共同语义或明确统一触发条件。

patterns.name: 词内子词切分位置
patterns.context: 激活落在单词内部的子词片段或相邻片段上；片段可能对应常见词尾、词干或不规则切分，未见统一词义。
patterns.domain: 混合：数学、医学论文、网页文字

patterns.name: program 相关表述
patterns.context: 出现 program，分别指培训计划或研究计划；触发位置并不一致，且 program 本身不总被标记。
patterns.domain: 培训文案、科研项目摘要

patterns.name: 代码中的标识符及结构
patterns.context: 代码片段中出现类名、标识符、注释或标点；激活集中于标识符片段、括号和注释开头。
patterns.domain: Dart/Flutter 风格代码、Github 示例注释

patterns.name: 微观结构术语
patterns.context: 材料或组织的 microstructure 处于医学组织学或记录介质材料性质的讨论中。

en.description: Activation mainly occurs on X in GitHub SPDX license lines. Two NIH passages also activate on the SP fragments in specialized and SPACE, possibly indicating a weak spelling-fragment association.

patterns.name: X in SPDX license identifiers
patterns.context: Mainly appears in SPDX-License-Identifier lines in GitHub source-code comments; the same license header is repeated multiple times.

patterns.name: SP / SPACE subword fragments
patterns.context: In NIH text, SPACE appears in “EXCEED THE SPACE PROVIDED,” and SPEC appears in “specialized”; these occur only in the two passages, with differing trigger positions and contexts.

4_864.description: 主要激活于 GitHub SPDX 许可证行中的 X；另有两段 NIH 文本激活在 SP 字符片段上，分别位于 specialized 和 SPACE，可能是弱的拼写片段关联。

patterns.name: SPDX 许可证标识中的 X
patterns.context: 主要出现在 GitHub 源码注释中的 SPDX-License-Identifier 行；相同许可证头重复出现多次。

patterns.name: SP / SPACE 字符片段
patterns.context: NIH 文本中，SPACE 出现在“EXCEED THE SPACE PROVIDED”里，SPEC 出现在“specialized”里；仅见于这两段，触发位置和语境并不一致。

en.description: Activation occurs on varied formatting cues: sentence-initial Up and bracketed headings in medical abstracts, uppercase length disclaimers, the mathematical infinity symbol, and a few web bylines and patent symbol strings. No single semantic theme spans all passages.

patterns.name: Expressions beginning with “Up to/ till”
patterns.context: At or near the start of a sentence, introduces an upper quantity limit, a time range, or a statement up to the present; activation concentrates on Up.

patterns.name: Space-limit disclaimer in uppercase text
patterns.context: A fixed uppercase disclaimer stating that the provided length or space has been exceeded; the same passage occurs repeatedly.

patterns.name: Infinity symbol in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: The infinity symbol appears in a mathematical formula or in natural-language text about a variable tending to negative infinity.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial brackets and abstract heading format
patterns.context: An abstract heading or item begins with square brackets followed by heading text; co-occurs with the “Up” pattern in medical abstracts.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial It statement structure
patterns.context: “It is known that …” introduces a general fact, followed by a medical risk statement.

patterns.name: Web bylines and disclaimer contexts
patterns.context: A blog post byline and commercial disclosures about affiliate links, commissions, and related matters.

patterns.name: Special-symbol strings in chemical formulas or patent numbers
patterns.context: Isolated punctuation, symbols, and alphanumeric combinations, possibly from chemical names or patent text; context is insufficient to confirm the specific trigger condition.

4_864.description: 激活分布于多种格式线索：医学摘要中的句首 Up 与方括号标题、大写篇幅免责声明、数学无穷符号，以及少量网页署名和专利符号串；没有单一语义主题贯穿全部片段。

patterns.name: “Up to/ till” 起始的表达
patterns.context: 句首或句首附近用来引出数量上限、时间范围或截至目前的陈述；激活集中在 Up。

patterns.name: 大写文本中的空格限制声明
patterns.context: 固定的大写免责声明，内容表示超出所提供的篇幅或空间；同一片段重复出现。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的无穷符号
patterns.context: 无穷符号出现在数学公式或关于变量趋于负无穷的自然语言说明中。

patterns.name: 句首方括号及摘要标题格式
patterns.context: 摘要标题或条目以方括号开头，随后接标题文字；与 “Up” 模式同现于医学摘要。

patterns.name: 句首 It 的陈述结构
patterns.context: 以 “It is known that …” 引出一般事实，后接医学风险陈述。

patterns.name: 网页作者署名与免责声明语境
patterns.context: 博客文章的署名及联盟链接、佣金等商业披露语句。

patterns.name: 化学式或专利编号中的特殊符号串
patterns.context: 孤立的标点、符号与字母数字组合，可能属于化学名称或专利文本片段；缺少足够上下文确认具体触发条件。

en.concept: Triggers in mathematical and technical-term fragments
en.description: Activation is distributed across mathematics, medicine, astrophysics, and patent corpora. Visible local triggers include tending to infinity, keyword formatting, technical terms, and formula fragments, but no single pattern explains all passages.

patterns.name: Tending-to-infinity symbols in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: A variable or parameter tends to infinity in a mathematical problem or expression; passage 5 also contains “\infty”, but its context is a point at infinity in projective space.
patterns.domain: Mathematical papers; mainly formulas, with one example from algebraic geometry

patterns.name: Percentage-style metallicity ranges
patterns.context: Globular clusters are grouped by iron abundance and thresholds are given.

patterns.name: Physiotherapist terminology
patterns.context: The trigger word is segmented and marked in a discussion of the therapeutic relationship and patient resources.

patterns.name: Locomotive-related terms
patterns.context: Describes motor overcurrent and locomotive engineers recording operating conditions.

patterns.name: Formatting in keyword sections
patterns.context: The keyword label at the end of a paper and the indentation, line breaks, and punctuation before it; keyword formatting varies slightly across passages.

patterns.name: Nuclear spin relaxation terminology
patterns.context: Discusses nuclear spin relaxation rates and dynamical spin structure factors.

patterns.name: Special mathematical word fragments
patterns.context: In an abstract on finite group theory, words are tokenized and marked as “Sy” and “low,” followed by discussion of p-subgroups.

patterns.name: Bold mathematical letters in formulas
patterns.context: Mathematical letters represent homogeneous elements in an algebraic expression; the passage also contains a keyword label.

patterns.name: The text fragment \infty in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: In passage 5, denotes a point at infinity in projective space, unlike the use for variables tending to infinity in passages 6 and 10.

patterns.name: Mathematical fragments not assigned to a clear pattern
patterns.context: Examples come from graph expansions, algebraic geometry, tiling problems, and the energy functional of the nonlinear Schrödinger equation; beyond the mathematical-paper context, no clear shared trigger pattern is evident.

4_864.concept: 数学与专业术语片段触发
4_864.description: 激活分散在数学、医学、天体物理和专利语料中。可见局部触发包括趋于无穷、关键词排版、专业词及公式片段，但没有单一模式能解释全部段落。

patterns.name: 数学公式中的趋向无穷符号
patterns.context: 在数学问题或表达式中，变量或参数趋向无穷；第5段也出现“\infty”，但其上下文是射影空间中的无穷远点。
patterns.domain: 数学论文；主要是数学公式，另有代数几何

patterns.name: 百分比式金属丰度区间
patterns.context: 把球状星团按铁丰度分组并给出阈值。

patterns.name: 生理治疗师术语
patterns.context: 谈论治疗关系和患者资源时，触发词被拆分标记。

patterns.name: 机车相关词语
patterns.context: 描述电动机超额定电流及机车工程师记录运行情况。

patterns.name: 关键词部分的排版
patterns.context: 文末关键词标签及其前面的缩进、换行和标点；不同段落中的关键词形式略有差异。

patterns.name: 核自旋弛豫术语
patterns.context: 讨论核自旋弛豫率及动力学自旋结构因子。

patterns.name: 特殊数学词语片段
patterns.context: 有限群论摘要中，词语被分词标记为“Sy”“low”，随后讨论 p-子群。

patterns.name: 公式中的粗体数学字母
patterns.context: 在代数表达式中以数学字母表示齐次元素；该段还包含关键词标签。

patterns.name: 数学公式中的 \infty 文字片段
patterns.context: 在第5段表示射影空间的无穷远点，与第6、10段变量趋于无穷的用法不同。

patterns.name: 未能归入明确模式的数学片段
patterns.context: 分别来自图展开、代数几何、平铺问题和非线性薛定谔方程能量泛函；除数学论文语境外未见共同的明确触发模式。

en.concept: Formulas and parameters in scientific papers
en.description: Activation samples span diverse paper topics. A notable shared surface feature is formulas, Greek letters, subscripts, values, and units in scientific papers; other local patterns include particle spectra, material parameters, biophysical responses, astrophysical mass ratios, and mathematical definitions.

patterns.name: Energy spectra and particle-physics quantities
patterns.context: Discusses the energy spectra of neutrinos, muons, or charged-current events and related parameters

patterns.name: Values, units, and parameterized expressions
patterns.context: Reports measurements, fit results, error ranges, or physical quantities in scientific papers; no clear cross-domain shared terminology is evident

patterns.name: Signed mathematical symbols and formula fragments
patterns.context: Mathematical definitions or probability-distribution statements, with formulas interspersed with prose

patterns.name: Materials and structural characterization
patterns.context: Reports interatomic distances, X-ray wavelengths, or electronic structure/subband properties

patterns.name: Poroelasticity and pH response
patterns.context: Describes changes in excitation frequency, stress amplitude, and phase with bath-solution pH

patterns.name: Interstellar dust and mass ratios
patterns.context: Reports the dust-to-gas mass ratio and related astrophysical parameters

patterns.name: Results presented only as parameters in context
patterns.context: Solutions, cross-section units, and phase angles in a results section; the available passages are insufficient to group these with other topics

patterns.name: Statistical distribution definition
patterns.context: States that the number of successes in independent trials follows a binomial distribution

4_864.description: 激活样本横跨多种论文主题，较明显的共同表面特征是科学论文中的公式、希腊字母、下标、数值和单位；另有粒子能谱、材料参数、生物物理响应、天体质量比及数学定义等局部模式。

patterns.name: 能谱与粒子物理量
patterns.context: 讨论中微子、缪子或带电流事件的能谱及相关参数

patterns.name: 数值、单位及参数化表达
patterns.context: 科学论文中报告测量值、拟合结果、误差范围或物理量；未见明显跨领域的共同术语

patterns.name: 带符号的数学符号与公式片段
patterns.trigger: “$\Gamma_{!X!}(A)$”“$V\subseteq X$”“$B(\nu,\rho)$”及其中的希腊字母、下标和公式标记
patterns.context: 数学定义或概率分布陈述，公式与正文交替出现

patterns.name: 材料与结构表征
patterns.context: 报告原子间距、X 射线波长或电子结构/子带性质

patterns.name: 多孔弹性与 pH 响应
patterns.context: 描述激发频率、应力幅值和相位随浴液 pH 的变化

patterns.name: 星际尘埃与质量比
patterns.context: 报告尘埃与气体质量比及相关天体物理参数

patterns.name: 上下文中仅呈现参数结果
patterns.trigger: “two solutions”“pb”“phase angle”及不完整的拟合参数串
patterns.context: 结果段中的解、截面单位和相位角；现有片段不足以和其他主题归并

patterns.name: 统计分布定义
patterns.context: 说明独立试验中成功次数服从二项分布

en.concept: Structural symbols in formulas and code
en.description: Strong activation is distributed across numbers, variables, operations, and parentheses in mathematical formulas, and also across fragments adjacent to numbers or formatting symbols in code and markup. There is no single stable semantic theme.

patterns.name: Numerical/variable symbols in formulas
patterns.context: Mathematical formulas or nearby text, especially adjacent to variables, subscripts, parentheses, and equations; spans linear algebra, analysis, and theoretical physics

patterns.name: Right parentheses and closing symbols in formulas
patterns.context: Appear at the beginning or end of formula fragments in LaTeX mathematical expressions; trigger forms are not fully consistent

patterns.name: Number formatting in Shell command text
patterns.context: A bash script uses a date format to obtain minutes and a comment explains replacing leading zeros with underscores

patterns.name: Numeric output in interactive Python examples
patterns.context: In Python REPL examples, numbers appear near prompt indentation, library calls, or expressions related to distance matrices

patterns.name: Numeric style values in HTML tags and attributes
patterns.context: Adjacent to tags, attributes, or indentation in HTML snippets; examples include heading levels, navigation bars, and font-size control elements

4_864.concept: 公式与代码中的结构符号
4_864.description: 强激活分散于数学公式的数字、变量、运算及括号，也见于代码和标记语言中与数字或格式符号相邻的片段；没有单一稳定的语义主题。

patterns.name: 公式中的数值/变量符号
patterns.context: 数学公式或公式邻近文本，尤其紧邻变量、下标、括号和等式；跨线性代数、分析及理论物理内容

patterns.name: 公式中的右括号与闭合符号
patterns.context: LaTeX 数学表达式中出现在公式片段开头或闭合处；触发点形态不完全一致

patterns.name: Shell 命令文本中的数字格式
patterns.context: bash 脚本用 date 格式获取分钟，并在注释中说明下划线替换前导零

patterns.name: 交互式 Python 示例中的数字输出
patterns.context: Python REPL 示例中，数字出现在提示符缩进、库调用或距离矩阵相关表达式附近

patterns.name: HTML 标签及属性中的数字样式值
patterns.context: HTML 片段中与标签、属性或缩进相邻；如标题级别、导航栏及字号控制元素

en.description: Mainly activates on X-ray and its contexts in observations, astrophysics, and imaging. Other examples include dimensional suffixes, paper metadata, digits in GRB identifiers, and formula-formatting tokens; some triggers may reflect local subword or formatting effects.

patterns.name: X-ray astronomy and observations
patterns.context: The trigger appears in contexts describing X-ray light curves, sources, peaks, emissions, or imaging systems; “X-ray” is sometimes split into multiple tokens.
patterns.domain: Astrophysics, astronomical observations, and medical-imaging patents; scientific papers

patterns.name: Dimensional suffix
patterns.context: Appears in the physical term “the -dimensional phase space”; the marked trigger token in this example is dimensional.

patterns.name: Bibliographic metadata and author markers
patterns.context: Structured metadata such as author names, reference filenames, and subject classifications.
patterns.domain: Paper metadata or bibliographic export formats

patterns.name: Digits in GRB strings
patterns.context: Appears in the gamma-ray burst identifier “GRB 080517”; activation falls on the numeric token, not an explicit semantic word.

patterns.name: Formula-formatting markers
patterns.context: Appears near LaTeX mathematical formulas, their formatting commands, exponents, or labels; the formulas discuss X-ray emission from galaxy clusters.
patterns.domain: LaTeX formulas in theoretical astrophysics papers

4_864.description: 主要对 X-ray/X 射线及其在观测、天体物理和成像中的语境激活；另见维数词尾、论文元数据、GRB 编号数字和公式排版 token，部分触发可能是局部子词或格式效应。

patterns.name: X 射线天文与观测
patterns.context: 触发词出现在描述 X 射线光变曲线、源、峰值、发射或成像系统的语境中；有时「X-ray」被拆成多个 token。
patterns.domain: 天体物理、天文观测及医学成像专利；科学论文

patterns.name: 维数词尾
patterns.context: 出现在“the -dimensional phase space”这类物理术语中；本例中标记的触发 token 是 dimensional。
patterns.domain: 理论物理、统计力学论文

patterns.name: 文献元数据与作者标记
patterns.context: 作者姓名、参考文献文件名与学科分类等结构化元数据中。
patterns.domain: 论文元数据或文献导出格式

patterns.name: GRB 字符串中的数字
patterns.context: 出现在伽马射线暴编号“GRB 080517”中；激活落在编号的数字 token，而非明确的语义词上。
patterns.domain: 天体物理论文标题与关键词

patterns.name: 公式排版标记
patterns.context: 出现在 LaTeX 数学公式及其排版命令、指数或标签附近；这些 token 所在公式讨论星系团的 X 射线发射。
patterns.domain: 理论天体物理论文中的 LaTeX 公式

en.description: Activation is most prominent on viewed, especially viewed from, and related uses of view. Other examples are scattered across discussions of operators, delayed early dynamics, code punctuation and indentation, table numbers, laboratory formatting, formula symbols, positive/negative components, and Markdown structure, with no unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: viewed with from
patterns.context: The passive participle viewed is followed by from, introducing a viewpoint or reference object

patterns.name: View queries and interface references
patterns.context: Related to images, results, or web/API views; may be a form of viewed or view in a URL parameter

patterns.name: Python identity/equality operators
patterns.context: Discusses semantic differences between equality or identity operators in Python and JavaScript

patterns.name: Phrase about delayed early dynamics
patterns.context: Modifies the dynamics of a viral homolog; activation covers a subword fragment of delayed

patterns.name: Code indentation and delimiters
patterns.context: Semicolons, line breaks, and indentation co-occur in code snippets

patterns.name: Tables/data formats dense with numbers and symbols
patterns.context: Aligned numeric columns or dotted fill, showing table, output, or text-formatting structure

patterns.name: Line breaks and units in laboratory procedures
patterns.context: A methods passage is formatted with headings, line breaks, and temperature units

patterns.name: Formula-formatting symbols
patterns.context: Mathematical formulas or symbolic expressions in patent background text

patterns.name: Quoted positive/negative signs or component labels
patterns.context: Quotation marks identify two components or signs in an expression for physical-quantity evolution

patterns.name: Markdown document structure
patterns.context: A Markdown page comprising a heading divider, italicized note, and link

4_864.description: 激活最显著地落在 viewed（尤其 viewed from）及相关 view 用法；其余分散在运算符讨论、延迟早期、代码标点缩进、表格数字、实验室排版、公式符号、正负分量和 Markdown 结构中，未见统一语义模式。

patterns.name: viewed 搭配 from
patterns.context: 被动分词 viewed 后接 from 引出的观察视角或参照对象

patterns.name: view 查询与界面引用
patterns.context: 与图像、结果或网页/API 视图有关；可能是 viewed 的词形变体，也可能是 URL 参数中的 view

patterns.name: Python 身份/相等运算符
patterns.context: 讨论 Python 与 JavaScript 中相等或身份运算符的语义差异

patterns.name: 延迟早期动力学短语
patterns.context: 修饰病毒同源物的动力学；激活覆盖 delayed 的子词片段

patterns.name: 代码缩进与分隔符
patterns.context: 代码片段中分号、换行和缩进共同出现

patterns.name: 数字与符号密集的表格/数据格式
patterns.context: 对齐的数值列或点状填充，呈现表格、输出或文本排版结构

patterns.name: 实验室流程中的换行和单位
patterns.context: 实验方法段落以标题、换行及温度单位呈现

patterns.name: 公式排版符号
patterns.context: 专利背景中的数学公式或符号化表达

patterns.name: 带引号的正负号/分量标记
patterns.context: 物理量演化式中用引号标示两个分量或符号

patterns.name: Markdown 文档结构
patterns.context: 标题分隔线、斜体说明和链接构成的 Markdown 页面文档

en.description: Activation is scattered across symbols and local word fragments: it is prominent in the “as of” date phrase, hyphens/plus-minus signs, and code punctuation; other sporadic examples include periods and line breaks, English word fragments, and ancient scripts. No single semantic pattern explains them.

patterns.name: Hyphens, dashes, and minus signs
patterns.context: Symbols occur in programming comparisons/strings, positive and negative components in mathematical formulas, or hyphenated words; trigger positions differ.

patterns.name: “as of” date expression
patterns.context: The fixed phrase “as of” occurs before a date or time point; it is followed by a specific date and repeats in multiple passages.

patterns.name: Sentence-final periods and line breaks
patterns.context: Sparse markings near periods or line breaks; they occur in both formula explanations and general passages, and it is uncertain whether they are stable triggers.

patterns.name: Punctuation and structural boundaries in code
patterns.context: Activation occurs near semicolons, square brackets, curly braces, or quotation marks in code lines; these appear alongside hyphen-like markers.

patterns.name: Fragments within or at the end of English words
patterns.context: Activation falls on local substrings of English words, but meanings and positions vary across passages, with no shared lexical semantics evident.
patterns.domain: Forums, scientific papers, news, and other text

patterns.name: Characters in ancient scripts or proper names
patterns.context: Appears in encyclopedia entries about the South Arabian script and its transliteration.

patterns.name: Symbol boundaries in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Symbols themselves strongly activate when describing the positive and negative components in the evolution of Q.

patterns.name: Formatting markers in ordinal dates
patterns.context: Ordinal numerals in dates appear adjacent to superscript suffixes.

4_864.description: 激活分散在多种符号与局部词片上：突出于 as of 日期短语、连字符/加减号及代码标点；另有句点换行、英语词片和古文字等零散例子，无法由单一语义模式解释。

patterns.name: 连字符、破折号与减号
patterns.context: 符号处于编程比较/字符串、数学公式的正负分量或单词内部连字符中；触发点不完全相同。

patterns.name: “as of”日期表达
patterns.context: 日期或时间点前的固定短语“as of”，后接具体日期；多个段落重复出现。
patterns.domain: 新闻、科学报告、百科条目

patterns.name: 句末句点与换行
patterns.context: 句点或换行附近的稀疏标记；在公式说明及一般段落中均出现，是否为稳定触发条件不确定。

patterns.name: 代码中的标点与结构边界
patterns.context: 代码行中的分号、方括号、花括号或引号附近有激活；和连字符类标记同时出现。

patterns.name: 英语词内部或词尾片段
patterns.context: 激活落在英语词的局部子串上，但跨段词义和位置不同，未见共同词汇语义。

patterns.name: 古文字或专名中的字符
patterns.context: 出现在南阿拉伯文字及其转写的百科条目中。

patterns.name: 数学公式中的符号边界
patterns.context: 公式描述 Q 演化所含的正、负分量时，符号本身强烈激活。

patterns.name: 日期序数的格式标记
patterns.context: 日期中的序数数字与上标后缀相邻出现。

en.concept: Symbols and markers in technical text
en.description: Activations are scattered across code and technical text, often on operators, quoted symbols (especially hyphens and plus/minus signs), string boundaries, and integer names. Other examples include “viewed” in a patent and “of/1991” in a paper, which are difficult to unify with code patterns.

patterns.name: Equality and comparison operators
patterns.context: Comparing equality in code or technical discussion; also includes explanations of comparison semantics across different languages.

patterns.name: Integer type names
patterns.context: The set of integers appears in a mathematical definition, especially as the codomain of a mapping.

patterns.name: Code strings and regular-expression construction
patterns.context: Code concatenates strings, constructs regular expressions, or handles function definitions; activations fall on string boundaries and related code fragments.

patterns.name: Hyphen options in quotes
patterns.context: Code compares a single hyphen as a command-line argument or string value.

patterns.name: Experimental symbols in quotes
patterns.context: Figure captions compare a minus sign with experimental condition labels.

patterns.name: Plus/minus components
patterns.context: Theoretical physics formulas discuss positive and negative components of evolution, with the symbols emphasized in quotes.

patterns.name: Hyphen in an ID character set
patterns.context: A code error message states that IDs may contain digits, hyphens, and lowercase letters, listing the hyphen as a literal character.

patterns.name: Braces and hyphens in character parsing
patterns.context: Code parses a string character by character, checking for an opening brace or hyphen.

patterns.name: Directional observation in patent prose
patterns.context: Describes a conveyed object as aligned with the longitudinal axis of a screw conveyor when viewed from above.

patterns.name: Lipid terminology and year phrase
patterns.context: A lipid metabolism term and a year phrase appear in a figure caption or scientific prose; the trigger is unclear.

4_864.concept: 技术文本中的符号与标记
4_864.description: 激活分散于代码和科技文本，常落在运算符、引号包围的符号（尤其连字符、加减号）、字符串边界及整数名称；另有专利中的“viewed”和论文中的“of/1991”，难与代码模式统一。

patterns.name: 等号与比较运算符
patterns.context: 代码或技术讨论中比较相等性；也包括对不同语言比较语义的说明。

patterns.name: 整数类型名称
patterns.context: 数学定义中出现整数集合，尤其作为映射的陪域。

patterns.name: 代码字符串与正则表达式构造
patterns.context: 代码中拼接字符串、构造正则表达式或处理函数定义；激活落在字符串边界和相关代码片段上。

patterns.name: 引号中的连字符选项
patterns.context: 代码将单个连字符作为命令行参数或字符串值进行比较。

patterns.name: 引号中的实验符号
patterns.context: 实验图表说明中，将减号与实验条件标签并列比较。

patterns.name: 加减号分量
patterns.context: 理论物理公式中讨论演化所包含的正、负分量，符号带引号强调。

patterns.name: ID 字符集合中的连字符
patterns.context: 代码错误提示描述 ID 可含数字、连字符和小写字母，连字符作为字面字符列举。

patterns.name: 字符解析中的括号与连字符
patterns.context: 代码逐字符解析字符串，检查开头的大括号或连字符。

patterns.name: 专利叙述中的方向观察
patterns.context: 描述输送物从上方观察时与螺旋输送机纵轴对齐。

patterns.name: 脂质术语与年份短语
patterns.context: 图注或科学叙述中出现脂质代谢术语及年份短语；触发原因不明显。

en.description: Primarily responds to operators, delimiters, and dense symbols in code, as well as numbers, units, and specialized notation in scientific text; also appears in wording for material preparation steps and discussion of verbatim quotations.

patterns.name: Code operators and punctuation
patterns.context: Operators, delimiters, brackets, and parameter assignments appear densely in code or regular expressions.

patterns.name: Scientific data and parameter notation
patterns.context: Numbers occur alongside specialized symbols, units, or terms in chemistry, experimental parameters, or mathematical definitions.

patterns.name: Process steps and material terminology
patterns.context: Describes sample treatment or preparation procedures, including step order and material names.

patterns.name: Paraphrase and quotation wording
patterns.context: Discusses whether transmitted content is quoted verbatim and the distinction between quotation and paraphrase.
patterns.domain: Religious historical sources or discussions of transmission

4_864.concept: 结构化技术文本中的标记
4_864.description: 主要对代码中的运算符、分隔符和密集符号，以及科学文本中的数值、单位与专门记法起反应；另见材料制备步骤措辞和讨论逐字引述的表达。

patterns.name: 代码运算符与标点
patterns.context: 代码或正则表达式中，运算符、分隔符、括号及参数赋值等符号密集出现

patterns.name: 科学数据与参数记法
patterns.context: 化学、实验参数或数学定义中，数字与专门符号、单位或术语并列

patterns.name: 工艺步骤与材料术语
patterns.context: 描述样品处理或制备流程，出现步骤顺序和材料名称

patterns.name: 转述与引文措辞
patterns.context: 讨论传述内容是否逐字引用，以及引文与转述的区别

en.description: Activations are scattered across multiple formats: medical thresholds, numbers and units, Objective-C format strings, MRI echo/section terminology, and regular expressions and LaTeX. A possible commonality is sensitivity to structured symbols, delimiters, and nearby content, but the patterns are not fully unified.

patterns.name: Inequality and comparison symbols
patterns.context: Comparison symbols express thresholds for age, years, number of ribs, and similar quantities; numbers and units often occur nearby, though not every instance is fully marked.

patterns.name: Numbers, measurement units, and statistical values
patterns.context: Values occur near units, demographic data, or parameters, often in abstracts describing methods, results, and thresholds.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts and medical imaging methods

patterns.name: Objective-C format strings and object output
patterns.context: Activations occur near format specifiers, string formatting, and printing object information in Objective-C code.

patterns.name: Section and echo in medical terminology
patterns.context: In MRI acquisition parameter contexts, terminology appears alongside colons, commas, units, and values.

patterns.name: Punctuation-dense regular-expression symbol sequences
patterns.context: Multiple escape characters, quantifiers, parentheses, and vertical bars appear consecutively, forming regular expressions or similar pattern text.

patterns.name: LaTeX mathematical expressions and typesetting commands
patterns.context: Alignment symbols at line beginnings, superscript and subscript variables, and spacing/typesetting commands appear in equation environments.
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematics or technical paper source

4_864.concept: 结构化符号与格式文本
4_864.description: 激活分散在多种格式中：医学阈值、数字和单位，Objective-C 格式字符串，MRI 的 echo/section 术语，以及正则表达式和 LaTeX。共同点可能是对结构化符号、分隔符及其邻近内容敏感，但各模式并不完全统一。

patterns.name: 不等号与比较关系符号
patterns.context: 比较符号用于表达年龄、年限、肋骨数量等阈值；符号附近常有数字和单位，但不是每处都完整标记。

patterns.name: 数字、计量单位与统计数值
patterns.context: 数值和单位、人口统计资料或参数相邻，常见于摘要中的方法、结果及阈值描述。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要及医学影像方法

patterns.name: Objective-C 格式化字符串及对象输出
patterns.context: Objective-C 代码中，格式占位符、字符串格式化及打印对象信息附近出现激活。

patterns.name: 医学术语中的 section 与 echo
patterns.trigger: “single-section multispin echo”“stepped echo time”“echo spacing”“acquisition matrix”
patterns.context: MRI 采集参数语境，术语与冒号、逗号、单位及数值并列。

patterns.name: 标点密集的正则表达式符号序列
patterns.context: 多个转义符、量词、括号和竖线连续排列，构成正则表达式或类似模式的文本。

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学表达式与排版命令
patterns.context: 行首对齐符号、上标下标变量及间距/排版命令出现在公式环境中。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学或技术论文源码

en.concept: Structural and syntactic cues across domains
en.description: Activations are scattered across papers and code, often on punctuation, function words, and formal research prose. Specific content includes astrophysics, biophysics, paper cross-references, and Markdown, Shell, Python, and Objective-C code; no unified specialized topic is apparent.

patterns.name: Quotation marks, parentheses, and marker symbols
patterns.context: Appear at text boundaries, in code syntax, citations, or mathematical expressions; both symbols and neighboring tokens are activated in multiple excerpts.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain; paper typesetting, code, and mathematical text

patterns.name: English function words and syntactic connections
patterns.context: Often occur in English phrases, clauses, or coordination structures, suggesting sporadic responses to local syntax and frequent function words, but with substantial variation across contexts.
patterns.domain: English text in papers, code comments, and other sources

patterns.name: Methods, reporting, and research statements in academic papers
patterns.context: Formal statements in research papers describing objectives, prior findings, samples, or analytical steps.
patterns.domain: Astrophysics, biophysics, and dust-radiation research papers

patterns.name: Galaxies, celestial objects, and astronomical observation terms
patterns.context: Contexts involving galaxies, celestial object classes, observational samples, or astronomical catalogs.

patterns.name: Segmented citations and section/table references
patterns.context: Cross-references to sections, tables, or bibliography labels in papers, often accompanied by numbers and parentheses.

patterns.name: Thick- versus thin-shell model comparison
patterns.context: Repeatedly compares thick-shell and thin-shell models and reports the corresponding electron density.

patterns.name: Ion and cell-membrane transport mechanisms
patterns.context: Diffusion of ions and water across the cell wall, and mechanisms by which cells expel NaCl.
patterns.domain: Biophysics and cell physiology research plan

patterns.name: Markdown paragraph-processing code
patterns.context: Code defines or modifies GitHub-flavored Markdown paragraph parsing rules, including regular expressions.

patterns.name: Command-line arguments and path handling
patterns.context: Shell startup scripts or Python methods branch based on arguments, paths, and file status.
patterns.domain: Github source code and command-line tools

patterns.name: Objective-C image object operations
patterns.context: Code reads the number of images, shuffles them, and prints the result.

patterns.name: Dust spinning and radiative transfer
patterns.context: Discusses the effects of gas ionization state, dust grain spinning, and radiative transfer on dust emission.

4_864.concept: 多领域文本中的结构与语法线索
4_864.description: 激活分散于论文和代码，常落在标点、功能词及正式研究表述；具体内容涵盖天体物理、生物物理、论文交叉引用，以及 Markdown、Shell、Python、Objective-C 代码，未见统一专门主题。

patterns.name: 引号、括号及标记符号
patterns.context: 在文本边界、代码语法、引用或数学表达式中出现；多个片段中符号与邻近 token 都有激活。
patterns.domain: 跨领域；论文排版、代码及数学文本

patterns.name: 英文功能词与句法连接
patterns.context: 常见于英文短语、从句或并列结构中，似乎对局部句法和高频功能词有零散响应，但不同语境差异较大。
patterns.domain: 论文 prose 与代码注释等英文文本

patterns.name: 学术论文中的方法、报告与研究表述
patterns.context: 研究论文中描述研究目的、既有发现、样本或分析步骤的正式表述。
patterns.domain: 天体物理、生物物理及尘埃辐射研究论文

patterns.name: 星系、天体与天文观测术语
patterns.context: 围绕星系、天体类别、观测样本或天文目录的语境。

patterns.name: 分段引用及章节、表格指引
patterns.context: 论文中指向章节、表格或文献标签的交叉引用，常伴随数字和括号符号。

patterns.name: shell 厚薄模型对照
patterns.context: 重复比较厚壳与薄壳模型，并报告相应电子密度。

patterns.name: 离子与细胞膜转运机制
patterns.context: 细胞壁内外离子和水的扩散，以及细胞排出 NaCl 的机制。
patterns.domain: 生物物理与细胞生理研究计划

patterns.name: Markdown 段落处理代码
patterns.context: 代码中定义或修改 GitHub-flavored Markdown 段落解析规则，包含正则表达式。

patterns.name: 命令行参数与路径处理
patterns.context: Shell 启动脚本或 Python 方法根据参数、路径和文件状态分支处理。
patterns.domain: Github 源代码与命令行工具

patterns.name: Objective-C 图像对象操作
patterns.context: 读取图像数量、打乱图像并打印结果的代码片段。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 上的 Objective-C 编程问答

patterns.name: 尘埃自旋与辐射转移
patterns.trigger: «spinning motion»、«grains»、«gas ionisation state»、«radiative transfer»、«spinning dust emission»
patterns.context: 讨论气体电离状态、尘埃粒子自旋及辐射转移对尘埃发射的影响。

en.description: Activations are scattered across medical subword fragments, code punctuation and line breaks, academic paper structure terms, mathematical logic symbols, and threshold comparisons; there is no single stable semantic trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Word-final or internal fragments in medical terminology
patterns.context: Medical text concerning infection, osteomyelitis, or joint replacement treatment; strongest activation is on «brid» in de«brid»ement.

patterns.name: Punctuation and syntax tokens in code
patterns.context: Appears in code, regular expressions, or code comments; trigger points are often line breaks, operators, quotation marks, and punctuation. Also includes variable fragments «numbers», «At».
patterns.domain: StackExchange programming Q&A and GitHub code

patterns.name: Paper structure and discourse terms
patterns.context: Academic paper body or conclusion discussing models, structure, results, discussion, and section organization.

patterns.name: Mathematical definitions and logical symbols
patterns.context: Functions, distance axioms, or definitional conditions expressed with mathematical symbols.
patterns.domain: Mathematics papers or formalized philosophical text

patterns.name: Threshold comparisons
patterns.context: Age or duration categories expressed as comparison conditions such as “> or = 9 years”.

4_864.description: 激活分散于医学词片段、代码标点与换行、学术论文结构用语、数学逻辑符号及阈值比较表达；没有单一稳定的语义触发模式。

patterns.name: 医学术语中的词尾或词内片段
patterns.context: 感染、骨髓炎或关节置换治疗相关的医学文本；其中尤以 de«brid»ement（清创）中的 «brid» 激活最强。
patterns.domain: 医学论文摘要与生物医学论文

patterns.name: 代码中的标点与语法 token
patterns.context: 出现在代码、正则表达式或代码注释中，触发点多为换行、运算符、引号及标点；也包括变量片段 «numbers»、«At»。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 编程问答与 GitHub 代码

patterns.name: 论文结构与论述用语
patterns.trigger: « discussions»、« section»、« conclusions»、« models»、« pattern»、« show»、« evolutions»
patterns.context: 学术论文正文或结尾，涉及模型、结构、结果、讨论和章节安排。

patterns.name: 数学定义与逻辑符号
patterns.context: 用数学符号表述函数、距离公理或定义条件。
patterns.domain: 数学论文或哲学形式化文本

patterns.name: 阈值比较表达
patterns.context: 年龄或年限类别以“> or = 9 years”一类比较条件呈现。

en.description: Activation patterns are scattered: “It is hoped” in research plans, verbs of academic argument, legal dispute terms, patent description terms, numerical symbols, and several internal word fragments and heading markers; no unified semantic trigger condition is apparent.

patterns.name: “It is hoped” after expectations, arguments, or plans
patterns.context: The preceding text describes research objectives, experimental plans, or mechanisms, followed by “It is hoped” to express an expected outcome; activation is concentrated on hoped.
patterns.domain: Research grant abstracts, biomedical research plans

patterns.name: Claim verbs in argumentative or debate text
patterns.context: Introduces an argument or claim made by another party or the author; argued/claimed are the most strongly activated tokens in two paragraphs.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, including physics and signal processing

patterns.name: Disputed status in legal documents
patterns.context: Appears in a federal civil litigation opinion, referring to a matter disputed by the parties; the word happens to be a strongly activated token near a paragraph boundary.

patterns.name: Step markers in procedural descriptions
patterns.context: Patent background text describes a programming pulse verification process and introduces a figure; activation is concentrated in an internal word fragment.

patterns.name: Numbers and comparison symbols in numerical or symbolic expressions
patterns.context: Astrophysics text describes possible observed radiation, with strong activation on a mathematical/numerical expression.

patterns.name: Internal word fragment in a Dutch parliamentary heading
patterns.context: Appears in a Dutch heading about gender equality in the European Parliament, followed by a line break and speaker marker; no local semantic cue shared with the other excerpts is apparent.

patterns.name: Word-final or terminological fragments in general academic text
patterns.context: Appears in discussions of sparsity and comparisons of constitutive relations; activation is scattered across word endings, abbreviations, or internal term fragments, with no clear shared semantics.

patterns.name: Terminological fragments about perception and conceptual content
patterns.context: Discusses proprioception, perception, and nonconceptual content; multiple perception-related words are marked, but activation is especially concentrated on an internal fragment in “nonconceptual”.
patterns.domain: Philosophy papers, perception and consciousness research

4_864.description: 激活模式分散：研究计划中的“It is hoped”、学术论证动词、法律争议词、专利说明词、数值符号，以及若干词内片段和标题标记；尚无统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 预期、论证或计划之后的「It is hoped」
patterns.context: 前文说明研究目标、实验方案或机制，随后用“It is hoped”表达预期结果；标记集中在 hoped。
patterns.domain: 科研资助摘要、生物医学研究计划

patterns.name: 争论或论证文本中的主张动词
