4_1246.concept: 多语境英文片段与格式边界
4_1246.description: 激活分散于多种语境：普通英文连接词和换行边界、数字与标点密集的科学文本、网站及法律叙述、开源评论、地理统计和结构化标注；未见稳定的单一语义触发模式。

patterns.name: 分词边界处的 to
patterns.context: 出现在句中，用于不定式或目的结构；后续接动词短语

patterns.name: X射线观测中的数字与标点
patterns.context: 数值、符号和天文学术语交错，描述X射线源及观测样本

patterns.name: 网站隐私政策用语
patterns.trigger: « and»、« social»、« media»、« our»、« traffic»、« see»
patterns.context: Cookie提示中列举网站用途并引导读者查看政策

patterns.name: 执法叙述中的扣押与物证
patterns.context: 叙述信用卡等物品在嫌疑人住所或公文包中被发现、扣押

patterns.name: 天体物理中的时间尺度与恒星形成
patterns.trigger: « our»、« H»、« star»、« last»、« sim»、« Gyrs»
patterns.context: 讨论恒星形成率及其在宇宙历史中的变化

patterns.name: FOSS社区中的群体行为评论
patterns.context: 论坛评论讨论独立开发者及开源社区中某些人或群体的行为

patterns.name: 土地面积比例的统计表达
patterns.context: 用百分比列出建成区、水域和未利用土地，并进一步描述建成区

patterns.name: 标注数据中的标点符号标签
patterns.context: 标点 token 与语法类别及属性字段交替出现
patterns.domain: Github上的结构化标注或代码数据

patterns.name: 超新星回声的亮度与距离
patterns.trigger: « resolved»、« LE»、« sim»、« pc»、« SN»、« echo»、« luminous»
patterns.context: 比较超新星回声的空间尺度和亮度，并涉及成像观测

en.description: Activations are scattered across English function words and syntactic fragments, LaTeX table code, scientific notation and units, subwords in proper names, and local fragments in legal, statistical, and biographical narratives; the contexts lack consistent semantic trigger conditions.

patterns.name: English function words and function-word sequences
patterns.context: These common words occur in continuous English narrative, often with syntactic links or auxiliary verbs; however, activation may also fall on marked subwords.
patterns.domain: Philosophical discussion, biography, law, scholarly papers

patterns.name: LaTeX formatting and command fragments
patterns.context: Near table environments, line breaks, and image-insertion commands, activation spans whitespace, brackets, commands, and their arguments.

patterns.name: Values, units, and scientific notation
patterns.context: Numbers and adjacent mathematical markers, units, or percent signs; appears in astrophysical data and timescale descriptions.

patterns.name: Subwords in proper names and place names
patterns.context: Subword fragments within institution names, place names, or common words show no stable proper-name semantics; the marked positions may be influenced by subword tokenization.

patterns.name: Legal evidence and seized items
patterns.context: Factual narratives describe credit cards, evidence, and the process of finding or confiscating them.

patterns.name: Comparative legal term in law
patterns.context: In the phrase “lesser included offense”, “lesser” is split and marked; the phrase discusses a lesser included offense.

patterns.name: Statistical learning terminology
patterns.context: An apostrophe followed by a possessive suffix refers to the learnability of a variable-importance method, but the activated fragment is short.

patterns.name: Concept of defiance in philosophy
patterns.context: Discusses defiance in the ordinary sense, especially the relationship between general rules or expectations and acts of defiance.

patterns.name: Biography and career history
patterns.context: Describes a person studying and being hired in different places and appearing in a role; may overlap with activations on similar function words in other passages.

4_1246.description: 激活分散于英文虚词与句法片段、LaTeX表格代码、科学记数与单位、专名子词，以及法律、统计和人物叙述中的局部词片段；各处缺少一致语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 英文功能词与虚词串
patterns.trigger: « there»、« to»、« be»、« must»、« would»、« the»、« and»、« with»
patterns.context: 这些常见词出现在连续英文叙述中，常伴随句法连接或辅助动词；但激活位置也可能落在被标记的子词上。
patterns.domain: 哲学论述、人物传记、法律、学术论文

patterns.name: LaTeX排版与命令片段
patterns.context: 表格环境、换行和图像插入命令附近，激活跨越空白、括号、命令及其参数。

patterns.name: 数值、量纲与科学记号
patterns.context: 数字及其邻接的数学标记、单位或百分号；出现在天体物理数据和时间尺度描述中。

patterns.name: 专名与地名中的子词
patterns.context: 机构名、地名或普通词的词内片段，未显示稳定的专名语义；标记位置可能受子词切分影响。
patterns.domain: 学术论文致谢及法律引文

patterns.name: 法律证据与被扣押物品
patterns.context: 描述信用卡、证据及其发现或查获过程的事实叙述。

patterns.name: 法律中的比较级法律术语
patterns.context: 短语“lesser included offense”中，“lesser”被拆分标记，讨论较轻的包含罪名。

patterns.name: 统计学习术语
patterns.context: 撇号加所有格词尾，指向变量重要性方法的学习能力，但激活片段很短。
patterns.domain: 贝叶斯非参数统计论文

patterns.name: 哲学中的反抗概念
patterns.context: 讨论普通意义上的反抗，尤其是一般规则或预期与反抗行为之间的关系。

patterns.name: 人物生平与职业经历
patterns.context: 叙述人物在不同地点学习、受聘并出演角色；与其他段落中同类虚词激活可能重叠。

en.description: Activation patterns are scattered: clearer local cues include would/would-be, consecutive closing tags, lists of purpose infinitives with to, patent quotation marks, footnote asterisks, and specific line-break boundaries. Most other cases are scattered cross-domain words that are difficult to assign a single semantic function.

patterns.name: Postposed would / would-be construction
patterns.context: After “there is some general rule or expectation that ...”, the repeated construction would lead the would-be ... appears; activation concentrates on both instances of would and the adjacent hyphen and be.

patterns.name: XML/plist closing tags
patterns.context: In serialized configuration text, slash-prefixed closing tags appear consecutively, especially for array and dict, plist.

patterns.name: List of purpose infinitives with to
patterns.context: Research aims or tasks are listed by number; several parallel items begin with to plus a verb, and the final item repeats to.

patterns.name: Quotation marks introducing entity names
patterns.context: A patent narrative uses single quotes to introduce a patent identified by number; high activation falls on the opening single quote and the following number.

patterns.name: Table footnote asterisk
patterns.context: After list or table content, an asterisk serves as a footnote marker introducing explanatory text.

patterns.name: Line breaks at text-region boundaries
patterns.context: Two consecutive newline characters occur at the boundary between the end of one passage and the start of the next heading or body text.

patterns.name: Line break before a possessive pronoun
patterns.context: After a line break in a sentence, a new line begins with American and continues with descriptive prose; only this example activates the adjacent boundary marker.

patterns.name: Uppercase separation in a disclaimer heading
patterns.context: A disclaimer heading is presented as an all-caps phrase; LIMITED is split within the word, with activation on the final part.

patterns.name: Scattered conjunctions and word-form fragments
patterns.context: These activations are scattered across plant breeding, web promotion, and biomedical text; some are common prepositions or conjunctions, others nouns. The available passages show no shared specific syntactic or semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain; possibly generalized word items or incidental contextual activations

patterns.name: Other local activations without a clear pattern
patterns.context: Occur separately in damage disclaimers, argumentative text, tables, or historical narratives; an individual local trigger is insufficient to establish a stable shared condition.

4_1246.description: 激活模式分散：较清楚的局部线索包括 would/would-be、连续闭合标签、目的状语 to 列表、专利引号、脚注星号及特定换行边界；其余多为跨领域零散词项，难归为单一语义功能。

patterns.name: 后置词的 would / would-be 结构
patterns.context: 在“there is some general rule or expectation that ...”之后，出现 would lead the would-be ... 的重复 would 构式；激活集中在两个 would 及其相邻连字符、be。

patterns.name: XML/plist 闭合标签
patterns.context: 序列化配置文本中连续出现带斜线的闭合标签，尤其是 array 以及 dict、plist。

patterns.name: 目的状语 to 不定式列表
patterns.context: 研究目标或任务按编号分列，多个并列项目以 to 加动词开头，末项仍重复 to。
patterns.domain: NIH 生物医学研究计划

patterns.name: 用于说明实体名称的引号
patterns.context: 专利叙述中以单引号引出由数字标识的专利；高激活落在左单引号及紧随的数字。

patterns.name: 表格脚注星号
patterns.context: 列表或表格内容之后，星号作为脚注标记引出说明文字。

patterns.name: 文本区域边界换行
patterns.context: 两个换行符连续出现，位于一段内容结束、下一段标题或正文开始的边界。

patterns.name: 所有格代词前的换行
patterns.context: 句中换行后以 American 开始新行，随后接续描述性正文；仅此例中相邻边界标记被激活。

patterns.name: 排版免责声明标题中的大写分隔
patterns.context: 免责声明标题以全大写词组呈现，LIMITED 在词中被切分，激活落在词尾部分。
patterns.domain: 电子书许可与法律免责声明

patterns.name: 零散连接词与词形片段
patterns.trigger: « more»10；« hybrids»1；« from»4；« us»9；« and»14；« species»1
patterns.context: 这些激活分散在植物育种、网页宣传和生物医学文本中；有的为常见介词或连词，有的为名词，当前片段未显示共同的特定句法或语义条件。
patterns.domain: 跨领域；可能是泛化词项或上下文偶然激活

patterns.name: 其他未形成明确模式的局部激活
patterns.trigger: « other»1«↵»2；« cannot»1« be»1；« of»1；« a»3« different»2；« better»8；« your»1
patterns.context: 分别出现在损害免责文本、论证文字、表格或历史叙述中；单个局部触发不足以确定稳定的共同条件。

en.description: Patterns are scattered: the quantity phrase “two or more” in patents; tags and table symbols in structured text; website link navigation and line breaks; would in philosophical contexts; and damage and liability terms in disclaimers.

patterns.name: Quantity expression “two or more”
patterns.context: Near the quantity phrase “two or more”, especially before a noun; also appears in “two or more times”.

patterns.name: Structured markup and closing tags
patterns.context: In structured text such as XML/plist tags and wiki table markup, activation concentrates on delimiters and tag boundaries.

patterns.name: Website links and navigation copy
patterns.context: Near website footers, social media links, or URL-introduction text; newline characters are also activated.
patterns.domain: Website content, news websites, adult websites

patterns.name: Conditional discussion of rules and expectations
patterns.context: When discussing rules, normal expectations, and defiant behavior, would and its hyphenated construction recur.

patterns.name: Damage and disclaimer terminology
patterns.context: Legal disclaimer contexts listing media defects, damage, or limitations of liability.

4_1246.description: 模式分散：专利中的“two or more”数量短语；结构化文本的标签、表格符号；网页链接导航及换行；哲学语境中的would；免责声明中的损坏与责任术语。

patterns.name: “two or more”数量表达
patterns.context: 数量词组“two or more”附近，尤其接名词；也有“two or more times”。

patterns.name: 结构化标记与闭合标签
patterns.context: XML/plist 标签、维基表格标记等结构化文本中，激活集中于分隔符和标签边界。
patterns.domain: 代码、配置文件、维基表格

patterns.name: 网页链接与导航文案
patterns.context: 网页页脚、社交媒体链接或网址引出语附近；换行符也有激活。
patterns.domain: 网站内容、新闻网页、成人网站

patterns.name: 规则与预期的条件论述
patterns.context: 讨论规则、常态预期及违抗行为时，反复出现 would 及其连字符结构。

patterns.name: 损坏与免责声明术语
patterns.context: 列举介质缺陷、损坏或责任限制的法律免责声明语境。
patterns.domain: 电子文本许可与免责声明

en.description: Activations are scattered across different corpora and formats: web phrases, English constructions and quantity expressions, legal formatting, XML/LaTeX markers, and scholarly citations. No stable shared semantic or stylistic trigger condition is apparent.

patterns.name: us in a web address phrase
patterns.context: Appears in the common website prompt “visit us at”, immediately before a place name; the preceding text introduces a news website.

patterns.name: would-be construction
patterns.context: A hyphen connects would and be, forming “would-be defiant party”; the preceding text discusses rules, expectations, and defiant behavior.

patterns.name: XML/plist closing tags
patterns.context: Appears after a group of plist/XML entries, as the closing tags for an array and dictionary.

patterns.name: Quantity expression in breeding
patterns.context: In “crosses ... parental lines”, describes the number of parental lines crossed by breeders; nearby are genetic breeding terms such as selfing.

patterns.name: Legal motion formatting
patterns.context: A paragraph begins with a newline and “Complaint.” in a pleading format; subsequent text describes a motion to dismiss and causes of action.

patterns.name: Generic quantity expression
patterns.context: “a host of” means many processes, followed by different setups and the differential rates they produce; nearby is a discussion of shear-flow instability.

patterns.name: List punctuation and enumeration
patterns.context: A colon follows including to introduce a list of bands or musicians.

patterns.name: them in a literature citation
patterns.context: Refers back to a preceding set of references or studies, followed by citations in square brackets.

patterns.name: Court docket header and decorative symbol
patterns.context: Appears in a court docket header after the court name and case number, containing a Filed date and a line of asterisk separators.

patterns.name: LaTeX table length unit
patterns.context: Appears after a line-break command in a table environment, as a vertical-spacing parameter in square brackets; adjacent to LaTeX table code.

4_1246.description: 激活分散于不同语料与格式：网页短语、英语构式和数量表达、法律版式、XML/LaTeX 标记及学术引用。未见稳定共享的语义或文体触发条件。

patterns.name: 网页地址中的 us
patterns.context: 出现在句中“visit us at”这一常见网页引导语里，紧接地点名之前；前文是新闻网站介绍。
patterns.domain: 地方新闻网站宣传文案

patterns.name: would-be 结构
patterns.context: 连字符连接 would 与 be，构成“would-be defiant party”；前文讨论规则、预期及违抗行为。

patterns.name: XML/plist 闭合标签
patterns.context: 出现于一组 plist/XML 条目之后，作为数组及字典的结束标签。

patterns.name: 育种中的数量词
patterns.context: 位于“crosses ... parental lines”中，描述育种者杂交的亲本系数量；附近还有 selfing 等遗传育种术语。
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术、植物育种

patterns.name: 法律动议格式
patterns.context: 段首以换行和“Complaint.”形成诉状文书格式，后续说明驳回动议及诉因。

patterns.name: 泛指数量表达
patterns.context: 以“a host of”表达许多过程，后接不同设置及其产生的差分速度；附近讨论剪切流不稳定性。
patterns.domain: 等离子体/天体物理论文

patterns.name: 列举标点与名单
patterns.context: including 后接冒号，引出乐队或音乐家的例举名单。

patterns.name: 文献引用中的 them
patterns.context: 回指前述一系列文献或研究，随后接方括号内的引用。

patterns.name: 法院案卷页眉与装饰符号
patterns.context: 出现在法院名称、案号之后的案卷页眉，包含 Filed 日期以及一行星号分隔符。

patterns.name: LaTeX 表格长度单位
patterns.context: 位于表格环境换行命令之后，作为方括号中的垂直间距参数；紧邻 LaTeX 表格代码。

en.concept: January dates and a few word forms
en.description: Strongly activates primarily on “January” in dates across encyclopedias, news, books, and legal texts; also shows localized activation on “ISO” in a scheduling path, “research” in a URL, and “Historically” in a medical abstract.

patterns.name: January dates
patterns.context: Appears in date expressions such as titles, birth and death dates, publication dates, or case dates; sometimes followed by a specific day or year.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, news webpages, book title pages, legal documents

patterns.name: ISO in scheduling files
patterns.context: Appears near a filename in a scheduling file path, which contains wording such as California Scheduling.
patterns.domain: Business logs or file paths in Enron emails

patterns.name: research in a webpage URL
patterns.context: Appears in the domain portion of a URL (research.swtch.com).

patterns.name: Historically
patterns.context: Appears as a sentence-initial adverb in a medical abstract, introducing an overview of personalized medicine.

4_1271.concept: January 日期及少数词形
4_1271.description: 主要对日期中的“January”强烈激活，横跨百科、新闻、书籍和法律文本；另对排程路径中的“ISO”、URL 中的“research”及医学摘要中的“Historically”有局部激活。

patterns.name: January 日期
patterns.context: 出现在标题、人物生卒日期、出版日期或案件日期等日期表达中；有时后接具体日、年份。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、新闻网页、书籍扉页、法律文书

patterns.name: 排程文件中的 ISO
patterns.context: 出现在排程文件路径的文件名附近，路径包含 California Scheduling 等字样。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的业务日志或文件路径

patterns.name: 网页 URL 中的 research
patterns.context: 出现在 URL 的域名部分（research.swtch.com）。

patterns.name: Historically
patterns.context: 出现在医学摘要中，作为句首副词，引出对个体化医疗的概述。

en.concept: Proper names and scheduling logs in structured text
en.description: Responds primarily to schedule, variances detected, and parsing-path formats in power scheduling logs; also activates on the Netball Quad Series title and a cannabis-policy article title and date.

patterns.name: Netball event name and year
patterns.context: The year is adjacent to the name Netball Quad Series; the text appears as a title, repeated title, or disambiguation entry in the form “may refer to”.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia article titles and disambiguation pages

patterns.name: Power scheduling variance log
patterns.context: In power scheduling plan logs, reports whether variances were detected for a given plan type; often accompanied by parsing file paths and plan names.
patterns.domain: Machine-generated logs in Enron power trading and scheduling emails

patterns.name: Scheduling plan file path
patterns.context: Appears after “PARSING FILE -->>” as part of a power grid scheduling file path or filename; often co-occurs with variance detection logs.
patterns.domain: File paths and power scheduling data in Enron emails

patterns.name: Cannabis policy title and date
patterns.context: An article title discusses state drug policy and cannabis use, accompanied by a date and author information.

4_1271.concept: 结构化文本中的专名与调度日志
4_1271.description: 主要响应电力调度日志中的 schedule、variances detected 及解析路径格式；另对 Netball Quad Series 标题和大麻政策文章标题、日期有激活。

patterns.name: 网球赛事名称与年份
patterns.context: 年份紧邻 Netball Quad Series 名称；文本以标题、重复标题或“may refer to”消歧条目形式出现。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 条目标题与消歧页面

patterns.name: 电力调度差异日志
patterns.context: 电力调度计划日志中，报告某类计划检测到或未检测到差异；常伴随解析文件路径和计划名称。
patterns.domain: Enron 电力交易与调度邮件中的机器生成日志

patterns.name: 调度计划文件路径
patterns.context: 出现在“PARSING FILE -->>”之后，作为电网调度文件路径或文件名的一部分；多与差异检测日志共现。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的文件路径及电力调度数据

patterns.name: 大麻政策标题与日期
patterns.context: 文章标题谈论州内毒品政策及大麻使用，并附有日期和作者信息。

en.concept: Power scheduling log formats and a few title texts
en.description: Responds primarily to ISO file parsing formats, scheduling variance statuses, and error messages in Enron power scheduling logs; also appears in a sports event title and a drug policy article title, neither of which has an evident connection to the main pattern.

patterns.name: ISO scheduling file log
patterns.context: In automated processing logs in Enron emails, lists file paths and parsing results; often accompanied by leading indentation, line breaks, and numeric filenames.
patterns.domain: Power trading and scheduling system logs

patterns.name: Scheduling variance detection status
patterns.context: Appears as the processing status or result of a scheduling file, often adjacent to scheduling types such as Load, Generation, SC Trades, and Energy Import/Export.

patterns.name: Scheduling download failure alert
patterns.context: A parsing file log immediately follows an error status message; activation covers the alert and subsequent log format.

patterns.name: Sports event name
patterns.context: The opening of a Wikipedia entry repeats the event name and explains what it refers to and the competition dates; no clear semantic connection to Enron logs.

patterns.name: Drug policy article title and introduction
patterns.context: A share marker and byline date appear after the article title and subtitle; no clear semantic connection to the scheduling logs in other snippets.

4_1271.concept: 电力调度日志格式及少量标题文本
4_1271.description: 主要响应 Enron 电力调度日志中的 ISO 文件解析格式、调度差异状态及错误提示；另见网球赛事标题和药物政策文章标题，后两者与主模式无明显联系。

patterns.name: ISO 调度文件日志
patterns.context: 在 Enron 邮件中的自动化处理日志里，列出文件路径及解析结果；常伴随行首缩进、换行和数字文件名。
patterns.domain: 电力交易与调度系统日志

patterns.name: 调度差异检测状态
patterns.trigger: “Variances detected”及其变体“Variance(s) detected”；也包括“No variances detected”
patterns.context: 作为调度文件处理状态或结果出现，常与 Load、Generation、SC Trades、Energy Import/Export 等调度类型相邻。
patterns.domain: 电力调度系统状态消息

patterns.name: 调度下载失败警报
patterns.trigger: “HourAhead schedule download failed. Manual intervention required.”
patterns.context: 异常状态消息后紧接解析文件日志；激活落在该警报及后续日志格式中。
patterns.domain: 电力调度系统错误日志

patterns.name: 网球赛事名称
patterns.context: Wikipedia 条目开头重复赛事名称，并说明其指代及比赛日期；与 Enron 日志无明显语义联系。

patterns.name: 药物政策文章标题与导语
patterns.trigger: “Drug policy in my state”, “Marijuana Use is Now ‘No Big Deal’ - What About MDMA?”
patterns.context: 文章标题及副标题之后出现分享标记和署名日期；与其他片段的调度日志无明显语义联系。

en.description: Responds primarily to the -odal fragment in words (amodal, multimodal, antipodal) and a subword fragment in the legal word forfeited; also activates on less and a URL string. Other strong activations are sporadic.

patterns.name: Word-final -odal (multimodal)
patterns.context: The trigger falls on the -odal part of English word forms; the context includes amodal or multimodal.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragment in forfeited
patterns.context: In a legal context, describes allegations or appeals as forfeited; activation falls on the latter part of the word’s segmentation.

patterns.name: less
patterns.context: Appears in comparative or degree expressions such as “care less”, “less than”, and “less problems”; these contexts differ from one another.
patterns.domain: Forums, emails, legal texts, Q&A, etc.

patterns.name: antipodal
patterns.context: In the geometric definition “antipodal map”, activation concentrates on the intra-word -odal fragment; it shares a spelling fragment with amodal/multimodal but has a different meaning.

patterns.name: String fragment in a code link
patterns.context: Activation appears near a Markdown link and URL in a Hacker News post, with no clear semantic or recurring cross-snippet trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Unexplained high activations
patterns.context: These activations are scattered across sports commentary and business emails and do not match the recurring word-form patterns above.

4_1271.concept: 英语词内片段检测
4_1271.description: 主要响应词内的 -odal 片段（amodal、multimodal、antipodal）及法律词 forfeited 的切分片段；另对 less 和一处网址字符串激活。其余强激活较零散。

patterns.name: 词尾 -odal（多模态）
patterns.context: 触发点落在英语词形的 -odal 部分；语境中形成 amodal 或 multimodal。
patterns.domain: 科研摘要、医学/护理文本

patterns.name: forfeited 的词内片段
patterns.context: 法律语境中描述指控或上诉主张被 forfeited；激活落在词内切分的后半部分。

patterns.name: less
patterns.context: 出现在比较或程度表达中，如 “care less”“less than”“less problems”；这些语境彼此不同。

patterns.name: antipodal
patterns.context: 几何定义中的 “antipodal map”，激活集中于词内 -odal 部分；与 amodal/multimodal 共享字形片段，但语义不同。

patterns.name: 代码链接中的字符串片段
patterns.trigger: 链接路径中的 «12» «92»（整体 URL 后接 «»10）
patterns.context: 激活出现在 HackerNews 帖子的 Markdown 链接及网址附近，没有明显语义或跨段重复的触发模式。

patterns.name: 未解释的高激活
patterns.trigger: 无明确共同触发词；可见 «class» «championship» «enormous» «Corporation» «perfect» «execution» 等
patterns.context: 这些激活分散在体育评论和商务邮件中，与上述重复词形模式不吻合。

en.concept: Recognition of the forfeit word form
en.description: Every snippet contains the word form forfeited/forfeit, with activation concentrated on the stem forfe-; contexts include forfeiture of rights or claims in law, property confiscation, and forfeiture of corporate status or a match result.

patterns.name: forfeited in judicial contexts
patterns.context: In legal opinions or rulings, indicates that a right, argument, objection, or claim was lost because it was not raised or preserved in time; may also refer generally to property being confiscated.

patterns.name: General waiver of rights
patterns.context: In informal discussion, uses forfeiture to refer to giving up an entitlement, such as the right to free medical care.

patterns.name: Entity or team disqualified / forfeits
patterns.context: Describes a company losing its status for failing to file documents, or a match being forfeited because the opposing team did not appear; this is not procedural forfeiture of a legal argument.
patterns.domain: FreeLaw administrative/corporate law materials; Wikipedia sports entries

4_1271.concept: forfeit词形识别
4_1271.description: 各段都含 forfeited/forfeit 词形，激活集中在词干 forfe-，涵盖法律上的权利或主张失权、财产没收，以及公司资格或比赛结果的 forfeiture。

patterns.name: 司法语境中的 forfeited
patterns.context: 法律意见书或判决中，表示权利、论点、异议或主张因未及时提出、未保留等而丧失；也可能泛指财产被没收。

patterns.name: 一般性放弃权利
patterns.context: 在非正式讨论中把 forfeiture 用于放弃某项权益，例如放弃免费医疗权。

patterns.name: 实体或球队被判没收／失去
patterns.context: 描述公司因未提交申报而被撤销资格，或比赛因对手缺席而判为没收；并非法律论点的程序性失权。
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 行政／公司法材料；Wikipedia 体育条目

en.description: Activations are scattered across code and license comments, Objective-C declarations, a Wikipedia list of Cardiff music, three different Hacker News discussions, and a medical term; no single shared meaning is evident.

patterns.name: Objective-C header import and interface declaration
patterns.context: After a code comment ends, an AppDelegate header is imported and an interface declaration begins.

patterns.name: Software license text and code boundary
patterns.context: Fixed legal wording in a license or copyright comment, often adjacent to a comment terminator and subsequent code.
patterns.domain: GitHub source code, licenses, and copyright comments

patterns.name: Strong activation marker in code: backslash
patterns.context: Appears near file comments, type declarations, or namespace identifiers; the specific code snippets are not identical.

patterns.name: Cardiff music performance list title
patterns.context: The title and category entries concern Cardiff and music venues.

patterns.name: Volos Kayak and “Explore” text
patterns.context: After discussion of machines needing to experiment and handle possibilities, a separator, a name, and the phrase Go-Explore appear.

patterns.name: Russian profanity and comparison with English profanity
patterns.context: Explains the meaning of a Russian expression and compares Russian and English three-letter swear words.

patterns.name: Sarcastic response about the abbreviation J2ME
patterns.context: Quotes or responds to a joke about J2ME, mentioning that one need not learn its abbreviation anymore.

patterns.name: Diffuse astrocytoma terminology
patterns.context: The disease name appears in the introduction of a medical article.

4_1271.concept: 无统一概念
4_1271.description: 激活分散在代码与许可证注释、Objective-C 声明、维基百科卡迪夫音乐列表，以及三段不同的 Hacker News 讨论和一处医学术语；未见单一共同词义。

patterns.name: Objective-C 头文件导入与接口声明
patterns.context: 代码注释结束后，紧接着导入 AppDelegate 头文件并开始接口声明。
patterns.domain: GitHub 上的 Objective-C 源代码

patterns.name: 软件许可证文本及代码边界
patterns.trigger: "WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND"、"All rights reserved"、"*/"
patterns.context: 许可证或版权注释中的固定法律措辞，常与注释结束符及后续代码相邻。
patterns.domain: GitHub 源代码、许可证与版权注释

patterns.name: 代码中的强激活标记：反斜杠
patterns.context: 出现在文件注释、类型声明或命名空间标识符附近；这些具体代码片段并不完全相同。

patterns.name: 卡迪夫音乐演出列表标题
patterns.context: 标题及分类条目以 Cardiff 和音乐演出场馆为主题。
patterns.domain: 英文维基百科列表页面

patterns.name: Volos Kayak 与“探索”文本
patterns.context: 讨论机器需要实验和处理可能性之后，出现分隔线、名称及短语 Go-Explore。

patterns.name: 俄语粗口及英语脏话比较
patterns.context: 解释俄语表达的含义，并比较俄语与英语三字母脏话。

patterns.name: J2ME 缩写的讽刺回应
patterns.context: 引用或回应对 J2ME 的调侃，提到不必再学习其缩写。

patterns.name: 弥散性星形细胞瘤术语
patterns.context: 医学文章引言中出现疾病名称。

en.description: Activates strongly primarily on http in URLs or network code, commonly in email links, webpage links, and net/http and aiohttp; Enron emails also contain a receipt confirmation template and a fixed IP. A forum title and a medical journal listing are also present and are difficult to explain through the main pattern.

patterns.name: http in HTTP protocols or links
patterns.context: Appears in the protocol portion of a URL or in code as a network package path / HTTP client identifier; linked domains and surrounding text vary widely.
patterns.domain: Emails, code, forum links, webpage scrape text

patterns.name: Email notification template
patterns.context: An email asks the recipient to click a link to confirm receipt, often with horizontal separators and a URL nearby.

patterns.name: Importing network-related libraries in code
patterns.context: Go code imports net/http or net/url; another Python async function uses an aiohttp client.

patterns.name: Specific address prefix in an HTTP link
patterns.context: A URL in an email body points to the same numeric IP address and appears after an email confirmation notification.

patterns.name: http in other webpage links
patterns.context: Ordinary webpage links surrounded by forum titles, article titles, or scraped webpage text; domains vary.

patterns.name: Meta filter in a webpage title
patterns.context: Part of a title, immediately followed by YouTube comments and a URL; unrelated to code or email notifications.

patterns.name: Journal name in publication information
patterns.context: A sentence lists the journals in which the same paper was co-published; the neuron marker falls within a journal name.

4_1271.concept: HTTP 字符串
4_1271.description: 主要对 URL 或网络代码中的 http 强烈激活，常见于邮件链接、网页链接及 net/http、aiohttp；Enron 邮件还含确认收件模板和固定 IP。另有论坛标题及医学期刊列举，难以由主模式解释。

patterns.name: HTTP 协议或链接中的 http
patterns.context: 在 URL 的协议部分，或代码中的网络包路径 / HTTP 客户端标识中出现；链接域名和周围文本差异很大。
patterns.domain: 邮件、代码、论坛链接、网页抓取文本

patterns.name: 邮件通知模板
patterns.context: 邮件中请求收件人点击链接确认收到邮件，附近常有横线分隔符和 URL。

patterns.name: 代码导入网络相关库
patterns.context: Go 代码导入 net/http 或 net/url；另一段 Python 异步函数使用 aiohttp 客户端。

patterns.name: HTTP 链接中的特定地址前缀
patterns.context: 邮件正文 URL 指向同一数字 IP 地址，出现在邮件确认通知之后。

patterns.name: 其他网页链接中的 http
patterns.context: 普通网页链接，周围是论坛标题、文章标题或抓取的网页正文；域名并不一致。

patterns.name: 网页标题中的 Meta filter
patterns.context: 作为标题文本的一部分，紧接 YouTube comments 与网址；和代码或邮件通知无关。

patterns.name: 论文发表信息中的期刊名
patterns.trigger: «An»«nals»« of»« Internal»« Medicine»，以及后续多个期刊名
patterns.context: 句子列举同一论文同时发表的期刊，神经元标记落在期刊名称内部。

en.description: Activations occur mainly in software code and configuration, covering member access, assignment, comments, paths, Android, and localization syntax; also responds to fragments of legal names, tool questions, and proper names in music entries.

patterns.name: Dot-notation member access in code identifiers
patterns.context: Punctuation or call chains connect objects, members, methods, paths, and other identifiers; examples include Scala, JavaScript, Java, and Java/Kotlin-style code.

patterns.name: Assignment and configuration syntax in code
patterns.context: In build configuration, dependency declarations, or program statements, symbols and identifiers occur in assignments, parameters, or XML configuration structures.

patterns.name: Code and documentation comments
patterns.context: Line or block comments with brief explanations appear near code and alongside code syntax.

patterns.name: Names and abbreviations in legal citations
patterns.context: In U.S. case citations, names appear in segmented capitalization, initials, and periods, followed by the format for opposing litigants.

patterns.name: Android UI and event-handling code
patterns.context: An XML layout snippet is followed by an Android Java example involving an Activity, view text, or Intent.

patterns.name: Proper names in software dependency or tool configuration
patterns.context: A question or YAML configuration mentions a browser automation tool and its extension; activation falls on proper names and configuration identifiers.

patterns.name: Fields and translations in localized strings
patterns.context: In a gettext-style resource file, English keys correspond to Chinese translations and include field names, quotation marks, and translated text.

patterns.name: Person names and name spelling fragments
patterns.context: Names are split into tokens or initials; they occur in code file author credits and song personnel lists, respectively.

patterns.name: Paths and slash separators
patterns.context: A separator is adjacent to path components in file paths, directories, or URL module paths.

patterns.name: Phrase in a user-agent question
patterns.context: A natural-language technical question asks how to set the user agent for PhantomJS/Mink; the trigger word itself is an ordinary English word.

patterns.name: Music tracks and personnel fields
patterns.context: Song titles and personnel names appear in a track list, with metadata such as quotation marks, parentheses, and durations.

4_1271.concept: 代码标识符与专名片段
4_1271.description: 激活主要出现在软件代码及配置中，覆盖成员访问、赋值、注释、路径、Android 与本地化语法；也对法律姓名、工具问答和音乐条目中的专名片段有反应。

patterns.name: 代码标识符中的点号成员访问
patterns.context: 标点或调用链连接对象、成员、方法、路径等标识符；包括 Scala、JavaScript、Java 和 Java/Kotlin 风格代码。

patterns.name: 代码中的赋值与配置语法
patterns.context: 构建配置、依赖声明或程序语句中，符号及标识符位于赋值、参数或 XML 配置结构内。

patterns.name: 代码注释与文档注释
patterns.context: 代码附近出现行注释或块注释，常含简短说明；与代码语法共同出现。

patterns.name: 法律引文中的姓名与缩写
patterns.context: 美国判例引文中，姓名以分段大写、首字母和句点呈现，后接诉讼双方格式。

patterns.name: Android 界面与事件处理代码
patterns.context: XML 布局片段后接 Android Java 示例，涉及 Activity、视图文本或 Intent。

patterns.name: 软件依赖或工具配置中的专名
patterns.context: 问题或 YAML 配置提及浏览器自动化工具及其扩展；激活落在专名和配置标识符上。

patterns.name: 本地化字符串中的字段与翻译
patterns.context: gettext 风格资源文件中，英文键对应中文译文，含字段名、引号与翻译文本。

patterns.name: 人名及姓名拼写片段
patterns.context: 人名被拆成词片或首字母；分别出现在代码文件作者署名和歌曲人员名单中。

patterns.name: 路径与斜杠分隔符
patterns.context: 文件路径、目录或 URL 模块路径中，分隔符与路径成分相邻。

patterns.name: 用户代理相关提问中的短语
patterns.context: 自然语言技术问题询问如何设置 PhantomJS/Mink 的 user agent；触发词本身是普通英语词。

patterns.name: 音乐曲目与人员字段
patterns.context: 歌曲列表中的曲名及人员姓名，含引号、括号和时长等元数据。

en.concept: Structural and boundary features across domains
en.description: Activations cover code punctuation, HTML forms, Ajax/URLs, string and link handling; they also appear in legal provisions, accommodations and legal arguments in rulings, service copy, and public cultural policy. No single semantic theme explains all snippets.

patterns.name: Punctuation and syntax boundaries in code
patterns.context: In code, HTML, JavaScript, or URLs, punctuation appears at structural boundaries such as calls, assignments, attributes, and tags; triggers are not limited to one language.

patterns.name: HTTP requests and cross-origin Ajax
patterns.context: Code or problem descriptions involving Ajax requests, cross-origin access, and request URLs.

patterns.name: Forms and HTML attributes
patterns.context: HTML form and control tags, and link attribute syntax.

patterns.name: Conventional collocations in legal texts
patterns.context: Wording describing actors and their actions in statutory or judicial contexts.

patterns.name: Legal arguments and record materials
patterns.context: Discusses legislative or administrative history, records of decision-making bodies, and their relevance to legal determinations.

patterns.name: Sleeping and accommodation contexts
patterns.context: Describes a party staying overnight at a police station, accommodation arrangements, and whether they asked to leave.
patterns.domain: Factual account in a judicial opinion

patterns.name: Terms of service and customer interactions
patterns.context: Customer-facing service descriptions or website terms describing warranties, repairs, and user interactions with service channels.

patterns.name: Public cultural resources and policy
patterns.context: Discusses museum admission fees, public learning spaces, and the weakening of public funding for libraries.

patterns.name: String splitting and link extraction
patterns.context: Uses string processing to extract links from a result object and displays HTML link output.

4_1271.concept: 多领域结构与边界特征
4_1271.description: 激活覆盖代码标点、HTML 表单、Ajax/URL、字符串与链接处理，也出现法律条文、判决中的住宿和法律论证，以及服务文案、公共文化政策；没有单一语义主题能解释全部片段。

patterns.name: 代码中的标点与语法边界
patterns.context: 在代码、HTML、JavaScript 或 URL 中，标点出现在调用、赋值、属性和标签等结构边界；触发并不局限于某一种语言。

patterns.name: HTTP 请求与跨域 Ajax
patterns.context: 围绕 Ajax 请求、跨域访问和请求 URL 的代码或问题描述。

patterns.name: 表单与 HTML 属性
patterns.context: HTML 表单、控件及链接的标签和属性语法。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的惯用搭配
patterns.context: 法律条文或判决语境中，描述行为主体及其行为的措辞。

patterns.name: 法律论证与记录材料
patterns.trigger: « legislative» « administrative» « members» « decision» « meetings» « reports»
patterns.context: 讨论立法或行政历史、决策机构记录及其对法律判断的相关性。

patterns.name: 睡眠与住宿情境
patterns.trigger: « slept» « arrange» « lod» « requested» « to» « leave»
patterns.context: 叙述当事人在警局过夜、住宿安排及是否要求离开的事实。

patterns.name: 服务条款与客户互动
patterns.trigger: « warranty» « serv» «iced» « visit» « interact» « sites» « applications» « tools» « messaging»
patterns.context: 面向客户的服务说明或网站条款，描述保修、维修和用户与服务渠道的互动。

patterns.name: 公共文化资源与政策
patterns.context: 讨论博物馆收费、公共学习空间及图书馆公共资助受到削弱。

patterns.name: 字符串拆分与链接抽取
patterns.context: 用字符串处理从结果对象中提取链接，并展示 HTML 链接输出。

en.concept: Entities and code operations in technical text
en.description: Activations are scattered across Android view binding, search and string code, item lists, an analytics article, automotive engineering, and user-agent configuration; there is no single clear trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Android view binding and resource IDs
patterns.context: Android Java code looks up, initializes, or sets UI views; activation often falls near resource references, control declarations, and assignment symbols.

patterns.name: Retrieval or search operations
patterns.context: Code or technical Q&A discusses search requests, string splitting, and regular-expression matching; the specific trigger forms vary across examples.

patterns.name: List entries and item categories
patterns.context: Items or equipment categories are listed with bullets, with visitors and contraband mentioned nearby.

patterns.name: Analytics introduction title and narrative
patterns.context: A title and opening paragraph about analytics; the title discusses data security, while the body shifts to personal narrative.

patterns.name: Automotive thermal conditions and knocking
patterns.context: Discusses overheating and damage to exhaust components, and engine knocking and temperature.

patterns.name: User-agent configuration
patterns.context: Asks how to set the user agent in a Mink and PhantomJS environment.

4_1271.concept: 技术文本中的实体与代码操作
4_1271.description: 激活分散在 Android 视图绑定、搜索与字符串代码、物品清单、分析文章、汽车工程及 user-agent 配置中；没有单一明确触发模式。

patterns.name: Android 视图绑定与资源 ID
patterns.context: Android Java 代码中查找、初始化或设置界面视图；激活常落在资源引用、控件声明和赋值符号附近。

patterns.name: 检索或搜索操作
patterns.trigger: «Search»、«ajax»、«url»；另有 «split» 和正则表达式示例
patterns.context: 代码或技术问答讨论搜索请求、字符串拆分及正则匹配；不同例子中的具体触发形式并不一致。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答、JavaScript/R 代码

patterns.name: 列表条目与物品类别
patterns.trigger: « Video»« equipment»、« We»«apons»、« chains»、« guns»、« kn»«if»«es»、« Wh»ist«les»
patterns.context: 以项目符号列出物品或设备类别，周围提及访客及非法物品。

patterns.name: 分析入门标题及叙述
patterns.trigger: «Getting»« Start»«ed»、« Analytics»；正文另有 « kicked»« off»
patterns.context: 分析主题的标题和文章开头，标题谈数据安全，正文转入个人叙述。

patterns.name: 汽车热状态与爆震
patterns.context: 讨论排气部件过热、损坏及发动机爆震和温度。

patterns.name: 用户代理配置
patterns.context: 询问如何在 Mink 与 PhantomJS 环境中设置 user agent。

en.description: Activations are scattered across Android prompts and success-alert code, German subword fragments, legal inducement to commit perjury, prohibited-item lists, detention reports, and HTML documents and iframe tags; apart from local repetition within prompts and HTML, no unified trigger condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Android Toast prompt
patterns.context: Creating and displaying a short message prompt in Java/Android code, with parameters including context and the text to display; the text may come from a variable, string, or result data

patterns.name: Success prompt and resource icon
patterns.context: Constructing a success-state AlertModel, setting a localized title, a success message, and an image resource

patterns.name: Conditional filtering and prompt assignment
patterns.context: Assigning a value to a toast variable after a range-condition check; appears alongside Android Toast code, but here the focus is on the conditional check and assignment form

patterns.name: Subword fragments within German words
patterns.context: Activations fall on fragments within split words in continuous German text, especially word or inflected-form fragments; no clear code or prompt-related semantic condition

patterns.name: Inducement in legal provisions
patterns.context: Criminal statutes describing the inducement of another person to commit perjury and the corresponding penalties

patterns.name: Weapons and prohibited-item lists
patterns.context: Bulleted lists of items prohibited at or requiring action at a location, with a note that people may be detained if illegal items are found

patterns.name: Law-enforcement detention and reprimand report
patterns.context: News report stating that tourists were arrested for making pornographic photos, briefly detained, and reprimanded

patterns.name: HTML document skeleton and template title
patterns.context: HTML document declaration, head section, and templated title markup

patterns.name: HTML iframe and link attributes
patterns.context: Setting a base target and embedding an iframe in an HTML page, with src constructed from a link expression

4_1271.concept: none
4_1271.description: 激活分散于 Android 提示与成功告警代码、德语词片段、法律诱使作伪证、违禁物品清单、拘留报道及 HTML 文档和 iframe 标记；除提示和 HTML 内部各有局部重复外，未见统一触发条件。

patterns.name: Android Toast 提示
patterns.context: Java/Android 代码中创建并显示短消息提示，参数包含 context 和要显示的文本；文本可由变量、字符串或结果数据构成

patterns.name: 成功提示与资源图标
patterns.context: 构造成功状态的 AlertModel，设置本地化标题、发送成功文案及图片资源

patterns.name: 条件筛选与提示赋值
patterns.context: 在区间条件判断后给 toast 变量赋值；与 Android Toast 同段，但此处突出条件判断及赋值形式

patterns.name: 德语词内子词片段
patterns.context: 德语连续文本中激活落在被拆分的词内片段，尤见词语或词形片段；没有明显代码或提示语义条件

patterns.name: 法律条文中的诱使行为
patterns.trigger: « induces»10« another»4 person to« give»1« false»2« testimony»2
patterns.context: 刑事法律条文描述诱使他人作伪证及相应处罚

patterns.name: 武器与违禁物品清单
patterns.trigger: « Weapons»4 including« chains»4,« guns»4, or« kn»4«if»1«es»4；« Whist«les»10
patterns.context: 项目符号列举场所内禁止或需处理的物品，并说明发现非法物品时可拘留

patterns.name: 执法拘留与训诫报道
patterns.context: 新闻叙述游客因制作色情照片被捕、被短暂拘留并受训诫

patterns.name: HTML 文档骨架与模板标题
patterns.context: HTML 文档声明、head 区域及模板化标题标记

patterns.name: HTML iframe 与链接属性
patterns.context: HTML 页面中设置 base target 并嵌入 iframe，src 由链接表达式构造

en.concept: Prominent markers and phrases in technical text
en.description: Activations are distributed across several structures: git+HTTPS addresses in GitHub metadata, marketing copy with toll-free customer-service numbers, code syntax and fields, Android instrumentation calls, and automotive terms for overheating and knocking. No single semantic theme explains all passages.

patterns.name: git HTTPS repository address
patterns.context: In JSON repository metadata, the repository type is git and the url field contains git+https://github.com

patterns.name: Toll-free phone marketing copy
patterns.context: Customer-facing hotel booking or product/service copy that provides a toll-free number after an apology, customer-service information, or an invitation to inquire
patterns.domain: Website copy, customer service, or marketing content

patterns.name: Syntax punctuation and structure in code
patterns.context: Programming text containing function calls, conditional expressions, object/configuration fields, or route definitions; these markers occur across different languages and structures

patterns.name: Android method-call identifier
patterns.context: Instrumentation/performance-tracing call in an Android Java service connection callback method

patterns.name: Automotive engine overheating and knocking
patterns.context: Technical background describing exhaust-pipe overheating and damage, as well as engine knocking and high temperatures

4_1271.concept: 技术文本中的醒目标记与短语
4_1271.description: 激活分布于多类结构：GitHub 元数据中的 git+HTTPS 地址、含免费客服电话的营销文案、代码语法与字段、Android 插桩调用，以及汽车过热/爆震术语。没有单一语义主题能解释全部段落。

patterns.name: git HTTPS 仓库地址
patterns.context: JSON 仓库元数据中，repository 的 type 为 git，url 字段包含 git+https://github.com

patterns.name: 免费电话营销文案
patterns.context: 面向客户的酒店预订或产品服务文案，在道歉、客服说明或咨询邀请后提供免费电话
patterns.domain: 网站文案、客服或营销内容

patterns.name: 代码中的语法标点与结构
patterns.trigger: 括号、赋值符号及相关代码片段，如“if(”“toast = Toast.makeText(”“type: 'GET'”“url: 'https://…'”“url: "{controller}/…”
patterns.context: 编程文本中出现函数调用、条件表达式、对象/配置字段或路由定义；这些标记分布在不同语言与结构中

patterns.name: Android 方法调用标识符
patterns.context: Android Java 服务连接回调方法中出现的插桩/性能追踪调用

patterns.name: 汽车发动机过热与爆震
patterns.context: 描述排气管过热损坏，以及发动机爆震和高温的技术背景

en.concept: Multiple local lexical and code patterns
en.description: Activations cover toll-free hotline copy, neuroscience stimulation terminology, engine overheating and knocking, legal claims for a check, and Android Toast, button event binding, and Python URL-handling code; there is no single clear common trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Toll-free format in hotline numbers
patterns.context: Copy about service outages or product inquiries instructs users to call a toll-free number; activations concentrate on “toll-free” and the number that follows

patterns.name: Stimulation- and reward-related terminology
patterns.context: An NIH research proposal studying opioid reinforcement or euphoric effects; the target word occurs in academic descriptions of behavior and neural pathways

patterns.name: Overtemperature and engine knocking
patterns.context: Technical background describing overheated and damaged exhaust components and engine knocking; activation is especially prominent on “knocking”

patterns.name: Unclaimed paychecks in legal context
patterns.context: Legal narrative stating that the defendant did not contact anyone about or claim a paycheck; multiple words related to claiming a check activate together

patterns.name: Toast UI method call
patterns.context: Android-style code creating a Toast prompt; also appears in code with error or data-loading prompts

patterns.name: Button click event binding
patterns.context: C#-style UI code binding a button’s Click event to a handler

patterns.name: Python URL construction and parsing
patterns.context: Importing Python URL parsing/joining utilities and constructing a URL based on a site object

4_1271.concept: 多种局部词汇与代码模式
4_1271.description: 激活涵盖 toll-free 热线文案、神经科学刺激术语、发动机过热爆震、法律中的索要支票，以及 Android Toast、按钮事件绑定和 Python URL 处理代码；没有单一明确的共同触发模式。

patterns.name: 热线号码的 toll-free 格式
patterns.context: 服务故障或产品咨询等文案中，提示用户拨打免费电话；激活集中在“toll-free”及紧随的号码

patterns.name: 刺激与奖赏相关术语
patterns.context: 研究阿片类药物强化或欣快效应的 NIH 研究提案；目标词位于关于行为及神经通路的学术描述中

patterns.name: 温度过高与发动机爆震
patterns.context: 描述排气部件过热、损坏及发动机爆震的技术背景；激活尤其出现在“knocking”

patterns.name: 法律语境中的未领取薪酬支票
patterns.context: 被告未联系或索要薪酬支票的法律叙述；多个与索取支票相关的词同时激活

patterns.name: Toast UI 方法调用
patterns.context: Android 风格代码中创建 Toast 提示；也出现在含错误提示或数据加载提示的代码里

patterns.name: 按钮点击事件绑定
patterns.context: C# 风格界面代码中将按钮的 Click 事件绑定到处理函数

patterns.name: Python URL 构造与解析
patterns.context: Python 导入 URL 解析/拼接工具，并基于站点对象构造 URL

en.concept: Syntax boundaries in code and structured text
en.description: Primarily activates on syntax punctuation, member calls, and parameter boundaries in code and structured text, especially Toast/UI code; also responds to JSON and Unity fields. Other highlights include pressure and drug terminology in papers and a word in a Q&A title.

patterns.name: Punctuation and syntax boundaries in code
patterns.context: These markers occur at syntactic separators in code or structured text; adjacent content is mostly identifiers, calls, assignments, or properties.
patterns.domain: Programming Q&A, code snippets, configuration files

patterns.name: Member access and method syntax
patterns.context: Member access, method calls, or event-handler expressions in code, often accompanied by dots, parentheses, and parameters.
patterns.domain: C#, Java, JavaScript, and other code

patterns.name: Toast notification code
patterns.context: Android-style code creating and displaying a short message prompt, or constructing a Toast-related expression.

patterns.name: Strings and UI text
patterns.context: Code passing strings, label text, or formatted content to UI controls or notifications.

patterns.name: English word fragments: pressure and support
patterns.context: Describes employee stress, peer pressure, and supervisor support; not a code-syntax pattern.
patterns.domain: Academic paper on organizational or workplace psychology

patterns.name: Drug reinforcement and stimulation behavior terminology
patterns.context: Discusses opioid reinforcement or euphoric effects and their relationship to self-stimulation behavior pathways.

patterns.name: Interaction word in a Q&A title
patterns.context: Question title describes resetting vocabulary entries after clicking “View All”.

patterns.name: Serialized key-value configuration
patterns.context: JSON-style configuration with adjacent keys, values, booleans, and nested fields.
patterns.domain: Monitoring dashboard or chart configuration text

patterns.name: Unity serialized fields
patterns.context: Serialized records composed of colon-separated fields and object-reference identifiers.

4_1271.concept: 代码与结构化文本语法边界
4_1271.description: 主要激活于代码及结构化文本中的语法标点、成员调用和参数边界，尤其是 Toast/UI 代码；也响应 JSON 与 Unity 字段。另有论文中的压力、药物术语及问答标题词。

patterns.name: 代码中的标点与语法边界
patterns.context: 这些标记出现在代码或结构化文本的语法分隔位置；相邻内容多为标识符、调用、赋值或属性。
patterns.domain: 编程问答、代码片段、配置文件

patterns.name: 成员调用与方法语法
patterns.context: 代码中的成员访问、方法调用或事件处理表达式，常伴随点号、括号及参数。

patterns.name: Toast 通知代码
patterns.context: Android 风格代码中创建并显示短消息提示，或构造 Toast 相关表达式。

patterns.name: 字符串与界面文本
patterns.context: 代码将字符串、标签文本或格式化内容传给 UI 控件或通知。

patterns.name: 英文词语片段：压力与支持
patterns.context: 叙述员工压力、同伴压力与主管支持；不属于代码语法模式。
patterns.domain: 学术论文，组织或工作场所心理相关论述

patterns.name: 药物强化与刺激行为术语
patterns.context: 讨论阿片类药物的强化或欣快效应及其与自我刺激行为通路的关系。
patterns.domain: NIH 生物医学研究摘要

patterns.name: 问答标题中的交互词
patterns.context: 问题标题描述点击“View All”后重置词汇表条目。

patterns.name: 序列化配置键值
patterns.context: JSON 风格配置中键、值、布尔量和嵌套字段相邻出现。
patterns.domain: 监控面板或图表配置文本

patterns.name: Unity 序列化字段
patterns.context: 冒号分隔字段及对象引用标识符构成的序列化记录。

en.concept: Concatenation operators and markup text in code
en.description: Activations are mainly scattered across code, configuration, and markup text, especially plus signs in string concatenation and text near tags/attributes; there are also sporadic PHP, identifier, and technical-word fragments, as well as customer-service phone snippets, with no clear unified explanation.

patterns.name: Plus signs in string concatenation
patterns.context: Plus signs appear in code expressions or HTML/JavaScript attribute strings to concatenate values, variables, or strings; sometimes they are adjacent to variables or string fragments.

patterns.name: Markup-language attributes and attribute values
patterns.context: Tags, attributes, or key-value fields appear in XML/XAML, HTML, or Unity serialized text; activations often occur near attribute names, quotation marks, and colons.

patterns.name: Proper-name or keyword fragments in code
patterns.context: Language names, field names, and identifier fragments in code or configuration text, with no consistent semantic role.

patterns.name: Technical terms and discussion words
patterns.context: Ordinary words embedded in question descriptions or URLs in technical Q&A or discussions; the contexts vary.

patterns.name: Toll-free in customer-service phone numbers
patterns.context: A webpage message about hotel search being unavailable presents a phone number in toll-free format.

patterns.name: Punctuation or phrase fragments
patterns.context: Natural language contains comparison-, assistance-, or action-related phrases, with no stable shared semantics; some fragments may also reflect code/text boundary effects.

4_1271.concept: 代码中的拼接符与标记文本
4_1271.description: 激活主要散布于代码、配置与标记文本，尤其字符串拼接的加号及标签/属性附近；另有少量 PHP、标识符、技术词和客服电话片段，难以统一解释。

patterns.name: 字符串拼接中的加号
patterns.context: 加号出现在代码表达式或 HTML/JavaScript 属性字符串中，用于拼接值、变量或字符串；有时紧邻变量或字符串片段。

patterns.name: 标记语言属性与属性值
patterns.context: XML/XAML、HTML 或 Unity 序列化文本中出现标签、属性或键值字段；激活点常在属性名、引号、冒号附近。

patterns.name: 代码中的专名或关键字片段
patterns.context: 代码或配置文本中的语言名、字段名及标识符片段，未见统一的语义角色。

patterns.name: 技术术语及技术讨论词
patterns.context: 技术问答或技术讨论中，普通词嵌在问题描述或 URL 中；各自上下文不同。

patterns.name: 客服电话号码中的 toll-free
patterns.context: 酒店搜索不可用的网页提示中，电话号码以 toll-free 形式呈现。

patterns.name: 标点或短语片段
patterns.context: 自然语言中出现比较、助人或行动相关短语，未发现稳定的共同语义；部分片段也可能只是代码/文本边界效应。

en.description: The most stable pattern is the title and author fields in ArXiv metadata; there are also responses to GitHub JSON keys and fields such as title and name. Other highlighted words are scattered across disciplines and lack unified semantics.

patterns.name: Paper title field
patterns.context: Appears in bibliographic metadata, followed by a paper title; this field marker recurs in multiple ArXiv snippets.

patterns.name: Author field
patterns.context: Author metadata field after a paper abstract or main text, often adjacent to a newline and the title field.

patterns.name: Structured key-value punctuation
patterns.context: In JSON or similar configuration text, a key is followed by a colon, quotation marks, and a value; occurs alongside highlighted field names and punctuation.

patterns.name: Title key and value
patterns.context: The title or text field in a configuration object, followed by a string value; in passage 8, the value is Max cpu_temp_avg.

patterns.name: Name and application description fields
patterns.context: Key-value pairs in an application manifest or sample configuration describing a project name and summary.

patterns.name: General English phrases and paper topic words
patterns.context: Appear separately in papers on recommender systems, social networks, algorithm analysis, cryptography, and mathematics; these phrases are scattered, with no stable shared semantic trigger condition.

patterns.name: Other paper title content
patterns.context: Located near the title field, but the title topics vary apart from sharing the paper metadata format.

4_1271.concept: 结构化文档字段标记
4_1271.description: 最稳定的模式是ArXiv元数据中的title与author字段；另对Github JSON键值及标题、名称等字段有反应。其余高亮词分散于不同学科，缺少统一语义。

patterns.name: 论文标题字段
patterns.context: 出现在文献元数据中，后接论文标题；此字段标记在多个 ArXiv 片段反复出现。

patterns.name: 作者字段
patterns.context: 论文摘要或正文之后的作者元数据字段，常与换行及标题字段相邻。

patterns.name: 结构化键值标点
patterns.context: JSON 或类似配置文本中，键名后接冒号、引号和值；与高亮的字段名及标点共同出现。

patterns.name: 标题键及值
patterns.context: 配置对象中的 title 或 text 字段，后接字符串值；第 8 段值为 Max cpu_temp_avg。

patterns.name: 名称及应用描述字段
patterns.context: 应用清单或示例配置中，以键值对描述项目名称与简介。

patterns.name: 一般英文词组及论文主题词
patterns.context: 分别出现在推荐系统、社交网络、算法分析、密码学和数学论文内容中；这些词组分散，未见稳定共同语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 其他论文标题内容
patterns.context: 位于标题字段附近，但除共享论文元数据格式外，标题主题各异。

en.concept: Title/display markers in structured fields or UI text
en.description: Activations are concentrated in the title field of paper metadata and its title content; there are also sporadic responses to GUI message-box calls, booking inquiries in business emails, tablet input and application descriptions, and HTML title tags.

patterns.name: MessageBox display call
patterns.context: Code calls a GUI dialog/message box to display content, often alongside System.Windows.Forms or input-box-related variables

patterns.name: Booking-related contact and information
patterns.context: Business email explains what information to prepare before booking and mentions travel arrangements for business and personal travelers

patterns.name: Paper metadata title field
patterns.context: The title field begins in paper or academic-document metadata/export text and introduces the paper title

patterns.name: Input methods and lightweight applications
patterns.context: Discusses lightweight applications suitable for tablet devices due to their limited keyboard input

patterns.name: Webpage title tag
patterns.context: An HTML example uses a title tag to set the webpage title, whose content describes drawing a circle

4_1271.concept: 结构化字段或界面文本的标题/显示标记
4_1271.description: 激活集中出现在论文元数据的 title 字段及其标题内容；另对 GUI 消息框调用、商务邮件中的预订联系、平板输入与应用描述、HTML 标题标签有零散响应。

patterns.name: MessageBox 显示调用
patterns.context: 代码中调用 GUI 对话框/消息框显示内容，常伴随 System.Windows.Forms 或输入框相关变量

patterns.name: 预订行程联系与信息
patterns.context: 商务邮件中说明预订前应准备信息，并提及商务与个人旅客的行程安排

patterns.name: 论文元数据标题字段
patterns.trigger: «title»«:»« |» 或 «title»«:» 后接论文标题；常邻近 bibliography 和 .bib 文件名
patterns.context: 论文或学术文档的元数据/导出文本中，标题字段开始并引出论文标题

patterns.name: 输入方式及轻量应用
patterns.context: 讨论平板设备因键盘输入受限而适合运行的轻量应用

patterns.name: 网页标题标签
patterns.context: HTML 示例中用 title 标签设置网页标题，内容描述绘制圆形

en.concept: Fields and delimiters in structured text
en.description: Activations mainly fall on dots, operators, and property/method access in code, as well as title/author field markers in document or paper metadata; there are also local patterns involving title fields, the ending of the word crowdfunding, and the name MovieLens.

patterns.name: Ruby/code punctuation and property access
patterns.context: In Ruby/ERB or JavaScript code, activations occur near dots, operators, object properties, and method calls; the specific syntax varies across snippets.

patterns.name: ArXiv metadata fields
patterns.context: Author/title labels and colons appear in paper text or metadata, with the title possibly following; activations concentrate on field markers and colons.

patterns.name: YAML/Markdown title field
patterns.context: In YAML front matter delimited by three hyphens, a title field is followed by a colon and title text; title languages and content vary.

patterns.name: Within the word crowdfunding
patterns.context: The word crowdfunding appears in English prose, with activations on consecutive subword fragments, especially toward the end of the word.

patterns.name: Recommender-system dataset name
patterns.context: MovieLens is enclosed in parentheses or italics when datasets are listed in an academic context.

4_1271.concept: 结构化文本中的字段与分隔符
4_1271.description: 激活主要落在代码中的点号、运算符和属性/方法访问，以及文档或论文元数据的 title/author 字段标记；另有标题字段、crowdfunding 词尾和 MovieLens 名称等局部模式。

patterns.name: Ruby/代码标点与属性访问
patterns.context: Ruby/ERB 或 JavaScript 代码中，激活落在点号、运算符及对象属性、方法调用附近；不同片段具体语法不完全相同。

patterns.name: ArXiv 元数据字段
patterns.context: 论文文本或元数据中出现 author/title 标签及冒号，标题可能紧随其后；激活集中在字段标记和冒号。

patterns.name: YAML/Markdown 标题字段
patterns.context: 文档以三连横线分隔的 YAML front matter 中，title 字段冒号后接标题文本；标题语言、内容各异。

patterns.name: crowdfunding 词形内部
patterns.context: 英文叙述中出现 crowdfunding，激活落在该词的连续子词片段，尤其词尾部分。

patterns.name: 推荐系统数据集名称
patterns.context: 学术语境中列举数据集时，MovieLens 被括号或斜体标记包围。

en.description: Primarily activates on addition/concatenation, assignment/field delimiters, and identifiers in code; there are also sporadic responses to the word feedback and to several specific code contexts.

en.description: Strong activations are scattered across different words and code positions: fragments containing iv in Nordic, Derivatives, captivating, Nattiv, and others, as well as Close, medical terms, OMEMS, 255, and neo. Although some subword fragments are similar, there is no stable shared meaning or clear unified trigger pattern.

patterns.name: ic within the word Nordic
patterns.context: The word Nordic is segmented in a sentence, with activations concentrated on ic after Nord; the paragraph discusses energy activity.

patterns.name: Subword fragment in Derivatives
patterns.context: Derivatives is segmented in an email salutation, with strong activations on iv; followed by Week subscriber.

patterns.name: Close
patterns.context: In a news headline, Close appears in a statement about voting to close the domestic ivory market.

patterns.name: Subword fragment in captivating
patterns.context: When describing a theatrical performance, activations concentrate on the iv subword in captivating.

patterns.name: Urethroscopy term
patterns.context: Urethroscopy at the beginning of a medical title; activations fall on the term-final -opy.

patterns.name: Fragment of the surname Nattiv
patterns.context: A film entry introduces director Guy Nattiv; activations occur on the iv subword at the end of the name.

patterns.name: OM E MSM abbreviation fragment
patterns.context: The abbreviation OMEMS appears in parentheses in examples of MEMS optical scanners and switches.

patterns.name: 255 value in code
patterns.context: When setting a graphics background color, the RGBA parameters begin with 255; the first 255 has the strongest activation.

patterns.name: neo- prefix fragment
patterns.context: The core structure of neo-clerodane diterpenes in a chemical title; activations fall on the neo prefix.

patterns.name: Subword fragment in Spectroscopy
patterns.context: A materials-science title begins with Spectroscopy; activations fall on the word-final -opy.

en.concept: iv character fragments and layout features
en.description: Activations prominently occur on iv fragments and names or words containing iv, and also cover uppercase ordinals and layout whitespace in some legal headings; scattered activations on other words and proper names cannot be grouped into a stable semantic theme.

patterns.name: Word-final/in-word iv and v spelling fragments
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on names, words, or transliterated fragments containing iv; they sometimes occur word-finally and sometimes are followed by other characters, with no unified semantic condition.

patterns.name: Uppercase segmentation in headings

patterns.name: Layout whitespace and line breaks
patterns.context: Line breaks and alignment spaces at paragraph beginnings or in court letterheads have significant activations; whitespace activations are not limited to ordinary body text.

patterns.name: Other local words and names
patterns.context: Some individual common words, proper names, or their subword fragments also activate, with no consistent context across passages.
patterns.domain: Narrative text, proper names, and lists

4_1286.concept: iv 字符片段及版面特征

en.description: Activation patterns are scattered: line breaks, tags, and code structure are prominent; court recurs in FreeLaw, alongside evidence/conditional words and layout traces. Patent technical passages and several numeric and symbolic triggers lack a unified explanation.

patterns.name: Line breaks or line-initial positions
patterns.context: The newline itself or text immediately following it is marked; this occurs across multiple passages, often alongside line wrapping or pagination in code and legal text.

patterns.name: XML/HTML tags and structured markup
patterns.context: Occurs near tag names, attributes, or closing tags, including XML- and HTML-style structures; activations also fall near tag contents.

patterns.name: Types, paths, and index structures in code
patterns.context: Marks occur in Scala type definitions and StackExchange explanations of array indices and shapes; the shared feature is code syntax or index/type expressions, but the precise trigger is not fully consistent.

patterns.name: court in legal documents
patterns.context: Occurs in legal opinions or judgment narratives, referring to a court; the word has strong activation in two passages.

patterns.name: Conditional/evidence expressions in legal text
patterns.context: Involves the application of legal rules, evidence, or statements of fact; includes different words besides court, so it cannot be identified as a single narrow trigger.

patterns.name: Technical terms and electromagnetic principles
patterns.context: Occurs separately in descriptions of memory technology and the electromagnetic force-compensation principle in electronic scales; the technical explanatory style is shared, but the trigger words differ.

patterns.name: NamedNodeMap identifier
patterns.context: In an HTML table code example, the initial segment of the interface name NamedNodeMap is strongly marked; other marks cluster around tags and line breaks.

patterns.name: Numbers and delimiters
patterns.context: Numbers, parentheses, or index-related symbols appear in legal citations, code, and mathematical explanations, with no consistent semantic condition.

patterns.name: Pagination and indentation in legal layout
patterns.context: Weak activations occur near page breaks, indentation, and split words in case text; these may reflect PDF/OCR layout traces.

4_1286.concept: 结构边界与文书标记
4_1286.description: 激活模式分散：换行、标签与代码结构较明显；FreeLaw 中 court 反复突出，另有证据/条件词及排版痕迹。专利技术段和若干数字、符号触发缺乏统一解释。

patterns.name: 换行或行首位置
patterns.context: 换行符本身或其后紧接文本被标记；在多段中出现，常伴随代码、法律文本的行折叠或分页格式。

patterns.name: XML/HTML 标签与结构化标记
patterns.context: 出现在标签名、属性或闭合标签附近，包含 XML、HTML 风格结构；激活也落在标签内容附近。

patterns.name: 代码中的类型、路径与索引结构
patterns.context: 标记出现在 Scala 类型定义及 StackExchange 对数组索引、形状的说明中；共同点是代码语法或索引/类型表达，但具体触发不完全一致。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的 court
patterns.context: 出现在法律意见或判决叙述中，指法院；此词在两个片段中强激活。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的条件/证据表达
patterns.context: 涉及法律规则适用、证据或事实陈述；除 court 外还包含不同词语，不能确定为同一窄触发。

patterns.name: 技术名词及电磁原理
patterns.context: 分别出现在存储器技术背景和电子秤电磁力补偿原理的说明中；共享技术说明文体，但触发词并不一致。

patterns.name: NamedNodeMap 标识符
patterns.context: HTML 表格代码示例中，接口名 NamedNodeMap 的首段被强烈标记；其余标记集中在标签与换行。
patterns.domain: GitHub 技术文档/代码示例

patterns.name: 数字及分隔符
patterns.context: 数字、括号或索引相关符号在法律引文、代码和数学说明中均出现，未显示一致语义条件。

patterns.name: 法律排版中的分页与缩进
patterns.context: 判例文本中的分页符、缩进及被断开的单词附近出现较弱激活；可能反映 PDF/OCR 排版痕迹。

en.description: Activations often fall on arguments, definitions, and logical transitions following formulas in mathematics papers, especially alongside sets, matrices, coordinates, and LaTeX notation; a few domain-specific cases involve XML build configuration and physics/biology terms.

patterns.name: Introductions and explanations after formulas/symbols
patterns.context: After a mathematical symbol, formula, or definition, introduces a conclusion, property, or notation explanation; often occurs in complete English sentences
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematics papers, StackExchange mathematics answers

patterns.name: Conditional clauses and logical transitions
patterns.context: Logical connectives in conditional, corollary, or case-based arguments, usually near formulas and mathematical objects

patterns.name: Sets/objects denoted by A and coordinate or index structures in formulas
patterns.context: Objects such as sets, matrices, or operators denoted by A, accompanied by coordinates, powers, indices, or linear-space notation

patterns.name: Paper notation and mathematical layout boundaries
patterns.context: Near LaTeX math environments, theorem labels, section-style notation explanations, or citation markers

patterns.name: Specific XML/MSBuild configuration markers
patterns.context: Near attribute conditions and build configuration strings in XML project files

patterns.name: Specialized terms in physical/biological materials
patterns.context: Describes stealth structures or the physical process of lasers acting on lipid molecules, with variables and units interspersed

patterns.name: Isolated Markov chain terminology
patterns.context: States the chain's irreducibility and its properties after a formula

patterns.name: Informal statement of a statistical distance definition
patterns.context: First states that a standard definition is used, then expresses distribution distance in terms of events and probabilities

4_1286.concept: 数学符号上下文中的论证衔接
4_1286.description: 激活常落在数学论文中公式后的论证、定义和逻辑衔接处，尤其伴随集合、矩阵、坐标及 LaTeX 记号；另有 XML 构建配置和物理/生物术语等少数领域特例。

patterns.name: 公式/符号后的引出与说明
patterns.trigger: “there is a coordinate”, “it follows that”, “we also have”, “denote”, “We say that”
patterns.context: 数学符号、公式或定义之后，引出结论、性质或记号说明；常见于完整英文句子中
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学论文、StackExchange 数学回答

patterns.name: 条件从句与逻辑衔接
patterns.trigger: “If such a Markov chain is irreducible, then”, “In particular”, “Thus”, “Second, if”
patterns.context: 条件、推论或分情况论证中的逻辑连接词，附近通常有公式与数学对象

patterns.name: 公式中的集合/对象 A 与坐标或索引结构
patterns.context: 集合、矩阵、算子等以 A 表示的对象，伴随坐标、幂、索引或线性空间记号

patterns.name: 论文记号与数学排版边界
patterns.context: LaTeX 数学环境、定理标签、章节式记号说明或引用标记附近

patterns.name: 特定 XML/MSBuild 配置标记
patterns.context: XML 项目文件中属性条件与构建配置字符串附近

patterns.name: 物理/生物材料中的专门术语
patterns.context: 描述隐身结构或激光作用于脂质分子的物理过程，夹杂变量与单位

patterns.name: 独立的马尔可夫链术语
patterns.context: 公式后陈述链的不可约性及其性质

patterns.name: 统计距离定义的口语化陈述
patterns.trigger: “We use a standard definition”, “We say that two distributions”
patterns.context: 先说明采用标准定义，再用事件与概率表达分布距离
patterns.domain: 理论计算机科学/概率论文

en.description: Activations are scattered across whitespace, line breaks, punctuation, and text-structure boundaries, and also involve common function words, subword fragments, and numeric symbols; they span domains and styles, with no stable topic word or single semantic field.

patterns.name: Non-contiguous whitespace and layout spacing
patterns.context: Unusually long spaces, line breaks, or layout spacing between words or at line beginnings; activations fall on whitespace tokens, often alongside other punctuation and word fragments.
patterns.domain: Multiple styles, including legal, academic, web, code, and email text

patterns.name: Punctuation and structural boundaries
patterns.context: Punctuation, parentheses, arrows, braces, and line-break boundaries in sentences or code; sometimes co-occurs with nearby whitespace.
patterns.domain: Prose, mathematical typesetting, source code, and LaTeX

patterns.name: General function words and phrase continuation
patterns.context: Common English function words occur in grammatical connections, conditions, explanations, or requests within sentences; no fixed word or collocation recurs across all examples.
patterns.domain: Academic discussion, encyclopedias, Q&A, emails, and legal narratives

patterns.name: Subwords within words and technical identifiers
patterns.context: Internal fragments of words or identifiers, especially in compounds, underscore naming, and technical terms; triggers are sporadic.
patterns.domain: Academic text, technical documentation, and code

patterns.name: Numeric values and mathematical symbols
patterns.context: Years, mathematical expressions, or numbers appear in explanatory text and formulas.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic historical entries, academic mathematics text

patterns.name: Incidental lexical items
patterns.context: These words occur in only one context and do not show a stable shared semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Web plugin Q&A, historical narration, business emails

4_1286.concept: 文本边界与形式特征
4_1286.description: 激活分散于空白、换行、标点和文本结构边界，也涉及常见功能词、词内片段及数字符号；跨领域、跨文体，没有稳定主题词或单一语义场。

patterns.name: 非连续空白与排版间距
patterns.context: 在单词之间或行首出现异常长空白、换行或排版间距；激活落在空白 token 上，常与其他标点、词片段同时出现。
patterns.domain: 多种文体，包括法律文本、学术文本、网页、代码和邮件

patterns.name: 标点和结构边界
patterns.context: 句子或代码中的标点、括号、箭头、花括号及换行边界；有时与相邻空白共同出现。
patterns.domain: 散文、数学排版、源代码和 LaTeX

patterns.name: 通用功能词与短语续接
patterns.context: 常见英语功能词出现在句内语法连接、条件、说明或请求表达中；未见某个固定词或搭配贯穿所有例子。
patterns.domain: 学术论述、百科、问答、邮件及法律叙述

patterns.name: 词内子词与技术标识符片段
patterns.context: 词语或标识符的内部片段，尤其在复合词、下划线命名和技术术语中；触发较零散。
patterns.domain: 学术文本、技术文档与代码

patterns.name: 数值与数学符号
patterns.context: 年份、数学表达式或编号出现在说明性文本和公式中。
patterns.domain: 百科历史条目、学术数学文本

patterns.name: 偶发词项
patterns.context: 这些词只在单个语境中出现，未显示稳定的共同语义条件。
patterns.domain: 网页插件问答、历史叙述、商务邮件

en.description: Activations occur across word-final or internal fragments of long words, whitespace and punctuation boundaries, and sporadically in date/time expressions, legal actions, regulatory compounds, entertainment descriptions, and code structures. No clear cross-domain rule emerges; some high activations fall on spaces or word endings.

patterns.name: Word-final or suffix fragments in long words
patterns.context: Activations often fall on the endings, suffixes, or internal fragments of longer words; this is especially evident in passages 1, 3, and 4. Not all instances can be reduced to the same morphological rule.
patterns.domain: Natural language across domains and legal text

patterns.name: Spaces or layout gaps
patterns.context: Activations mark interword whitespace or layout gaps, especially in email bodies, legal materials, and around code; whitespace itself may trigger jointly with following words or formatting boundaries.
patterns.domain: Emails, legal documents, code, and mixed-format text

patterns.name: Commas and nearby positions
patterns.context: Commas are prominent in business emails and also occur in other texts; punctuation alone does not explain the other high activations.

patterns.name: Date and time expressions
patterns.context: Moderate to strong activations occur near dates, years, days of the week, or durations; it is unclear whether this is an independent trigger pattern.
patterns.domain: Sports news, music entries, and legal narratives

patterns.name: Action-word fragments in legal records
patterns.context: Activations occur near words related to bodily actions, movement, and testimony in legal narratives or trial records; commonality among these examples is limited.

patterns.name: Time frames and rulemaking-related words
patterns.context: Activations occur near compounds or word boundaries related to rulemaking and time frames in energy regulatory briefings.

patterns.name: Types and punctuation boundaries in code
patterns.context: In C# declarations, structural positions such as square brackets, identifier fragments, underscores, and colons activate, but intensity is scattered and difficult to unify with natural-language patterns.

patterns.name: Evaluative words in entertainment show descriptions
patterns.context: Near time words and evaluative or action words in the title or promotional description of a WWE show recap.

patterns.name: Entity fragments in song titles and album information
patterns.context: Activations occur around copulas, years, and entity names in song cover and album descriptions; no clear consistent semantic trigger is evident.

4_1286.concept: 词尾与文本边界片段
4_1286.description: 激活分布于长词末尾或内部片段、空白与标点边界，也零散出现在日期时间、法律动作、监管复合词、娱乐描述和代码结构中。跨域一致规则不明显，部分高激活落在空格或词尾。

patterns.name: 长词内部的词尾或后缀
patterns.context: 激活常落在较长单词的末尾、后缀或词内片段；段1、3、4尤其明显。但并非所有实例都能归结为同一词形规则。
patterns.domain: 多领域自然语言及法律文本

patterns.name: 空格或版式间隔
patterns.context: 激活标在词间空白或排版间隔上，尤其出现在邮件正文、法律材料及代码周边；空白本身可能与后续词或格式边界共同触发。
patterns.domain: 邮件、法律文书、代码及混合格式文本

patterns.name: 逗号及其邻近位置
patterns.context: 逗号在商务邮件中突出出现，也见于其他文本；单靠标点无法解释其余高激活。

patterns.name: 日期与时间表达
patterns.context: 日期、年份、星期或时长等时间表达附近出现中等至较强激活；是否为独立触发模式并不确定。
patterns.domain: 体育新闻、音乐条目及法律叙述

patterns.name: 法律记录中的动作词片段
patterns.context: 法律叙述或庭审记录中，身体动作、移动及证言相关词附近出现激活；这些例子之间的共同性有限。

patterns.name: 时间框架及规则制定相关词
patterns.context: 能源监管简报中，规则制定、时间框架等复合词或词边界附近激活。

patterns.name: 代码中的类型与标点边界
patterns.context: C# 声明中方括号、标识符片段、下划线和冒号等结构位置有激活，但强度分散，难与自然语言模式统一。

patterns.name: 娱乐节目描述中的评价词
patterns.context: WWE 节目回顾的标题或宣传性描述中，时间词及评价、动作类词附近激活。

patterns.name: 歌曲名及专辑信息中的实体片段
patterns.context: 歌曲翻唱与专辑介绍中，系词、年份及实体名称周围出现激活；未见明确一致的语义触发词。

en.concept: Evaluative nouns and formal duties, authority
en.description: The strongest and most recurrent pattern is things in evaluative contexts; there are also activations for lip/product effects in beauty descriptions, duties and obligations, and power and tenure in political or professional contexts.

patterns.name: Evaluative collocations with things
patterns.context: things occurs in about phrases, preceded by an evaluative modifier, introducing the merits of a place, person, product, or service; e.g. “good things about Kasabian”“best things about Las Animas”“smart things to say”“great things about Google+”“two important things”。
patterns.domain: Reviews, travel introductions, music reviews, technology marketing, academic writing

patterns.name: Descriptions of appearance and physical features
patterns.context: Describes the appearance of lips and changes brought about by lip-plumping products; the same passage also contains pluming qualities, possibly related to appearance or product effects.

patterns.name: Duties or responsibilities
patterns.context: The noun refers to someone's work responsibilities or formal occupational duties; examples occur in employment-duty legal materials and a political report about senators' duties.

patterns.name: Power and tenure
patterns.context: Discusses emergency powers that can be used to take action, or the length of time someone holds a position; both occur in specific institutional or professional contexts.

4_1286.concept: 评价性名词及正式职责、权力
4_1286.description: 最强且重复的模式是评价性语境中的 things；另对美容描述中的唇部／产品效果、职责义务，以及政治或职业语境中的权力和任期有激活。

patterns.name: things 的评价性搭配
patterns.context: things 位于 about 短语中，前面带有评价性限定，介绍某地、人物、产品或服务的优点；如 “good things about Kasabian”“best things about Las Animas”“smart things to say”“great things about Google+”“two important things”。
patterns.domain: 评论、旅游介绍、音乐评论、科技营销、学术写作

patterns.name: 外观与身体特征描述
patterns.context: 描述唇部外观、丰唇产品带来的变化；同段还出现 pluming qualities，可能与外观或产品效果相关。
patterns.domain: 美容产品评论／生活方式文本

patterns.name: 职责或责任
patterns.context: 名词指某人的工作责任或正式职务义务；分别处于法律材料中的雇佣职责、政治报道中的参议员职责语境。

patterns.name: 权力与任期
patterns.context: 谈及可用于采取行动的紧急权力，或某人在某职位上的任职期限；两处均为具体制度或职业语境。

en.description: Activations are most concentrated on things: it refers generally to matters, merits, or preferences, as well as personal belongings. There are also sporadic activations on duty terms duties/responsibilities, time and multiplicative expressions, and a few dates, punctuation marks, and proper-name fragments, with no unified syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Semantic uses of things
patterns.context: thing/things is a general noun, modified by an evaluative or preference word and often followed by about/of; describes preferences, merits, or matters.
patterns.domain: Blogs, reviews, personal profiles, and other informal text

patterns.name: things as personal belongings
patterns.context: things refers to someone's personal belongings to pack up or take, rather than abstract matters.

patterns.name: responsibilities in the sense of duties
patterns.context: Refers to someone's job responsibilities in legal text.

patterns.name: duties in the sense of responsibilities
patterns.context: In a public-office or professional-responsibility context, means carrying out one's duties.

patterns.name: Time spans and multiplicative units
patterns.context: Numbers modify time units or times to express term length or a multiplicative degree; the specific activated words differ.

patterns.name: Time words in column headings
patterns.context: Date/frequency words in a blog column introduction indicate a regular publishing schedule.

patterns.name: Punctuation and structural positions
patterns.context: Commas and periods in a list of committee names also activate, with no clear semantic trigger condition.

patterns.name: Local activations in titles or proper names
patterns.context: Occurs only in individual proper names, titles, or subword fragments, without a stable shared context.
patterns.domain: Personal dating profiles, committee names, etc.

patterns.name: Transcription/formatting residue
patterns.context: Possibly truncated words or layout/line-break residue; the semantic trigger cannot be determined from context.

4_1286.concept: 名词性事项与职责表达
4_1286.description: 激活最集中于 things：泛指事项、优点或喜好，也包括个人物品；另对职责词 duties/responsibilities、时间与倍数表达及少数日期、标点、专名片段有零散激活，未见统一句法条件。

patterns.name: things 的语义性用法
patterns.context: thing/things 作泛指名词，前有评价或偏好词修饰，常接 about/of；描述喜好、优点或事项。
patterns.domain: 博客、评论、个人资料等非正式文字

patterns.name: things 作个人物品
patterns.context: things 指某人要收拾或拿走的随身物品，而非抽象事项。

patterns.name: responsibilities 的职责义
patterns.context: 法律文本中指某人的工作职责，后接职责内容。

patterns.name: duties 的职责义
patterns.context: 公职或职业责任语境，表示履行职务。

patterns.name: 时间跨度与倍数单位
patterns.context: 数字修饰时间单位或 times，表达任期长度或程度倍数；被激活的具体词并不相同。
patterns.domain: 新闻评论、环境政策文本

patterns.name: 栏目标题中的时间词
patterns.context: 博客栏目介绍中，日期/频率词用于安排定期发布。

patterns.name: 标点与结构位置
patterns.context: 委员会名称列举中的逗号、句点也出现激活，缺乏明确语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 标题或专名中的局部激活
patterns.context: 只在个别专名、标题或词内片段出现，未显示稳定的共同上下文。
patterns.domain: 个人交友简介、委员会名称等

patterns.name: 转录/格式残留
patterns.context: 疑似截断词或排版/换行残留，无法从上下文确定语义触发因素。

en.description: Activations fall on words such as things, affairs, season, sessions, work/works, duties, roles, place, and Ohio, covering general things, affairs, seasons, training, works, duties, roles, status, and case citations; they span multiple genres with no unified semantics.

patterns.name: General things or categories
patterns.context: The noun things refers to hobbies, benefits, topics, or objects, usually appearing after a modifier or in evaluations of a category of things.

patterns.name: Owning or conducting business
patterns.context: In legal contexts, refers to an organization’s affairs, preceded by the modifier business.

patterns.name: Season performance
patterns.context: Sports reporting discusses a team’s results or performance in a given season.

patterns.name: Boxing rounds and matchups
patterns.context: Describes a boxer’s training sparring and compares it with official matches.

patterns.name: Work or works
patterns.context: Refers to an individual’s creative or professional works, including literary and screen works.

patterns.name: Duties
patterns.context: Describes a public official’s duties and their balance with personal life.

patterns.name: Roles
patterns.context: Introduces an actor’s best-known acting roles.

patterns.name: Position
patterns.context: Discusses someone’s standing or position in boxing.

patterns.name: State name
patterns.context: A state name in a legal case citation, followed by reporter volume and page information.

4_1286.concept: 事物及其相关名词
