4_1286.description: 激活落在 things、affairs、season、sessions、work/works、duties、roles、place、Ohio 等词上，涵盖泛指事物、事务、赛季、训练、作品、职责、角色、地位及判例引文；跨多种文体，未见统一语义。

patterns.name: 泛指事物或类别
patterns.context: 名词 things 指爱好、好处、主题或事物，通常出现在修饰语之后或表达对某类事物的评价时。

patterns.name: 拥有或经营事务
patterns.context: 法律语境中指某组织的事务，前有 business 修饰。

patterns.name: 赛季表现
patterns.context: 体育报道中谈球队在某赛季的成绩或表现。

patterns.name: 拳击回合与对阵
patterns.context: 描述拳击手的训练对练，并与正式比赛作比较。

patterns.name: 工作或作品
patterns.context: 指个人创作或专业作品，分别涉及文学作品与影视作品。

patterns.name: 职责
patterns.context: 描述公职人员的职责及其与个人生活之间的平衡。

patterns.name: 角色
patterns.context: 介绍演员最知名的表演角色。

patterns.name: 地点
patterns.context: 讨论某人在拳击领域中的地位或位置。

patterns.name: 州名
patterns.context: 法律判例引文中的州名，后接判例集卷页信息。

en.description: The most stable pattern activates thing/things, especially when modified by evaluative adjectives or followed by complements such as about, to do, and to say. Several other content nouns also activate sporadically, without a unified context.

patterns.name: Positive or specific content after “things”
patterns.context: The noun thing(s) heads a phrase, often modified by evaluative words such as good, smart, or enjoyable, or followed by specifications such as about/to do/to say; activation falls on things/thing.
patterns.domain: Reviews, sports news, personal profiles, blogs, and other genres

patterns.name: Additional activation of thing or domain nouns
patterns.context: Activation falls on content nouns or within noun phrases, without an obvious things trigger nearby; their connection to the main pattern is unclear.
patterns.domain: News, law, sports and entertainment, blogs, literature

4_1286.concept: 事物与内容名词
4_1286.description: 最稳定的模式是激活 thing/things，尤其在评价性形容词修饰、或接 about、to do、to say 等补语时。另有若干分散的内容名词激活，缺乏统一上下文。

patterns.name: “things”后的褒义或具体内容
patterns.trigger: « things»10 about« Kasabian»；« good»3« thing»9« happens»；« things»9 to do；« smart»« things»9 to say；« all»« things»8 French；« enjoyable»« things»8
patterns.context: 名词 thing(s) 位于短语中心，常由 good、smart、enjoyable 等评价词修饰，或接 about/to do/to say 等补充说明；激活落在 things/thing 上。
patterns.domain: 评论、体育新闻、个人简介、博客等多种文体

patterns.name: 事物或领域名词的补充激活
patterns.trigger: « emergency» powers；« Fourth»…« Amendment» rights；« hardcore» history；« place»；« favorite» things
patterns.context: 激活落在内容名词或名词短语内部，周围没有明显的 thing(s) 触发；这些例子与主模式的联系不明确。
patterns.domain: 新闻、法律、体育娱乐、博客、文学

en.description: Activations occur mainly on things and nearby modifiers, especially expressions that categorize, evaluate, or enumerate things; other activations occur in “7th season” and “emergency powers” in political reporting, with different triggers.

patterns.name: Enumeration of kinds of things
patterns.context: When evaluating, introducing, or listing a category of “things,” often in structures such as “things about X,” “things French,” or “things to say”; the trigger falls on “things” and adjacent words.
patterns.domain: Reviews, blogs, news, and forum posts

patterns.name: Season marked by an ordinal
patterns.context: A professional athlete announces a return, with an ordinal numeral modifying “season.”

patterns.name: Emergency powers
patterns.context: Political news quotes an official calling on a governor to use emergency powers to provide aid; the trigger is “powers,” not a things-enumeration structure.

4_1286.concept: things 类别表达为主
4_1286.description: 主要激活于 things 及其邻近修饰语，尤其是对事物作类别化、评价或列举的表达；另在“7th season”和政治报道的“emergency powers”中出现，触发条件不同。

patterns.name: 东西／事物的类别枚举
patterns.trigger: “things”后接或紧邻性质、类别词，如 “good things”“cool things”“French things”“interesting things”“smart things”
patterns.context: 在评价、介绍或列举某类“things”时，常用于 “things about X”“things French” 或 “things to say” 等结构；触发位置在 “things” 及其相邻词上。
patterns.domain: 评论、博客、新闻及论坛文本

patterns.name: 序数词所标记的赛季
patterns.context: 职业运动员宣布将回归，数字序数词修饰 “season”。

patterns.name: 紧急权力
patterns.context: 政治新闻引述官员要求州长动用紧急权力提供援助；触发词是 “powers”，而非 things 枚举结构。

en.concept: Multiple local lexical and code patterns
en.description: Activations cluster around good thing(s) collocations, legal remedies and powers, professional season expressions, Java Map generics, and contracts and debuts after soccer transfers; other scattered items cannot be grouped.

patterns.name: “things” noun collocations
patterns.context: thing(s) follows modifiers such as good or appears in evaluative expressions such as “one good thing happens” and “a couple of good things about”; activation centers on thing(s) and nearby collocates.
patterns.domain: News and review articles, everyday language

patterns.name: Legal remedies and powers
patterns.context: Legal discussion considers whether administrative remedies have been exhausted, whether legal remedies are adequate, and the court’s exercise of equitable powers.

patterns.name: Season and career expressions
patterns.context: An athlete announces a season in their professional career and says they will return to compete; activation falls on the ordinal season expression and season.

patterns.name: Java generic Map declaration
patterns.context: Java code declares a generic Map with String or Integer keys and String values, commonly in field or local-variable declarations.

patterns.name: Map generics in entity lists
patterns.context: Java method return values, variables, or collection elements use Map generics; code also includes types such as List, ItemEntity, String, and Object.
patterns.domain: Java code and comments on StackExchange/GitHub

patterns.name: Contract and debut after a soccer transfer
patterns.context: After a player transfers to a club, they sign a multiyear contract; the narrative describes their first match and the competition round.

patterns.name: Unexplained words and fragments
patterns.context: These occur separately in rugby news, text about the Hungarian league, band reviews, dietary advice, and code comments/annotations; the visible activation tokens do not reveal a common trigger sufficient for a unified category.
patterns.domain: Sports news, reviews, health articles, and code

4_1286.concept: 多类局部词汇与代码模式
4_1286.description: 激活集中于 good thing(s) 搭配、法律救济与权力、职业赛季表达、Java Map 泛型，以及足球转会后合同和首战；另有多处零散词项无法归并。

patterns.name: “things”名词搭配
patterns.context: thing(s) 位于 good 等修饰语后，或进入“one good thing happens”“a couple of good things about”这样的评价表达；激活集中在 thing(s) 本身及其邻近搭配。
patterns.domain: 新闻与评论文章、日常表达

patterns.name: 司法救济与权力用语
patterns.context: 法律论述中讨论行政救济是否穷尽、法律救济是否充分，以及法院行使衡平权力。

patterns.name: 赛季与生涯表达
patterns.context: 宣布职业生涯某一赛季，并说明将回归参赛；激活落在序数赛季表达及 season。

patterns.name: Java 泛型映射声明
patterns.context: Java 代码中声明以 String 或 Integer 为键、String 为值的泛型 Map，常见于字段或局部变量声明。
patterns.domain: GitHub 上的 Java 源码

patterns.name: 实体列表中的 Map 泛型
patterns.context: Java 方法返回值、变量或集合元素使用 Map 泛型；代码中还出现 List、ItemEntity、String、Object 等类型。
patterns.domain: StackExchange/GitHub 上的 Java 代码及注释

patterns.name: 足球转会后的合同与首战
patterns.context: 球员转会至俱乐部后签订多年合同，并叙述首场比赛及赛事轮次。
patterns.domain: 百科全书式足球运动员传记

patterns.name: 未解释的词汇与片段
patterns.context: 分别出现在橄榄球新闻、匈牙利联赛相关文字、乐队评论、饮食建议和代码注释/标注中；可见激活 token 未显示出足以统一归类的共同触发条件。
patterns.domain: 体育新闻、评论、健康文章及代码

en.concept: Broad responses to syntax and content words
en.description: Activations span sentence-final punctuation, common connective function words, and words conveying events, outcomes, or research content across genres. A few numeric time expressions and domain terms also activate, with no single stable semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Sentence-closing punctuation
patterns.context: Punctuation appears at the end of sentences or clauses, with activations especially around commas and periods; sometimes it may cross subword boundaries.

patterns.name: Function words and verb collocations
patterns.context: Common function words or auxiliaries occur in syntactic connections, clause introductions, and verb phrases; the pattern is not very specific.

patterns.name: Key nouns in events or entries
patterns.context: Nouns in noun phrases activate when describing experiences, games, research functions, or research findings.
patterns.domain: Personal narratives, sports reporting, academic text

patterns.name: Key action or outcome words
patterns.context: Verbs and nominal outcome words activate when narrating events, people’s roles, or institutional/legal effects.
patterns.domain: News, entertainment, political and legal text

patterns.name: Numeric and time expressions
patterns.context: Numbers, years, and time units appear in personal experiences or sports/transfer timelines.

patterns.name: Insufficiently explained local collocations
patterns.context: These words activate locally in their respective contexts, but the samples do not establish common semantic or syntactic conditions.

4_1286.concept: 广泛的句法与内容词响应
4_1286.description: 激活分布于句末标点、常见连接功能词，以及多文体中承载事件、结果或研究内容的词；少数数字时间表达和领域词也被激活，缺乏单一稳定语义模式。

patterns.name: 句子收束标点
patterns.context: 标点出现在句子或分句的收束位置，尤以逗号、句号前后激活；有时可能是跨子词边界

patterns.name: 功能词与动词搭配
patterns.context: 常见功能词或助动词出现在句法连接、从句引入及动词短语中，模式不够专一

patterns.name: 事件或条目中的关键名词
patterns.context: 描述经历、比赛、研究功能或研究发现时，名词短语中的名词被激活
patterns.domain: 个人叙述、体育报道、学术文本

patterns.name: 关键动作或结果词
patterns.context: 叙述事件发展、人物角色或制度/法律效力时，动词及名词性结果词出现激活
patterns.domain: 新闻、娱乐、政治法律文本

patterns.name: 数字与时间表达
patterns.context: 数字、年份及时间单位出现在个人经历或赛事/转会时间线中

patterns.name: 未充分解释的局部搭配
patterns.context: 这些词在各自语境中局部激活，但无法从样本确认共同的语义或句法条件
patterns.domain: 娱乐、食品科学、法律、商业

en.concept: Mixed technical and narrative text features
en.description: Activation patterns are diverse: expressions about the credibility of testimony in legal trials, and distinct local patterns involving durations, mathematical summation and optimization, biomedical experiments, soccer narratives, and generated code comments.

patterns.name: Witness credibility
patterns.context: In a legal trial context, evaluates the credibility of a witness’s or party’s statements or testimony; often co-occurs with words such as trial, counsel, testimony, and statement.

patterns.name: Duration expressions
patterns.context: A duration modified by a number, especially with the colloquial approximation suffix “-ish,” in a personal account of past experiences.

patterns.name: Infinite sums in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: A LaTeX mathematical derivation contains a sum from 1 to infinity and probability/expectation symbols.

patterns.name: BMP2 experiments and methods
patterns.context: Introduces experimental design and technical methods, reporting mice and assessing OA progression.

patterns.name: Summation in physics formulas
patterns.context: A field-theory formula in LaTeX sums indexed variables, alongside Greek letters and derivative symbols.

patterns.name: Soccer seasons and match narratives
patterns.context: Describes team season performance, player selections, and matches coached, including club and competition names.

patterns.name: Required-method comments in generated code
patterns.context: XML-style comments in a code designer’s generated region describe required methods and warn against modification.

patterns.name: Objective functions in optimization problems
patterns.context: A mathematical optimization statement marks the objective with Objective and requires minimizing an expression involving a sum, norm, or set size.
patterns.domain: Mathematics papers or optimization problem descriptions

4_1286.concept: 混合技术与叙事文本特征
4_1286.description: 激活模式多样：法律审判中关于证言可信度的表述，以及时间长度、数学求和与优化、生物医学实验、足球叙述和生成代码注释等各自独立的局部模式。

patterns.name: 证人可信度
patterns.context: 法律审判语境中评价证人或当事人陈述、证言的可信性；常与 trial、counsel、testimony、statement 等词同现。

patterns.name: 时间长度表达
patterns.context: 数字修饰的时间长度，尤其带有口语化约数后缀“-ish”，并处于个人回顾经历的语境。

patterns.name: 数学公式中的无穷求和
patterns.context: LaTeX 数学推导中出现从 1 到无穷的求和及概率/期望符号。

patterns.name: BMP2实验与技术
patterns.context: 介绍实验设计、报告小鼠及评估 OA 进展的技术方法。

patterns.name: 物理公式中的求和
patterns.context: LaTeX 场论公式中对带指标的变量求和，伴随希腊字母及导数符号。

patterns.name: 足球赛季与比赛叙述
patterns.context: 叙述球队赛季表现、球员入选与教练执教比赛，含俱乐部和赛事名称。

patterns.name: 生成代码中的必需方法注释
patterns.context: 代码设计器生成区域中的 XML 风格注释，说明必需方法及勿修改提示。

patterns.name: 优化问题目标函数
patterns.context: 数学优化表述中以 Objective 标记目标，并要求最小化含求和、范数或集合大小的表达式。
patterns.domain: 数学论文或优化问题描述

en.concept: Phrase and field boundaries across diverse texts
en.description: Activations span multiple genres, concentrating mainly on phrase boundaries and specific word fragments in structured narratives: soccer matches, mining and health research terminology, unit-conversion problems, news expressions, and encyclopedia-entry formats. No unified semantic trigger is evident.

patterns.name: Soccer events and player narratives
patterns.context: Mentions matches, seasons, transfers, or team history, often with years, dates, and team names.

patterns.name: Mining exploration results heading
patterns.context: A drilling report for a mining area or ore body describes mineral resource results and grade.

patterns.name: Diseases, outcomes, and groups in research reports
patterns.context: Disease or health research discusses outcome measures, occupational groups, and reference groups.

patterns.name: Numeric strings in math unit-conversion problems
patterns.context: Asks “What is/how many …?” and requires converting time or mass units; activation often falls on answer numbers or split numeric fragments.

patterns.name: Polls and percentages in reporting
patterns.context: Reports poll results, identifying the polling organization, media source, and share of voters.

patterns.name: Life and place of residence in personal reflections
patterns.context: First-person reflections on personal experiences mention work-life balance or place of residence.

patterns.name: Historical sports event narratives
patterns.context: Chronologically recounts teams’ visits, tours, or matches by year, involving British and American teams and historical figures.

patterns.name: Links and category labels at the end of encyclopedia entries
patterns.context: The end of an entry lists external links and categories for people, birth years, or ethnic background.

4_1286.concept: 多样文本中的短语与字段边界
4_1286.description: 激活覆盖多种文体，主要集中在结构化叙述中的短语边界与特定词片：足球比赛、矿业和健康研究术语、换算题数字、新闻表达，以及百科条目格式；未见统一语义触发点。

patterns.name: 足球赛事与球员叙述
patterns.trigger: « match»10；« first»5« match»9；« Euro»；« transfer»；« contract»
patterns.context: 提及比赛、赛季、转会或球队经历，常带年份、日期和球队名。
patterns.domain: 足球新闻与百科人物传记

patterns.name: 矿业钻探结果标题
patterns.context: 矿区或矿体的钻探报告，描述矿物资源结果及品位。

patterns.name: 研究报告中的疾病、结局与分组
patterns.context: 疾病或健康研究，讨论结局指标、职业分组及参照组。

patterns.name: 数学单位换算题中的数值串
patterns.trigger: «?»后的答案，以及« millenn»«ia»、« millig»«rams»、« tonnes»等单位附近的数字
patterns.context: 以“What is/how many …?”提问，要求对时间或质量单位进行换算；激活常落在答案数字或被拆分的数字片段上。

patterns.name: 民调报道中的调查与百分比
patterns.context: 报道民调结果，交代调查机构、媒体来源和选民比例。

patterns.name: 个人反思中的生活与居住地
patterns.trigger: « my» « life»；« I» call home；« months» in Nashville
patterns.context: 第一人称回顾个人经历，并谈到生活平衡或居住地。

patterns.name: 历史体育赛事叙述
patterns.context: 按年份叙述球队访问、巡回或比赛，涉及英美球队及历史人物。

patterns.name: 百科条目末尾的链接与分类标签
patterns.context: 条目尾部列出外部链接和人物类别、出生年份或族裔背景。

en.description: Activations are distributed across multiple genres, marking common words, numbers, punctuation, and formatting fragments; the fragments show no stable semantic or topical commonality, and the available evidence is insufficient to identify a consistent trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Tokenization boundary of the same surface string “ on”
patterns.context: Activation often falls on words beginning with a space or on punctuation, and sometimes on punctuation itself; meanings and grammatical functions vary widely, so these fragments do not establish a common semantic trigger.
patterns.domain: Multiple genres, including news, encyclopedias, email, medical abstracts, and webpages

4_1286.concept: none
4_1286.description: 激活分布于多种文体，标记位置包括常见词、数字、标点及格式片段；片段间看不出稳定的语义或主题共性，现有证据不足以确定一致触发模式。

patterns.name: 同一表面字符串“ on”的分词边界
patterns.trigger: «-»、«,»、« according»、« for»、« from»、« of»、« is»、« in»、« years»、« people»、« households»等被标记片段
patterns.context: 激活位置常落在以空格开头的词或标点上，也有标点自身；词义和语法功能差异很大，无法由这些片段确定共同语义触发条件。
patterns.domain: 新闻、百科、邮件、医学摘要及网页等多种文体

en.concept: Multidomain text features related to numbers and structural boundaries
en.description: Activations span multiple topics, often occurring near years, quantities, specifications, punctuation, and paragraph boundaries; additional local contexts involve soccer, demographics, elections, legal payments, history, real estate, products, and food. No single semantic pattern fully explains them.

patterns.name: Numeric and quantity formats
patterns.context: Numbers or quantity expressions occur within sentences or in text sequences of adjacent numbers, units, commas, hyphens, and similar elements; the trigger is the number itself or a nearby token. Topics differ across passages.
patterns.domain: Multiple genres, including encyclopedias, news, legal text, and product descriptions

patterns.name: Paragraph or section boundaries
patterns.context: A narrative unit has just ended, followed by a line break, heading, or new event opening; prominent activations in paragraphs 1, 3, and 4 are adjacent to these boundaries.

patterns.name: Place names and regional descriptions
patterns.context: Place names occur in descriptions of population, national history, city markets, or local food culture; activation may also fall on nearby quantities, domain words, or sentence structure.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, news, real estate, forum discussions

patterns.name: Population, growth, and statistical statements
patterns.context: Describes a county or region’s growth ranking, then turns to census information, population totals, and household counts.

patterns.name: Soccer narratives and match/season information
patterns.context: A team’s, player’s, or coach’s seasons, competitions, appointments, and transfer history; numbers and paragraph transitions may also contribute to activation.

patterns.name: Elections and opinion polls in news
patterns.context: Reports population movement and voting before and after an election, and polling organizations’ assessments of the state of the race.

patterns.name: Payments and dates in legal cases
patterns.context: Describes payment arrangements, recipients, months, and legal case records; date and amount formats are prominent.

patterns.name: National history and industrialization
patterns.context: Introduces Belgium’s history after independence, industrialization, and the context of European wars.

patterns.name: Real estate markets and safe havens
patterns.context: Distinguishes safe-haven status inside and outside a region, and discusses Dubai’s luxury housing market and possible drivers.

patterns.name: Product specifications and dimensions
patterns.context: In consumer electronics descriptions, specifications, brightness, screen size, and phrases describing image quality occur near each other.

patterns.name: Local food and identity differences
patterns.context: Forum-style discussion compares local food and its cultural influence, emphasizing subtle differences and local perspectives.

patterns.name: Article tags and caption markers
patterns.context: Headings, HTML attributes, and template markers appear at the start of a web article or in an image caption; strong activation in the passage may be related to formatting boundaries.

patterns.name: Metaphorical title for European wars
patterns.context: A fixed metaphorical title describes Belgium’s geopolitical role in European wars, followed by an account of the two world wars.

4_1286.concept: 数字与结构边界相关的多域文本特征
4_1286.description: 激活分布于多种题材，常见于年份、数量、规格、标点及段落边界附近；另有足球、人口统计、选举、法律付款、历史、房地产、产品和饮食等局部语境，无法由单一语义模式充分解释。

patterns.name: 数字与数量格式
patterns.context: 数字或数量表达处于句中或相邻数字、单位、逗号、连字符等组成的文本序列；触发位置在数字本身或其紧邻 token。各段主题并不一致。
patterns.domain: 百科、新闻、法律、产品描述等多种文体

patterns.name: 段落或章节边界
patterns.trigger: “↵”“Later career”“In Juande Ramos' first match”等换行、章节标题或新段落开头
patterns.context: 文本刚结束一个叙述单元，随后出现换行、标题或新事件开头；第1、3、4段的显著激活紧邻这类边界。

patterns.name: 地名与区域描述
patterns.context: 地名出现在人口、国家历史、城市市场或地方饮食文化等描述中；触发也可能落在附近的数量、领域词或句子结构上。
patterns.domain: 百科、新闻、房地产、论坛讨论

patterns.name: 人口、增长与统计陈述
patterns.context: 描述县或地区的增长排名，并转入人口普查、人口总量及家庭数等统计信息。

patterns.name: 足球叙述与比赛／赛季信息
patterns.trigger: “the season against Real Zaragoza”“UEFA Euro 2008”“first match as Madrid manager”“joined ... Southampton”
patterns.context: 球队、球员或教练的赛季、赛事、任职及转会经历；数字和段落衔接也可能贡献激活。

patterns.name: 新闻中的选举与民意调查
patterns.trigger: “went home to vote”“polling organizations”“narrow race”“the country's two main”
patterns.context: 报道选举前后的人口流动、投票及民调机构对竞争态势的判断。

patterns.name: 法律案件中的款项与日期
patterns.trigger: “monthly payments”“four of the monthly payments”“March to June 1999”“June ... 1999”
patterns.context: 叙述付款安排、收款人、月份及法律案件记录，日期和金额式格式较突出。

patterns.name: 国家历史与工业化
patterns.context: 介绍比利时独立后的历史、工业化及欧洲战争背景。

patterns.name: 房地产市场与避风港
patterns.trigger: “safe-haven cities”“safe haven market”“Dubai’s luxury residential market”“boost”
patterns.context: 区分区域内外的避险属性，并讨论迪拜高端住宅市场及其可能受到的推动。

patterns.name: 产品规格与尺寸
patterns.context: 消费电子产品介绍中，规格、亮度、屏幕尺寸及形容画质的短语相邻出现。

patterns.name: 地方饮食与身份差异
patterns.context: 论坛式对话比较地方饮食及其文化影响，强调细微区别和本地人视角。

patterns.name: 文章标签与图注标记
patterns.context: 网页文章开头或图片图注中出现标题标签、HTML属性和模板标记；该段强激活可能与格式边界有关。

patterns.name: 欧洲战事的比喻称号
patterns.trigger: “the battlefield of Europe”“the cockpit of Europe”
patterns.context: 用固定比喻称号描述比利时在欧洲战争中的地缘角色，并接续两次世界大战的说明。

en.concept: Proper nouns and structured factual text
en.description: Activations are scattered across encyclopedic facts, sports and place names, numbers and proper nouns, citations, and webpage formatting, and also occur in legal, real estate, and astronomy texts; no stable single semantic trigger is evident.

patterns.name: Numbers and proper nouns in encyclopedia entries
patterns.context: Numbers, ordinals, years, and proper nouns appear densely in encyclopedic explanations or factual narratives; activation often falls near numbers or adjacent punctuation and spaces.
patterns.domain: Geography, population, sports, astronomy, and other encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: Lists of place names and institution names
patterns.context: Place names, clubs, or institution names occur in introductions, lists, or news narratives; some activation falls on nearby words such as and, commas, or market.
patterns.domain: Geography, sports, medical institutions, and business reporting

patterns.name: Citations, parentheses, and structural markers
patterns.context: Parentheses, citation numbers, line breaks, or webpage markup occur next to body text, commonly in cited encyclopedias, papers, or webpages.

patterns.name: Claims and rulings in legal documents
patterns.context: In an immigration-law ruling, a judge explains point by point whether claims are substantiated; activation is prominent on “claim.”

patterns.name: Real estate market wording
patterns.context: Discusses safe-haven status inside and outside a region and the outlook for Dubai’s residential market; activation centers on “market.”

patterns.name: Technical terms and symbols
patterns.context: An astronomy paper discusses Titan’s obliquity, with terminology adjacent to mathematical symbols.

patterns.name: Sports event titles and headings
patterns.context: An event entry title or section heading contains a sport and event name.

patterns.name: Sports biographies and club transfers
patterns.context: A soccer player’s career narrative is organized under headings and describes transfers and clubs.

patterns.name: Urban area safety and market comparisons
patterns.context: Compares how a city is positioned as a safe haven or market inside versus outside a region.

patterns.name: Repeated growth-rate statements
patterns.context: The same paragraph repeats a county’s ranking and the metropolitan area it belongs to.

4_1286.concept: 专名与结构化事实文本
4_1286.description: 激活分散于百科事实、体育与地名、数字和专名、引文及网页格式，也见于法律、房地产和天文学文本；未见稳定单一语义触发点。

patterns.name: 百科条目中的数字与专名
patterns.trigger: “2nd Fastest growing county”“2010 census”“142,324 people”“UEFA Euro 2008”“9th”“26.7$^{\circ}$”
patterns.context: 在百科式说明或事实叙述中，数字、序数、年份和专名密集出现；激活常落在数字附近或相邻标点、空格上。
patterns.domain: 地理人口、体育、天文等百科条目

patterns.name: 地名及机构专名列表
patterns.context: 地名、俱乐部或机构名称嵌在介绍、列表或新闻叙述中；部分激活落在附近的 and、逗号或 market 等词上。
patterns.domain: 地理、体育、医疗机构及商业报道

patterns.name: 引文、括号与结构标记
patterns.context: 括号、引用编号、换行或网页标记紧邻正文，常见于带引用的百科、论文或网页文本。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的主张与裁决
patterns.trigger: “the government of Guatemala would not protect him”“Finally”“CAT claim”
patterns.context: 移民法裁决叙述中，法官逐项说明主张是否成立；此处激活突出在“claim”。

patterns.name: 房地产市场措辞
patterns.context: 讨论区域内外的避险属性及迪拜住宅市场前景，激活集中在“market”。

patterns.name: 专业术语及技术符号
patterns.context: 天文学论文中，讨论泰坦的轴倾角，术语与数学符号相邻。

patterns.name: 体育赛事标题与小标题
patterns.trigger: “Swimming at the 2007 All-Africa Games”“The Swimming competition”
patterns.context: 赛事条目标题或章节标题，出现项目名和赛事名称。

patterns.name: 体育人物履历与俱乐部转会
patterns.context: 足球运动员生涯叙述中，以小标题和转会、俱乐部信息展开。

patterns.name: 城市区域安全与市场对比
patterns.context: 对比城市在区域内外作为避险地点或市场的不同定位。

patterns.name: 增长率重复表述
patterns.trigger: “2nd Fastest growing county”“2nd fastest growing county”
patterns.context: 同一段重复说明某县的排名及其所属都会区。

en.description: Strong activations occur both on the ile fragments in multiple words (tactile, facile, photolabile, and place-name spellings) and in patent phrases, the In in IM, and medical phrases; the segments lack a unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Word ending in tactile
patterns.context: The activation marker falls on the ile portion of tactile; it also appears in sensory-related terms.

patterns.name: Many electronic devices
patterns.context: A patent background paragraph begins with “Many personal electronic devices”.

patterns.name: Many computer systems
patterns.context: The sentence begins with “Many computerized systems”, followed by location and orientation sensors.

patterns.name: Split expansion of instant messaging abbreviation
patterns.context: Appears in the abbreviation “IM (Instant Messaging)”, specifically on the In fragment.

patterns.name: Fragment in an olefin reaction term
patterns.context: The activation falls on the ending of “facile”; the same chemistry title also includes terms for alkylation, olefins, and substituted products.

patterns.name: Fragment in a photochemistry term
patterns.context: The activation falls on the ending of “photolabile”, in a title about the photodissociation of manganese-NO complexes.

patterns.name: Fragment in a place name
patterns.context: Appears in the Wikipedia article title “Alileh Sar” and repeats on an adjacent line.

patterns.name: Fragment in a place name
patterns.context: Appears in the hyphenated construction of the place name “Baile-an-Iarla”.

patterns.name: Coronary artery risk phrase
patterns.context: Appears in a list of disease risks: “increased risk for coronary artery … disease”.

4_1405.concept: 混合的子词与短语触发
4_1405.description: 强激活既落在多个词中的 ile 片段（tactile、facile、photolabile、地名拼写），也出现在专利短语、IM 的 In 及医学短语中；各段缺少统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: tactile 的词尾
patterns.context: 激活标记落在 tactile 一词的 ile 部分；同时出现在感觉相关术语中。
patterns.domain: PubMed/NIH 感觉与神经科学文献

patterns.name: 许多电子设备
patterns.context: 专利背景段以 “Many personal electronic devices” 起句。

patterns.name: 许多计算机系统
patterns.context: 句首 “Many computerized systems” 后接位置和方向传感器。

patterns.name: 即时通讯缩写拆分
patterns.context: 出现在缩写 “IM (Instant Messaging)” 内，具体落在 In 的片段。

patterns.name: 烯烃反应术语片段
patterns.context: 激活落在 “facile” 的词尾；同一化学标题另有烷基化、烯烃及取代产物术语。

patterns.name: 光化学术语片段
patterns.context: 激活落在 “photolabile” 的词尾，处于锰-NO 配合物光解离标题中。

patterns.name: 地名中的片段
patterns.context: 出现在维基百科条目名 “Alileh Sar” 中，并在相邻行重复。

patterns.name: 地名中的片段
patterns.context: 出现在地名 “Baile-an-Iarla” 的连字符构词中。

patterns.name: 冠状动脉风险短语
patterns.context: “increased risk for coronary artery … disease” 的疾病风险列举中。

en.description: Patterns include patent plural noun phrases introduced by Many, several ile fragments within words, and references to the expansion of IM, a personal name, a preposition, and alcoholic liver disease terminology; the trigger forms and contexts vary substantially.

patterns.name: Plural noun after Many
patterns.context: Many at the beginning of a sentence is followed by modifiers and a plural noun in a technical background statement

patterns.name: ile string in a proper name
patterns.context: The activation falls on an ile string within a word or an adjacent subword fragment; examples include proper names, adjectives, and technical terms, with inconsistent meanings and syntax
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia, medical abstracts, and chemistry literature

patterns.name: Expansion of instant messaging abbreviation
patterns.context: IM is expanded in parentheses as Instant Messaging; the activation covers part of the abbreviation and expansion

patterns.name: Preposition between
patterns.context: Isolated before a time expression; preceding context is missing, so the specific syntactic relation cannot be determined

patterns.name: Isaac in a personal name
patterns.context: The activation falls on a segmented spelling of the name Isaac Asimov

patterns.name: alcoholic liver disease terminology
patterns.context: Alcohol and related disease terms appear in medical statements; activation is distributed across the beginning of a word, related words, and the disease name

4_1405.description: 模式包括 Many 引出的专利复数名词短语、若干词内 ile 片段，以及 IM 展开、人名、介词和酒精性肝病术语；触发形式与上下文差异较大。

patterns.name: Many 后接复数名词
patterns.context: 句首 Many 后跟修饰语及复数名词，出现在技术背景陈述中

patterns.name: 专名中的 ile 字符串
patterns.context: 激活落在词内的 ile 字符串或相邻子词片段；包含专名、形容词及技术术语，词义与句法并不一致
patterns.domain: 百科、医学摘要与化学文献

patterns.name: 即时通讯缩写展开
patterns.context: IM 后括号中展开为 Instant Messaging，激活覆盖缩写及展开词的一部分

patterns.name: 介词 between
patterns.context: 孤立于一段时间表达之前，前文缺失，无法确定具体句法关系

patterns.name: 人名中的 Isaac
patterns.context: 激活落在人名 Isaac Asimov 的分段拼写上

patterns.name: alcoholic liver disease 术语
patterns.context: 酒精及其相关疾病术语在医学陈述中出现，激活分布于词首、相关词及疾病名称
patterns.domain: NIH 医学资助项目文本

en.concept: Retail terms and several word fragments
en.description: Primarily responds to retail and collocations involving stores, venues, pharmacies, and similar terms; it also responds strongly to coronary in medical contexts, an internal fragment of Romanian curând, and an internal fragment of Instant, which do not match the main pattern.

patterns.name: retail terms
patterns.context: Retail-related terms themselves are marked; they appear in collocations such as retail settings, retail stores, retail store, retail food stores, and retail pharmacies, covering retail venues, stores, food stores, and pharmacies.
patterns.domain: Public health research, commercial product descriptions, patent background, clinical information exchange

patterns.name: Medical coronary term
patterns.context: Descriptions of coronary artery disease or stents in medical contexts; followed by artery and stenting, respectively.

patterns.name: Internal fragment in a Romanian word
patterns.context: The within-word segment «ând» in “ cât mai curând posibil” (as soon as possible) in a Romanian sentence.

patterns.name: Internal fragment in an instant messaging term
patterns.context: The expansion “Instant Messaging” of IM is tokenized in a patent background; high activation falls on an internal fragment of Instant.

4_1405.description: 主要响应 retail 及其商店、场所、药房等搭配；另对医学中的 coronary、罗马尼亚语 curând 的词内片段和 Instant 的词内片段强响应，语境与主模式不一致。

patterns.name: retail 词
patterns.context: 零售相关词项本身被标记；出现于 retail settings、retail stores、retail store、retail food stores、retail pharmacies 等搭配中，语境涵盖零售场所、商店、食品店与药房。
patterns.domain: 公共卫生研究、商业产品介绍、专利背景、临床信息交换

patterns.name: 医学冠状动脉词
patterns.context: 医学语境中的冠状动脉疾病或支架相关描述；分别接 artery 和 stenting。

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语词内片段
patterns.context: 罗马尼亚语句子中，“ cât mai curând posibil”（尽快）里的词内分段 «ând»。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会文本、罗马尼亚语

patterns.name: 即时通信词内片段
patterns.context: 专利背景中对 IM 的展开形式“Instant Messaging”进行分词；高激活落在 Instant 的词内片段。

en.description: Responds strongly primarily to descriptions of retail and related venues, goods, channels, or business targets, across many genres; there is also one strong response to “between” in a time range.

patterns.name: Retail-related terms
patterns.context: Appears in noun phrases describing stores, retail channels, retail venues, or retail business; this is the most stable and strongest shared trigger.
patterns.domain: Multiple genres, including patent backgrounds, research abstracts, business reporting, encyclopedias, and legal texts

patterns.name: Retail lumber dealing
patterns.context: Retail modifies lumber dealers, in a description of wholesale lumber businesses and their customers; although not marked as retail 10, it is consistent with retail semantics.
patterns.domain: Legal text, lumber industry business description

patterns.name: Time-range connector
patterns.context: Introduces the start time in a time range; it has no apparent semantic connection to the other retail-related fragments.
patterns.domain: Time or record fragment in a mathematical corpus

4_1405.description: 主要对零售及其相关场所、商品、渠道或经营对象的表述强烈响应，跨多种文体出现；另对时间范围中的“between”有一次强响应。

patterns.name: 零售相关用语
patterns.context: 出现在描述商店、零售渠道、零售场所或零售业务的名词短语中；这是最稳定、最强的共同触发。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、科研摘要、商业报道、百科与法律文本等多种文体

patterns.name: 零售木材经销
patterns.context: 零售修饰木材经销商，置于批发木材经营及其客户描述中；虽未标为 retail 10，仍与零售语义相符。
patterns.domain: 法律文本，木材行业经营描述

patterns.name: 时间范围连接词
patterns.context: 时间范围中引出起始时间；与其余零售相关片段没有明显语义联系。
patterns.domain: 数学语料中的时间或记录片段

en.description: Most fragments activate in retail-related contexts, especially retail and combinations with bank, customers, trade, and similar terms; one segment highlights alcoholic, and another activates at a line break, neither of which is readily unified with the main pattern.

patterns.name: retail and its compound forms
patterns.context: Appears in noun phrases describing retail, retail markets, or retail targets; the strongest triggers center on retail, regardless of whether it is followed by an industry noun or a target such as customers
patterns.domain: Multiple genres, including encyclopedias, legal, academic, news, and email texts

patterns.name: alcoholic, a possible retail contrast item
patterns.context: In a research abstract about patients’ self-labeling and problem drinkers; it has no apparent semantic connection to the retail pattern

patterns.name: Unexplained line break after operate
patterns.context: The fragment begins with to operate, followed immediately by a line break and an account of a bank’s history; the trigger cannot be determined from the local context shown

4_1405.description: 绝大多数片段在零售业相关语境中激活，尤其是 retail 及其与 bank、customers、trade 等词的组合；另有一段突出 alcoholic，另有一处换行激活，均难与主模式统一解释。

patterns.name: retail词及其复合形式
patterns.context: 在描述零售业、零售市场或零售对象的名词短语中；最强触发集中于 retail 一词，无论后接行业名词还是 customers 等对象
patterns.domain: 百科、法律、学术、新闻及邮件等多种文体

patterns.name: 疑似零售对照项的 alcoholic
patterns.context: 谈论患者自我标签及问题饮酒者的研究摘要中；与零售词模式无明显语义联系

patterns.name: 未解释的 operate 后换行
patterns.context: 片段开头为 to operate，紧接换行和银行历史叙述；无法从所示局部上下文确定触发依据

en.description: Activations are distributed across founder in proper names, regional and directional terms, internal fragments of technical terms, and contexts involving proportions, education, historical geography, religion, ecology, and meteorology; no single trigger semantics accounts for all passages.

patterns.name: founder in a proper name or term
patterns.context: Describes founders, initiators, or their roles in biographies or institutional profiles; the word is sometimes split into multiple tokens
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia biographies and organizational profiles, political reporting

patterns.name: Geographic regions or directional terms
patterns.context: Describes regions, directions, or geographic distributions; usually appears in contexts involving place names or regional statistics
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, statistical studies, geography, and biographies

patterns.name: Internal fragments of domain terms and compounds
patterns.context: Tokens near the internal structure or affix boundaries of longer technical terms or compounds; activation falls on internal word fragments rather than a stable word class
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, meteorology, and administrative services

patterns.name: Proportions and comparative statistics
patterns.context: Reports proportions and compares differences between groups, genders, or regions
patterns.domain: Political polling reports, public health research

patterns.name: University, research, and education statements
patterns.context: Introduces a university’s establishment, goals, or research and educational mission

patterns.name: Place names and historical transport locations
patterns.context: Explains that a settlement was named after a river crossing or a historic transport location

patterns.name: Forest plots and ecological locations
patterns.context: Lists forest survey plots, reserves, and sampling locations such as provinces

patterns.name: Religious identity and organizational roles
patterns.context: Narrates the membership, church identity, or organizational role of religious groups

patterns.name: Weather services and military aviation
patterns.context: Describes providing meteorological services to the Royal Air Force and the South East Asia Air Command during World War II

patterns.name: Smoking rates and demographic differences
patterns.context: Compares differences in smoking prevalence by gender, age group, and city

4_1405.description: 激活分散于专名中的 founder、地域与方位词、专业词内部片段，以及比例比较、教育、历史地理、宗教、生态和气象等语境；没有单一触发语义能解释所有段落。

patterns.name: 专名或词项中的 founder
patterns.context: 人物或机构简介中描述创立者、发起人或其身份；有时该词被拆分成多个 token
patterns.domain: 百科人物及组织简介、政治报道

patterns.name: 地理区域或方位词
patterns.context: 描述地区、方位或地域分布；通常出现在地名或区域性统计的上下文中
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、统计研究、地理与人物传记

patterns.name: 领域术语及复合词内部片段
patterns.context: 较长专业词、复合词或词缀边界附近的 token；激活落在词内部片段而非稳定的完整词类
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、气象与行政服务

patterns.name: 比例与比较统计
patterns.context: 报告比例，并比较群体、性别或地区之间的差异
patterns.domain: 政治民调报道、公共卫生研究

patterns.name: 大学、研究与教育表述
patterns.context: 介绍大学的建立、目标或研究教育使命

patterns.name: 地名与历史上的交通地点
patterns.context: 说明聚落因河流渡口得名或交通地点的历史

patterns.name: 林地样地与生态地理位置
patterns.context: 列举森林调查样地、保护区及省份等采样地点

patterns.name: 宗教身份与组织职务
patterns.context: 叙述宗教团体成员、教会身份或组织职务

patterns.name: 天气服务与军事航空
patterns.context: 描述二战期间为皇家空军及东南亚航空司令部提供气象服务

patterns.name: 吸烟率及人口群体差异
patterns.context: 比较吸烟流行率在性别、年龄群体和城市间的差异

en.description: Activations often occur in statements about support, support capacity, or lack of support, covering unions, the EU, research variables, software features, and initiatives; other activations occur in legal-political narratives about term statistics, divorce and child support, court rulings, and refusal to cooperate, which cannot be fully reduced to a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Political figure term statistics
patterns.context: Numbers occur with terms between a person’s name, party, and election information, indicating number of terms served

patterns.name: Divorce and child support
patterns.context: Legal narrative describing a divorce judgment, custody, and weekly child support payments

patterns.name: Union support and labor disputes
patterns.context: Discusses union grievance procedures, fair representation, and whether employees can obtain relief

patterns.name: Social support for mothers
patterns.context: Appears as a research variable alongside outcomes or expected measures and statistical significance

patterns.name: EU support for a technology project
patterns.context: A parliamentary speech says technological progress depends on EU support and cites the Desertec project as an example

patterns.name: Acknowledgment of software authors or components
patterns.context: Appears in a CREDIT_LINE code macro alongside software libraries and contributor names

patterns.name: Legal ruling and its consequences
patterns.context: Comments on a court ruling and expresses concern about the possible consequences of a different ruling

patterns.name: Legal support for an initiative
patterns.context: The state government and initiative proponents intervene in a case in support of a tobacco tax initiative

patterns.name: Refusal to cooperate prompts U.S. action
patterns.context: Describes an organization’s refusal to cooperate with a pursuit or extradition, prompting subsequent U.S. action; no explicit “support” trigger is visible

patterns.name: Software library feature compatibility
patterns.context: Compares software libraries’ support for or handling of features such as Unicode and snippet libraries

4_1405.concept: 支持及相关法律政治叙述
4_1405.description: 激活多见于支持、支持能力或缺乏支持的表述，涵盖工会、欧盟、研究变量、软件功能及倡议；另有任期统计、离婚抚养、法院裁决和拒绝合作等法律政治叙述，不能完全归为同一语义模式。

patterns.name: 政治人物任期统计
patterns.context: 数字与 terms 搭配，出现在人物名、党派及选举信息之间，表示任期数
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 人物条目、选举资料

patterns.name: 离婚与子女抚养费
patterns.context: 法律叙述中说明离婚判决、监护权和每周子女抚养费

patterns.name: 工会支持与劳动争议
patterns.context: 讨论工会申诉程序、代表公平性及员工能否获得救济

patterns.name: 母亲的社会支持
patterns.context: 作为研究变量，与结果或预期指标及统计显著性并列

patterns.name: 欧盟对技术项目的支持
patterns.context: 议会发言称技术进展离不开欧盟支持，并举 Desertec 项目为例

patterns.name: 软件作者或组件致谢
patterns.context: 出现在 CREDIT_LINE 代码宏中，与软件库及贡献者姓名并列
patterns.domain: 开源软件代码与致谢信息

patterns.name: 法律裁决及其后果
patterns.context: 评论法院作出的裁决，并表达对不同裁决可能引发后果的顾虑

patterns.name: 对倡议的法律支持
patterns.context: 州政府及倡议发起方介入案件，支持一项烟草税倡议
patterns.domain: 法律判决、选举倡议诉讼

patterns.name: 拒绝合作促使美国采取行动
patterns.context: 描述组织拒绝配合追捕或引渡后引发美国的后续行动；未见明确的“support”触发词

patterns.name: 软件库功能兼容性
patterns.context: 比较软件库对 Unicode 和片段库等功能的支持或处理能力

en.description: Activations are distributed across expressions of degree, rate, and time, as well as crisis escalation, political status, territorial control, and policy identity terms; another segment involves a Russian word fragment and sentence-boundary activation. They share few semantic regularities.

patterns.name: High degree, speed, or proportion
patterns.context: Activations cluster near words expressing degree, rate, or temporal position; sometimes they fall directly on a magnitude or time word, even when no explicit number appears in the preceding context.
patterns.domain: General narrative, scientific abstracts, news, and history

patterns.name: Pressure and crisis escalation
patterns.context: When describing oppressive weather, a growing crisis, or escalating political conflict, highlights words conveying intensity, severity, or unpredictability.
patterns.domain: Personal accounts, international news, political commentary

patterns.name: Control, rule, or forceful occupation
patterns.context: Narratives about armed groups or political forces controlling, ruling, or capturing cities and territories.

patterns.name: Political institutions and politicians’ status
patterns.context: Describes party power structures, candidates’ leading positions, or international political meetings in political reporting.

patterns.name: Controversial policy categories and identity labels
patterns.context: Employment equality statements and debate about whether affirmative action is compatible with equal opportunity.

patterns.name: Russian word fragment and syntactic boundary
patterns.context: In Russian text, activation falls on a segmented internal word fragment and near a sentence or paragraph boundary; no semantic connection to the other passages is apparent.

4_1405.description: 激活分散于程度、速率和时间表达，以及危机升级、政治地位、领土控制和政策身份词；另有一段俄语词片段与句界激活。它们共享的语义规律有限。

patterns.name: 高程度、速度或比例
patterns.context: 激活集中在表达程度、速率或时间位置的词附近；有时直接落在量级/时间词上，前文未必有显式数字。
patterns.domain: 一般叙述、科学摘要、新闻与历史

patterns.name: 压力与危机加剧
patterns.trigger: «opp»1«ress»9«ively»4 cloudy；«rise»3 in«9» global crises；«unim»2«agin»3«able»5 prospect；«civil»3 war
patterns.context: 描述压迫性天气、危机增长或政治冲突升级时，突出表示强烈、严峻或难以预料的词。
patterns.domain: 个人经历、国际新闻、政治评论

patterns.name: 控制、统治或强势占据
patterns.trigger: government« control»9；«liberated»9 the city；under the« rule»4；«strong»hold in«5» the country
patterns.context: 武装组织或政治势力控制、统治或夺取城市及领土的叙述。

patterns.name: 政治机构与政治人物地位
patterns.context: 政治报道中描述党内权力结构、候选人领先地位或国际政治会议。

patterns.name: 争议性政策类别与身份标签
patterns.context: 雇佣平等声明及对平权行动与机会平等是否相容的讨论。
patterns.domain: 雇佣声明、社会政策讨论

patterns.name: 俄语词片段及句法边界
patterns.context: 俄语文本中，激活落在被拆分的词内片段与句子/段落边界附近；看不出与其他段落的语义联系。

en.concept: Heterogeneous word forms and degree expressions
en.description: Activations occur in superlatives, comparatives, quantity or range expressions, and also on common suffixes, internal word fragments, prepositions, and articles; there is also an isolated activation in the middle of a weather term and one in a concessive construction, with no unified trigger condition overall.

patterns.name: Degree or quantity limits/extremes
patterns.context: Trigger words often appear in expressions of degree, ranking, range, or magnitude of change; sometimes a following noun completes the phrase, and they can also occur as part of a comparative or superlative.
patterns.domain: Across fields: medicine, housing and business, geography, finance, etc.

patterns.name: Internal suffix or word-form fragment
patterns.context: Activation falls on a subword fragment within a complete word or at its ending; there is no apparent consistent semantic or grammatical condition.
patterns.domain: Multiple genres and vocabulary, including news, business, and academic texts

patterns.name: Specific English function words or phrase positions
patterns.context: Common prepositions, articles, or connectors activate in different collocations and syntactic positions; the conditions are inconsistent.

patterns.name: Middle of a climate or weather word
patterns.context: Appears inside an adverb describing overcast conditions, near mentions of no sunshine and winter; a single instance.

patterns.name: Word-form fragment expressing agreement/concession
patterns.context: Used to introduce a situation coexisting with the preceding assessment in a description of market performance; a single instance.

4_1405.description: 激活分布在最高级、比较级、数量或范围表达中，也落在常见后缀及词内片段、介词冠词等功能词上；另有天气词中部及让步结构的单例，整体触发条件并不统一。

patterns.name: 程度或数量上限/极值
patterns.context: 触发词多出现在程度、排名、范围或变化幅度的表达中；有时由后接的名词补足，也可作为比较级或最高级的一部分。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：医学、住房与商业、地理、金融等

patterns.name: 词内后缀或词形片段
patterns.context: 激活落在完整词内部或词尾的子词片段；没有明显一致的词义或语法条件。
patterns.domain: 多种文体及词汇，含新闻、商业和学术文本

patterns.name: 特定英语功能词或短语位置
patterns.trigger: «in»（“in Toronto”“«in» *p38δ*”“«in» December”）、«after»（“«after» their Q3 earnings”“immediately «after» the operation”）、«a»（“at «a» lower Hct levels”“«a» terrible mistake”）
patterns.context: 常见介词、冠词或连接成分，在不同搭配与句法位置中激活；条件不统一。
patterns.domain: 跨领域散文及学术文本

patterns.name: 气候与天气词中部
patterns.context: 出现在描述阴云密布的副词内部，附近提到无阳光与冬季；仅此一例。

patterns.name: 同意/让步词形片段
patterns.context: 在描述市场表现时，用于引出与前述判断并存的情况；单例。

en.description: The strongest pattern is sensitivity to levels in biomedical contexts, commonly lower/low levels and descriptions of indicator levels; there are also sporadic responses to the -est in weakest, material content, and price-cap phrases.

patterns.name: Numbers and quantification after levels
patterns.context: levels refers to the level of a physiological indicator or quantity, often preceded by lower/low and followed by a value, prepositional phrase, or related description; sometimes it appears without low/lower.

patterns.name: lowest/superlative construction
patterns.context: The suffix -est forms a superlative; this example occurs in the maxim-like expression “your weakest point”.

patterns.name: Percentage by weight
patterns.context: content refers to the nitrogen content of a material and is reported as a percentage by weight; the sentence compares candidate additives.
patterns.domain: Patent background technology, materials or agricultural chemistry

patterns.name: Price limits in political economy
patterns.context: rate cap refers to a wholesale price cap, appearing in a discussion of an institution filing a petition and the position of a utility.

4_1405.description: 最强模式是生物医学语境中对 levels 的敏感，常见 lower/low levels 及指标水平描述；另对 weakest 的 -est、材料含量及价格上限短语有零星响应。

patterns.name: levels 后的数字与量化表达
patterns.context: levels 表示某种生理指标或量的水平，前面常有 lower/low，后接数值、介词短语或相关描述；有时不带 low/lower。

patterns.name: lowest/superlative 结构
patterns.context: 词尾 -est 构成最高级；此例位于格言式表达“your weakest point”中。

patterns.name: 数值单位百分比
patterns.context: content 指材料中的氮含量，并以重量百分比报告；句中比较候选添加剂。
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术、材料或农业化学

patterns.name: 政治经济中的价格限制
patterns.trigger: “lower« the»3« rate»2 cap« on»1 wholesale« prices»2”
patterns.context: rate cap 指批发价格上限，出现在机构提交请愿及公用事业立场的讨论中。

en.description: Primarily responds to English levels, especially in medical contexts describing physiological measures or concentrations; also shows sporadic responses to president, economic and market-related words, and the superlative ending in weakest, with no consistent morphological or semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Physiological or measurement levels
patterns.context: Indicates the level of a physiological measure, experimental quantity, or substance concentration, often alongside high/lower, a numerical range, or a disease state; [1], [3], [7], [9], [10].

patterns.name: Presidential title
patterns.context: The presidential office appears in political text, with activation on president; includes both assertive and hypothetical contexts.

patterns.name: Market and economic conditions
patterns.context: Economic reporting about financial systems, housing markets, high prices, or speculative activity; the precise trigger location varies.
patterns.domain: Canadian financial and housing market reporting

patterns.name: Expression for the weakest link
patterns.context: In the fixed comparative expression “weakest point”, activation falls on the word-final superlative marker est; the preceding text discusses strength and dependency.

4_1405.description: 主要响应英语 levels，尤其医学语境中描述生理指标或浓度；另对 president、经济市场相关词及 weakest 的最高级词尾有零散响应，触发形态和语义并不统一。

patterns.name: 生理或测量水平
patterns.trigger: «levels»（[1] 的 «ct»«levels»；[3] 的 G«FR»«levels»；[7] 的 Pi«levels»；[9] 的 «levels»；[10] 的 «levels»）
patterns.context: 表示生理指标、实验量或物质浓度的高低，常与 high/lower、数值范围或疾病状态搭配；[1]、[3]、[7]、[9]、[10]。

patterns.name: 总统称谓
patterns.trigger: «president»，前有国家或政治人物语境（如 «black»«president»、U.S. «president»、«Conservative»«President»）
patterns.context: 政治文本中出现总统职务称谓，激活落在 president；包括肯定与假设语境。
patterns.domain: 新闻、政治评论、网络讨论

patterns.name: 市场与经济状况
patterns.context: 围绕金融系统、住房市场、价格昂贵或投机活动的经济报道；具体触发位置不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 加拿大金融与住房市场报道

patterns.name: 最弱环节表达
patterns.context: 固定比较表达“weakest point”中，激活落在词尾最高级标记 est；前文谈论强弱与依赖关系。

en.concept: place rankings and other local word forms
en.description: Strongly activates mainly when place denotes a competition or database ranking; also appears with political office, nomination, governing, and comparative adjective suffixes. These uses are dispersed across different contexts.

patterns.name: place in a ranking
patterns.context: In competition, league, or database rankings, place denotes a rank; usually near ordinal or ranking information.

patterns.name: Political office and nomination
patterns.context: Accounts of political figures holding public office, receiving a party nomination, or running for a seat.

patterns.name: Political power and governing
patterns.context: Discusses a party's interest in maintaining the status quo and remaining in power.

patterns.name: Comparative adjective suffix
patterns.context: The suffix of a comparative form is marked; the examples describe spring and the condition of fish and birds.

4_1405.description: 主要在 place 表示比赛或数据库名次时强烈激活，也见于政治职位、提名、执政，以及比较级形容词后缀；这些用法分散于不同语境。

patterns.name: 名次或排名中的 place
patterns.trigger: « place»10、« place»9、« seventh»2 « place»9、« fourth»2 « place»9
patterns.context: 描述比赛、联赛或数据库排名时，place 表示名次；多为序数词或排名信息附近。

patterns.name: 政治职位与提名
patterns.trigger: « governor»6 « of»6、« governor»5、« nominee»10、« Senate»6 « seat»9
patterns.context: 政治人物担任公职、获得政党提名或竞选席位的叙述。

patterns.name: 政治权力与执政
patterns.context: 谈及政党维持现状及其继续执政的利益。

patterns.name: 比较级形容词后缀
patterns.context: 比较级词形的后缀部分被标记；此处分别描述春季和鱼类、鸟类的状况。
patterns.domain: 自然环境说明、评论性文章

en.description: Primarily responds to ordinal rankings and “place”, especially sports results and rankings; also responds to accounts of elections, political parties, and seats, with sporadic activations on names, word endings, and party politics.

patterns.name: Ranking or placement expressions
patterns.context: Ordinal numbers combine with place, or rank is expressed as “in + ordinal”; commonly found in rankings, competition results, or season summaries.
patterns.domain: Sports reporting, encyclopedia entries, forum discussions

patterns.name: Political elections and seats
patterns.context: Involves candidates, parties, election outcomes, or seats; activation falls on election- and seat-related words.

patterns.name: Word endings in names or titles
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on internal or final fragments of proper names or common words, with no clear shared semantic condition locally.

patterns.name: Party-related words in political contexts
patterns.context: In U.S. political reporting, a party name is followed by a word related to a primary.

4_1405.description: 主要响应序数名次及“place”，尤其是体育成绩与排名；也响应选举、政党和议席叙述，并有零星人名或词尾及党派政治用例。

patterns.name: 名次或排名表达
patterns.trigger: “4th place of all open-source databases”“finish in third place”“finish in fourth place”“equal sixth place”“5th place”
patterns.context: 名次序数词与 place 搭配，或名次由“in + 序数词”表达；多出现在排名、比赛结果或赛季总结中。
patterns.domain: 体育报道、百科条目、论坛讨论

patterns.name: 政治选举及席位叙述
patterns.trigger: “bye election”“member of the … Dal”“lost the … seat”“nominee in the race for … Senate seat”
patterns.context: 涉及候选人、政党、选举胜负或议席；激活落在选举和席位相关词语上。

patterns.name: 人名或称谓中的词尾
patterns.context: 激活集中在专名或普通词的内部/结尾片段，局部没有明确的共同语义条件。

patterns.name: 政治语境中的党派词
patterns.context: 美国政治报道中，党派名称后接初选相关词。

en.description: Primarily responds to placement expressions in competitions, elections, or lists, especially ordinal numbers (including th/nd/rd) combined with place; nearby result words such as finishing and winning also activate. One passage highlights only primaries in a political context.

patterns.name: Rankings and “place”
patterns.context: Describes a person's or team's placement in competition, election, or list results, commonly in the form ordinal + place or in + rank; paragraph [1] also contains the database ranking phrase “4th place”.
patterns.domain: Sports reporting, election results, list discussions

patterns.name: Other competition result words
patterns.context: The same context often contains rankings or competition results, but these words do not always pair with an explicit place ranking.
patterns.domain: Sports reporting and competition result accounts

patterns.name: Political primary context
patterns.context: Political reporting about Trump and his business partners and a proposal to bar Muslims; no explicit ranking or place expression is observed.

4_1405.description: 主要对赛事、选举或榜单中的名次表达起反应，尤其是序数数字（含 th/nd/rd）与 place 的组合；相邻的完赛、获胜等结果词也会激活。另有一段只突出政治语境中的 primaries。

patterns.name: 名次与“place”
patterns.trigger: 序数或排名数字及其后缀，如“4»1«th»4« place»10”、“35»2«th»6« place»9”、“5»2«th»5« place»9”、“2»2«nd»3« place»8”、“3»2«rd»4« place»8”；也包括“fourth»4« place»8”和“second»3« place»8”
patterns.context: 在比赛、选举或榜单结果中描述某人或队伍获得的名次，常见结构为序数 + place，或 in + 名次；第[1]段另有数据库排名表述“4th place”。
patterns.domain: 体育赛事报道、选举结果、榜单讨论

patterns.name: 其他比赛结果词
patterns.context: 同一上下文常出现排名或赛事结果，但这些词本身并不总是与明确的 place 名次搭配。
patterns.domain: 体育报道及竞赛结果叙述

patterns.name: 政治初选语境
patterns.context: 关于特朗普及其商业伙伴、禁入穆斯林提议的政治报道；未见明确的名次或 place 表达。

en.description: Most activations occur on ordinal suffixes in numerical rankings and near place, covering competition rankings, team season records, and other rankings; there are also activations related to political office, as well as proper-name and word-ending activations that do not fit the main pattern.

patterns.name: Ordinal suffixes and place in rankings
patterns.context: Describes rankings, placements, or competition results; the number and ordinal suffix are usually adjacent, followed by place
patterns.domain: Sports results, database rankings, encyclopedia or forum texts about elections and local politics

patterns.name: Political figures and elected office
patterns.context: Biographies of political figures introduce office-holding, candidacy, or nomination; no single consistent trigger word is evident

patterns.name: Unexplained proper names and word endings
patterns.context: Activation falls on tokenized fragments of proper names or word endings, with no clear nearby ranking expression

4_1405.description: 多数激活出现在数字名次的序数后缀及 place 附近，涉及竞赛排名、球队赛季成绩和其他排名；另有政治职务相关激活，以及无法归入主模式的专名和词尾激活。

patterns.name: 名次中的序数后缀与 place
patterns.trigger: 数字后接 «th» / «st» 并出现 «place»，如 «4»«th»« place»、«5»«th»« place»、«35»«th»« place»、«7»«th»« place»、«9»«th»« place»
patterns.context: 描述排名、名次或竞赛结果；数字和序数后缀通常紧邻，随后出现 place
patterns.domain: 体育赛果、数据库排名、选举与地方政治等百科或论坛文本

patterns.name: 政治人物与选举职务
patterns.trigger: «Political» life、« school» « trustee»、« Democratic» « Party» « nominee»
patterns.context: 政治人物传记中介绍任职、参选或获提名；未见稳定的单一触发词

patterns.name: 未解释的专名与词尾
patterns.context: 激活落在分词后的专名片段或词尾，附近没有明显的名次表达

en.description: Activations concentrate on wins and losses, rankings, candidates, and offices in political and election contexts; they also occur in government decisions, legislation, and election lists, as well as database and company rankings and a Portuguese word for government resolution.

patterns.name: Rankings and placements
patterns.context: A database, company, or candidate's relative ranking, placement, or ordering appears, usually within a noun phrase.

patterns.name: Competition results and wins or losses
patterns.context: Discusses success, leading, winning, or an outcome favoring one side, often involving a campaign or election.

patterns.name: Election- and political office-related words
patterns.context: Political candidates, elections, terms of office, or positions such as president/senator appear; activation falls on related words and their subword fragments.
patterns.domain: Political news, legal texts, encyclopedia entries, email

patterns.name: Election headings and list formats
patterns.context: Headings or tabular entries such as election names, years, and candidate lists; often accompanied by line breaks and years.

patterns.name: Government decisions and legislative processes
patterns.context: Content related to government officials, Congress, or administrative decisions; the trigger may be an office, institution, or its actions.

patterns.name: Government and resolution words in Portuguese
patterns.context: Portuguese text contains words for government, decision, or council; activation is distributed across subwords within the words.

4_1405.description: 激活集中在政治与选举语境中的胜负、排名、候选人和职位，也见于政府决策、立法与选举列表；另有数据库和公司排名，以及葡语政府决议词。

patterns.name: 排名与名次
patterns.context: 出现数据库、公司或候选人的相对排名、名次或排序；通常位于名词短语中。

patterns.name: 竞赛结果与胜负
patterns.context: 谈论成功、领先、胜出或结果偏向某方，常涉及竞选或选举。

patterns.name: 选举与政治职位相关词
patterns.context: 出现政治候选人、选举、任期或总统/参议员等职位；激活落在相关词及其子词片段上。
patterns.domain: 政治新闻、法律文本、百科条目、邮件

patterns.name: 选举标题及列表格式
patterns.context: 选举名称、年份、候选人列表等标题或表格式条目；常伴随换行和年份。

patterns.name: 政府决策及立法程序
patterns.context: 政府官员、国会或行政决策相关内容；触发可能由职位、机构或其行动引起。

patterns.name: 葡语中的政府与决议词
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语文本中出现政府、决定或理事会等词；激活分布在词内子词。

en.description: Primarily activates on “place” in ordinal ranking phrases and on ranking expressions; also appears in contexts involving election victories, candidacy, and terms of office, as well as political office terms and sporadic activations on “faces”.

patterns.name: Ranking phrase “place”
patterns.context: Indicates a placement in a competition, ranking, or list; usually modified by an ordinal, occasionally hyphenated
patterns.domain: News, web discussions, biographies, and sports reporting

patterns.name: Winning and placement in elections
patterns.context: Political election reporting describes a candidate winning, running, serving a term, or placing

patterns.name: Ranking or list position
patterns.context: Describes a company or database's position in a ranking; ranking may be based on market size or criteria such as an open-source database

patterns.name: Sports competition placement
patterns.context: An athlete or racehorse's placement in an event or challenge

patterns.name: Political identity and constituency labels
patterns.context: Biographical or political career passages mention an office, position, or constituency; not necessarily related to ranking expressions

patterns.name: Political processes and election vocabulary
patterns.context: Discusses campaigns, party interests, governance, or election prospects, without necessarily containing an explicit ranking phrase

patterns.name: Word-form activation of unclear relation
patterns.context: Appears in a sentence about inequality in the UK; context alone does not establish its relation to other patterns

4_1405.description: 主要对序数名次短语中的“place”及排名表达激活，也见于选举获胜、参选和任期语境；另有政治职务词及“faces”等零散激活。

patterns.name: 名次短语“place”
patterns.context: 表示竞赛、排名或列表中的名次；通常由序数词修饰，偶尔连字符连接
patterns.domain: 新闻、网页讨论、传记及体育报道

patterns.name: 选举中的获胜与名次
patterns.context: 政治选举报道中描述候选人获胜、参选、任期或名次

patterns.name: 排名或榜单位置
patterns.context: 描述公司或数据库在排名中的位置；排名可由市场规模或开放源代码数据库等标准确定

patterns.name: 体育赛事名次
patterns.context: 运动员或赛马在赛事、挑战赛中的名次

patterns.name: 政治身份与选区标签
patterns.context: 人物简介或政治生涯段落中，涉及职务、职位或选区；不一定与名次表达有关

patterns.name: 政治过程与选举语汇
patterns.context: 讨论竞选、政党利益、治理或选举前景，但不必出现明确排名短语

patterns.name: 不明关联的词形激活
patterns.context: 出现在关于英国不平等的句子中；单凭上下文无法确认与其他模式的关系

en.concept: rankings and wins or losses in competitions and elections
en.description: Activations mainly fall on phrases for placements and wins or losses in competitions or elections: runner-up, second/fourth place, candidacy, election victories, and losing rankings; there is also a call to action in a news headline and a campaign gaffe.

patterns.name: Placement expression: runner-up
patterns.context: Describes a contestant finishing as runner-up in a talent or singing competition; paragraph 2 has “runner-up to”, paragraph 6 has “runner-up of the third season”, and paragraph 10 has “runner-up”.

patterns.name: Ordinal ranking and place
patterns.context: Describes a company ranking, competition placement, or candidate position; the ranking word is adjacent to place or forms a hyphenated placement phrase.
patterns.domain: Business reporting, political commentary, sports biographies

patterns.name: Election- and outcome-related expressions
patterns.context: Involves running for office, winning an election, or describing candidates by rank; paragraphs 1 and 9 discuss elections and conditions for winning, while paragraph 4 recounts a campaign and lists rankings and the incumbent.

patterns.name: Call to action in a news headline
patterns.context: A headline-style short phrase in which a political group calls for an action; activation concentrates on part of the party name.

patterns.name: Gaffe in a campaign context
patterns.context: Discusses a verbal gaffe in campaign reporting; it co-occurs with election outcome context in the same passage but is not an explicit ranking expression.

4_1405.concept: 竞赛与选举中的名次、胜负
4_1405.description: 激活主要落在比赛或选举中的名次与胜负词句：亚军、第二/第四名、参选、胜选和落选排名；另有一处新闻标题中的呼吁，以及竞选口误表述。

patterns.name: 名次表达：runner-up
patterns.context: 选秀或歌唱比赛中，描述参赛者获得亚军；段2为“runner-up to”，段6为“runner-up of the third season”，段10为“runner-up”。

patterns.name: 序数名次与 place
patterns.context: 描述公司排名、比赛名次或候选人位置；名次词与 place 相邻或以连字符组成名次短语。
patterns.domain: 商业报道、政治评论、体育传记

patterns.name: 选举及胜负相关表达
patterns.context: 涉及参选、赢得选举或按名次描述候选人；段1、9讨论选举及胜选条件，段4记述竞选并列出名次和现任者。
patterns.domain: 政治新闻、政治人物传记

patterns.name: 新闻标题中的呼吁表达
patterns.context: 标题式短句中，政治团体呼吁采取某项行动；激活集中在党派名称的一部分。

patterns.name: 舌误及竞选语境
patterns.trigger: «in» «the» best slip «of» the tongue of the «campaign»（段9）
patterns.context: 竞选报道中讨论口误；与同段选举胜负语境并存，但并非明确名次表达。

en.description: Activations concentrate on expressions of competition and outcomes: running for office, winning or campaigning in political elections, and rankings such as runner-up, placement, and place; also includes a leading score and loses to.

patterns.name: Winning, candidacy, or campaigning in political elections
patterns.context: Political figures run for office, win elections, or discuss campaigns and election outcomes; sometimes in predictions or conditional statements, sometimes in biographies.

patterns.name: runner-up / rankings and place
patterns.context: Describes runner-up finishes and placements in competitions, evaluations, or rankings; includes evaluation contexts such as “runner-up for the top five”.
patterns.domain: Entertainment, academic journal rankings, political campaign reporting, company rankings

patterns.name: Sporadic competition results or comparison structures
patterns.context: Compares entities by score or states who is leading or losing; related to ranking but not a typical runner-up expression.
patterns.domain: Journal evaluations, polls, or news reporting

4_1405.description: 激活集中在竞争与结果表达：政治选举中的参选、获胜或竞选，以及 runner-up、名次、place 等排名说法；另见领先分数和 loses to。

patterns.name: 政治选举中的获胜、参选或竞选
patterns.context: 政治人物参选、赢得选举或讨论竞选及选举结果；有时是预测或条件句，有时是人物履历。
patterns.domain: 新闻政治报道、政治人物传记

patterns.name: runner-up／名次与 place
patterns.context: 描述比赛、评选或排名中的亚军及名次；包括“runner-up for the top five”这类评选语境。
patterns.domain: 娱乐、学术期刊排名、政治竞选报道、企业排名

patterns.name: 零散的竞赛结果或比较结构
patterns.context: 以分数比较对象或陈述领先、落败；含义与排名相关，但不属于典型的 runner-up 表述。
patterns.domain: 期刊评比、民调或新闻报道

en.description: Primarily responds to winning, contesting, and candidate information in political elections, and also responds to competition or business ranking expressions; party names and accounts of running for and winning office also appear.

patterns.name: Election victories or conditions for winning
patterns.context: A political figure, president, or party wins an election, or the consequences of winning are discussed; paragraphs 1, 3, and 8 concern political effects after a victory, while paragraphs 4 and 10 directly describe election victories
patterns.domain: Political news, political commentary, encyclopedia election histories

patterns.name: Election contests and candidate eligibility
patterns.context: Mentions running for office, candidate nominations, election schedules, or political figures participating in a campaign, even when no winner is specified

patterns.name: Rankings and placements
patterns.context: Ordinal number + place denotes a competition placement or business ranking; the former is fourth place in a political debate, while the latter is an energy company's market position
patterns.domain: Political competition reporting, corporate and market news

patterns.name: Party names or abbreviations
patterns.context: Activation falls on the ending of a party abbreviation in a headline-style report of party action

patterns.name: Descriptions of party and election activity
patterns.context: Describes party nominations, running in a constituency, or being re-elected; activation is distributed across party names and election-related words
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia biographies of politicians and elections

4_1405.description: 主要响应政治选举中的胜出、竞逐和候选人信息，也响应竞赛或商业排名表达；另见政党名称及参选、当选叙述。

patterns.name: 选举胜出或胜选条件
patterns.context: 政治人物、总统或政党在选举中获胜，或讨论获胜后果；段1、3、8涉及胜选后的政治影响，段4、10直接描述选举胜出
patterns.domain: 政治新闻、政治评论、百科选举史

patterns.name: 选举竞逐与候选资格
patterns.context: 提及竞选职位、候选人提名、选举赛程或政治人物参与竞选，即使未明确说谁获胜
patterns.domain: 选举新闻与政治人物传记

patterns.name: 名次及位置排序
patterns.context: 以序数词加 place 表示竞赛名次或商业排名；前者是政治辩论中的第四名，后者是能源公司的市场位置
patterns.domain: 政治竞赛报道、企业与市场新闻

patterns.name: 政党名称或简称
patterns.context: 激活落在政党简称的词尾，出现在新闻标题式的政党行动报道中

patterns.name: 政党及选举活动描述
patterns.context: 描述政党提名、选区参选或再次当选；激活分散在党名和选举相关词上
patterns.domain: 百科政治人物与选举传记

en.description: Activations are distributed across many unrelated subword fragments and formats: child-related words, designers, fragments within medical terms, code macros, names, school phrases, Cyrillic text, and mathematical symbols. No single stable semantic or stylistic pattern runs through all passages.

patterns.name: Specific tokenization fragment ven
patterns.context: Appears in the split medical term “Microvenous,” near “thrombosis rates” and “anastomosis”; activation primarily falls on an intra-word fragment.

patterns.name: Child-related vocabulary
patterns.context: Involves children's learning, self-discovery of knowledge, extracurricular projects, or achievement patterns; some activation falls on Children/children and possessive forms, while segment 3 also activates teach.
patterns.domain: Education and child development research abstracts

patterns.name: Designers and their activities
patterns.context: The plural noun designers appears once referring to clock-domain designers and once to knit/crochet pattern designers; segment 4 also activates «even».

patterns.name: Preprocessor directives and diagnostic identifiers
patterns.context: In C/C++ header guards and include directives, several preprocessor symbols and identifier fragments are activated.

patterns.name: Fragment within proper name Salvagn(o)
patterns.context: Appears in the contact name “Ken Salvagno”; activation falls on a subword fragment within the surname.

patterns.name: YMCA after-school program vocabulary
patterns.context: In the phrases “out-of-school time” and “after school programs,” activation occurs near school and the preposition of.

patterns.name: Cyrillic subword fragments
patterns.context: Near the Russian string “Механизмъ,” several Cyrillic characters or subword fragments are activated.

patterns.name: s and exponents in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Appears in polynomial/algebraic expressions; activation includes the letter s, the number 2 (including in exponent positions), and the coefficient 278.

4_1522.description: 激活分布于多种互不相同的词片段与格式：儿童相关词、designers、医学术语内片段、代码宏、姓名、school短语、西里尔文和数学符号；没有单一稳定语义或文体贯穿全部段落。

patterns.name: 特定分词片段 ven
patterns.context: 出现在被拆分的医学术语“Microvenous”中，附近是“thrombosis rates”“anastomosis”等词；激活主要落在词内片段。

patterns.name: 儿童相关词汇
patterns.context: 涉及儿童的学习、自我发现知识、课外项目或成就模式；部分激活落在 Children/children 及其所有格形式，段3还激活 teach。
patterns.domain: 教育与儿童发展研究摘要

patterns.name: 设计者及其活动
patterns.context: 出现复数人称名词 designers：一处指时钟域设计人员，另一处指针织/钩织图案设计者；段4同时激活«even»。
patterns.domain: 专利背景；针织/钩织社区讨论

patterns.name: 预处理指令与诊断标识符
patterns.context: C/C++头文件保护宏和 include 指令中，多个预处理符号、标识符片段被激活。

patterns.name: 专名内的片段 Salvagn(o)
patterns.context: 出现在联系人姓名“Ken Salvagno”中，激活落在姓氏内部的子词片段。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的联系信息

patterns.name: YMCA课后项目词汇
patterns.context: 短语“out-of-school time”和“after school programs”中，激活与 school 及介词 of 相邻出现。

patterns.name: 西里尔文词片段
patterns.context: 俄语字符串“Механизмъ”附近，多个西里尔字母或子词片段被激活。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的 s 与幂次
patterns.context: 出现在多项式/代数表达式中，激活字母 s、数字 2（含幂次位置）以及系数 278。

en.description: Primarily responds to child-related words, especially “children” in research and educational contexts; also responds to designers, teaching actions, and sporadic tokens such as medical word fragments, Cyrillic text, mathematical symbols, and name fragments.

patterns.name: Child-related words
patterns.context: Appears in child development, education, after-school programs, or clinical research contexts; sometimes near self-esteem, learning, or health conditions

patterns.name: Designers
patterns.context: Refers to people who design or make a scheme or product; used for electronic module design and knitting pattern design
patterns.domain: Patent technical descriptions, craft community articles

patterns.name: Teaching action
patterns.context: Describes children teaching others a method

patterns.name: Vein-related word fragment
patterns.context: Embedded in the word “Microvenous thrombosis”

patterns.name: Cyrillic text fragments
patterns.context: Appears in fragments of Russian or other Cyrillic text

patterns.name: Mathematical variables and coefficients
patterns.context: Appears in polynomial or algebraic expressions, mixed with multiplication, exponents, and coefficients

patterns.name: Name fragment
patterns.context: Appears in the contact name “Ken Salvagno”

4_1522.description: 主要响应儿童相关词，尤其是研究与教育语境中的“children”；也响应设计者、教学动作，以及医学词片段、西里尔文字、数学符号和姓名片段等零散 token。

patterns.name: 儿童相关词
patterns.context: 出现在儿童发展、教育、课后项目或临床研究语境中；有时与自尊、学习或健康状况相邻
patterns.domain: 儿童发展、教育、心理学、医学

patterns.name: 设计者
patterns.context: 指设计或制作某种方案、产品的人；分别用于电子模块设计和编织图案设计
patterns.domain: 专利技术说明、手工艺社区文章

patterns.name: 教学动作
patterns.context: 描述儿童教授他人某种方法

patterns.name: 静脉相关词片段
patterns.context: 嵌在“Microvenous thrombosis”一词中

patterns.name: 西里尔文字片段
patterns.context: 出现在俄语或其他西里尔文字文本的片段中

patterns.name: 数学变量与系数
patterns.context: 出现在多项式或代数表达式中，夹杂乘法、幂和系数

patterns.name: 姓名片段
patterns.context: 出现在联系人姓名“Ken Salvagno”中

en.description: The most stable pattern is children in child-related contexts (8 passages); two isolated triggers involve dietary sodium and blood pressure, and electronic designers and clock domains, neither of which is explained by the child-related theme.

patterns.name: Marker after children
patterns.context: The text contains children, especially when discussing child populations, childhood diseases, development, or risk; modifiers may vary.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, child development, and public health research

patterns.name: Diet and blood pressure
patterns.context: Describes a statement about dietary sodium inducing increased blood pressure; the passage also contains strong non-children activation tokens.

patterns.name: Designers and clock domains
patterns.context: In an electronic module design context, describes designers meeting performance requirements for each clock domain.

4_1522.concept: 儿童相关文本中的 children
4_1522.description: 最稳定的模式是儿童相关语境中的 children（8段）；另有饮食钠与血压、电子设计者及时钟域两种孤立触发，均无法由儿童主题解释。

patterns.name: children 后的标记
patterns.context: 文本中出现 children，尤其是谈及儿童群体、儿童疾病、发展或风险；其前后可有不同修饰语。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、儿童发展与公共卫生研究

patterns.name: 饮食与血压
patterns.context: 描述饮食钠诱发血压升高的陈述；该段同时含有较强的非 children 激活 token。

patterns.name: 设计者与时钟域
patterns.context: 电子模块设计背景中，描述设计者满足各时钟域性能要求。

en.concept: Subword fragments and local token patterns
en.description: Strong activations often fall on subword fragments: tam/ta/tem/pered, involving tampered, tapered, tempered, and prospered; affected and interaction also appear, as do URL digits and scientific-notation numbers, the latter two difficult to explain with a unified lexical pattern.

patterns.name: Word-internal t/tapered fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on the tokenized English fragments “tam/ta”; examples include tampered, tapered, and untapered, with semantics and word-initial forms not entirely consistent.

patterns.name: Word-internal tempered fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on the tokenized portion within tempered; one instance describes moderating historical volatility, and another says celebrations should be tempered with caveats.
patterns.domain: News commentary, economic and financial commentary

patterns.name: Word-final fragment in prospered
patterns.context: Activation falls on the word-final fragment in prospered, discussing a group flourishing under modern institutions.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in affected
patterns.context: The full word affected is activated in a policy item describing people served by mental disorder services and their families and communities.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in interaction
patterns.context: Appears in the title of an analysis of interactions between cationic comb copolymers and DNA.

patterns.name: URL digit string
patterns.context: Part of a URL digit string is activated in a HackerNews link about personal finance startup experience; no clear semantic association is apparent.

patterns.name: Scientific-notation number fragments
patterns.context: Several number tokens are activated at varying positions in a list of negative values and values multiplied by 10^-20.

4_1522.description: 强激活多落在分词后的词片段：tam/ta/tem/pered，涉及 tampered、tapered、tempered、prospered；另见 affected、interaction，以及网址数字和科学计数法数字，后两者难以与词汇模式统一解释。

patterns.name: 词中 t/tapered 片段
patterns.context: 激活落在英语词的分词片段“tam/ta”；包括 tampered、tapered、untapered 等，语义和词首形态并不完全一致。

patterns.name: tempered 词中片段
patterns.context: 激活落在 tempered 的词内分段；一处表示缓和历史波动，一处表示应以 caveats 限制庆贺。
patterns.domain: 新闻评论、经济与金融评论

patterns.name: prospered 词尾片段
patterns.context: 激活落在 prospered 的词尾分段，谈群体在现代制度下兴盛。

patterns.name: affected 词中片段
patterns.context: 在描述精神障碍服务对象及其家庭、社区的政策条目中，激活完整的 affected。
patterns.domain: 健康服务政策／项目文本

patterns.name: interaction 词中片段
patterns.context: 出现在对阳离子梳型共聚物与 DNA 相互作用的分析标题中。

patterns.name: 网址数字串
patterns.context: 个人理财创业经验的 HackerNews 链接中，激活 URL 数字串的一部分；缺少明显语义关联。

patterns.name: 科学计数法数字片段
patterns.context: 负数及乘以 10^-20 的数值列表中，激活若干数字 token，位置不固定。

en.description: Primarily activates word-final fragments containing -pered in tempered, peppered, prospered, tampered, and similar words, especially at labeled subword fragments; isolated activations in interaction, inhibits, and Citric acid do not fit this spelling pattern.

patterns.name: Word ending in tempered
patterns.context: Appears in uses such as “tempered by” or “tempered Bayesian”; activation is concentrated on the word-final -pered portion

patterns.name: Other words containing -pered
patterns.context: Activation falls on the word-final spelling fragment -pered; the preceding parts are pep- and pros- respectively

patterns.name: Word ending in tampered with
patterns.context: In a political election context, refers to electronic voting machines possibly being tampered with

patterns.name: Isolated activations in domain vocabulary
patterns.context: Neither instance has an evident -pered spelling; they occur in accounts of molecular interaction research and biological inhibition processes, respectively

patterns.name: Sporadic activation in a chemical name
patterns.context: At the beginning of a chemical buffer name; activation falls on the tokenized fragments Citric and acid

4_1522.description: 主要激活 tempered、peppered、prospered、tampered 等含 -pered 的词尾片段，尤其在标注词片段处；另有 interaction、inhibits、Citric acid 等孤立激活，无法归入该拼写模式。

patterns.name: tempered 的词尾
patterns.context: 出现在“tempered by”或“tempered Bayesian”等用法中；激活集中在词尾 -pered 部分
patterns.domain: 新闻、金融、学术（含贝叶斯方法）

patterns.name: 其他含 -pered 的词
patterns.context: 激活落在词尾拼写片段 -pered；前面分别是 pep-、pros-
patterns.domain: 育儿叙述、社会科学论述

patterns.name: tampered with 中的词尾
patterns.context: 政治选举语境中，指称电子投票机可能遭到篡改

patterns.name: 领域词汇中的孤立激活
patterns.context: 两处均没有明显的 -pered 拼写；分别位于分子相互作用研究及生物学抑制过程的叙述中

patterns.name: 化学名中的零散激活
patterns.context: 化学缓冲液名称开头；激活在分词后的 Citric 与 acid 片段

en.description: Activations are distributed across several types of technical terms: HDL lipid research is most prominent, with additional responses to Mixture in recipes, IgA/immunity, MRI sequences, astronomical NIR spectra, and C#; no stable cross-domain shared semantic condition is apparent.

patterns.name: HDL-related medical terms
patterns.context: Appears in medical text about lipoproteins, cholesterol, plasma, lipid metabolism, or treatment

patterns.name: Cooking instructions containing Mixture
patterns.context: Instructions for preparing mixtures of eggs, milk, and similar ingredients in recipes

patterns.name: IgA and treatment or immune response
patterns.context: Medical text discussing kidney disease treatment or immunoglobulin secretion

patterns.name: MRI/GRASS imaging terms

patterns.name: NIR spectroscopy terms
patterns.context: Discusses stellar populations in galaxies and near-infrared spectral templates

patterns.name: C# marker
patterns.context: Appears in a Hacker News sentence about the technical backgrounds of startup founders

4_1522.description: 激活分散在多类专业术语上：以 HDL 脂质研究最集中，也响应食谱中的 Mixture、IgA/免疫、MRI 序列、天文 NIR 光谱及 C#；未见跨领域稳定的共同语义条件。

patterns.name: HDL 相关医学术语
