patterns.name: One 在句首
patterns.context: 句首大写的 One，表示不确定的某个数字、项目或主体；此例不足以判定具体语义。

patterns.name: 数字 1 后接小数点 8
patterns.context: 金额数字格式中，小数点后的数字；周围有货币符号及金额单位。

patterns.name: 句点后接句首大写字母
patterns.context: 句点标记句子或条目结束，后接大写缩写；此处是手册宏格式。

patterns.name: JavaScript 方法名中含大写 T
patterns.context: 驼峰式 JavaScript 方法名，位于方法调用链中。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语复数形式的词尾
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语句子中，谈及气候变化等议题；激活分散在词内及标点附近，未见一致词法条件。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会葡萄牙语发言

en.description: Activations involve the participial ending of Industry, the geographical adjectives Asian/Eastern, multi-item structures with more than one, and occasional patent boilerplate, printing phrases, and America in news URLs. The pattern spans domains, and trigger features are inconsistent.

patterns.name: Industry-related word form Industry
patterns.context: Industry is split into multiple tokens, with activation concentrated on the ending fragment «ry»; [1] has Industry in a class template, while [10] occurs in policy commentary about industry benefits.

patterns.name: Geographical or ethnic adjective Asian
patterns.context: A geographical or ethnic name modifies a population, region, or project; both instances occur in compound place names such as Middle Eastern / Central Asian.

patterns.name: One in multi-item or multi-level structures
patterns.context: One occurs in the structure more than one, referring to folder levels, games, messages, or names; the meanings all involve plural objects or choices.

patterns.name: Laid-Open in patent terminology
patterns.context: Occurs near a patent application number and title; a fixed term in formal patent documents.

patterns.name: Out as an emphasis marker
patterns.context: Occurs in a description of printing previously entered messages in sequence; out is part of the phrase print ... out.

patterns.name: America in news URLs
patterns.context: Occurs in the path of a CNN article URL, among news links concerning the US-China tariff war.

4_1843.concept: none
4_1843.description: 激活涉及 Industry 的分词词尾、Asian/Eastern 地理形容词、more than one 多项结构，也零星响应专利固定词、打印短语及新闻网址中的 America；模式跨领域，触发特征并不统一。

patterns.name: 行业相关词形 Industry
patterns.context: 词内 Industry 被拆分成多个 token，激活集中在词尾片段 «ry»；[1] 位于类名模板中的 Industry，[10] 位于行业受益的政策评论中。

patterns.name: 地理或族群形容词 Asian
patterns.context: 地理/族群名称修饰人群、地区或项目；两处都在 Middle Eastern / Central Asian 这样的复合地名中。
patterns.domain: 公共卫生研究、百科叙述

patterns.name: 多项或多层级结构中的 one
patterns.trigger: « more»7« than»7« one»9 folder« hierarchy»1（[3]）；“more than« one»9 game”（[4]）；“more than« one»8 message”（[7]）；“more than« one»8« name»1”（[8]）
patterns.context: one 出现在 more than one 结构中，表示多个文件夹层级、游戏、消息或名称；语义均涉及复数对象或选择。
patterns.domain: 问答、软件/游戏讨论、论文图注

patterns.name: 专利术语中的 Laid-Open
patterns.context: 出现在专利申请编号及专利名称附近，是正式专利文献中的固定术语。

patterns.name: 强度标记的 out
patterns.context: 出现在将先前输入的消息逐次打印出来的操作描述中，out 是短语 print ... out 的一部分。

patterns.name: 新闻网址中的 America
patterns.context: 出现在 CNN 文章网址的路径中，周围是美国与中国关税战相关的新闻链接。

en.description: Activations are most concentrated in for-loop headers in code, with additional instances in Python dotted imports, code parameters, and punctuation. A few peaks fall on unrelated phrases such as upstream/up, Balkan, Asia Pacific, and drone pilot, making them difficult to unify.

patterns.name: upstream/upscale phrases
patterns.context: Occurs in “upstream project” in a business/infrastructure context or in “scale up to large numbers” about scaling up drones; these are not the same fixed phrase.
patterns.domain: Energy business reporting; technology policy discussion

patterns.name: For-loop opening
patterns.context: Near the for keyword and following parentheses/loop header in code; multiple languages and loop variables are represented.

patterns.name: Python module/property dots
patterns.context: Module and property names separated by dots in a Python import path; the same segment also contains class names and response-class code.

patterns.name: Specific regional phrase
patterns.context: A geographical region name in a commercial market description, followed by regional; BP also appears nearby, but the activation peak falls on Pacific.

patterns.name: Balkan proper noun
patterns.context: Balkan Pipeline Talks appears in an energy news headline, alongside other company names and an upstream project in the same segment.

patterns.name: Drone compound
patterns.context: In a discussion of FAA drone licensing and airspace management, drone and pilot form drone pilot licenses.

patterns.name: Goods fragment in a function name
patterns.context: In a JavaScript function definition, the parameter Goods is inside the function parentheses, followed by a loop.

patterns.name: Numeric values/parameters and code punctuation
patterns.context: Numeric arguments in code, texture/buffer API parameters, or values in animation function calls; local markers are scattered without a stable semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Code-block indentation and output call
patterns.context: Indented code within a loop, immediately followed by a produce call; appears alongside a for loop in the same segment.

4_1843.concept: none
4_1843.description: 激活最集中于代码中的 for 循环头，另有 Python 点号导入、代码参数与标点；少量高峰落在 upstream/up、Balkan、Asia Pacific、drone pilot 等互不相同的词组，难以统一。

patterns.name: upstream／upscale 短语
patterns.context: 出现在商业／基础设施语境的“upstream project”，或无人机规模扩大的“scale up to large numbers”中；不是相同固定短语。
patterns.domain: 能源商业报道；科技政策讨论

patterns.name: for 循环开头
patterns.context: 代码中 for 循环关键字及其紧随的括号／循环头附近；多种语言和循环变量。

patterns.name: Python 模块／属性点号
patterns.context: Python import 路径中，以点号分隔的模块与属性名称；同段也有类名和响应类代码。

patterns.name: 特定地域词组
patterns.context: 商业市场描述中的地理区域名称及其后接 regional；BP 一词也在附近，但激活峰值落在 Pacific。

patterns.name: Balkan 专名
patterns.context: 能源新闻标题中出现 Balkan Pipeline Talks；与同段其他公司名及 upstream 项目并存。

patterns.name: drone 复合词
patterns.context: FAA 无人机许可及空域管理讨论中，drone 与 pilot 构成 drone pilot licenses。

patterns.name: Goods 函数名片段
patterns.context: JavaScript 函数定义中，参数名 Goods 位于函数括号内，后续进入循环。

patterns.name: 数值／参数与代码标点
patterns.context: 代码中的数字参数、纹理／缓冲区 API 参数或动画函数调用数值；局部标记分散，未形成稳定语义模式。

patterns.name: 代码块缩进与输出调用
patterns.context: 循环体内缩进代码，紧接 produce 调用；与同段 for 循环同时出现。

en.concept: Local structures and fragments in English text
en.description: Activations occur across multiple styles, commonly marking function words and number-hyphen-noun compounds. They also cover local fragments such as take up, legal phrasing, patent citation numbers, and code indices, with no single stable semantic theme.

patterns.name: Spaces and prepositional connections
patterns.context: Common function words such as prepositions and conjunctions are marked, but their specific trigger positions vary across segments.
patterns.domain: Multiple styles, including legal documents, everyday web text, and patent specifications

patterns.name: Numbers and word segments in hyphenated compounds
patterns.context: The number two combines with a hyphen and following noun to form a compound modifier; another example is «two»«-»«thirds».
patterns.domain: Legal and patent technical descriptions; also legislative text

patterns.name: Fixed multiword fragment take up
patterns.context: The phrase refers to using up an electricity allowance in one segment and occupying space in another.

patterns.name: Numbers, identifiers, and punctuation in English text
patterns.context: Numbers and punctuation occur in code data resembling arrays or indices, without natural-language syntax.

patterns.name: Legal causation and degree phrasing
patterns.context: Occurs in a legal sentence about injury, pain, and a jury's determination.

patterns.name: Fundraising and legislative voting language
patterns.context: Concerns funds from private sources, fundraising, and wording about a House resolution passing.

patterns.name: Patent document numbers and citation format
patterns.context: Cites US patent numbers and document formatting in a patent background section.

patterns.name: Patent numbers composed of consecutive digits/letters
patterns.context: European patent numbers are split into multiple numeric and alphabetic fragments.

patterns.name: Array index assignment code
patterns.context: Near variable assignments and row/column index expressions.

patterns.name: Product requirements and invention purpose in patents
patterns.context: Describes the structure of an end-cap assembly, regulatory requirements, and the invention's purpose of reducing costs.

4_1843.concept: 英语文本局部结构与片段
4_1843.description: 激活分布于多种文体，常见标记涉及功能词及数字-连字符-名词复合结构；也覆盖 take up、法律表述、专利引文编号和代码索引等局部片段，未显示单一稳定语义主题。

patterns.name: 空格及介词连接结构
patterns.context: 介词、连词等常见功能词被标记，但不同段落中的具体触发位置不一致。
patterns.domain: 法律、日常网页文本、专利说明书等多种文体

patterns.name: 连字符复合词中的数字与词段
patterns.context: 数字 two 与连字符及后续名词构成复合修饰语；另有«two»«-»«thirds»。
patterns.domain: 法律与专利技术说明；另见立法文本

patterns.name: 固定多词片段 take up
patterns.context: 片段中该短语分别指占用电力额度或占用空间。

patterns.name: 英文文本中的数字、编号与标点
patterns.context: 数字及标点出现在类似数组或索引的代码数据中，缺少自然语言句法。

patterns.name: 法律因果与程度表述
patterns.context: 位于关于伤害、疼痛及陪审团评定的法律句子中。

patterns.name: 筹资与立法表决用语
patterns.context: 涉及私人来源资金、筹款，以及众议院通过决议的表述。

patterns.name: 专利文献编号及引文格式
patterns.context: 专利背景段中引用美国专利号及文献格式。

patterns.name: 连续数字/字母组成的专利编号
patterns.context: 欧洲专利编号被拆分成多个数字和字母片段。

patterns.name: 数组索引赋值代码
patterns.context: 变量赋值及行列索引表达式附近。

patterns.name: 专利中的产品要求和发明目的
patterns.context: 描述端盖组件的结构、监管要求及降低成本的发明目的。

en.concept: Occupying (take up) and code indentation whitespace
en.description: Primarily responds to the phrase “take up” and the following content denoting occupied space, resources, or time. Examples include equipment taking up space, networks using bandwidth, and tests taking time; there are also activations on indentation whitespace near closing parentheses in two code segments.

patterns.name: “take up” meaning occupying space or resources
patterns.context: The subject is equipment, an object, activity, or process, followed by the occupied quantity, such as space, screen area, bandwidth, or testing time; also includes the weaker “takes up a large portion”.
patterns.domain: Patent background, technical descriptions, forum comments, and popular science articles

patterns.name: Indentation whitespace in code blocks
patterns.context: In JavaScript code or code snippets, a newline and consecutive indentation spaces appear near a closing parenthesis; activation falls on whitespace rather than an obvious semantic word.

patterns.name: Unexplained atypical code marker
patterns.context: A combination of numbers and punctuation in code. Although indentation whitespace is nearby, this specific marker is inconsistent with other trigger forms.

4_1843.concept: 占用（take up）与代码缩进空白
4_1843.description: 主要响应短语“take up”及其后表示被占用的空间、资源或时间的内容，涵盖设备占空间、网络占带宽、测试耗时等；另在两段代码中对闭括号附近的缩进空白激活。

patterns.name: “take up”表示占用空间或资源
patterns.context: 主语是设备、物体、活动或过程，后接空间、屏幕、带宽、测试时间等被占用的量；也包括较弱的“takes up a large portion”。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、科技说明、论坛评论及科普文章

patterns.name: 代码块中的缩进空白
patterns.context: JavaScript 代码或代码片段中，闭括号附近出现换行和连续缩进空格；激活落在空白而非明显语义词上。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答中的代码

patterns.name: 未解释的非典型代码标记
patterns.context: 代码中的数字及标点组合，附近虽有缩进空白，但该具体标记与其他触发形式不一致。

en.description: Activations are scattered across code, SQL, aviation, toxicology, supernatural topics, commercial copy, and vaccine abstracts; no stable cross-domain semantic trigger is apparent. Some code snippets share a technical Q&A context, but their triggers differ.

patterns.name: Width variables and boundary checks in JavaScript
patterns.context: Assigns and compares browser-window or document width, then branches at a threshold; followed by window event code at the end of the segment.

patterns.name: SQL queries and table joins
patterns.context: Selects projected columns, aliases, tables, and join conditions, involving relational data such as players/products.

patterns.name: Drone regulation and airspace operations
patterns.context: Discusses drone pilot licenses, coordination with existing air traffic control, and restrictions on large-scale operations.

patterns.name: Occupational exposure and toxicology research
patterns.context: Introduces exposure to MDA in manufacturing environments and assesses internal dose and toxicity risks.

patterns.name: Supernatural, UFO, and conspiracy topics
patterns.context: A podcast or talk-show introduction describes the supernatural and conspiracy topics discussed by its hosts.

patterns.name: JavaScript objects, constructors, and options
patterns.context: Shows a constructor initializing options and votes, and discusses copying options rather than updating votes.

patterns.name: Null fields in a user profile object
patterns.context: An object literal lists user profile fields initialized with null, followed by Q&A content.

patterns.name: Cost and size of collapsible containers
patterns.context: Marketing or feasibility copy compares empty container sizes and resulting cost savings.

patterns.name: Oral vaccines and mucosal adjuvants
patterns.context: Discusses adjuvant availability in oral vaccine development and introduces related experiments.

4_1843.concept: none
4_1843.description: 激活分散于代码、SQL、航空、毒理、超自然话题、商业文案和疫苗摘要；未见跨领域稳定的语义触发。部分代码片段共享技术问答语境，但触发内容各异。

patterns.name: JavaScript 中的宽度变量及边界判断
patterns.context: 浏览器窗口或文档宽度赋值、比较并按阈值分支；片段末尾接着 window 事件代码。

patterns.name: SQL 查询与表连接
patterns.context: 查询投影列、别名、表及连接条件，涉及玩家/产品等关系型数据。

patterns.name: 无人机监管与空域运行
patterns.context: 讨论无人机驾驶执照、与现有空管协调及规模化运行限制。

patterns.name: 职业暴露与毒理研究
patterns.context: 介绍生产环境中接触 MDA 的情况，并评估内剂量与毒性风险。

patterns.name: 超自然、UFO 与阴谋话题
patterns.context: 播客或谈话节目介绍主持人讨论的超自然及阴谋论主题。

patterns.name: JavaScript 对象、构造函数与选项
patterns.context: 展示构造函数初始化选项和票数，并讨论复制选项而非更新投票。

patterns.name: 用户资料对象中的空值字段
patterns.context: 对象字面量列出用户资料字段并以 null 初始化，后续接问答内容。

patterns.name: 可折叠容器的成本与尺寸
patterns.context: 营销或可行性说明比较空容器尺寸及其带来的成本节省。

patterns.name: 口服疫苗与黏膜佐剂
patterns.context: 讨论口服疫苗开发中的佐剂可用性，并介绍相关实验。

en.concept: Common phrase fragments and formatting markers
en.description: The clearest pattern is the phrasal verb take up, especially meaning to occupy space or a screen; Here you go also repeatedly activates strongly in emails. There are also sporadic activations on numbers, proper nouns, and code whitespace, with unclear relationships.

patterns.name: Phrasal verb take up (occupy/use up)
patterns.context: take up is followed by space, screen, or another object being occupied; also includes the unusual usage “take up the kva”.
patterns.domain: Patents, home descriptions, forum comments, and web text

patterns.name: Go in emails
patterns.context: In email body text, Here you go introduces a file or content being provided.

patterns.name: Numbers and formatting markers
patterns.context: Structured numeric text such as legal document page numbers/case numbers and email dates/times; it is unclear whether they share a trigger condition.

patterns.name: Marked technical terms or proper nouns
patterns.context: Strong activations occur around proper nouns or group labels, but trigger positions are scattered and lack an obvious shared local pattern.

patterns.name: Spaces in code
patterns.context: In an HTML/CSS example, strong activation falls on a space marker after code, possibly related to whitespace or code formatting.

4_1843.concept: 常见短语片段与格式标记
4_1843.description: 最清楚的模式是短语动词 take up，尤其表示占用空间或屏幕；邮件中 Here you go 也反复强烈激活。另有数字、专名及代码空格处的零散激活，彼此关联不明。

patterns.name: 短语动词 take up（占用/耗费）
patterns.context: take up 后接 space、screen 等表示被占用的对象；也有“take up the kva”这一异常用法。
patterns.domain: 专利、家居描述、论坛评论及网络文本

patterns.name: 邮件中的 go
patterns.context: 邮件正文中以 Here you go 引出所提供的文件或内容。

patterns.name: 数字与格式标记
patterns.context: 法律文书页码/案号与电子邮件日期时间等结构化数字文本；是否由同一触发条件导致不确定。

patterns.name: 带标记的技术或专名
patterns.context: 专名或分组标签周围出现较强激活，但触发位置分散，缺少共同的明显局部模式。

patterns.name: 代码中的空格
patterns.context: HTML/CSS 示例中，较强激活落在代码后的空格标记，可能与空白或代码格式有关。

en.concept: Mixed local morphological and phrase features
en.description: Strong activations concentrate on “take up” in resource-occupancy contexts, and also occur in “all the time,” Swedish word endings, legal citation numbers, and indentation in structured text; the latter categories have no obvious shared semantics.

patterns.name: “take up” meaning occupying space or resources
patterns.context: In the phrase “take up,” describes equipment, shipping containers, activities, or broadcasting occupying space, capacity, or resources; in [7], the object is kva in an electricity bill, an unusual meaning.
patterns.domain: Patent background, technical descriptions, general descriptions

patterns.name: Time in “all the time”
patterns.context: Occurs in “all the time,” meaning that something happens continuously or remains true; one instance is in casual chat, another in a remote-work discussion.

patterns.name: Swedish word endings and “ändringar”
patterns.context: A subword fragment in continuous Swedish text; strong activation falls near word endings or subword boundaries.

patterns.name: Number 1 in a legal citation
patterns.context: Occurs in the legal case citation “Syllabus Point 1,” with a comma following the number.

patterns.name: Indentation whitespace
patterns.context: A large span of spaces after a field in structured text provides indentation, followed by a closing brace.

4_1843.concept: 混合的局部词形与短语特征
4_1843.description: 强激活集中于“take up”及资源占用语境，也出现在“all the time”、瑞典语词尾、法律引文数字和结构化文本缩进中；后几类缺少明显共同语义。

patterns.name: “take up”表示占用空间或资源
patterns.context: 在“take up”短语中，描述设备、运输箱、活动或广播占用空间、容量或资源；[7]的对象是电费中的 kva，语义略不寻常。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、技术说明、一般说明

patterns.name: “all the time”中的 time
patterns.context: 出现在“all the time”中，表示某事持续发生或一直如此；一处是口语聊天，一处是远程工作讨论。

patterns.name: 瑞典语词尾与“ändringar”
patterns.context: 瑞典语连续文本中的词内片段；高激活落在词尾或分词边界附近。

patterns.name: 法律引文中的编号 1
patterns.context: 出现在法律判例引文“Syllabus Point 1,”中，数字后接逗号。

patterns.name: 缩进空白
patterns.context: 结构化文本中，字段结束后的大段空格用于缩进，随后接闭合花括号。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 风格的代码或数据片段

en.description: All passages activate on “organisms” and are noun phrases in a life-science context; the preceding modifiers and specific topics vary.

patterns.name: organisms and its complex noun phrases
patterns.context: The word appears after various modifiers or determiners, often at the end of a noun phrase in scientific statements; it is sometimes preceded by “fungal,” “higher-order,” “vertebrate,” etc.
patterns.domain: Life-science papers, abstracts, and grant text

4_2183.concept: organisms
4_2183.description: 所有段都在“organisms”上有激活，且均处于生命科学语境中的名词短语；前置修饰语和具体主题各不相同。

patterns.name: organisms 及其复杂名词短语
patterns.context: 该词出现在多种修饰语或限定词之后，常位于科学陈述中的名词短语末尾；有时前面是“fungal”“higher-order”“vertebrate”等
patterns.domain: 生命科学论文、摘要和基金文本

en.description: Most passages show strong activation on the final s in organisms across biomedical, neuroscience, patent, and agricultural contexts; a few fungal words also activate weakly. The strong activations on January and Mem cannot be explained by the main pattern.

patterns.name: final letter of organisms
patterns.context: The complete word organisms begins with an unmarked space, and its final s is marked as highly activating; it appears in noun phrases or sentences and may have various preceding modifiers.
patterns.domain: Biomedical, neuroscience, patent, and agricultural texts

patterns.name: fungus-related word forms
patterns.context: Fungal or fungus appears in fungus-related sentences; the strongest activation remains on the final letter of organisms, while fungus itself also activates more weakly.

patterns.name: Other non-organism word forms or fragments
patterns.context: These occur respectively in a month name in a date and in an internal fragment of a tumor name; neither the word form nor the context matches organisms, and no shared trigger can be confirmed.

4_2183.concept: organisms 的词尾形态
4_2183.description: 多数段落在 organisms 的词尾 s 处强激活，跨生物医学、神经科学、专利和农业语境；少数真菌词也弱激活。January 与 Mem 的强激活无法与主模式统一解释。

patterns.name: organisms 的词尾
patterns.context: 完整单词 organisms 以未标记的空格开头、末尾 s 标记为高激活；出现在名词短语或句子中，且前面可有多种修饰语。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、神经科学、专利及农业文本

patterns.name: 真菌相关词形
patterns.context: 真菌相关句子中出现 fungal 或 fungus；最高激活仍落在 organisms 的词尾，而 fungus 本身也有较弱激活。

patterns.name: 其他非 organism 词形或片段
patterns.context: 分别出现在日期中的月份名和肿瘤名称内部片段；与 organisms 词形及语境均不相同，缺乏可确认的共同触发条件。
patterns.domain: 论文日期；医学肿瘤名称

en.description: All snippets contain the Introduction heading, section marker, and equals-sign divider used in PMC papers; after the divider is the opening body text of introductions from papers in various fields. Specific topics and trigger words vary, with no consistent semantic theme.

patterns.name: Paper introduction heading and divider
patterns.context: The beginning of a PMC paper introduction, with a section marker and equals-sign divider after the heading; present in every passage, though passage 1 uses a slightly different form of section marker.

patterns.name: Field-specific terms or topic openings in introductions
patterns.context: The opening body text after the divider; different papers discuss topics such as anemia, hormones, obesity, mental illness, aquaporins, and praying mantises, with no shared lexical meaning or domain condition.

patterns.name: General academic phrasing in introduction text
patterns.context: After the divider, the text includes statements of the paper's topic, research methods, or background; trigger words and sentence structures differ.

4_2183.concept: PMC论文引言格式
4_2183.description: 所有片段都含PMC论文的Introduction标题、章节标记及等号分隔线；分隔线后是多领域论文引言的正文开头，具体主题和触发词各异，未见一致的语义主题。

patterns.name: 论文引言章节标题与分隔线
patterns.context: PMC 论文的引言开头，标题后带章节标记及等号分隔线；各段均出现，段1的章节标记形式稍有不同

patterns.name: 引言中的领域术语或主题开头
patterns.context: 分隔线后的引言正文开头；不同文章分别涉及贫血、激素、肥胖、精神疾病、水通道蛋白、螳螂等主题，未见统一的词义或领域条件

patterns.name: 引言正文中的一般学术表达
patterns.trigger: «Translation» of scientific discoveries into practice；«The» construction of a comprehensive phylogenetic；«In»dependent component analysis；«Our» world is facing the pandemic
patterns.context: 分隔线后出现论文主题陈述、研究方法或背景句；触发词和句式彼此不同

en.description: All snippets share the PMC paper Introduction heading and the same divider format. Activations in the body text are scattered across different words and topics, with no consistent semantic trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Paper introduction heading template
patterns.context: Every passage begins with the same PMC document structure: the Introduction heading, a fragment resembling a number or marker, a divider, and a line break; the opening words of the body text vary.
patterns.domain: PubMed Central paper text and its formatting markers

patterns.name: Local word activations in body text
patterns.context: In the opening body-text fragments following the heading template, several different words or subword fragments activate; no stable shared meaning or topic is apparent.
patterns.domain: Cross-topic scientific paper text, including scientific translation, phylogeny, gonadotropins, ICA, obesity, schizophrenia, aquaporins, praying mantises, epidemics, and geometry

4_2183.concept: 论文引言格式标记
4_2183.description: 所有片段共享 PMC 论文 Introduction 标题及相同分隔格式。正文激活分散在不同词语与主题中，未显现一致的语义触发模式。

patterns.name: 论文引言标题模板
patterns.context: 每段均以相同的 PMC 文档结构开头：Introduction 标题、类似编号/标记的片段、分隔线和换行；正文开头词各异。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 论文文本及其格式标记

patterns.name: 正文中的局部词语激活
patterns.context: 标题模板之后的正文起始片段中，若干不同词语或词内子词被激活；未见稳定的共同词义或主题。
patterns.domain: 跨主题科学论文正文；涉及科学转化、系统发育、促性腺激素、ICA、肥胖、精神分裂症、水通道蛋白、螳螂、疫情及几何等

en.concept: mixed features of mathematical symbols and question fragments
en.description: Strong activations cluster around mathematical symbols, numbers, and simplification problems, with scattered activations in questions, English function words, and passages from different fields. Technical Q&A, research abstracts, workplace discussions, and population surveys each contribute sporadic triggers, which cannot be reduced to a single semantic theme.

patterns.name: Local fragments in numbers and mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Appears in DM Mathematics number puzzles or arithmetic and radical simplification content; triggers are not limited to a single operator or fixed number.

patterns.name: Question or interrogative contexts
patterns.context: Appears in questions or sentences containing a question mark; some math problems, Q&A, and survey texts contain such cues, but they do not explain all mathematical activations.

patterns.name: Connectives and function words in English text
patterns.context: Several common function words and components within phrases are marked in continuous English text; no single fixed word or phrase covers these examples.
patterns.domain: Academic abstracts, expository text, Q&A, forum text

patterns.name: Code and technical terminology
patterns.context: In a Java object and index question and an explanation of a Linux ioctl call, some words in code or technical Q&A are marked; the trigger words in the two passages do not fully match.

patterns.name: Field-specific word fragments in a research abstract
patterns.context: A few words are marked in the opening of an abstract introducing a solar dynamo model; this does not establish whether the cause is astrophysical semantics or abstract style.

patterns.name: Work experience and comparison of time gaps
patterns.context: Compares two developers' years of work experience and periodic gaps, then asks about their impact.

patterns.name: Family planning survey and demographic factors
patterns.context: Survey-style questions about an Indonesian family planning program, education, and fertility rates.

4_2183.concept: 数学符号与问句片段的混合特征
4_2183.description: 强激活集中于数学符号、数字及化简题，同时散见问句、英文功能词和不同领域语段；技术问答、科研摘要、职场与人口调查各有零散触发，无法归结为单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 数字与数学表达式中的局部片段
patterns.context: 出现在 DM Mathematics 的数字谜题或算术、根式化简内容中；触发并非只限某一个运算符或固定数字。
patterns.domain: 形式化数学题、符号算式

patterns.name: 提问或疑问语境
patterns.context: 问题句或带问号的句子中出现；部分数学题和问答、调查文本包含这类线索，但不足以解释所有数学激活。

patterns.name: 英文词语间的连接与功能词
patterns.context: 英文连续文本中，若干常见功能词及词组内部成分被标记；未见单一固定词或短语能覆盖这些例子。
patterns.domain: 学术摘要、说明文、问答、论坛文本

patterns.name: 代码与技术术语
patterns.context: Java 对象与索引问题、Linux ioctl 调用说明中，代码或技术问答的部分词语被标记；两段触发词并不完全相同。

patterns.name: 科研摘要中的领域词片段
patterns.context: 摘要开头介绍太阳发电机模型时，少量词语被标记；无法据此确定是天体物理语义还是摘要文体导致。

patterns.name: 求职经历与时间间隔比较
patterns.context: 比较两位开发者的工作年限及周期性空档，并追问其影响。

patterns.name: 家庭计划调查与人口因素
patterns.context: 围绕印尼家庭计划项目、教育与生育率的调查式问题。
patterns.domain: 公共卫生或人口学调查材料

en.description: Activations mainly fall on the Tor string and its subsequent tokens across various fields; they also occur on tan, arithmetic symbols, and delimiters in mathematical formulas. A Q&A passage containing garbled text and a suspected encoded string also triggers multiple locations, for unclear reasons.

patterns.name: Continuation of the Tor string
patterns.context: The word-initial or internal fragment “Tor” is highlighted; subsequent characters may form different words or names due to tokenization.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain text, including software discussions, marketing copy, emails, car repair, and game descriptions

patterns.name: tan in special mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Appears in mathematical formulas or LaTeX-style equations containing arctan/tan; passage 9 also highlights formula delimiters and differential symbols.
patterns.domain: Patent technical text, StackExchange math or physics Q&A

patterns.name: Corrupted or abnormally encoded text
patterns.context: After garbled characters or a hash/encoding-like string, multiple tokens in an ordinary question are also highlighted; no clear shared semantic trigger is apparent.
patterns.domain: StackExchange help Q&A with garbled or unusual characters

4_2183.concept: 字符串片段与公式符号触发
4_2183.description: 激活主要落在 Tor 字符串及其后续分词上，跨多种领域；另在数学公式的 tan、算式符号和定界符处激活。一个含乱码与疑似编码串的问答也触发多处，原因不明。

patterns.name: Tor 字符串延续
patterns.context: 词首或词内的片段“Tor”被突出；后续字符因分词而可能继续组成不同单词或名称。
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本，包括软件讨论、营销文案、邮件、汽车维修、游戏介绍等

patterns.name: 特殊数学表达式中的 tan
patterns.context: 出现在 arctan/tan 的数学公式或 LaTeX 风格方程中；第9段还突出公式定界符及微分符号。
patterns.domain: 专利技术文本、StackExchange 数学或物理问答

patterns.name: 损坏或异常编码文本
patterns.context: 字符乱码或类似哈希/编码串之后，普通问句中的多个 token 也被突出；未见清楚的共同语义触发条件。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 求助问答，文本含乱码或异常字符

en.description: The main response is to underscore-separated compound identifiers and member-access structures in code, and activations also commonly appear at syntax boundaries such as parentheses, commas, semicolons, and line breaks. Other instances include HTML row attributes, comments, and natural-language passages about circuits and golf.

patterns.name: Underscore-separated parts of identifiers
patterns.context: Activations often fall near an underscore or on an identifier fragment after it; the fragment is usually part of a compound variable, attribute, or key name in a code statement.
patterns.domain: Multilingual programming code (JavaScript, Python, Swift, PHP, etc.), covering [1][2][3][4][8][9].

patterns.name: Member-access period and adjacent names
patterns.context: In code, the member-access operator next to an object, module, or variable is adjacent to a property or method name; it may co-occur with underscore identifiers.

patterns.name: Code punctuation and structural boundaries
patterns.context: Code punctuation appears near function calls, arguments, statement endings, or code-block boundaries; activations are not limited to any one punctuation mark.

patterns.name: HTML rows and attribute formatting
patterns.context: Structured text appears in HTML table tags and attribute values; activations fall near row-markup-related content.

patterns.name: Rule explanations in code comments
patterns.context: Comments explain CSS property rules or classifications, with code conditionals nearby.
patterns.domain: Github code comments and CSS-related code, covering [6].

patterns.name: Word fragments in ordinary text
patterns.context: Activations appear in a response's natural-language explanation of a circuit design, rather than in identifiers or code structure.

patterns.name: Words in golf equipment discussions
patterns.context: Discusses golf club performance and differences, with activations scattered across ordinary narrative words.

4_2183.concept: 代码标识符与结构边界
4_2183.description: 主要响应代码中的下划线复合标识符及成员访问结构，也常见于括号、逗号、分号和换行等语法边界；另有 HTML 行属性、注释，以及电路和高尔夫自然语言片段。

patterns.name: 标识符中的下划线分隔部分
patterns.context: 激活常落在下划线附近或下划线后的标识符片段；片段通常是复合变量名、属性名或键名，处于代码语句中。
patterns.domain: 多语言编程代码（JavaScript、Python、Swift、PHP 等），覆盖 [1][2][3][4][8][9]。

patterns.name: 成员访问点号及其邻接名称
patterns.context: 代码中对象、模块或变量后的成员访问符与属性/方法名相邻，可能与下划线标识符同时出现。

patterns.name: 代码标点与结构边界
patterns.context: 代码标点出现在函数调用、参数、语句结束或代码块边界附近；激活并非只限于某一种标点。

patterns.name: HTML 行与属性格式
patterns.context: HTML 表格标签及属性值中出现结构化文本；激活落在行标记相关内容附近。
patterns.domain: HTML 模板/网页代码，覆盖 [9]。

patterns.name: 代码注释中的规则说明
patterns.context: 注释解释 CSS 属性规则或分类，附近仍有代码条件判断。
patterns.domain: Github 代码注释与 CSS 相关代码，覆盖 [6]。

patterns.name: 普通文本中的词语片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在回答中对电路方案的自然语言说明，而非标识符或代码结构。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 电子/电路问答，覆盖 [5]。

patterns.name: 高尔夫器材讨论中的词语
patterns.context: 讨论高尔夫球杆性能及差异，激活散落在普通叙述词语中。

en.description: Activations are distributed across mathematical formulas, numbers and inequalities, database terminology, legal phrasing, personal names and addresses, and forum words; they also include several subwords and sporadic English words. Triggers span domains and occur in scattered locations, making it difficult to reduce them to a single semantic function.

patterns.name: Specific word forms and tokenization boundaries
patterns.context: Activations fall on subwords within words, affixes, or word boundaries; however, the words and semantics differ, with no shared contextual condition.

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and formula structure
patterns.context: Occurs in formulas, variables, comparison symbols, or mathematical expressions; activation locations and mathematical topics are not fixed.
patterns.domain: Math Q&A, analysis, and partial differential equation papers

patterns.name: Numbers and comparison/numeric boundaries
patterns.context: Appears adjacent to values, variables, and inequalities; it may also overlap with general formula structure.

patterns.name: Database and relational-schema terminology
patterns.context: Relational database queries or database normal forms/key dependencies appear; activations fall on SQL fields and words in a discussion of 3NF, respectively.

patterns.name: Legal provisions and command phrasing
patterns.context: In a Chapter 13 bankruptcy case, the court orders the trustee to calculate interest.

patterns.name: Personal names, addresses, and mapping examples
patterns.context: Example data maps personal names to name and address records; activations are scattered across personal names and street/address fragments.

patterns.name: Person names and descriptions of artworks
patterns.context: Describes an Indigenous representative, their portrait painter, artwork, and the artist who painted it.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic biographies and art history entries

patterns.name: Reference, contrast, and evaluation in forum dialogue
patterns.context: [6] concerns commentary and evaluative tone; [9] concerns a forum post introducing a catalog of cheat tables. The passages have no clear shared semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Sporadic English words and formula fragments
patterns.context: These activations are distributed in ordinary text or at formula edges; the few examples do not establish a stable meaning or consistent context.
patterns.domain: Mixed mathematical, legal, and technical texts

4_2183.concept: none
4_2183.description: 激活分布于数学公式、数字与不等式、数据库术语、法律措辞、人名地址及论坛词语；还包括若干词内子词和零散英文词。触发条件跨领域且位置分散，难以归结为单一语义功能。

patterns.name: 特定词形与分词边界
patterns.context: 激活落在词内子词、词缀或词边界附近；但各词和语义不一致，缺乏共同上下文条件

patterns.name: 数学符号及公式结构
patterns.context: 处于公式、变量、比较符号或数学表达式中；激活位置和数学主题并不固定
patterns.domain: 数学问答、分析与偏微分方程论文

patterns.name: 数字及比较/数值边界
patterns.context: 数值、变量与不等式相邻时出现；也可能与一般公式结构重叠

patterns.name: 数据库及关系模式术语
patterns.context: 出现关系数据库查询或数据库范式/键依赖术语；激活分别落在 SQL 字段及3NF讲解中的词语
patterns.domain: SQL 编程与数据库教学/讨论

patterns.name: 法律条文及命令措辞
patterns.context: 破产法第13章案件中，法院命令受托人计算利息

patterns.name: 人名、地址及映射示例
patterns.context: 以人名映射到姓名和地址记录的示例数据；激活散布在人名和街道/地址片段
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答中的示例

patterns.name: 人名与艺术作品记述
patterns.context: 介绍原住民代表及其肖像画家、艺术作品和画作作者
patterns.domain: 百科人物与艺术史条目

patterns.name: 论坛对话中的指代、转折与评价
patterns.context: [6] 为评论和评价语气；[9] 为论坛发帖中介绍作弊表目录。两段没有明确共享的语义触发条件

patterns.name: 零散英文词与公式残片
patterns.context: 这些激活分布在普通文本或公式边缘，无法从给出的少量例子判定稳定语义或一致上下文
patterns.domain: 混合数学、法律与技术文本

en.description: The most salient activation cue is freeze/thaw and its cycles, especially in biomedical and drug-storage contexts; other activations are scattered across honeycomb structures, unit values, sports and software names, mathematical terms, and legal words, with no unified pattern.

patterns.name: freeze/thaw compounds
patterns.context: Refers to freezing, thawing, and their cycles, counts, or procedures; it can describe bone experiments or drug storage.

patterns.name: comb in compound words
patterns.context: Activates in compounds such as honeycomb ducts/openings; the context concerns honeycomb structures or filtration channels.

patterns.name: Local strings in proper names or terminology
patterns.context: Activations fall in sports event names and playoff vocabulary, the software name Spring Boot, and the mathematical terms radius/hamming spheres; no shared semantic condition is apparent.
patterns.domain: Sports biographies, software Q&A, math Q&A

patterns.name: Units and numerical expressions
patterns.context: Appears in material capacity units or quantity statements, activating local subwords/numbers rather than a stable repeated expression.

patterns.name: Large values and repeated counts
patterns.context: Appears in experimental repetition counts or statistical analyses, as well as in general counting statements.

patterns.name: Procedural terms in legal text
patterns.context: Appears in a presentence investigation report; the activation here seems to fall on an internal word fragment.

4_2183.concept: 混合的词形与领域线索
4_2183.description: 激活最突出的线索是 freeze/thaw 及其循环，尤其见于生物医学与药品储存；其余激活分散在蜂窝结构、单位数值、体育与软件专名、数学术语和法律词语中，未形成统一模式。

patterns.name: freeze/thaw 复合词
patterns.context: 表示冷冻、解冻及其循环、次数或操作；可描述骨骼实验或药物储存。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、药品与材料研究

patterns.name: 复合词中的 comb
patterns.context: 在 honeycomb ducts/openings 等构词中被激活；上下文谈及蜂窝结构或过滤通道。

patterns.name: 专名或术语中的局部字符串
patterns.context: 激活落在体育赛事名称及季后赛词汇、软件名称 Spring Boot，以及数学术语 radius/hamming spheres 中；难见共同语义条件。
patterns.domain: 体育传记、软件问答、数学问答

patterns.name: 单位与数值表达
patterns.context: 出现在材料容量单位或数量陈述中，激活局部子词/数字，而非稳定的同一表达。

patterns.name: 大数值与重复计数
patterns.context: 在实验重复次数或统计分析中出现；同时有一般计数表述。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的程序词
patterns.context: 出现在 presentence investigation report（量刑前调查报告）中；此处激活似为词内片段。

en.concept: mixed technical text and local word-form patterns
en.description: Activations are scattered across plural noun endings, formula numbers and symbols, technical word fragments, and fragments within drug names; other instances occur in network formula variables, predictive decision language, conversational speech, and expressions of experimental results, with no unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Plural endings adjacent to numbers/symbols
patterns.context: Activations often fall on the endings of English plural nouns, especially in mathematical, scientific, or technical contexts; some words are split at token boundaries.
patterns.domain: Mathematics, physics, biomedicine, and machine-learning texts

patterns.name: Numbers or relation symbols in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Sporadic activations occur near numbers, operators, or formula layout, often alongside equations, combinations, or decimal problems.
patterns.domain: Math Q&A, formulas, and scientific data

patterns.name: Local substrings in technical terms
patterns.context: Falls on local fragments of technical terms or common English words, with descriptions of inverse functions, matrices, or models nearby; no consistent semantic trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: Fragment within a drug name
patterns.context: The name “okadaic acid” is split into tokens, and the fragment activates in a discussion of phosphatase inhibitors.

patterns.name: Backpropagation symbols and variables
patterns.context: Activations occur near variables and formula symbols in an error-update equation for neural-network output units.

patterns.name: Quantifiers in predictive decisions
patterns.context: Appears in discussions of whether to adopt a prediction, probabilities, and remaining time; cases also fits the plural-noun pattern.

patterns.name: Conversational discourse and chat sign-offs
patterns.context: In an IRC conversation, colloquial connectives, expressions confirming or ending the conversation, and chat-style abbreviations are marked.

patterns.name: Numeric units or result expressions
patterns.context: Sporadic activations appear near percentage changes and mean ± error expressions in experimental results.

4_2183.concept: 混合的技术文本与局部词形模式
4_2183.description: 激活分散于复数名词词尾、公式数字与符号、技术词片段及药名内部；另见网络公式变量、预测决策措辞、聊天口语和实验结果表达，未形成统一语义触发。

patterns.name: 复数词尾与数值/符号相邻
patterns.trigger: « waves»；« spheres»；« operations»；« fluctuations»；« components»；« estimates»；« arte»facts；« outputs»；« cases»
patterns.context: 激活多落在英语复数名词的词尾，尤其在数学、科学或技术语境中；部分词在标记边界处被拆分
patterns.domain: 数学、物理、生物医学及机器学习文本

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的数字或关系符号
patterns.context: 数字、运算符或公式排版附近出现零散激活，常伴随等式、组合数或小数题目
patterns.domain: 数学问答、公式及科学数据

patterns.name: 技术词项中的局部子串
patterns.context: 落在技术术语或常见英语词的局部片段上，周围有反函数、矩阵或模型描述；未见一致的语义触发条件
patterns.domain: 数学、物理、生物医学论文

patterns.name: 药物名称内部片段
patterns.context: 名称“okadaic acid”被分词拆开，片段在讨论磷酸酶抑制剂时激活

patterns.name: 反向传播符号与变量
patterns.context: 神经网络输出单元的误差更新公式中，变量和公式符号附近激活

patterns.name: 预测决策中的数量词
patterns.context: 讨论是否采纳预测、概率及剩余时间时出现；其中 cases 也符合复数名词模式

patterns.name: 口语话语与聊天结束语
patterns.context: IRC 对话中，口语连接词、确认/结束对话的表达及聊天式缩写被标记

patterns.name: 数字单位或结果表达
patterns.context: 实验结果中，百分比变化和均值±误差式表达附近出现零散激活

en.concept: Multiple local word-form and formatting features
en.description: Activation is clearest on fragments of the okadaic acid name, base-number strings, argumentative connectives, plus/minus notation, and the adhes root. Formula formatting, patent and legal phrasing, and sporadic word fragments also appear; no single stable theme is evident.

patterns.name: Internal fragments of the “okadaic acid” drug name
patterns.context: When describing protein phosphatases and their pharmacological inhibitors, activation centers on the okadaic fragment split by tokenization; segment 1 also concerns phosphatases insensitive to the drug.

patterns.name: Chunking of base-number strings
patterns.context: Appears in base-15, base-13, and similar questions; activation is on alphanumeric strings and their chunks. Whether it points to a specific number pattern is unclear.

patterns.name: Logical connectives and conditional expressions
patterns.context: These words connect inferences, indicate contrast, or express necessary/sufficient conditions in arguments; the specific topics vary across segments.

patterns.name: Plus/minus notation
patterns.context: Appears in experimental-result error expressions “plus/minus 0.95” and “plus/minus 28%”.

patterns.name: Mathematical formatting boundary fragments
patterns.context: Near formulas or LaTeX formatting, trigger points fall on mathematical notation, variable boundaries, or within split words.

patterns.name: Adhesion-related word root
patterns.context: Contexts describe cell adhesion, bonding of fibers to a substrate, or objects remaining attached; trigger words share the adhes root or a near-synonymous form.
patterns.domain: Biomedical science and patent materials descriptions

patterns.name: Psychosocial terminology fragments
patterns.context: Discusses self-image, social structures, and their formation; activation falls on terms and nearby common words, with a weak pattern.

patterns.name: Numeric range symbols
patterns.context: Appears in the experimental concentration notation “1x10-16M”; activation centers on the hyphen and adjacent unit fragment.

patterns.name: Concessive connective in patent phrasing
patterns.context: A patent description first states that a material can maintain adhesion during use, then contrasts this with its easy removal.

patterns.name: Claims and requests in litigation
patterns.context: Describes parties’ claims, alternative pleadings, and whether a case proceeds in discussion of court proceedings.

patterns.name: Other sporadic argumentative and common words
patterns.context: These activations fall variously on common function words, letter fragments, quantum entanglement terminology, game-theory vocabulary, or contrastive connectives, and resist grouping into a unified content pattern.

4_2183.concept: 多种局部词形与格式特征
4_2183.description: 激活最明确地落在okadaic酸名称、进位制数字片段、论证连接词、plus/minus记法及adhes词根；另有公式排版、专利和法律句式及零散词片段，未见单一稳定主题。

patterns.name: “okadaic acid”药物名称内部片段
patterns.context: 在描述蛋白磷酸酶及其药理抑制剂时，激活集中在被分词拆开的 okadaic 片段；段1还涉及对该药不敏感的磷酸酶。

patterns.name: 进位制数字串的分块
patterns.context: 出现在 base 15、base 13 等进位制数值题中，激活的是字母数字串及其分块；是否指向特定数字模式不明确。

patterns.name: 逻辑连接词及条件表达
patterns.trigger: « and»、« thus»、« but»、« not»、« necessary»、« sufficient»、« condition»
patterns.context: 这些词出现在论证中，用于连接推论、转折或表达必要/充分条件；各段具体主题不同。

patterns.name: plus/minus 书写形式
patterns.context: 出现在实验结果的数值误差表达式“plus/minus 0.95”及“plus/minus 28%”中。

patterns.name: 数学排版边界片段
patterns.context: 公式或 LaTeX 排版附近，触发点落在数学标记、变量边界或被拆分的单词内部。
patterns.domain: 数学/理论计算机科学论文

patterns.name: 黏附相关词根
patterns.context: 描述细胞黏附、纤维与基体黏结或物体保持黏附的语境；触发词共享 adhes 词根或近义形式。
patterns.domain: 生物医学与专利材料描述

patterns.name: 心理社会学术语片段
patterns.context: 讨论自我形象、社会结构及其形成；激活落在术语及邻近常见词上，模式较弱。

patterns.name: 数字范围符号
patterns.context: 出现在实验浓度标记“1x10-16M”中，激活集中于连字符及紧邻单位片段。

patterns.name: 专利句式中的让步连接
patterns.context: 专利描述中先说明材料在使用期间能维持黏附，随后转折说明容易剥离。

patterns.name: 法律诉讼中的主张与请求
patterns.trigger: « claim»3« should» be « allowed»4« to»1« proceed»；« possibility»5« of»2 pleading in the alternative
patterns.context: 法院诉讼程序讨论中描述当事人的主张、替代诉辩及案件是否继续。

patterns.name: 其他零散论证词及常见词
patterns.trigger: « at»、« least»、« one»、« these»、« G»、«wl»（段1）；« Z»、« positive»、« general» 等（段3）；段5的« dealer»、« profit»；段6的« but»等
patterns.context: 这些激活分别落在普通功能词、字母片段、量子纠缠术语、博弈论词汇或转折连接词上，难以归为统一的内容模式。

en.description: Strong activation prominently involves tokenized fragments of okadaic acid, but markers also occur sporadically on numeric symbols, dosage numbers, common words, legal phrases, and forum text. No stable semantic pattern spans all segments.

patterns.name: Spelling fragments of okadaic acid
patterns.context: The compound name is marked by tokenization, with activation centered within the name; it appears in sentences discussing phosphatases or cell motility.

patterns.name: Plus numeric expressions
patterns.context: Appears in numerical expressions of experimental data, means, or magnitude of change; isolated plus also occurs next to a drug dose.

patterns.name: Specific English word fragments
patterns.context: Words occur in ordinary narration or argument; though appears in contrastive or concessive contexts, while the other words share no clear semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Forum, legal, parliamentary, and scientific texts

patterns.name: Metes in a surveying description
patterns.context: Appears in the legal fixed expression “metes and bounds description”.

patterns.name: mg/m² in a treatment regimen
patterns.context: A drug-dose number appears in a list of mg/m² chemotherapy regimens; other dose numbers in the same segment are unmarked.

patterns.name: Qualifying modifier fragment
patterns.context: Part of meritorious, modifying defense in the Rule 60(b)(1) legal standard.

patterns.name: Discourse marker ja
patterns.context: Appears near an independent utterance or speaker marker in HackerNews dialogue, followed by «ke».

4_2183.concept: none
4_2183.description: 强激活较突出地涉及 okadaic acid 的分词片段，但标记也散见数值符号、剂量数字、普通词、法律词组和论坛文本，未见能覆盖全部段落的稳定语义模式。

patterns.name: okadaic acid 拼写片段
patterns.trigger: «ok»«ada»«ic»« acid»（第[2]段为 «ok»«ada»«ic»« acid» 的相邻片段）
patterns.context: 该化合物名称被分词标记，激活集中在名称内部；出现于讨论磷酸酶或细胞运动的句子中。
patterns.domain: 生物化学与细胞生物学论文

patterns.name: plus 数值表达
patterns.context: 出现在实验数据、均值或变化幅度的数值表达中；也有孤立的 plus 与药物剂量相邻。
patterns.domain: 生物医学结果及剂量报告

patterns.name: 特定英文词片段
patterns.context: 词语位于普通叙述或论述中；though 出现在转折、让步语境，其他词没有共同的明显语义条件。
patterns.domain: 论坛、法律、议会及科学文本

patterns.name: 计量描述中的 metes
patterns.context: 出现在“metes and bounds description”这一法律固定表达中。

patterns.name: 治疗方案中的 mg/m²
patterns.context: 药物剂量数字位于 mg/m² 化疗方案列举中；同段其他剂量数字未标记。

patterns.name: 限定性修饰片段
patterns.context: 组成 meritorious 一词，修饰 defense，出现在 Rule 60(b)(1) 法律标准中。

patterns.name: 话语标记 ja
patterns.context: 出现在 HackerNews 对话文本中的独立发言或说话者标记附近，后接 «ke»。

en.concept: Symbols and numbers in structured technical text
en.description: Activation is distributed across punctuation- and number-dense text such as formulas, parameters, and code; scientific units, drug doses, and a few medical narratives also appear. These are difficult to group under one semantic theme.

patterns.name: Structured text dense with numbers, operators, and punctuation
patterns.context: Appears in mathematical formulas, parameter tables, or program code, especially when numbers, variables, operators, and separators occur in sequence.
patterns.domain: Mathematics, statistics, programming, and technical text

patterns.name: Numeric scientific measurements and units
patterns.context: In experimental measurements or clinical dosing text, units occur next to numbers, times, or drug doses.

patterns.name: Statistical terminology and variable importance
patterns.context: Terminology occurs alongside numeric parameters or theorem references in parameter estimation, statistical modeling, or machine-learning discussions.

patterns.name: English function definitions and asymptotic relations
patterns.context: Mathematical definitions, limits, or asymptotic relations are explained in words, with formulas embedded in English sentences.

patterns.name: Code control structures and example instructions
patterns.context: Control syntax, code punctuation, and brief explanations are mixed in loop code or tutorial examples.

patterns.name: Drug regimens and dosage notation
patterns.context: Drug names, doses, administration times, and regimen abbreviations are listed in sequence.

patterns.name: Narrative about neonatal jaundice
patterns.context: English medical prose discusses neonatal discharge timing and the subsequent difficulty of managing jaundice.

4_2183.concept: 结构化技术文本中的符号与数值
4_2183.description: 激活分布于公式、参数和代码等标点数字密集文本，也见科学单位、药物剂量及少数医学叙述；难以归为单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 数字、运算符与标点密集的结构化文本
patterns.context: 在数学公式、参数表或程序代码中出现，尤其是数字、变量、运算符和分隔符连续交错时。
patterns.domain: 数学、统计、编程及技术文本

patterns.name: 数字化科学测量与单位
patterns.trigger: “« Hz»”“« sec»”“« min»”“« um»”“« mg»”“« m2»”“« h»”，以及邻近的数值
patterns.context: 实验测量或临床剂量文本中，单位与数字、时间或药物剂量相邻。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究与临床摘要

patterns.name: 统计术语与变量重要性
patterns.context: 参数估计、统计建模或机器学习论述中，术语与数值参数或定理引用并列。
patterns.domain: 统计学与机器学习论文

patterns.name: 英文函数定义与渐近关系表达
patterns.context: 以文字说明数学定义、极限或渐近关系，公式嵌在英文句子中。

patterns.name: 代码控制结构和示例指令
patterns.context: 循环代码或教程示例中，控制语法、代码标点与简短说明混合出现。

patterns.name: 药物方案及剂量记法
patterns.context: 药物名称、剂量、给药时间和方案缩写连续列出。

patterns.name: 新生儿黄疸相关叙述
patterns.context: 讨论新生儿出院时间及其后续黄疸管理困难的英文医学叙述。

en.description: Activation is scattered across within-word subwords, common English function words, and syntactic fragments in multiple languages; time expressions, Portuguese morphology, and SQL code also appear. Topics and semantics are dispersed, with no single stable theme.

patterns.name: Subword fragments within and at the boundaries of English words
patterns.context: Activation falls on complete English words or tokenized subwords; some fragments occur at the beginning, end, or middle of words, with no unified lexical or syntactic condition.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain; includes encyclopedia, technical, legal, scientific, narrative, and code documentation

patterns.name: Common function words and connective structures
patterns.context: Connectives, pronouns, prepositions, or subordinate-clause markers in ordinary English sentences; sentence structures and semantics vary.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain English prose, legal documents, scientific text, technical documentation, and narrative

patterns.name: Portuguese morphological fragments and function words
patterns.context: In Portuguese Q&A, activation is distributed across nouns, verbs, their endings or subword fragments, and short function words.

patterns.name: Time expressions and time markers
patterns.context: Appears in a specific clock time or idiomatic time expression; the two instances differ in semantics and syntactic function.
patterns.domain: Personal narrative and historical figure entries

patterns.name: Numeric and code-condition syntax
patterns.context: Numbers, branch keywords, and operators in SQL CASE expressions; activation centers on code syntax fragments.

patterns.name: Localized trigger from high-intensity but
patterns.context: But occurs in contrastive sentences involving legal argument, personal narrative, and performance narrative; it may be a salient trigger, but these examples alone cannot establish its independence.

4_2183.concept: 词法与子词片段
4_2183.description: 激活散布于多语种文本的词内子词、常见英语虚词及句法片段；另见时间表达、葡萄牙语形态、SQL 代码。题材和语义分散，缺乏单一稳定主题。

patterns.name: 英语词内部及边界处的子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在英语词的完整形式或切分后的子词上；部分片段位于词首、词尾或词中，未见统一的词义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: 跨领域；含百科、技术文本、法律、科研、叙事及代码说明

patterns.name: 常见虚词和连接结构
patterns.context: 普通英语句子中的连接词、代词、介词或从句标记；所在句式和语义各异。
patterns.domain: 跨领域英语散文、法律文书、科研文本、技术说明及叙事

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语形态片段与功能词
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语问答中，激活分布于名词、动词及其词尾或子词片段，并包括短功能词。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 葡萄牙语技术问答

patterns.name: 时间表达与时间标记
patterns.context: 出现在具体钟点或习语式时间表达中；两处语义和句法作用不同。
patterns.domain: 个人叙事及历史人物条目

patterns.name: 数值与代码条件语法
patterns.context: SQL CASE 表达式中的数字、分支关键词和运算符；激活集中在代码语法片段。

patterns.name: 高强度 but 的局部触发
patterns.context: but 在转折句中出现，分别用于法律论证、个人叙事和演出叙事；它可能是显著触发，但仅凭这些例子无法确认其独立性。

en.concept: Local structure and contrast in English text
en.description: Activation is distributed across copyright templates and legal disclaimers, mathematical expressions, and technical or academic text. Visible local triggers include uppercase legal boilerplate, arithmetic symbols, and but within sentences, but these do not form a unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Placeholders and uppercase words in copyright templates
patterns.context: A standard copyright notice template in a code comment; activation falls on split fragments of uppercase words and punctuation such as apostrophes.

patterns.name: Legal wording in disclaimers
patterns.context: A disclaimer lists limitations of liability, types of damages, and exceptions.

patterns.name: Operators and variable expressions in English math problems
patterns.context: Variables, function definitions, and arithmetic expressions alternate in math problems or automatically generated algebra problems.
patterns.domain: Math problems and formal arithmetic text

patterns.name: Contrastive connective within a sentence
patterns.context: A limitation, contrast, or addition follows a preceding statement; the word appears in texts on different topics.
patterns.domain: Various English explanatory and academic texts

patterns.name: Comparative or degree expression longer
patterns.context: Compares the time required by delivery methods and uses “but” to introduce a contrast in security.

patterns.name: Specific technical abbreviations and email terminology
patterns.context: Technical explanation of email authentication policies, DNS domains, and aggregate reports.

patterns.name: Qualifying discussion in biochemical research
patterns.context: Proposes a possible interaction between fatty acid synthases from different tissues.

patterns.name: Low-redshift bursts in astrophysical text
patterns.context: Discusses a few known low-redshift gamma-ray bursts, then uses a contrast to introduce detection status.

patterns.name: Discussion of energy correlator constraints
patterns.context: Reviews constraints on the one-point energy correlator, then moves to a derivation or subsequent discussion.

4_2183.concept: 英文文本中的局部结构与转折
4_2183.description: 激活分布于版权模板和法律免责声明、数学表达式、技术或学术文本；可见的局部触发包括大写法律套语、算术符号及句中 but，但这些内容并无统一语义模式。

patterns.name: 版权模板中的占位符与大写词
patterns.context: 代码注释中的标准版权声明模板；激活落在被拆分的大写单词片段及撇号等标点上。
patterns.domain: GitHub 代码与许可证文本

patterns.name: 免责声明中的法律措辞
patterns.trigger: “PARTICULAR PURPOSE”、“DISCLAIMED”、“IN NO EVENT SHALL”、“LIABLE”、“INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED”
patterns.context: 免责声明中列举责任限制、损害类型与例外。

patterns.name: 英文数学题中的运算符与变量表达式
patterns.context: 数学题或自动生成的代数题中，变量、函数定义与算术式交替出现。
patterns.domain: 数学题目与形式化算术文本

patterns.name: 句中转折连接词
patterns.context: 前文陈述后接限制、反差或补充；该词在不同主题文本中均出现。
patterns.domain: 多种英文说明文与学术文本

patterns.name: 比较级或程度表达 longer
patterns.context: 比较交付方式所需时间，并以“but”引出安全性反差。

patterns.name: 特定技术缩写与邮件术语
patterns.context: 描述邮件认证政策、DNS 域及汇总报告的技术说明。

patterns.name: 生化研究中的限定性论述
patterns.context: 提出组织来源脂肪酸合成酶之间可能存在的相互作用。

patterns.name: 天体物理文本中的低红移爆发
patterns.context: 讨论少数已知低红移伽马射线暴，并以转折引出探测情况。

patterns.name: 能量关联函数约束论述
patterns.trigger: “energy correlators”、“what kind of constraints do we get?”、“but for now”
patterns.context: 先回顾一点能量关联函数的约束，再转入推导或后续讨论。

en.description: Activation is scattered across Google identifiers in code, give up, enough time, astronomical numeric units, but contrasts in patent and legal language, and the mathematical term prime ideal. No single stable semantics or style covers all segments.

patterns.name: Google/GitHub identifiers and separators
patterns.context: Google API/Protobuf names and path fragments in code, script URLs, or serialized data; activation falls on domain and path components

4_2183.concept: none
4_2183.description: 激活分散于代码中的 Google 标识符、give up、enough time、天文数值单位、专利与法律语句中的 but 转折，以及数学术语 prime ideal；没有单一稳定语义或文体能覆盖全部段。

patterns.name: Google/GitHub标识符与分隔符
patterns.context: 代码、脚本 URL 或序列化数据中，Google API/Protobuf 名称及路径片段；激活落在域名和路径的组成部分
patterns.domain: GitHub 代码或二进制/协议数据

patterns.name: give up 短语
patterns.context: 短语表示放弃，常接 career、dream 或其他目标；激活集中在 up
patterns.domain: 人物经历与建议性散文

patterns.name: enough 后接时间/数量
patterns.context: 条件句中表示有足够的时间可采取行动

patterns.name: 数值与单位标记
patterns.context: 天文/物理文本中描述吸收线及波长

patterns.name: 材料性能及让步转折
patterns.context: 专利语句先说明材料粘附性能，再以 but 引出可剥离性

patterns.name: but 转折后的否定或限制
patterns.context: 在法律论述中承认材料有帮助，同时限制其证明力；与[9]同样出现 but，但上下文不同
patterns.domain: 法律意见或选举法论述

patterns.name: prime ideal 数学术语
patterns.context: 介绍余维数为1的素理想及相关理论

en.description: The most prominent trigger is but, especially in contrast, concession, or disclaimers; it appears across multiple domains. The remaining segments show no clear shared trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Strong contrast after but
patterns.context: But is often followed by negation, limitation, or content contrasting with what precedes it; the marker falls on but itself.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain English prose, explanatory text, and license text

patterns.name: But in license disclaimers
patterns.context: In software licenses or copyright disclaimers, but introduces “no warranty”; warranty and without often occur nearby.

patterns.name: But at the end of code snippets
patterns.context: After code or comments, but shifts to natural-language explanation or a qualification.

patterns.name: Concessive explanation addressed to readers
patterns.context: But introduces concerns or difficulties readers may encounter, followed by a solution.

patterns.name: But contrast in a mathematics paper
patterns.context: Describes a quantity that cannot be measured directly but can be reconstructed from other information.

patterns.name: But with weak neighboring-word activation
patterns.context: In an architecture description, but is followed by don’t forget, reminding readers of a benefit that remains important despite the trade-off.

4_2183.concept: 英语转折词 but
4_2183.description: 最突出的触发是 but，尤其在转折、让步或免责声明中；多领域均出现。其余段落的激活未见明确共同触发模式。

patterns.name: but 后的强转折
patterns.context: 在 but 之后，常接否定、限制或与前文形成对照的内容；标记落在 but 本身。
patterns.domain: 跨领域英语散文、说明文及许可证文本

patterns.name: 许可证免责声明中的 but
patterns.context: 软件许可证或版权免责声明中，but 引出“无任何保证”；多处邻近 warranty、without。

patterns.name: 代码片段末尾的 but
patterns.context: 在代码或注释之后，but 转入自然语言说明或限制。
patterns.domain: 代码托管文本、技术问答

patterns.name: 面向读者的让步说明
patterns.context: but 引出读者可能遇到的疑虑或困难，随后给出解决方案。
patterns.domain: 面向开发者的网页文案

patterns.name: 数学论文中的 but 转折
patterns.context: 描述某量不可直接测量，但可由其他信息重建。

patterns.name: 相邻词强度较弱的 but
patterns.context: 架构说明中，but 后接 don’t forget，提示权衡后仍应注意收益。

en.description: Activation covers operators and variables in mathematical expressions, code and formatting boundaries, scoring contexts in cricket reports, and qualifying statements in academic abstracts. Trigger forms differ substantially across segments, with no unique stable lexical or semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Plus/minus signs and operators in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Near math problems, expressions, or formulas; a minus sign may occur before a number, within parentheses, or between operators, with no fixed sentence pattern required.

patterns.name: Structural boundaries in code and markup languages
patterns.context: In HTML/code snippets or formatted license text; activation is distributed across tags, near line breaks, and body words, with no single fixed trigger word.
patterns.domain: Web markup, code Q&A, and software license text

patterns.name: Quantity or score in a narrative
patterns.context: Numbers in cricket match narratives indicate runs, innings scores, or match results; the specific numbers in [5] and [6] are unmarked, while runs is prominently activated.

patterns.name: Qualifying language in academic text
patterns.context: An academic abstract on artifact analysis discusses research constraints, especially minimizing damage.

4_2183.concept: none
4_2183.description: 激活覆盖数学表达式中的运算符与变量、代码及格式边界、板球报道中的得分语境，以及学术摘要中的限制性表述。各段的触发形式差异明显，未见唯一稳定的词项或语义模式。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的正负号与运算符
patterns.trigger: «+», «-», «*», «/» 等算术符号，尤其是运算式中的 «-»；也包括 [1] 的 «p»、«v»、«f» 等变量标记
patterns.context: 数学题、表达式或公式附近；负号可处于数字、括号或运算符之间，并不要求固定句式。

patterns.name: 代码与标记语言中的结构边界
patterns.trigger: [2] 的 «</option», «</select», «</div»、缩进和换行；[4] 的 «↵» 及 «under» 等许可证文本边界处标记
patterns.context: HTML/代码片段或带有格式化结构的许可证文本中；激活分布在标签、换行附近及正文词语上，未呈现单一固定触发词。
patterns.domain: 网页标记、代码问答与软件许可证文本

patterns.name: 叙述中的数量或得分
patterns.context: 数字出现在板球比赛叙述中，表示得分、局分或比赛结果；[5]、[6] 的具体数字未标记，明显激活包括 runs。

patterns.name: 学术文本中的限制表达
patterns.context: 关于文物分析的学术摘要中，讨论研究需遵守的约束，尤其是尽量减少破坏。

en.description: Activation is distributed across multiple domains. Clearer triggers include “suppositories” in pharmaceutical patents and the words destructive, waiting, dienes, runs, and words; mathematical segments fall on various forms of notation, with no unified semantics.

patterns.name: Rectal dosage form “suppositories”
patterns.context: Appears in descriptions of pharmaceutical formulations, routes of administration, or related background; strong activation falls in the middle of the word, “itories”.

patterns.name: “destructive” in a phrase about degree of damage
patterns.context: Discusses scientific testing of artifacts or objects, particularly the constraint to be “as little destructive as possible”.

patterns.name: “waiting” in a phrase about waiting time
patterns.context: Describes a stage in a trajectory, where waiting is a short phase after diffusion and return.

patterns.name: Diene reactant name “dienes”
patterns.context: Mentions cyclic or acyclic reactants in a cycloaddition reaction chemistry abstract.

patterns.name: Local activation in numbers or mathematical notation
patterns.context: Near mathematical formatting, algebra problems, or formulas; no consistent mathematical semantics or shared trigger substring explains the activation.

patterns.name: Runs as the required score
patterns.context: In a cricket match report, a team needs to reach a specific score to preserve its chance of advancing.

patterns.name: “words” in a keyword heading
patterns.context: The “Suggested Keywords” field at the end of a paper or in abstract metadata.

4_2183.concept: 无统一概念（局部词形/词汇触发）
4_2183.description: 激活分散于多个领域，较明确的触发包括药学专利中的“suppositories”，以及 destructive、waiting、dienes、runs、words 等词；数学段落则落在多种记号上，未见统一语义。

patterns.name: 直肠给药剂型“suppositories”
patterns.context: 在药物制剂、给药途径或相关背景描述中出现；强激活落在词的中段“itories”。

patterns.name: 破坏性程度短语中的“destructive”
patterns.context: 讨论文物或对象的科学检测，尤其在“as little destructive as possible”这一尽量减少破坏的约束中。

patterns.name: 等待时间短语中的“waiting”
patterns.context: 描述运动轨迹的阶段，等待是扩散、返回之后的短暂阶段。

patterns.name: 二烯反应物名“dienes”
patterns.context: 环加成反应的化学摘要中提到环状或非环状反应物。

patterns.name: 数值或数学记号中的局部激活
patterns.context: 数学排版、代数题或公式附近；没有一致的数学语义或相同触发子串可解释激活。

patterns.name: “runs”所指的得分需求
patterns.context: 板球比赛报道中，球队需要达到特定得分以保住晋级机会。

patterns.name: 关键词标题中的“words”
patterns.context: 论文末尾或摘要元数据里的“Suggested Keywords”字段。

en.concept: Mathematical problem text boundaries and local function words
en.description: Primarily appears in math-question wording, answer-to-next-question boundaries, and text following numbers; local words also appear in artifact-research constraints and scientific trajectory descriptions. No unified cross-domain semantics emerges.

patterns.name: Question marks in math problems
patterns.context: Direct questions in math problems, especially questions beginning with Is, What, Find, Solve, or Calculate; activation is near words or punctuation within the question.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics, interleaved problems and solutions

patterns.name: Answer boundaries in math problems
patterns.context: A math Q&A ends, the answer is followed by a line break, and a new problem begins with Let; this pattern occurs where adjacent problems are concatenated.

patterns.name: Text following numbers in math problems
patterns.context: After a numerical answer or numeric expression in a calculation problem, a new problem prompt follows; the trigger position may span the problem boundary.

patterns.name: Analysis constraints for an artifact
patterns.context: In an introduction to scientific artifact research, describes constraints to be observed, especially minimizing damage and working directly on the object.

patterns.name: Waiting phase in motion
patterns.context: When describing motion trajectories in phases, the waiting phase is used to optimize localization; strong activation centers on waiting and time.
patterns.domain: ArXiv research paper, trajectories and localization

4_2183.concept: 数学题文本边界及局部功能词
4_2183.description: 主要出现在数学题问句、答案与下一题的边界及数字后续文本；另见文物研究限制和科研轨迹描述中的局部词语，未形成跨领域统一语义。

patterns.name: 数学题中的问号
patterns.trigger: “Is f”, “Is z a composite number?”, “What is the thousands digit of n?”, “Find the second derivative”, “Solve … for g”, “Calculate n(14)”
patterns.context: 数学题里出现直接提问，尤其是以 Is、What、Find、Solve、Calculate 引出的问句；激活落在问句中的词或标点附近。

patterns.name: 数学题的答案边界
patterns.context: 一个数学问答结束、答案后换行，并紧接新题的 Let；此模式在相邻题目拼接处出现。

patterns.name: 数字后的题目文本
patterns.context: 计算题的数值答案或数字表达式后，继续出现新题提示词；触发位置可能横跨题目边界。

patterns.name: artifact 的分析限制
patterns.context: 介绍文物科学研究时，描述研究应遵守的限制，尤其是尽量少破坏、直接在物件上进行。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要，文物分析方法

patterns.name: motion 的等待阶段
patterns.context: 描述运动轨迹分阶段时，等待阶段用于优化定位；强烈激活集中于 waiting 与 time。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 科研论文，轨迹与定位

en.concept: Letter strings and common subword fragment detection
en.description: The most consistent trigger is the Marcel letter string split across words; it occasionally matches Carcel as well. “components” also repeatedly activates in technical or scientific contexts. Activations for Anchors, email phrases, and a public-health sentence are isolated and difficult to reconcile with the main pattern.

patterns.name: Marcel substring
patterns.context: The letter sequence Marcel appears across word boundaries or in names, often with different tokenizations; [1] is the Spanish phrase «Carcel de la Corte», which does not exactly match the spelling of Marcel.
patterns.domain: Incidental spellings in personal names, place names, and book titles; novels, Wikipedia, legal texts, and astrophysics papers

patterns.name: components
patterns.context: The word appears in statements about constituent parts, ingredients, or components; activation is concentrated on the word itself.

patterns.name: Isolated AnChors string
patterns.context: The capitalized string Anchors appears in code or structured text; nearby are YAML-style key-value pairs and Khmer text.

patterns.name: Isolated “on recent” phrase
patterns.context: An email notifies recipients about recent activity; activation falls on “on” in a common phrase.

patterns.name: Isolated homelessness phrase
patterns.context: Literature discusses homeless individuals responding to drug abuse; activation is distributed across several common words in the sentence, with no clear shared trigger with other passages.

4_2253.concept: 字母串与常见词片段探测
4_2253.description: 最一致的触发是跨词切分的 Marcel 字母串，偶尔也命中 Carcel；另有 components 在技术或科学语境反复激活。Anchors、邮件短语及公共卫生句的激活较孤立，难与主模式统一解释。

patterns.name: Marcel 子串
patterns.context: 跨词边界或姓名中出现字母序列 Marcel，且常以不同 token 切分；[1] 是西班牙语短语 «Carcel de la Corte»，与 Marcel 拼写并不完全相同。
patterns.domain: 人名、地名及书名中的偶然拼写；小说、Wikipedia、法律和天体物理论文

patterns.name: components
patterns.context: 该词出现在对组成部分、成分或部件的陈述中；触发集中在词本身。
patterns.domain: 专利技术描述、科学论文

patterns.name: 孤立 AnChors 字符串
patterns.context: 代码或结构化文本中出现首字母大写的 Anchors 字符串；附近有 YAML 样式键值和高棉文字。

patterns.name: 孤立 on recent 短语
patterns.context: 邮件中通知收件人近期活动；激活落在常见短语中的 on。

patterns.name: 孤立 homelessness 短语
patterns.context: 讨论无家可归者应对药物滥用的文献；激活分布在该句多个常用词上，未见与其他段落明确共有的触发。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目摘要/公共卫生

en.concept: Specific substrings at word beginnings and within words
en.description: Activation mainly falls on word-initial Con (conventionally, conventional, concomitant, conjugated), and also appears in proper-name fragments such as Marcel, Conrad, and Carcel, as well as in components; spans patent, medical, encyclopedia, and literary texts.

patterns.name: Word-initial Con- fragment
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on «Con» at the beginning of words; subsequent forms vary and include conventionally, conventional, concomitant, conjugated

patterns.name: Subword fragments in names
patterns.context: These substrings appear in personal or proper names; Carcel in [3] occurs in the French title «Carcel de la Corte»

patterns.name: components in general sentences
patterns.context: A patent sentence describes components and their composition; activation mainly falls on components

4_2253.description: 激活主要落在词首 Con（conventionally、conventional、concomitant、conjugated），也出现在 Marcel、Conrad、Carcel 等专名片段及 components；跨专利、医学、百科和文学文本。

patterns.name: Con-词首片段
patterns.context: 激活集中在单词开头的 «Con»；后续词形各异，涵盖 conventionally、conventional、concomitant、conjugated

patterns.name: 人名中的分词片段
patterns.context: 人名或专名中出现这些子串；[3]中的 Carcel 位于法语标题 «Carcel de la Corte»
patterns.domain: 百科条目、古典文学文本

patterns.name: 一般句子中的组件词
patterns.context: 专利句子中描述组件及其构成；激活主要落在 components

en.description: The activation pattern is scattered: inspection appears in patent, regulatory, and real-estate texts, while medical terms such as vision and language disorders also activate. Other local strings concern component composition, public health, photon methods, target quotations, and commercial advertising, making them difficult to group under a single semantic category.

patterns.name: inspection and related forms
patterns.context: Inspection and its inflected or compound forms appear in contexts involving inspectors conducting inspections, inspection light sources/defect detection, and contractual inspection periods.
patterns.domain: Regulatory texts, semiconductor patents, real-estate descriptions

patterns.name: vision
patterns.context: Vision screening tools or threatening complications related to eyesight

patterns.name: Terms for language disorders
patterns.context: Descriptions of dyslexia subtypes, language disorders, and their manifestations

patterns.name: Statements about components and composition
patterns.context: A patent background explains how certain parts make up a seat component

patterns.name: homeless individuals and drug abuse
patterns.context: Discusses related literature and homeless individuals responding to drug abuse; words span token fragments

patterns.name: Photon and color sequences
patterns.context: Discusses conformational changes in photon intervals and recognition when color sequences appear scrambled

patterns.name: Target and series transition sentence
patterns.context: A sentence introducing the following text by turning to a series of targets

patterns.name: estate coaching and infomercials
patterns.context: Mentions real-estate training companies, advertisements, and conditions for refunding deposits

4_2253.description: 激活模式分散：inspection 在专利、监管及房地产文本中出现，vision、语言障碍等医学词汇也有激活；另有成分构成、公共卫生、光子方法、目标引述和商业广告等局部词串，难以归为单一语义。

patterns.name: inspection 及其同族词
patterns.context: inspection 及其屈折或复合用法；分别见检查人员执行检查、检查光源/缺陷检测、合同检查期等上下文
patterns.domain: 监管、半导体专利、房地产说明

patterns.name: vision
patterns.context: 视觉筛查工具或视力相关的威胁性并发症

patterns.name: 语言障碍类别词
patterns.context: 描述阅读障碍亚型、语言障碍及其表现

patterns.name: 成分与组成表述
patterns.context: 专利背景中说明某些部件构成座椅部件

patterns.name: homeless individuals 与 drug abuse
patterns.context: 讨论相关文献及无家可归者应对药物滥用；词语跨分词片段
patterns.domain: 公共卫生/研究项目文本

patterns.name: 光子与颜色序列
patterns.context: 讨论光子间隔中的构象变化，以及颜色序列看似打乱时的识别

patterns.name: 目标与系列转折句
patterns.context: 以转向某系列目标的句式引出下文

patterns.name: estate coaching 与 infomercials
patterns.context: 谈及房地产培训公司、广告和订金退还条件

en.description: The main pattern concerns “inadvertently” and the accidental omissions, misoperations, mislabeling, damage, or outcomes it introduces. Other isolated activations include explaining, patent boilerplate, and email name fragments.

patterns.name: Related to “inadvertently”
patterns.context: The word appears directly, usually describing something happening unintentionally; in multiple passages it is the highest-activation point.
patterns.domain: Patent backgrounds, scientific papers, emails, etc.

patterns.name: Oversight or omission
patterns.context: Describes a part unintentionally left out during assembly; “inadvertently” also appears in the same passage.

patterns.name: Preventing accidental operation
patterns.context: Describes a locking arm or retaining arm being accidentally operated; preceding text explains that a cover structure is intended to prevent this.

patterns.name: Water accidentally entering a crack
patterns.context: Describes water possibly entering cracks in a material unintentionally during rolling.

patterns.name: Unintentional mislabeling
patterns.context: Uncontrolled labels may cause a content topic to be mislabeled.
patterns.domain: Patent backgrounds, information retrieval and content labeling

patterns.name: Accidental injury to adjacent tissue
patterns.context: Describes the possibility of unintentionally puncturing adjacent tissue or organs during a transesophageal procedure.
patterns.domain: Patent backgrounds, medical devices and surgery

patterns.name: Part omitted during assembly
patterns.context: Describes a component being unintentionally omitted during assembly of a connector assembly.

patterns.name: Unintentionally producing a positive effect
patterns.context: Describes a system design that may unintentionally produce a positive effect.

patterns.name: Explanatory wording
patterns.context: Activation falls on “explaining,” meaning an explanation of research results or limitations; “inadvertently” is absent.

patterns.name: Patent boilerplate fragment
patterns.context: An isolated patent-description boilerplate phrase; no obvious trigger shared with other highly activated words.

patterns.name: Business email and name fragment
patterns.context: Activation falls on a recipient-name fragment, surrounded by arrangements for approving and sending a press release; no obvious shared semantic trigger.

4_2253.description: 主模式是对“inadvertently”（非故意地）及其引出的意外遗漏、误操作、误标、损伤或结果敏感；另有 explaining、专利套语及邮件人名等孤立激活。

patterns.name: “inadvertently”相关
patterns.context: 该词直接出现，通常描述某事非故意发生；在多处是最高激活点。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、科研论文、邮件等

patterns.name: 疏漏或遗漏
patterns.context: 描述组装过程中零件被无意漏装；同段还有“inadvertently”。

patterns.name: 防止误操作
patterns.context: 描述锁臂、保持臂被意外操作，前文说明遮盖结构用于防止这种情况。

patterns.name: 水意外进入裂缝
patterns.context: 描述滚压时水可能非故意进入材料裂缝。
patterns.domain: 专利背景，道路施工材料

patterns.name: 无意误标
patterns.context: 未受控标签可能使内容主题被错误标记。
patterns.domain: 专利背景，信息检索与内容标注

patterns.name: 意外损伤邻近组织
patterns.context: 描述经食道操作时可能无意刺穿邻近组织或器官。
patterns.domain: 专利背景，医疗器械与手术

patterns.name: 组装时漏装部件
patterns.context: 描述组装接头组件时某部分被无意遗漏。
patterns.domain: 专利背景，电气组件组装

patterns.name: 意外产生正面影响
patterns.trigger: “inadvertently end up having a positive impact”
patterns.context: 描述系统设计可能非故意产生正面影响。

patterns.name: 解释性表述
patterns.context: 激活落在“explaining”，语义为解释研究结果或限制；未见“inadvertently”。
patterns.domain: NIH 科研摘要，癌症免疫治疗

patterns.name: 专利套语片段
patterns.context: 孤立的专利描述套语；未见明显与其他高激活词相同的触发。

patterns.name: 商业邮件与人名片段
patterns.context: 激活落在收件人姓名片段，周围是新闻稿审批与发送安排；无明显共同语义触发。

en.description: Strong activations often fall on find or morphologically varied fragments within words; one medical abstract also activates around quantities, scales, and examination terms. Some fragments may be coincidental and are difficult to group under a unified semantic category.

patterns.name: The “find” word family and cross-word fragments
patterns.context: The highest-intensity points are often subword fragments within or at the boundaries of words; explicit instances of find occur in “to find their way” and “could find no relationship,” while fragments from several other words resemble them.
patterns.domain: Multiple domains: stage directions, medical abstracts, patents, business emails, news, forums, traffic headlines, physiology abstracts, biographies

patterns.name: Quantities and examination terms in medical papers
patterns.context: Quantities, scales, examination procedures, and medical terms occur densely; activation falls on these words or fragments within them.

patterns.name: Stage lighting and performer access
patterns.context: Describes lighting that helps performers and technicians find their way in the dark during a performance; find is a standalone word in the sentence.

patterns.name: find in schizophrenia research
patterns.context: In the negative construction “could find no relationship,” find means that the study did not detect a relationship between variables.

4_2253.description: 强激活常落在 find 或形态各异的词内片段；另有一段医学摘要在数量、量表、检查术语处激活。部分片段可能只是偶合，难以归为统一语义。

patterns.name: “find”词族及其跨词片段
patterns.context: 强度最高处多为单词内部或边界处的子词片段；显式的 find 出现在“to find their way”和“could find no relationship”中，另有若干不同词的片段与其相似。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：舞台说明、医学摘要、专利、商务邮件、新闻、论坛、交通标题、生理学摘要、人物传记

patterns.name: 医学论文中的数量及检查术语
patterns.context: 数量、量表、检查过程及医学术语密集出现；激活分布在这些词或词内片段上。

patterns.name: 舞台灯光与演员通行

patterns.name: 精神分裂症研究中的 find
patterns.context: 在否定结构“could find no relationship”中，find 表示研究未发现变量间关系。

en.description: Activation often falls on sporadic subword fragments within words or across multilingual characters, most notably vis (e.g., viscoelastic, visage); there are also fragments in a Chinese idiom and an Arabic prayer. The passages differ greatly in domain and meaning, making it difficult to establish a unified trigger.

patterns.name: Cross-character fragment vis
patterns.context: The string appears within words or near hyphens/masking markers; it is not limited to a single domain or meaning.

patterns.name: Within-word letter fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls within tokenized words or multibyte characters; the fragments span domains, with no consistent lexical or grammatical condition.
patterns.domain: News, encyclopedias, medicine, philosophy, literature, and multilingual texts

patterns.name: Specific Chinese-character fragment
patterns.context: Appears in a Chinese idiom describing the appearance of the Four Great Beauties; fragments within the characters activate sporadically.

patterns.name: Arabic fragment
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of an Arabic Islamic prayer; multiple letters and diacritical marks activate separately.

4_2253.description: 激活多落在词内或多语字符的零碎子词片段，最醒目的是 vis（如 viscoelastic、visage）；另有汉字成语和阿拉伯祈祷语片段。各段领域与语义差异大，难以确认统一触发条件。

patterns.name: 跨字符片段 vis

patterns.name: 词内字母片段

en.description: Primarily activates on word forms ending in -ing and their cross-token fragments, including gerunds, participles, and adjectives; semantics are varied, with a few additional contexts involving dance, music, funding, and spectra.

patterns.name: Nominalized verbs ending in -ing
patterns.context: Responds to words ending in -ing or -ing forms assembled across tokens; words may function as gerunds, nouns, or adjectives. They are often preceded by verb, adjective, or noun stems.
patterns.domain: Multiple genres, including encyclopedias, academic papers, policy texts, news, and music profiles

patterns.name: Dance and skating terms
patterns.context: Dance activities or figure-skating contexts appear; passage 1 concerns dancers and ballet, while passage 7 describes an athlete switching to ice dancing.

patterns.name: Expressions describing vocals or music
patterns.context: Evaluates the emotional quality or effect of a melody; song«writing»10 in passage 2 also refers to songwriting, but is not the same semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Policy funding

patterns.name: Vibrational modes in ice and water spectra
patterns.context: Discusses molecular vibrations on ice surfaces or spectral band intensity; stretching is an -ing form, and bending is another form of the same kind.

patterns.name: Other unexplained -ing uses
patterns.context: Various participles, gerunds, or within-word tokenizations, with weaker intensity and no more specific semantic category.

4_2253.description: 主要对以 -ing 结尾的词形及其跨 token 片段激活，涵盖动名词、分词和形容词；语义分散，另有少量舞蹈、音乐、资金与光谱语境。
