patterns.name: 描述声乐或音乐的表达

patterns.name: 未解释的其他 -ing 用法

en.description: Activation locations are scattered: several passages involve “-ing” nominalizations for operations or processes, but others activate content words, punctuation, and sentence beginnings. Domains and semantics are not unified, and no single pattern covers them all.

patterns.name: “-ing” nouns around word-final or stem “ing”
patterns.context: Appears in names of processes, systems, or operations, often alongside words such as procedures, systems, and information; gerunds or nominalized operations also appear near “monitoring,” “retrieval,” “fixing,” “touching,” “seeking,” “dist[r]acting,” and “occupancy.”
patterns.domain: Multiple genres, including academic papers, patents, news commentary, emails, and institutional descriptions

patterns.name: Specific content words or local forms

patterns.name: Punctuation and sentence-initial boundaries
patterns.context: In some passages, activation is near line breaks or punctuation, but other passages show no consistent boundary pattern.

en.description: Activation locations are dispersed: Lithuanian word-initial fragments, en within words across languages, mathematical subscripts in papers, and word-final fragments in mothering and overcrowding. There is no stable semantic theme across passages; some hits may be coincidental subword or character fragments.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment matching English abbreviation content
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments matching en within cross-lingual or line-broken words; the contexts are semantically inconsistent.

patterns.name: Lithuanian words containing the letter sequence od
patterns.context: Activation concentrates at the beginning of the Lithuanian word obūdžio; the passage discusses giving people decision-making power.
patterns.domain: Lithuanian speeches in the European Parliament

patterns.name: Subscript characters in specific astrophysical notation
patterns.context: Activation appears in LaTeX mathematical expressions, especially subscript markers and adjacent symbols; some represent physical quantities or cosmological parameters.

patterns.name: Suffix in a word related to mothering
patterns.context: Activation falls on the suffix of mothering in a passage describing adoptive parenting.

patterns.name: End of the word crowding
patterns.context: Activation falls on the end of overcrowding in a list of socioeconomic indicators, preceded by references to family housing and other factors.
patterns.domain: Population and socioeconomic variables in medical papers

4_2253.concept: 特定子词片段与符号的混合响应
4_2253.description: 激活位置分散：立陶宛语词首、跨语言词内 en、论文数学下标，以及 mothering 和 overcrowding 的词尾。跨段没有稳定的语义主题；若干命中可能是子词或字符片段偶合。

patterns.name: 词内含有与英文缩写 content 相符的片段
patterns.context: 激活落在跨语言词语或断行词语内部与 en 相符的子词片段；上下文语义并不一致。
patterns.domain: 意大利语、葡萄牙语、法律英语

patterns.name: 含有字母组合 od 的立陶宛语词语
patterns.context: 激活集中在立陶宛语词语 obūdžio 的词首；该段谈论给予人们决策权。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会立陶宛语发言

patterns.name: 特定天体物理符号中的下标字符
patterns.context: 激活出现在 LaTeX 数学表达式中，尤其是下标标记及其相邻符号；其中部分是物理量或宇宙学参数。
patterns.domain: 天体物理与宇宙学论文

patterns.name: 母职相关词语的后缀
patterns.context: 激活落在描述收养育儿的 mothering 一词后缀上。

patterns.name: crowding 一词的末尾
patterns.context: 激活落在社会经济指标列表中的 overcrowding 末尾，前面提到家庭住房等因素。
patterns.domain: 医学论文中的人口与社会经济变量

en.description: Dispersed patterns: activation appears in motherhood narratives, medical support, demographics, horse-racing distances, excuses, patent support structures, and cosmological terms and equations. Some passages share only local word forms or domain expressions and are difficult to group under a single semantic theme.

patterns.name: Motherhood and parenting
patterns.context: Discussing motherhood, parenting, or adoption, and the emotions and losses experienced by mothers

patterns.name: Intensive support or treatment measures
patterns.context: Listing critical-care treatments or support measures when a patient's condition deteriorates; activation favors “support” and related treatment expressions

patterns.name: Statistical population and regional variables
patterns.context: Describing population, socioeconomic, or regional statistical indicators; activation falls on the end of “overcrowding”

patterns.name: Cosmological parameters and equations
patterns.context: Parameters, symbols, or equations appear in cosmology papers; multiple triggers are dispersed across terms and mathematical expressions

patterns.name: Concealment, excuses, and pretexts
patterns.context: Urging people to be honest rather than hiding behind excuses or management techniques; activation spans a line break

patterns.name: Support structure for a cover
patterns.context: Discussing the difficulty of removing a rigid tank cover and the complex support structure required

patterns.name: Horse-racing distance unit
patterns.context: Horse-racing reports describing race distance; the trigger word is split into multiple tokens

4_2253.description: 模式分散：母职叙述、医学支持、人口统计、赛马距离、托辞表达、专利支撑机构及宇宙学术语和公式均有激活；若干段落仅共享局部词形或领域表达，难以归为同一语义。

patterns.name: 母亲身份与育儿
patterns.context: 讨论母职、育儿或收养，以及母亲经历的情感与损失

patterns.name: 强烈支持或治疗措施
patterns.context: 病情恶化时列举重症治疗或支持措施，激活偏向“support”及相关治疗表述

patterns.name: 统计人口与地区变量
patterns.context: 描述人口、社会经济或地区层面的统计指标；激活落在“overcrowding”的词尾

patterns.name: 宇宙学参数与公式
patterns.context: 宇宙学论文中出现参数、符号或公式；多个触发分散在术语和数学表达中

patterns.name: 隐蔽、借口与托辞
patterns.context: 劝人坦诚而非躲在借口或管理手段之后；激活标记跨越换行

patterns.name: 覆盖物的支撑机构
patterns.context: 讨论储罐刚性盖的移除难度及其所需复杂支撑机构

patterns.name: 赛马距离单位
patterns.context: 赛马报道描述比赛距离，触发词被拆分成多个 token

en.description: Activation is concentrated on numbers, units, statistical symbols, and adjacent abbreviations in specialized academic texts. Medical research is most common, but quantitative environmental pollution reports and astrophysical equations also appear, along with one comparative expression.

patterns.name: Units, values, and abbreviation boundaries in medical/biomedical contexts
patterns.context: Numeric expressions for laboratory measures, doses, intake, statistical results, or clinical endpoints in medical papers; activation often falls on numbers, unit symbols, abbreviations, and their separators

patterns.name: Quantitative environmental pollution and substance names
patterns.context: Pollutant types, concentrations, or emissions/growth amounts and units in environmental reports or test results
patterns.domain: Environmental science, pollution monitoring and reporting

patterns.name: Astrophysical parameters and equation notation
patterns.context: Equation and parameter symbols embedded in academic discussion of model constraints, mass fluctuations, and systematic errors

patterns.name: Contrast or comparative words in quantitative results
patterns.context: Comparative constructions adjacent to numerical comparisons

4_2253.concept: 学术文本中的定量记号
4_2253.description: 激活主要集中于专业学术文本中数值、单位、统计符号及其相邻缩写；医学研究最常见，也见环境污染定量报告和天体物理公式，另有一次比较词触发。

patterns.name: 医学/生物医学语境中的单位、数值与缩写边界
patterns.context: 医学论文中实验室指标、剂量、摄入量、统计结果或临床终点的数字表达；激活常落在数字、单位符号、缩写及其分隔处
patterns.domain: 临床医学、营养学、生物医学研究

patterns.name: 定量环境污染与物质名称
patterns.trigger: « increase»1« of»1« industrial»2« and»3« domestic»2« waste»1«waters»3« from»3 11« to»1 60 km«3»2« per»10 year»3；« hydrocarbons»1、« ben»1«zo(«a»2)«py»1«rene»3、« ng»3«/»10g
patterns.context: 污染物种类、浓度或排放/增长量与单位出现在环境报告或检测结果中
patterns.domain: 环境科学、污染监测与报告

patterns.name: 天体物理参数与公式记号
patterns.context: 公式和参数符号嵌在讨论模型约束、质量涨落及系统误差的学术论述中

patterns.name: 定量结果中的转折或比较词
patterns.trigger: « than»2（“greater … for C than for W”）
patterns.context: 紧邻数值比较结果的比较结构

en.concept: Symbols and term fragments in scientific texts
en.description: Activation is dispersed across numbers, units, symbols, and fragments of technical terms in scientific texts. Some passages involve measurement or comparisons of change, but no stable lexical trigger pattern explains all activations.

patterns.name: Numbers, units, and statistical values
patterns.context: Near measurements, concentrations, units, numeric ranges, and statistical results in medical or experimental texts; several passages activate parts of numbers or units, but the markers are not always contiguous
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, medical reports, and statistical results

patterns.name: Numbers, symbols, and separators within terms
patterns.context: In proper abbreviations, mathematical expressions, or chemical/physical notation, activation falls on numbers, punctuation, backslashes, and symbol fragments rather than whole words
patterns.domain: Medical abbreviations, mathematical equations, physics papers

patterns.name: Local word fragments in technical terms
patterns.context: Multisyllabic terms, in-word fragments, or technical nouns in scientific or technical contexts; the context involves substances, measurements, or classification

patterns.name: Expressions of direction, comparison, and change
patterns.context: Narrative describing quantity changes, threshold comparisons, or lists of multiple factors

4_2253.concept: 科学文本中的符号与术语片段
4_2253.description: 激活分散在科学文本中的数值、单位、符号及专业术语片段；部分段落涉及测量或比较变化，但没有一个稳定的词汇触发模式能解释全部激活。

patterns.name: 数字、单位与统计数值
patterns.context: 医学或实验文本中的测量值、浓度、单位、数值范围和统计结果附近；多个段落激活数字或单位的一部分，但标记并不总是连续
patterns.domain: 科学论文、医学报告及统计结果

patterns.name: 术语内部的数字、符号与分隔符
patterns.context: 专有缩写、数学表达式或化学/物理符号中，激活落在数字、标点、反斜线及符号片段上，而非完整词语
patterns.domain: 医学缩写、数学公式、物理学论文

patterns.name: 专业词语中的局部字词片段
patterns.context: 科学或技术语境中的多音节术语、词内片段或专业名词；上下文涉及物质、测量或分类
patterns.domain: 环境科学、微生物学、医学

patterns.name: 方向、比较与变化表达
patterns.trigger: « increase»2、« industrial»3« and»3« domestic»2« waste»1«waters»4、« greater»1« than»1
patterns.context: 描述数量变化、阈值比较或多类因素并列的叙述

en.description: Activation is distributed across several local cues: spatial or capacity collocations with into, numbers and symbols and units in scientific and medical texts, encyclopedia list boundaries, and specific expressions such as per and within; no single semantic rule covers all passages.

patterns.name: “into” and its collocations
patterns.context: “into” appears in expressions describing putting content into a limited space or container; one example is a resume placed in a box, the other an insult compressed into a short space.

patterns.name: Numbers, separators, and units in scientific notation
patterns.context: Activation appears around mathematical, measurement, or statistical data, especially subscripts, exponents, slashes, values, and units; the trigger is not limited to one specific symbol.
patterns.domain: ArXiv papers, medical literature, and statistical results

patterns.name: List entries and entry boundaries
patterns.context: Activation appears near line breaks, consecutive name entries, and “See also” in encyclopedia articles or disambiguation pages; entries often include identities or years in parentheses.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia people lists and disambiguation pages

patterns.name: “per” and per-unit-time expressions
patterns.context: A “per unit time” structure describes frequency or quantity, with nearby content discussing the number of distractions.

patterns.name: “within” and diagnostic pathway expressions
patterns.context: “within” indicates the place of a measure or test method in an existing workflow; activation concentrates on the word and the phrase following it.

4_2253.description: 激活分散在几类局部线索上：into 的空间/容量搭配、科学和医学文本中的数字符号与单位、百科列表边界，以及 per、within 等特定表达；没有覆盖所有片段的单一语义规律。

patterns.name: “into”及其搭配
patterns.context: “into”出现在描述把内容放进有限空间或容器的表达中；前者是简历装进方框，后者是把侮辱塞进短小篇幅。

patterns.name: 科学符号中的数字、分隔符与单位
patterns.context: 数学、计量或统计数据周围出现激活，尤其是下标、指数、斜线、数值及单位；触发点并不固定为某个单一符号。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文、医学文献及统计结果

patterns.name: 列表条目与条目边界
patterns.context: 百科条目或消歧义页中，换行、连续人名条目及“See also”附近出现激活；条目常含括号内身份或年份。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 人物列表和消歧义页

patterns.name: “per”及单位时间表达
patterns.context: 以“每单位时间”的结构描述频率或数量，且邻近内容谈论分心次数。

patterns.name: “within”与诊断路径表达
patterns.context: “within”用于说明某指标或检测方法在既有流程中的位置；激活集中在该词及其后续短语。

en.description: Activation is distributed across several genres: encyclopedia entry formatting, medical research and case reports, and “entering/dividing into” structures; diagnostic workflows, job-application text boxes, and Swedish parliamentary word fragments also appear, making it difficult to identify a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Dividing or splitting into different parts
patterns.context: Describing an object, experience, or content being divided into different parts; one example is cell allocation, the other product splitting.

patterns.name: Parentheses and entry formatting in directory entries
patterns.context: Names, identities, years, positions, and other details arranged in compact entries, often with parentheses, line breaks, and “See also” cross-references.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia disambiguation pages or people directories

patterns.name: Research associations and grouping
patterns.context: Research describes associations between variables and groups cases by interval.

patterns.name: Diagnostic pathways and sample types
patterns.context: Discussing how a review helps researchers select samples and determine the role of a test in the existing diagnostic workflow.

patterns.name: Fitting into an established space or container
patterns.context: Describing a personal experience compressed into a text box on a job-search website; it shares the surface form of “entering a container/part” with cell allocation or product splitting.
patterns.domain: Online essay about a personal job-search experience

patterns.name: Medical values and units
patterns.context: A clinical narrative listing INR and hemoglobin values and units.

patterns.name: In-word fragments in Swedish parliamentary speech
patterns.context: Swedish parliamentary records contain subword fragments, proper names, and procedural language; there is little apparent semantic connection to the other passages.

4_2253.concept: 多模式格式与分隔结构
4_2253.description: 激活分布于多种文体：百科条目格式、医学研究与病例，以及“进入/分入”结构；另有诊断流程、求职文本框和瑞典语议会词片段，难以归为单一语义模式。

patterns.name: 分隔或拆分为不同部分
patterns.context: 表示将某对象、经验或内容分入不同部分；前者是细胞分配，后者是产品拆分。
patterns.domain: 生物医学；科技商业评论

patterns.name: 名录条目的括号与条目格式
patterns.context: 姓名、身份、年份、职务等以紧凑条目排列，常有括号、换行和“See also”交叉引用。
patterns.domain: 百科全书消歧义页或人物名录

patterns.name: 研究关联与分组
patterns.context: 研究描述变量间的关联，并将病例按区间分组。

patterns.name: 诊断路径与样本类型
patterns.context: 讨论综述如何帮助研究者选择样本并确定某检测在现有诊断流程中的作用。

patterns.name: 嵌入既定空间或容器
patterns.context: 描述把个人经历压缩到求职网站的文本框中；与细胞分配或产品拆分共享“进入容器/部分”的表面形式。
patterns.domain: 个人求职经历的网络随笔

patterns.name: 医疗数值及单位
patterns.context: 病历叙述中列出 INR 与血红蛋白数值及单位。

patterns.name: 瑞典语议会发言中的词内片段
patterns.context: 瑞典语议会记录中出现分词片段、专名及议事用语；与其他段落缺少明显语义联系。

en.description: Activation is distributed across unrelated phenomena: splitting/classification introduced by into, Swedish in-word fragments, number-unit formatting, and parentheses, line breaks, and cross-references in encyclopedia entries about people. The passages lack a unifying semantic theme.

patterns.name: Dividing or including within a range
patterns.context: Describing experiences, cases, or events being assigned, divided, or placed into different parts/categories; often paired with into or divided.
patterns.domain: Job-search texts, social media business commentary, biomedical papers, patent background

patterns.name: Swedish in-word fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls in continuous Swedish text, often on a split substring within a word rather than a complete word.

patterns.name: Number and unit formatting
patterns.context: Near numbers, measurement units, or medical/scientific notation combining numbers and units.

patterns.name: Entry boundaries and parenthetical formatting
patterns.context: Near structural markers such as parentheses, line breaks, and cross-references in people entries.

4_2253.description: 激活分布在多种互不相同的现象：into 引出的拆分/归类，瑞典语词内片段，数字单位格式，以及百科人物条目的括号、换行和交叉引用。各处缺少统一的语义主题。

patterns.name: 分割或纳入某一范围
patterns.context: 描述把经验、体验或病例分配、拆分或归入不同部分/类别；通常与 into 或 divided 搭配。
patterns.domain: 求职文本、社交媒体商业评论、生物医学论文、专利背景

patterns.name: 瑞典语词内片段
patterns.trigger: «ä»10、«mö»7、«fä»9，以及多处带重音字母的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在瑞典语连续文本中，常是被切分的词内部子串，而非完整词。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会瑞典语议事记录

patterns.name: 数值与单位格式
patterns.context: 数值、计量单位或数字与单位相连的医学/科学记法附近。

patterns.name: 条目边界与括号格式
patterns.context: 人物条目中括号、换行和交叉引用等结构标记附近。

en.description: Strongly activates primarily on the literal token “separation,” covering contexts such as physical separation, statistical distribution discrimination, cell sorting, and signal separation; also activates in a reference title and a name fragment.

patterns.name: The word separation
patterns.context: The word separation itself is marked as active; it most often appears in noun phrases or sentences describing a separation process, degree, or method.
patterns.domain: Cross-disciplinary academic texts, especially biomedicine and chemical engineering; also signal processing

patterns.name: The substring separation in a name
patterns.context: The trigger occurs as part of a proper name or title-like text rather than ordinary prose, such as a reference title.

patterns.name: A similar substring in a name
patterns.context: Strong activation falls on a fragment of the rider’s name Daghelinkcx; the surrounding content concerns cycling race medal records and has no clear separation-related meaning.

4_2299.description: 主要对字面 token“separation”强烈激活，涵盖物理分离、统计分布区分、细胞分选及信号分离等语境；另在参考文献标题和一个姓名片段中出现激活。

patterns.name: separation 一词
patterns.context: 词语 separation 本身被标记为激活；多出现在名词短语或描述分离过程、程度、方法的句子中。
patterns.domain: 跨领域学术文本，尤见生物医学与化学工程；也见信号处理

patterns.name: 名称中的 separation 子串
patterns.context: 触发词出现在专名或标题式文本的组成部分中，而非普通正文，如参考文献标题。

patterns.name: 姓名中的类似子串
patterns.context: 高激活落在骑手姓名 Daghelinkcx 的片段内；邻近内容是自行车赛事奖牌记录，没有明显的 separation 语义。

en.description: Activates primarily on separation and its collocations involving separation or discrimination, covering membrane treatment, ion exchange, signals, cells, statistical distributions, and biochemical separation; also includes several apparently unrelated web, encyclopedia, sports, and patent fragments.

patterns.name: separation vocabulary
patterns.context: The word itself is strongly marked, appearing in scientific and technical senses of separation, classification, or discrimination; it also occurs in ordinary contexts, where the specific collocation matters.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, references, and general text

patterns.name: Membrane separation and oxidation treatment
patterns.context: Membrane separation is described as a treatment process, alongside or near processes such as anodic oxidation.

patterns.name: Ion exchange and metal-ion separation
patterns.context: Separation of metal ions from aqueous solutions, involving complexing agents and cation exchange.

patterns.name: Separation in signal processing
patterns.context: Signal-processing methods such as independent component analysis are used to separate speech or other signals.

patterns.name: Immune cell separation
patterns.context: In a reference title, separation is used to describe identifying and isolating cells.

patterns.name: Statistical distribution discrimination
patterns.context: In the context of ROC curves, separation describes the degree of discrimination between two distributions.

patterns.name: Rank/separation context in team events
patterns.context: No clear occurrence of separation; the passage discusses a cycling team event and its riders, possibly just a weakly related activation appearing in the same batch as the main trigger.

patterns.name: Separation of glycated components
patterns.context: Boronate affinity gel is used to separate glycated and non-glycated components.

patterns.name: Scholarship title and name fragment
patterns.context: The passage contains a scholarship title and the phrase ethnic studies, with no clear separation-related trigger.

patterns.name: Repeated names and birth/death years
patterns.context: The encyclopedia entry lists people with the same name and dates, with no clear separation-related trigger.

patterns.name: Interactive drama modeling
patterns.context: Describes role-based games or interactive drama modeled as networks; no separation-related trigger is apparent.

4_2299.description: 主要对 separation 及其分离、区分搭配激活，涵盖膜处理、离子交换、信号、细胞、统计分布和生化分离；另有若干无明显关联的网页、百科、体育与专利片段。

patterns.name: separation词汇
patterns.context: 该词本身被强烈标记，出现在科学技术意义的分离、分类或区分中；也出现在普通语境中，需结合具体搭配判断。
patterns.domain: 科学论文、参考文献及一般文本

patterns.name: 膜分离及氧化处理
patterns.context: 膜分离作为处理过程的表述，与 anodic oxidation 等工艺并列或相邻。

patterns.name: 离子交换与金属离子分离
patterns.context: 分离水溶液中的金属离子，涉及络合剂及阳离子交换。

patterns.name: 信号处理中的分离
patterns.context: 独立成分分析等信号处理方法用于分离语音或其他信号。
patterns.domain: 信号处理、通信、神经影像

patterns.name: 免疫细胞分离
patterns.context: 参考文献标题中将 separation 用于识别、分离细胞。

patterns.name: 统计分布区分
patterns.context: ROC 曲线语境中，separation 描述两种分布的区分程度。
patterns.domain: 统计学、机器学习、生物医学

patterns.name: 团队赛事中的名次/分隔语境
patterns.context: 未见明确的 separation；段落谈自行车团队赛事及队员，可能只是与主触发词同批出现的弱相关激活。

patterns.name: 糖化组分分离
patterns.context: 硼酸亲和凝胶用于分离糖化与非糖化组分。

patterns.name: 奖学金标题及人名片段
patterns.context: 段落包含 scholarship 标题和 ethnic studies 字样，未见与 separation 相关的明显触发。

patterns.name: 重复人名与生卒年份
patterns.context: 百科条目中列出同名人物与日期，未见明显的 separation 相关触发。

patterns.name: 交互式戏剧建模
patterns.context: 描述基于角色的游戏或交互式戏剧被建模为网络；未见 separation 相关触发。

en.description: Peaks fall on various unrelated tokens: the code parameter sender, English words, name fragments, and negative numeric code literals. There is no stable common trigger across styles, semantics, or syntax, so the singleton patterns cannot be reliably generalized.

patterns.name: The string sender
patterns.context: Appears as a parameter in a code callback signature or in natural-language email narration to refer to the person who sent an email; the two uses have different meanings.

patterns.name: Highly activated English word fragments
patterns.context: Ordinary English words in different syntactic positions; some introduce technical terms, while others occur in informal or email text, with no stable semantic or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Unusual word fragments or identifiers
patterns.context: Appear respectively in a product name, a failure description, a scientific name, and code test data; their trigger positions and meanings are inconsistent.

4_2299.description: 峰值落在多种不相干 token 上：代码参数 sender、英语词、名称片段及负数代码字面量。跨文体、语义和句法均无稳定共同触发条件，单例模式无法可靠归纳。

patterns.name: sender 字样
patterns.context: 出现在代码回调签名的参数中，或自然语言邮件叙述中指发送邮件的人；两处语义不同。

patterns.name: 高强度英语词片段
patterns.context: 不同句法位置中的普通英语词；部分是术语介绍，部分是口语或邮件文本，未见稳定的语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 特殊词片段或标识符
patterns.context: 分别出现在产品名称、故障描述、学名和代码测试数据中；触发位置及含义不一致。
patterns.domain: 论坛、问答、百科、代码测试

en.concept: Responses to words and structural fragments across contexts
en.description: The most prominent clue is “greeted” across several contexts; there are also localized responses to code structures, legal terminology, medical/scientific paper openings, and materials-chemistry vocabulary. Overall, the examples span styles and lack a unified trigger feature.

patterns.name: greeted and its object
patterns.context: In narration or reporting, describes a person or reaction that “greeted” someone or something; no fixed subject or object is required.
patterns.domain: Fiction, news reports, music reviews, fitness advice

patterns.name: Structured code and punctuation
patterns.context: Near indentation, brackets, delimiters, and parameters/file names in code; especially concentrated in passage 4, with a code context also in passage 10.

patterns.name: Legal standard of proof
patterns.context: Describes evidentiary standards, findings of fact, and allegations in legal texts.

patterns.name: Opening of a medical topic
patterns.context: A medical paper introduction begins with a disease or research topic; this example is “ Iron deficiency anemia”.

patterns.name: Achievements and technological advances
patterns.context: A scholarly introduction evaluates scientific and technological achievements and transitions to methods or developments.

patterns.name: Materials-chemistry terminology
patterns.context: Discusses the photochromic effect of Ge-rich chalcogenide glass and its mechanism.

4_2299.concept: 多语境词与结构片段响应
4_2299.description: 最显著线索是多种语境中的“greeted”；另对代码结构、法律术语、医学/科技论文开篇及材料化学词汇有局部响应，整体跨文体且缺少统一触发特征。

patterns.name: greeted 及其受事
patterns.context: 在叙事或报道中，描述某人/某种反应“greeted”某人或事物；不要求固定主语或受事。
patterns.domain: 小说叙事、新闻报道、音乐评论、健身建议

patterns.name: 结构化代码与标点
patterns.context: 代码中的缩进、括号、分隔符和参数/文件名附近；第4段尤为集中，第10段也有代码语境。

patterns.name: 法律证明标准
patterns.context: 法律文本中描述证据标准、事实认定与指控。

patterns.name: 医学主题开篇
patterns.context: 医学论文引言中以疾病或研究主题起句；本例为“ Iron deficiency anemia”。

patterns.name: 成就与科技进展
patterns.context: 学术引言中评价科学技术成就，并衔接方法或发展。

patterns.name: 材料化学术语
patterns.context: 讨论富锗硫族玻璃的光致变色效应及其机制。

en.description: Activations occur in code identifiers, comments, and formatting boundaries, as well as numbered/field lists, title proper names, academic terminology, email evaluations, and quoted narration; there is no stable single meaning or syntactic trigger.

patterns.name: Identifiers and code structure
patterns.context: Variables, fields, type names, or comments in code; activation often falls within identifiers or around names, and code indentation and line breaks are also frequently marked.

patterns.name: Delimiters and formatted lists
patterns.context: Line breaks, indentation, colons, commas, and other structural boundaries occur in numbered results, table/list-style titles, or field lists.
patterns.domain: Code, Q&A text, title lists, and query results

patterns.name: Descriptive comments and explanatory text
patterns.context: Comments or ordinary explanatory sentences describe behavior, conditions, or results; trigger positions are scattered across content words and phrases.
patterns.domain: Code comments, email, technical and general narration

patterns.name: Names, titles, and proper-name strings
patterns.context: Proper names, titles, or personal names appear in continuous name-like text; activation may fall on a title word or an adjacent descriptive word.

patterns.name: Field names and category labels
patterns.context: Groups of listed field or category names, usually in query groupings or output-column lists.
patterns.domain: Queries or data-organization text on StackExchange

patterns.name: Numbers and numeric extraction
patterns.context: A string of digits appears with an explanation of how to extract its value, near result formatting or an example.

patterns.name: Terminology and academic abstract phrasing
patterns.context: Formal terminology concerning the causes and mechanisms of a phenomenon in a materials-science abstract.

patterns.name: Comments and evaluative language
patterns.context: Brief review-style feedback that begins with a positive assessment and then introduces suggestions.

patterns.name: Political narration in quotations
patterns.context: Reports or historical narration quoting another person’s attitudes, reactions, and evaluations.

4_2299.concept: 结构化文本中的显著片段
4_2299.description: 激活分布于代码标识符、注释和格式边界，也见于编号/字段清单、标题专名、学术术语、邮件评价及引语叙述；未见稳定单一词义或句法触发条件。

patterns.name: 标识符与代码结构
patterns.context: 代码中的变量、字段、类型名或注释；激活常落在标识符内部或名称周围，代码缩进与换行也常被标记。

patterns.name: 分隔符与格式化列表
patterns.context: 换行、缩进、冒号、逗号等结构边界出现在编号结果、表格/列表式标题或字段清单中。
patterns.domain: 代码、问答文本、标题列表及查询结果

patterns.name: 描述性注释与说明文字
patterns.trigger: «Boolean to hide built-in help command»、«If we got a falsey value back»、«will integration the options»
patterns.context: 以注释或普通说明句解释行为、条件、结果；触发位置分散在内容词和短语上。
patterns.domain: 代码注释、邮件及技术/普通叙述

patterns.name: 名称、标题及专名串
patterns.context: 专名、标题或人名出现在连续的名称性文本中；激活可能落在标题词或相邻描述词上。
patterns.domain: 电影标题列表、新闻/历史叙述

patterns.name: 字段名与分类标签
patterns.context: 成组列出的字段或类别名称，通常处于查询分组/输出列清单中。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 中的查询或数据整理文本

patterns.name: 数字与数值提取
patterns.context: 数字串与提取其数值的说明共同出现，附近有结果格式或示例。

patterns.name: 术语与学术摘要表达
patterns.context: 材料科学摘要中，围绕现象成因与机制的正式术语表达。

patterns.name: 评论与评价语
patterns.context: 简短的评审式反馈，先给正面评价再引出意见。

patterns.name: 引语中的政治叙述
patterns.context: 报道或历史叙述中引用他人态度、反应及评价。

en.description: Responses are scattered: Open, Use in code comments, divided in math problems, date slashes, and Private in a title all trigger locally; the other highlights span code, legal, and list text and are difficult to assign to a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Open identifier
patterns.context: The capitalization variant Open appears in license phrases, game/forum effect names, and compound identifiers; it is not necessarily a standalone word.

patterns.name: -ing suffix
patterns.context: Appears in the mathematical term “p-summing,” with activation on the final ing.

patterns.name: Division arithmetic question
patterns.context: In elementary math problems phrased as “number divided by number,” involving negative numbers or general division calculations.

patterns.name: Slash in dates
patterns.context: A slash separates month, day, and year in a court-record date field.

patterns.name: The number 10
patterns.context: Used as a divisor in an arithmetic problem or as part of a case number; the contexts differ.

patterns.name: Private in a title
patterns.context: Appears in the movie-list entry title “Private Affairs,” followed by Affairs and a year.

patterns.name: Use in code comments
patterns.context: Code comments begin with “Use …” to give an alternative or operational suggestion; the same trigger appears multiple times.

patterns.name: Unexplained code and documentation patterns
patterns.context: Involves comment markers, documentation tags, code identifiers, or formatting, but activation does not consistently fall on these common markers and cannot be explained by a single clear trigger.

patterns.name: Other unexplained highlights
patterns.context: Occur in localized contexts such as game configuration, legal tables, and movie titles, with no reliable shared trigger pattern.

4_2299.description: 响应分散：Open、代码注释里的 Use、数学题中的 divided、日期斜线及 Private 标题等均有局部触发；其余高亮跨代码、法律和列表文本，难归为单一语义模式。

patterns.name: Open 标识符
patterns.context: 大小写形式 Open 出现在许可证短语、游戏/论坛效果名及复合标识符中；未必是独立单词。

patterns.name: 动名词后缀 -ing
patterns.context: 出现在数学术语“p-summing”中，激活落在词尾 ing。

patterns.name: 除法算术问句
patterns.context: 在小学数学题的“数 divided by 数”表达中，涉及负数或一般除法计算。

patterns.name: 日期中的斜线
patterns.context: 斜线分隔月、日、年，位于法院档案日期字段中。

patterns.name: 数字 10
patterns.context: 作为算术题中的除数，或案号数字的一部分；上下文并不相同。

patterns.name: 标题中的 Private
patterns.context: 出现在电影条目标题“Private Affairs”中，后接 Affairs 和年份。

patterns.name: 代码注释中的 Use
patterns.context: 代码注释以“Use …”给出替代方案或操作建议；多处出现相同触发词。

patterns.name: 未解释的代码与文档模式
patterns.context: 涉及注释标记、文档标签、代码标识符或格式化，但激活未稳定落在这些常见标记上，且无法由同一明确触发项解释。

patterns.name: 未解释的其余高亮
patterns.context: 分别处于游戏配置、法律表格和电影标题等局部语境，未见共享的可靠触发模式。
patterns.domain: 代码、法律文书、列表文本

en.concept: Software execution and related word forms
en.description: Primarily responds to executed/execute in software contexts involving running programs or tasks; there are also sporadic activations on fragments of decompression terms, Python threading identifiers, cited surnames, and moving in the context of version migration.

patterns.name: Endings of execution-related words
patterns.context: Describes running or executing programs, commands, queries, test cases, etc.; activation is mainly on executed and occurs across different corpus types.
patterns.domain: Software engineering, programming Q&A, patent technical text

patterns.name: Fragment within a compression-related word
patterns.context: Appears in tokenized fragments of words such as decompressed and decompressing, in discussions of decompressing programs or instructions and when to execute them.

patterns.name: Thread fragment in a Python identifier
patterns.context: Occurs in Python modules or class names such as threading.Event and threading.RLock; activation falls on the tokenized fragment threading.

patterns.name: Surname fragments in patent citations
patterns.context: Appears in tokenized parts of the author surnames Wiessmuller and Wittinghofer, surrounded by journal citation formatting and years.
patterns.domain: Academic citations in patent background technology

patterns.name: Version-control migration terminology
patterns.context: A team describes moving from Visual SourceSafe to Subversion; this activation does not fall on the main execution-related words.

4_2299.description: 主要响应软件语境中执行、运行程序或任务的 executed/execute；另对解压词片段、Python threading 标识符、引文姓氏片段及版本迁移中的 moving 有零星激活。

patterns.name: 执行相关词的词尾
patterns.context: 与程序、命令、查询、测试用例等作主语或宾语，描述运行或执行；主要激活在 executed，且不同语料类型均出现。
patterns.domain: 软件工程、编程问答、专利技术文本

patterns.name: 压缩词内部片段
patterns.context: 出现在 decompressed、decompressing 等词被切分后的片段中，讨论程序或指令的解压及其执行时机。

patterns.name: Python 标识符中的线程片段
patterns.context: 处于 threading.Event、threading.RLock 等 Python 模块或类名中；激活落在被切分的 threading。

patterns.name: 专利引文中的姓氏片段
patterns.context: 出现在作者姓氏 Wiessmuller、Wittinghofer 的切分部分，周围是期刊引用格式与年份。
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术中的学术引文

patterns.name: 版本控制迁移用语
patterns.context: 团队说明从 Visual SourceSafe 转向 Subversion；该激活未落在主要的执行词上。

en.description: Activation mainly falls on -ing endings, Development, code structure, and program- or computing-related words such as storage/calculation; several other one-off sporadic activations are difficult to assign to a stable pattern.

patterns.name: -ing suffix activation
patterns.context: Activation falls on a subword at the end of an -ing word; the first two examples are Programming, and another is threading.

patterns.name: Development and its collocations
patterns.context: The complete word Development occurs in project planning or descriptions of institutional roles.

patterns.name: Code structure phrase
patterns.context: The phrase code structure appears in contexts discussing code organization or showing program implementation.

patterns.name: Program- and storage-related words
patterns.context: Computer-, program-, or data-processing-related descriptions; the examples concern program storage in a contract and path calculation in memory.

patterns.name: Unresolved sporadic activations
patterns.context: Each occurs in only one passage, with no consistent morphological, semantic, or syntactic environment; they should not be grouped with the repeated patterns above.
patterns.domain: Forums, encyclopedias, patents, and other styles

4_2299.description: 主要激活落在 -ing 词尾、Development、code structure，以及 storage/calculation 等程序或计算相关词；另有若干单次零散激活，难归为稳定模式。

patterns.name: -ing 词尾激活
patterns.context: 激活落在以 -ing 结尾的词内部子词上；前两例为 Programming，另一例为 threading。
patterns.domain: 论坛文本、百科条目、代码

patterns.name: Development 及其搭配
patterns.context: 完整单词 Development，在项目规划或机构职务描述中出现。
patterns.domain: 法律文本、百科人物介绍

patterns.name: 代码结构短语
patterns.trigger: «structure»9（[6]「The code structure will be exactly the same」；[9]「The code structure goes as follows」）
patterns.context: 短语 code structure，出现在讨论代码组织或展示程序实现的上下文。

patterns.name: 程序与存储相关词
patterns.context: 计算机、程序或数据处理相关表述；分别涉及合同中的程序存储和存储器中的路径计算。

patterns.name: 未解析的零散激活
patterns.context: 各自仅在单段出现，未见一致的词形、语义或句法环境；不应并入上述重复模式。
patterns.domain: 论坛、百科、专利等多种文体

en.description: The most consistent triggers are -ing suffix fragments in several English words: operating, executing, sentencing, logging, and resulting, across legal, encyclopedia, and technical contexts; other sporadic weak markers cannot be explained in a unified way.

patterns.name: Tokenized operating
patterns.context: Capitalization varies; the trigger substring spans the word-initial fragment and suffix. It appears in the legal phrase “operating under a charter,” the hospital-list title “Operating,” and the technical phrase “operating systems.”

patterns.name: Tokenized executing
patterns.context: “Executing” activates when describing carrying out a development plan or implementing an investment strategy; the word-initial fragment is sometimes marked as well.

patterns.name: Tokenized sentencing
patterns.context: In criminal proceedings, the suffix “encing” strongly activates when sentencing is mentioned; it is associated with procedural contexts involving error review and preserved disputes.

patterns.name: Tokenized logging
patterns.context: The English word logging in an XML dependency comment strongly activates on the final fragment.

patterns.name: Tokenized resulting
patterns.context: When introducing a result in a code example, the suffix “ing” strongly activates, while the word-initial fragment is weaker.

patterns.name: -ing endings in execution/run-related contexts
patterns.context: English verb -ing suffix fragments repeatedly activate strongly across multiple domains, but not all -ing words or semantically similar examples appear; therefore, all examples should not be treated as a single pattern.
patterns.domain: Legal, encyclopedia, software, and technical text

patterns.name: Other sporadic activations
patterns.context: Low-intensity markers scattered across passages, with no repeatable, clear shared trigger condition.

4_2299.description: 最稳定的触发是若干英语词的 -ing 后缀片段：operating、executing、sentencing、logging、resulting，分布于法律、百科及技术语境；另有零散弱标记，无法统一解释。

patterns.name: 被切分的 operating
patterns.context: 大小写不一，触发子串跨词首片段与后缀；出现在法律条文中的“operating under a charter”、医院列表标题“Operating”、技术文本“operating systems”。
patterns.domain: 法律、百科列表、技术讨论

patterns.name: 被切分的 executing
patterns.context: “executing”描述执行发展计划或实施投资策略时激活；词首片段有时也标记。
patterns.domain: 百科政务说明、法律叙述

patterns.name: 被切分的 sentencing
patterns.context: 在刑事程序中提及量刑时，后缀“encing”强激活；与错误审查、保留争议等程序语境相连。

patterns.name: 被切分的 logging
patterns.context: XML 依赖项注释中的英文词 logging，强激活集中在词尾片段。

patterns.name: 被切分的 resulting
patterns.context: 代码示例引出结果时，后缀“ing”强激活，词首片段较弱。

patterns.name: 执行/运行相关的 ing 词尾
patterns.trigger: “cre«ated»4”“ran« it»9”并非同一切分；较明确的形式为“exec«uting»9”“oper«ating»9/10”“Log«ging»9”“Result«ing»9”
patterns.context: 多个领域中，英语动词的 -ing 词尾片段反复强激活，但并非所有 -ing 词或同类语义都出现；不能由此把所有样例归为单一模式。
patterns.domain: 法律、百科、软件与技术文本

patterns.name: 其他零散激活
patterns.context: 分散于各段的低强度标记，未显示可重复、明确的共同触发条件。

en.description: Responds most strongly to the in-word suffix fragment ating in operating; it also responds more weakly to several word-final or in-word fragments (ed, ored, ining, aced, and ancing). Sporadic activations in code, publishing, institutional, and web text are difficult to assign to a unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Tokenized fragments of operating
patterns.context: The fragments cross an in-word boundary to form operating; the word appears in contexts involving hospitals, law, operating systems, and paper citations. Activation focuses on ating.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, law, technical discussions, academic papers

patterns.name: Common suffixes in spelling or grammar markers
patterns.context: Activation falls on suffixes or stem fragments within English words; neighboring words may belong to different contexts, such as publishing notes, code comments, or explanations of regular expressions.
patterns.domain: Book copyright pages, code and technical text

patterns.name: Word ending in an administrative agency name
patterns.context: In the full name of the U.S. agency “Health Care Financing Administration,” activation falls on the ending of Financing.
patterns.domain: Public health and administrative agency abstracts

patterns.name: Web-rendered text with no clear shared trigger
patterns.context: Activation is scattered across ordinary words in Q&A about HTML page rendering, with no stable in-word fragment or semantic pattern.

4_2299.description: 主要对 operating 的词内后缀片段 ating 强烈响应；另对若干词尾或词内片段（ed、ored、ining、aced、ancing）有较弱响应。代码、出版、机构及网页文本中的零散激活难以归为统一语义模式。

patterns.name: operating 的拆分词片段
patterns.trigger: «Oper»...«ating»，以及 «oper»...«ating»...；主要是 Oper/oper 后接 ating
patterns.context: 片段跨越词内边界，形成 operating；在 hospitals、law、operating systems、论文引文等语境中出现。激活重点落在 ating。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、法律、技术讨论、学术论文

patterns.name: 拼写或语法标记中的常见后缀
patterns.context: 激活落在英文词内部的后缀或词干片段；相邻词可属于出版说明、代码注释、正则表达式说明等不同场景。
patterns.domain: 书籍版权页、代码与技术文本

patterns.name: 行政机构名称中的词尾
patterns.context: 在美国卫生机构全称“Health Care Financing Administration”中，激活落在 Financing 的词尾。
patterns.domain: 公共卫生与行政机构摘要

patterns.name: 无明确共同触发的网页渲染文本
patterns.context: 激活分散在 HTML 页面渲染相关问答中的普通词，未显示稳定的词内片段或语义模式。

en.concept: English inflectional suffixes and intra-word boundaries
en.description: Activations fall mainly on morphological boundaries within English words: Call-ing, List-ing/ed, Oper-ating; they also occur in the scale name State-Trait Inventory. Trigger words come from different contexts, with no consistent thematic semantics.

patterns.name: “Calling” inflection
patterns.context: “Call” combines with the suffix “ing” to form a gerund or noun; it is sometimes followed by an object or prepositional phrase.
patterns.domain: StackExchange questions, health product descriptions, book indexes

patterns.name: Listing inflection
patterns.context: The root List is followed by -ing or -ed; it occurs in proper names, catalogs, or list-related sentences.

patterns.name: Operating inflection
patterns.context: Oper is followed by -ating as a subheading in a list.

patterns.name: Inventory in a statistical scale name
patterns.context: Occurs in the full names Beck and IDATE State-Trait Inventory of psychological scales.

4_2299.concept: 英语词形后缀与词内边界
4_2299.description: 激活主要落在英语词形内部的形态边界：Call-ing、List-ing/ed、Oper-ating；另涉及量表名称中的 State-Trait Inventory。触发词分属不同语境，未见一致的主题语义。

patterns.name: “Calling”词形
patterns.context: “Call”与后缀“ing”组合成动名词或名词；有时后接宾语或介词短语。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 问题、健康产品论述、书籍索引

patterns.name: Listing 词形
patterns.context: 词根 List 后接 -ing 或 -ed；出现在专名、目录或清单相关语句中。
patterns.domain: 维基百科说明、文档、历史条目

patterns.name: Operating 词形
patterns.context: Oper 后接 -ating，作为清单中的小标题。

patterns.name: 统计量表名称中的 Inventory
patterns.context: 出现在心理量表全名 Beck and IDATE 的 State-Trait Inventory 中。

en.description: The most consistent signal is the ed fragment, especially in words such as Listed and Printed; it also commonly appears in catalogs, classifications, and lists. Other examples include listing, printing and publishing, dentistry, email phrasing, legal headings, and several numbers or subword fragments, without forming a unified pattern.

patterns.name: ed at word endings or within words
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on the string ed, appearing in past participles, adjectives, or list-entry headings; it often coincides with the endings of words such as Listed and Printed.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, catalogs, historical texts, publication information, etc.

patterns.name: Listed catalog entries
patterns.context: Occurs in classification catalogs, lists, explanatory headings, or real-estate records; activation falls at different positions in the stem or ending.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia categories, email notices, professional descriptions, real-estate records

patterns.name: Publishing and printing terminology
patterns.context: Occurs in bibliographic or copyright information about book publishers, printing, and places of publication.
patterns.domain: End pages of Gutenberg books, publication information

patterns.name: dentistry in organization names
patterns.context: Occurs in government department names and research funding information, with activation split within dentistry.

patterns.name: Special category headings and formatting markers
patterns.context: Punctuation, line breaks, and category numbers also activate in category lists at the ends of Wikipedia entries; these are not necessarily explained by the ed ending.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia category markers and page formatting

patterns.name: Collaborative phrasing in business email
patterns.context: Activates in email body text describing teamwork, mutual support, and assistant coverage arrangements; it is adjacent to listed-related contexts but is not the same inflection.

patterns.name: Objecting creditor in legal documents
patterns.context: Appears in bankruptcy case titles, describing creditors who filed objections.

patterns.name: Several independent subword fragments
patterns.context: Occur respectively in category numbers, real-estate record statuses, letter closings, and novel titles; no clear shared context.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, real-estate records, historical letters, bibliographies

4_2299.description: 最一致的信号是 ed 词段，尤其是 Listed、Printed 等词中；也常见于目录、分类和清单。另有 listing、印刷出版、dentistry、邮件措辞、法律标题及若干数字或词片段，未形成统一模式。

patterns.name: 词尾或词内的 ed
patterns.context: 激活集中在 ed 字符串上，出现在过去分词、形容词或列目标题中；常与 Listed、Printed 等词的词尾重合。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、目录、历史文本、出版信息等

patterns.name: Listed 目录条目
patterns.context: 出现在分类目录、清单、说明标题或房产记录中；激活落在词干或词尾不同位置。
patterns.domain: 百科分类、邮件通知、专业论述、房产记录

patterns.name: 出版与印刷用语
patterns.context: 出现在书籍出版者、印刷及出版地等书目或版权信息中。
patterns.domain: Gutenberg 书籍末页、出版信息

patterns.name: 机构名称中的 dentistry
patterns.context: 出现在政府部门名称及研究资助信息中，激活拆分在 dentistry 的词内。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要、公共卫生研究

patterns.name: 特殊类别标题与格式标记
patterns.trigger: 反复出现的 “Category«:»”“«↵»”及数字片段
patterns.context: 维基百科条目末尾的分类列表中，标点、换行和分类编号也有激活；未必由 ed 词尾解释。
patterns.domain: 百科分类标记与页面格式

patterns.name: 商务邮件中的协作措辞
patterns.context: 在说明团队协作、相互支持及助理替补安排的邮件正文中激活；与 listed 清单语境相邻，但不是同一词形。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的异议债权人
patterns.context: 出现在破产案件标题中，描述提出异议的债权人。

patterns.name: 若干独立词片段
patterns.context: 分别见分类编号、房产记录状态、书信套语和小说书名；没有明确共同上下文。
patterns.domain: 百科、房产记录、历史书信、书目

en.description: Activations often fall on -ing and -ed endings, especially in calling, listed, charged, tried, and similar words; they also occur in line breaks in legal texts and fragments within names in case opinions. Earlier examples contain calling, but activation positions vary; semantics and genres span a wide range.

patterns.name: -ing in calling constructions
patterns.context: When used with Call(s), activation falls mainly on the ing ending of calling; there is also one instance of “query«ing»”.
patterns.domain: HackerNews comments, health product descriptions; one example also in a technical context

patterns.name: ing ending in a proper name
patterns.context: An internal suffix; the full word appears to be “contributing”, surrounded by email text about team responsibilities and supporting colleagues.

patterns.name: ed ending in list labels
patterns.context: Occurs in lists or item descriptions, with activation on the -ed ending of Listed.

patterns.name: Litigation verbs in legal documents
patterns.context: In criminal case narratives or court instructions, activation falls on the endings of charged, tried, convicted, and charging.

patterns.name: Letter fragments in legal names
patterns.context: Activation is embedded within uppercase names or spelling variants and does not correspond to an ordinary semantic affix.

patterns.name: Line-break markers in legal texts
patterns.context: The line break itself is marked, near the body text or signature formatting of an opinion.

patterns.name: ed ending in BMX event titles
patterns.context: Event titles listed after a heading in a profile; similar to ordinary list usage but occurring in an athlete career entry.

patterns.name: Hard-to-classify ed endings
patterns.context: Past participles in narratives of arrest, trial, and conviction, overlapping with the legal litigation-verb pattern.

4_2299.description: 激活常落在 -ing、-ed 词尾，尤其是 calling、listed、charged、tried 等；也见于法律文本换行及判决姓名内部片段。前几段虽含 calling，触发位置不尽一致，语义和文体跨度大。

patterns.name: calling 结构中的 -ing
patterns.context: 与 Call(s) 连用时，激活主要落在 calling 的词尾 ing；另有“query«ing»”这一处。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 评论、健康产品介绍；技术语境中也有一例

patterns.name: 专名词尾 ing
patterns.context: 词内后缀，完整词似为“contributing”，周围是团队职责和支持同事的邮件内容。

patterns.name: 列举标签词尾 ed
patterns.context: 出现在名单或条目说明中，激活落在 Listed 的 -ed 词尾。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 运动员履历、商务邮件

patterns.name: 法律文书中的诉讼动词
patterns.context: 刑事案件叙述或法院指示中，激活落在 charged、tried、convicted、charging 的词尾。

patterns.name: 法律姓名中的字母片段
patterns.context: 激活嵌在大写或拼写变体的姓名内部，不对应普通语义词缀。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的换行标记
patterns.context: 换行符本身被标记，出现在判决正文或署名排版附近。

patterns.name: BMX 赛事名称词尾 ed
patterns.context: 履历中标题后列出的赛事头衔；与普通名单用法相似，但出现在运动员生涯条目。

patterns.name: 难以归类的词尾 ed
patterns.trigger: “charg«ed»8”之外的片段：无；本段主要高亮“«charged»”相关词形
patterns.context: 逮捕、审判和定罪叙述中的过去分词，与法律诉讼动词模式重合。

en.concept: Procedural and record-related terms in documents
en.description: Activations occur mainly on procedural or adjudicative terms in legal documents and on data-collection phrasing involving “collection” in research texts; two other examples fall on participial endings in different contexts and are difficult to unify with the main pattern.

patterns.name: Data collection
patterns.context: In research, project, or trial contexts, describes designing, conducting, or analyzing data, or related tools and processes.

patterns.name: Legal adjudication/procedure terminology
patterns.context: Occurs in legal texts such as court opinions, case titles, or orders; trigger words appear in different descriptions of litigation procedures, rulings, or documents.

patterns.name: Word endings in participles
patterns.context: Activation falls on part of a word split across tokens; the surrounding contexts are respectively a technical forum discussion and a news/encyclopedia narrative, with no shared semantic condition.

4_2299.concept: 文书中的流程与记录用词
4_2299.description: 激活主要落在法律文书中的程序或裁判用词，以及研究文本中“collection”数据收集表述；另有两处落在分词词尾，语境不同，难以与主模式统一。

patterns.name: 资料收集
patterns.context: 研究、项目或试验语境中，描述设计、实施、分析数据或相关工具与流程。

patterns.name: 法律裁判／程序用语
patterns.context: 出现在法院意见、案件标题或命令等法律文本中，触发词分布在不同诉讼程序、裁判或文书表述里。

patterns.name: 分词中的词尾
patterns.trigger: «Call»«ing»（第5段中的 Calling）；«cha»«ired»（第6段中的 chaired）
patterns.context: 激活落在跨 token 切分的词的一部分，周围分别是技术论坛讨论和新闻／百科叙述；未见共同语义条件。

en.description: Activations are distributed across tried, adjudicative phrasing, and procedural headings in legal documents; catalog/category headings in encyclopedia entries; and chaired describing research or institutional leadership in two instances. The pattern combines specific word forms and document structure and cannot be reduced to a single semantic category.

patterns.name: Trial and adjudication procedures in legal opinions
patterns.context: In court case narratives, describes a defendant being tried or convicted, or the trial procedure; activation falls on tried.

patterns.name: Conclusive expressions in legal rulings
patterns.context: When a court discusses a claim, damages, and whether to overturn summary judgment, activation falls on relates.

patterns.name: Disciplinary proceeding heading
patterns.context: The legal document title includes Original Proceeding in Discipline; activation concentrates on a terminal fragment of proceeding written as multiple pieces.

patterns.name: Insurance exemption proceeding heading
patterns.context: The title of a legal document concerning bankruptcy or debtor exemptions; activation concentrates on a fragment of proceedings split across tokens.

patterns.name: Book and series catalog headings
patterns.context: The text transitions to a catalog headed Titles, followed by publications or editions.

patterns.name: Category and album-entry labels
patterns.context: At the end of an entry, a Category label lists music album categories, years, record labels, or producers.

patterns.name: Clinical research project description
patterns.context: When describing an intervention study involving women at high hereditary risk of ovarian cancer, chair(ed) describes the study project lead.

patterns.name: Position description in a biographical entry
patterns.context: A biography states that Alan Greenspan chaired or led the Federal Reserve and describes his tenure.

4_2299.description: 激活分布于法律文书中的 tried、裁判表述及程序标题，也见百科条目的目录/分类标题，以及两处描述研究或机构负责人职务的 chaired。模式兼含特定词形与文档结构，无法归为单一语义。

patterns.name: 法律判决中的审理、裁判程序
patterns.trigger: « tried»10« and»3« convicted»4« in»2« the»3 District Court；« tried»10« on»4« May
patterns.context: 法院案件叙述中，描述被告受审、定罪或案件审理程序；激活落在 tried 上。

patterns.name: 法律裁判的结论性表达
patterns.context: 法院讨论某项索赔、损害赔偿及是否推翻简易判决时，激活落在 relates。

patterns.name: 纪律处分程序标题
patterns.context: 法律文件标题中出现 Original Proceeding in Discipline；激活集中在被拆分书写的 proceeding 词尾片段。
patterns.domain: 律师纪律处分法律文件

patterns.name: 保险豁免程序标题
patterns.trigger: DEBTORS' CLAIM OF EXEMPTION IN PROC«E»1«ED»10«S»4 OF INSUR… SETT…LE
patterns.context: 破产或债务人豁免相关法律文书的标题；激活集中在被拆分的 proceedings 片段。

patterns.name: 书籍与系列目录标题
patterns.context: 正文后转入以 Titles 为标题的目录，接着列出出版物或版本。

patterns.name: 分类与专辑条目标签
patterns.context: 条目末尾以 Category 标签列出音乐专辑类别、年份、唱片公司或制作人。
patterns.domain: 百科全书条目／音乐分类元数据

patterns.name: 临床研究项目描述
patterns.context: 介绍卵巢癌高遗传风险女性相关干预研究时，chair(ed) 描述研究项目的负责人。

patterns.name: 人物词条中的任职描述
patterns.context: 人物简介中说明 Alan Greenspan 主持或领导美联储及其任期。

en.description: Activations are scattered across intra-word fragments, number and date fragments, code structures, common function words, and technical terms; trigger positions and semantics vary across domains, with no single stable condition.

patterns.name: Intra-word insertion/continuation fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on internal word fragments, often continuing after a prefix or stem to form a complete word; examples include participles, past-tense forms, and proper names, with no fixed trigger position.
patterns.domain: Code Q&A, historical narratives, email metadata, medical texts

patterns.name: Fragments in numbers, version numbers, and dates
patterns.context: A segment of a number string, date, version number, or code value is highlighted; punctuation or letters also sometimes appear near the number.
patterns.domain: Legal documents, email headers, code and technical Q&A

patterns.name: Structural boundaries in code/templates/commands
patterns.context: Occurs in templates, scripts, comments, or shell commands, often near line breaks, delimiters, closing tags, or command options.
patterns.domain: Web templates, source code, command-line text

patterns.name: Common function words and phrase components
patterns.context: Scattered activations in ordinary English sentences, with no stable syntactic position or specialized semantics; some occur in legal statements, code comments, or explanatory Q&A.
patterns.domain: Legal texts, code and technical Q&A

patterns.name: Specific technical/documentation word fragments
patterns.context: In code comments, build commands, or database descriptions, activation falls on local portions of technical identifiers or operation words.

4_2299.description: 激活散布于词内片段、数字与日期片段，以及代码结构、常见功能词和技术词中；触发位置和语义跨领域变化，未形成单一稳定条件。

patterns.name: 词内部的插入/续接片段
patterns.context: 激活落在词的内部片段上，常见于前缀或词干之后继续构成完整词；包括分词、过去式、专名等，触发位置并不固定。
patterns.domain: 代码问答、历史叙述、邮件元数据、医学文本

patterns.name: 数字、版本号与日期中的片段
patterns.context: 数字串、日期、版本号或代码数值中的一段被突出；有些数字附近同时出现标点或字母。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、邮件头、代码与技术问答

patterns.name: 代码／模板／命令中的结构性边界
patterns.context: 出现在模板、脚本、注释或 shell 命令中，常靠近换行、分隔符、结束标签或命令选项。
patterns.domain: 网页模板、源代码、命令行文本

patterns.name: 常见功能词及短语成分
patterns.context: 普通英文语句中零散激活，未见稳定的句法位置或专属语义；部分位于法律陈述、代码注释或问答解释中。
patterns.domain: 法律文本、代码与技术问答

patterns.name: 特定技术／文档词片段
patterns.context: 代码注释、构建命令或数据库说明中，激活落在技术标识符或操作词的局部。
patterns.domain: 软件开发与数据库问答

en.concept: Mixed word fragments and closing expressions
en.description: Activations are scattered across code, R output, email, and narrative text; the most prominent phrase is “close out”, alongside many code word fragments and common function words. No unified semantic trigger condition covers all examples.

patterns.name: Ending, wrapping up, or closing
patterns.context: close/out means wrapping up a matter, career, or file operation; the phrase “close out” also appears, and the trigger is not limited to code.

patterns.name: Word endings and subword fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on whole words or intra-word fragments created by tokenization; they occur in different contexts, with no unified semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Software discussions, code and data analysis texts

patterns.name: Code changes, conventions, and testing
patterns.context: Discusses refactoring, following naming conventions, cross-posting, or checking that code compiles or passes tests.
patterns.domain: Hacker News discussions, shell command comments

patterns.name: R data-frame output and errors
patterns.context: R/StackExchange Q&A showing tibble output, column counts and dimensions, or errors from tidy methods.

patterns.name: Polite email closings and requests
patterns.context: Business emails politely invite questions, report difficulty opening files, and close with a salutation.

patterns.name: Synchronization preferences in program comments
patterns.context: Java documentation comments describe handling synchronization-related preferences.

patterns.name: Template code closure and personal data description
patterns.context: A template script closing tag is adjacent to a StackExchange user's description of populating data from scope.

patterns.name: Retirement and signing narrative
patterns.context: Describes a hockey player's retirement and signing as the end of a career.

patterns.name: Code-generation documentation comments
patterns.context: Documentation comments in Smarty source code describe template compilation behavior.

4_2299.concept: 混合词片段与收尾表达
4_2299.description: 激活分散于代码、R 输出、邮件和叙事中；较突出的短语是“close out”，另有大量代码词片段及常见功能词，没有覆盖所有例子的统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 结束、收尾或关闭
patterns.trigger: «close»10 out、«close»9 out、close the file、«close»2 his career、«close» out those issues
patterns.context: close/out 表示把事项、职业生涯或文件操作收尾；也有“close out”短语，触发并不局限于代码

patterns.name: 词尾与子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在词语完整形式或 token 化后的词内片段；出现于不同语境，未见统一语义条件
patterns.domain: 软件讨论、代码与数据分析文本

patterns.name: 代码变更、规范与测试
patterns.context: 谈到重构、遵循命名规范、交叉发布或确认代码编译/测试
patterns.domain: Hacker News 讨论、shell 命令注释

patterns.name: R 数据框输出与错误
patterns.context: R/StackExchange 问答中展示 tibble 输出、列数尺寸或 tidy 方法错误

patterns.name: 邮件礼貌结尾与请求
patterns.context: 商务邮件中礼貌邀请提问、报告打开文件困难，并以致意结束

patterns.name: 程序注释中的同步偏好
patterns.context: Java 文档注释描述处理同步相关偏好设置

patterns.name: 模板代码闭合与个人数据说明
patterns.context: 模板脚本结束标签邻接 StackExchange 用户对从 scope 填充数据的描述

patterns.name: 退休与签约叙述
patterns.context: 叙述冰球运动员退役及签约结束职业生涯

patterns.name: 代码生成文档注释
patterns.context: Smarty 源码中的文档注释说明模板编译行为

en.description: Activations are scattered across compilation descriptions, naming subsections, code comments, and several email, legal, and table-format fields. Some numbers, rare word forms, and filenames also trigger; no single stable semantic pattern covers all examples.

patterns.name: compile(s) and code compilation descriptions
patterns.context: Occurs in source comments or technical discussions describing whether code, tests, or a project can compile; “compile(s)” is a prominent trigger, though the marked span varies slightly across examples.
patterns.domain: Software development, code comments, and technical Q&A

patterns.name: Naming
patterns.context: Occurs in a naming-conventions subsection heading in documentation comments, followed by convention and a separator line.

patterns.name: Number and date fields
patterns.context: Numbers occur in case-header dates, email timestamps, location numbers, or table dates and values; no single visible numeric format explains all instances.

patterns.name: plists filename
patterns.context: Occurs in Android/macOS/iOS build instructions, referring to generated or included plist files.

patterns.name: Religious suffix -tling
patterns.context: Occurs in a narrative of the Catholic canonization process, in the form “titling her as a Servant of God”; this word form is uncommon.

patterns.name: Special body symbol
patterns.context: An asterisk opens a C-style documentation comment line; the marker covers only the symbol, with nearby content describing an API/module.

patterns.name: Email field marker
patterns.context: Occurs in the cc field of an email header, followed by a colon and whitespace.

patterns.name: Other scattered formatting triggers
patterns.context: Occur respectively in a number in a historical narrative, ordinary words in technical documentation, and email fields; they lack shared local semantics or stable context and cannot be assigned a more specific pattern.

4_2299.description: 激活分散于编译说明、命名小节、代码注释及若干邮件、法律和表格格式字段。部分数字、罕见词形和文件名也触发，未见能覆盖全部例子的单一稳定语义模式。

patterns.name: compile(s)及代码编译说明
patterns.context: 出现在源码注释或技术讨论中，描述代码、测试或项目能够编译；“compile(s)”是醒目触发词，但各段标记范围略有不同。
patterns.domain: 软件开发、代码注释及技术问答

patterns.name: Naming
patterns.context: 出现在文档注释的命名约定小节标题中，后接 convention 和分隔线。

patterns.name: 数字及日期字段
patterns.context: 数字嵌在案件页眉日期、邮件时间戳、位置编号或表格日期与数值中；没有可见的单一数值格式能解释全部实例。

patterns.name: plists 文件名
patterns.context: 出现在 Android/macOS/iOS 构建说明中，指生成或附带的 plist 文件。

patterns.name: 宗教词尾 -tling
patterns.context: 出现在天主教封圣程序叙述中，形式为“titling her as a Servant of God”；该词形较少见。
patterns.domain: 百科全书、宗教人物传记

patterns.name: 特殊正文符号
patterns.context: 以星号开启 C 风格文档注释行；标记只覆盖符号，邻近内容是 API/模块说明。

patterns.name: 邮件字段标记
patterns.context: 出现在邮件头的 cc 字段，后接冒号及空白。

patterns.name: 其他零散格式触发
patterns.context: 分别出现在历史叙述中的数字、技术文档普通词语和邮件字段中，缺少共同的局部语义或稳定上下文，无法据此归为更具体模式。

en.concept: Fields and operational statements in structured technical and business texts
en.description: Primarily responds to forwarded-email headers, date and time fields, and contact fields in business email; it also covers requests, thanks, proposal feedback, printing, and event invitations in email, as well as code compilation checks and version-revision descriptions in technical Q&A.

patterns.name: Compilation/code-check context
patterns.context: Mentions ensuring a successful build or compilation result, or describes whether code compiles after changes.

patterns.name: Email forwarding and header metadata
patterns.context: Forwarded-email markers and the structured email-header information that follows, such as sender, date and time, and contact details.

patterns.name: Polite requests and email closings
patterns.context: In email body text, requests feedback, offers help, or responds, and closes with thanks.

patterns.name: Phone and contact information
patterns.context: Office/mobile numbers, fax numbers, or email addresses listed near a name.

patterns.name: Email subject and proposal review
patterns.context: The email subject identifies a revised draft or proposal, and the body requests feedback.
patterns.domain: Corporate email, project or regulatory proposal communications

patterns.name: Printing request
patterns.context: A brief email body directly requests printing, followed by thanks or forwarded information.

patterns.name: Event invitation/attendance inquiry
patterns.context: Lists the event time and place and asks whether the recipient would like to attend.

patterns.name: Version numbers and revision notes
patterns.context: Explains version updates, changes in revision numbers, and replacement of references.

patterns.name: Date/time numeric formats in email
patterns.context: Dates and times are split into numeric and punctuation tokens, often in quoted or forwarded email headers.

4_2299.concept: 结构化技术与商务文本中的字段和操作语句
4_2299.description: 主要响应商务邮件的转发头、日期时间和联系人字段，也覆盖邮件中的请求、感谢、提案意见、打印、活动邀请；另响应代码编译检查及技术问答中的版本修订说明。

patterns.name: 编译/代码检查语境
patterns.context: 提到确保构建成功、编译结果，或描述代码修改后能否编译
patterns.domain: 软件开发讨论、代码/命令行上下文

patterns.name: 邮件转发与邮件头元数据
patterns.trigger: «Forward»ed；« on» 日期、时间及 AM/PM；邮件地址、姓名或组织路径
patterns.context: 转发邮件标记及其后的发件人、日期时间、联系方式等结构化邮件头信息

patterns.name: 礼貌请求与邮件收尾
patterns.context: 邮件正文中请求反馈、提供帮助或回应，并以感谢语收尾

patterns.name: 电话与联系信息
patterns.context: 姓名附近列出办公/手机号码、传真或电子邮件地址
patterns.domain: 商务邮件签名/联系方式

patterns.name: 邮件主题及提案审阅
patterns.context: 邮件主题标明修订稿或提案，正文要求提供意见
patterns.domain: 企业邮件、项目或监管提案沟通

patterns.name: 打印请求
patterns.context: 简短邮件正文直接请求打印，随后附感谢或转发信息

patterns.name: 活动邀请/出席询问
patterns.context: 列出活动时间地点，并询问收件人希望参加与否

patterns.name: 版本号与修订说明
patterns.context: 解释版本更新、修订编号变化及参考资料替换

patterns.name: 邮件日期时间数字格式
patterns.context: 日期、时间被拆分为数字与标点 token，常出现在邮件引述或转发头中

en.description: Strongly responds to “compiles” in code contexts and also to the encyclopedia subsection heading “Titles”; it additionally responds to date/time formats in Enron forwarded-email headers and activates on “copied” in a command-line discussion. The common pattern is unclear.

patterns.name: compile/compiles code builds
patterns.context: Occurs in software code, testing, or version-change contexts, often as the predicate describing whether a build succeeds; the word activates most strongly in [1], [2], and [3].

patterns.name: Wikipedia title label
patterns.context: Serves as a heading or subsection heading in an encyclopedia entry, followed by a publication list or a description of a full title; the token is split into “T”“it”“les”.

patterns.name: Date and time in forwarded email headers
patterns.context: In forwarded Enron email metadata, dates, slashes, years, colons, and hour/minute fields are separately marked; the trigger may relate to date numbers and email-header formatting.

patterns.name: Copying command-line output
patterns.context: Discusses copying source files from a terminal; activation is on a subword of “copied”.

4_2299.description: 强烈响应代码语境中的“compiles”，也响应百科小节标题“Titles”；另对 Enron 转发邮件头中的日期时间格式有反应，并在一段命令行讨论的“copied”上激活。各模式的共同规律不明确。

patterns.name: compile/compiles 代码构建
patterns.context: 出现在软件代码、测试或版本变更的上下文中，常作为构建成功与否的谓语；[1]、[2]、[3] 中该词激活最强。

patterns.name: Wikipedia 标题标签
patterns.context: 百科条目中作为标题或小节标题，后接出版物清单或完整书名说明；token 被拆分为 “T”“it”“les”。

patterns.name: 邮件转发头中的日期时间
patterns.context: Enron 邮件的转发元数据中，日期、斜线、年份、冒号、时分等字段被分别标记；触发可能与日期数字和邮件头格式有关。

patterns.name: 复制命令行输出
patterns.context: 讨论从终端复制源文件；激活标在单词 “copied” 的子词上。

en.description: Responds strongly primarily to the indefinite article «an» before words beginning with a vowel phoneme, across many genres; occupational introductions in biographical entries are a common context. The activation on «saving» in paragraph 3 does not fit this pattern.

patterns.name: Indefinite article an
patterns.context: The article an precedes a noun or adjective phrase beginning with a vowel phoneme; the following word may begin with a vowel letter or, as in «American» and «ionic», with a vowel phoneme.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: patents, medical abstracts, encyclopedia biographies, research abstracts, and project summaries

patterns.name: Occupational descriptions in biographies
patterns.context: A biographical entry gives a person’s name and dates of birth and death or birth, then uses “was an …” or “is an …” to introduce their identity, occupation, or nationality.

patterns.name: Saving-operation context (anomalous)
patterns.context: Appears in the question title “Safeguarding against user error when saving a list of information”; there is no an in this instance, so it cannot be explained by the article pattern.

4_2317.description: 主要对元音音素开头词前的不定冠词 «an» 强烈响应，跨多种文体；人物条目中的职业介绍是其常见语境。第3段的 «saving» 激活与此模式不符。

patterns.name: 不定冠词 an
patterns.context: 冠词 an 位于以元音音素开头的名词或形容词短语之前；后续词可为元音字母开头，也可如 «American»、«ionic» 以元音音素开头。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：专利、医学摘要、百科人物传记、科研摘要及项目摘要

patterns.name: 人物传记中的职业描述
patterns.context: 人物条目先给出姓名、生卒或出生日期，随后以“was an …”或“is an …”引出身份、职业或国籍描述。

patterns.name: 保存操作语境（异常）
patterns.context: 出现在提问标题“Safeguarding against user error when saving a list of information”中；该处未标记 an，无法由冠词模式解释。

en.concept: Weak subword fragments and heterogeneous lexical responses
en.description: Activations are scattered across domains; repeatable local cues include saving, like in hyphenated compounds, and list/information-related fragments. Most others are one-off proper nouns, numbers, technical terms, or common subword fragments, with no unified semantics or context.

patterns.name: saving substring
patterns.context: The trigger appears in general English text, including a question title, technical discussion, or explanation of a religious term; surrounding semantics and syntax are inconsistent.
patterns.domain: StackExchange questions and answers, Wikipedia religious entries

patterns.name: like in compounds
patterns.context: Appears as the second part of a hyphenated compound, preceded by a protein or gene name; occurs only in specialized terminology.

patterns.name: Intra-word/boundary fragment of the indefinite article an
patterns.context: Appears as the complete article an before audio or after was; the adjacent contexts differ, suggesting a response to a common word fragment.

patterns.name: Patent material-property term
patterns.context: Modifies cross-linked polymeric material, describing its antioxidant properties.

patterns.name: update in a title
patterns.context: Appears in the title of a review of herpes simplex viruses and acyclovir resistance, followed by ten-year survey.

patterns.name: List and information words in a citation/title
patterns.context: Appears in the StackExchange title “Safeguarding against user error when saving a list of information”; the body also discusses returned lists.

patterns.name: Year numerals in biographical format
patterns.context: Appears after a name in an encyclopedia biography, in parentheses as birth and death dates; year or date fragments are marked.

patterns.name: Name and noun-phrase fragments in encyclopedia entries
patterns.context: Names appear in entry titles or dictionary-style phrases, or a Sanskrit giving-related term and its definition; activations are sporadic and show no consistent trigger.

patterns.name: Audio vocabulary in technical text
patterns.context: Audio codec, controller, and samples occur together in a patent technical description.

patterns.name: Biomedical terminology fragments
patterns.context: Appear respectively in a review title on antiviral resistance and a gene-expression abstract; apart from compound like, there is no shared salient semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Compound engineering terms
patterns.context: A genome-engineering review lists terms such as artificial chromosomes, nucleases, and TALENs; highlights span several different words.

patterns.name: extra traversal in a programming performance discussion
patterns.context: Discusses the trade-off between lazy lists, repeated traversal, and saving space; salient activations do not fall on core list terminology.

4_2317.concept: 弱词片段与异质词汇响应
4_2317.description: 激活分散于多领域；可重复的局部线索是 saving、like（连字符复合词）及列表/信息相关片段。其余多为单次专名、数字、术语或常见词片段，缺少统一语义与上下文。

patterns.name: saving 子串
patterns.context: 触发词出现在一般英文文本中；可处于疑问标题、技术讨论或宗教术语释义中，周围语义和句法不统一。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 问答、Wikipedia 宗教条目

patterns.name: like 复合词中的 like
patterns.context: 作为连字符复合词后半部分出现，前面为蛋白质或基因名称；只见于专门术语。

patterns.name: 不定冠词 an 的词内/词边界片段
patterns.context: 出现在 audio 前的完整冠词 an，或 was 后的冠词 an；相邻上下文不同，可能是常见词片段响应。
patterns.domain: 专利技术文本、百科人物传记

patterns.name: 专利材料性质词
patterns.context: 修饰 cross-linked polymeric material，描述其抗氧化性质。

patterns.name: 标题中的 update
patterns.context: 出现在 herpes simplex viruses 对 acyclovir resistance 的综述标题中，并接续 ten-year survey。

patterns.name: 引文/标题中的列表与信息词
patterns.context: 出现在 StackExchange 标题“Safeguarding against user error when saving a list of information”中；另有正文谈 returned lists。

patterns.name: 人物传记格式中的年份数字
patterns.context: 在百科人物条目的姓名后，以括号内出生、逝世日期形式出现；年份或日期片段被标记。

patterns.name: 百科姓名与名词短语片段
patterns.context: 条目标题或词条式短语中出现人名，或梵语布施术语及其释义；激活零散分布，未形成一致触发条件。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 人物条目、宗教/梵语条目

patterns.name: 技术文本中音频词汇
patterns.context: 音频 codec、controller 与 samples 同现，属于专利技术描述。

patterns.name: 生物医学领域术语片段
patterns.context: 分别出现在抗病毒耐药综述标题和基因表达摘要中；除复合词 like 外，没有共同的显著语义触发。

patterns.name: 工程术语复合词
patterns.context: 基因组工程综述中列举人工染色体、核酸酶及 TALEN 等术语；高亮涉及多个不同词。

patterns.name: 程序性能讨论中的 extra traversal
patterns.context: 讨论惰性列表、重复遍历与节省空间的取舍；显著激活未落在核心列表术语上。

en.concept: Enzyme terminology and sporadic word forms
en.description: Activations concentrate on enzyme, coenzyme, and isoenzyme term fragments in biochemical abstracts; there are also instances of passing in varied contexts, plus an isolated code identifier Bit and the descriptive form like, with no shared semantics apparent.

patterns.name: Enzyme- and coenzyme-related terminology
patterns.context: Descriptions of enzymes, isoenzymes, coenzymes, and their activity or metabolic roles; some terms are split into multiple tokens, with activations mainly on term fragments.

patterns.name: passing and transfer contexts
patterns.context: passing means transferring, carrying, or performing an operation; however, its specific meaning varies substantially across paragraphs.
patterns.domain: Medical experiment descriptions, programming questions and documentation

patterns.name: The letter sequence “Bit” in a technical name
patterns.context: Appears as part of a method name in code; it may be triggered by a specific identifier, with only one instance.

patterns.name: “like” in a medical term
patterns.context: Describes an animal with rodent-like incisors; occurs once, and its relation to other activation patterns is unclear.

4_2317.description: 激活集中在生化摘要中的酶、辅酶及同工酶术语片段；另有多种语境中的 passing，以及孤立的代码标识符 Bit 和形态描述 like，未显示共同语义。

patterns.name: 酶与辅酶相关术语
patterns.context: 围绕酶、同工酶、辅酶及其活性或代谢作用的描述；部分术语被拆分成多个 token，激活主要落在术语片段上。
patterns.domain: 生物化学、医学与生命科学摘要

patterns.name: passing 及传递语境
patterns.context: 出现 passing，表示传递、携带或执行某项操作；但不同段落的具体含义差异很大。
patterns.domain: 医学实验描述与编程问答、文档

patterns.name: 技术名词中的字母组合“Bit”
patterns.context: 代码中作为方法名的一部分出现，可能是特定标识符触发，语境仅此一例。

patterns.name: 医学术语中的“like”
patterns.context: 形容动物具有类似啮齿类的门齿；单次出现，和其他激活模式的关系不明。

en.description: The most prominent trigger shared by all snippets is the indefinite article «an»; it is followed by an occupation, physical object, product slogan, graph structure, compound, programming data type, or academic question. Genres and topics vary, with no reliable domain restriction.

patterns.name: Complement following an
patterns.context: Activations consistently occur after the English indefinite article an; the following noun or adjective phrase varies with context, including “English songwriter”, “alternating external bias”, “all-new Avatar”, “embedded graph”, “edge”, “array pointer”, “ions”, “eigenvalue problem”, and “interference alignment problem”.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain English text, especially abstracts and expository writing

4_2317.description: 所有片段共同且最突出的触发点都是不定冠词 «an»；其后接人物职业、物理对象、产品宣传语、图结构、化合物、程序数据类型或各类学术问题。文体与主题多样，未见可靠的领域限定。

patterns.name: an 后接不定冠词补语
patterns.context: 激活集中稳定出现在英文不定冠词 an 之后；后续名词或形容词短语因上下文而异，包括“English songwriter”“alternating external bias”“all-new Avatar”“embedded graph”“edge”“array pointer”“ions”“eigenvalue problem”“interference alignment problem”。
patterns.domain: 跨领域英文文本，尤以摘要和说明文为主

en.concept: Local English word forms and formatting fragments
en.description: Activations occur in several types of English text: the patent material term resistant, an in technical question titles, the Apache license template in code comments, and local words or typography in bibliographic and literary text. No single trigger pattern explains all snippets.

patterns.name: “resistant” in patent material terminology
patterns.context: Appears in the compound material name “Oxidation resistant cross-linked polymeric material”, describing a material property; activations concentrate on resistant.

patterns.name: an in an English question title
patterns.context: “an” appears in a StackExchange question title, followed by a technical object or operation, such as “an XML”, “an array”, or “an Entry Field”; the title has surrounding Q: and line-break formatting.

patterns.name: Software copyright notices and Apache license template
patterns.context: Code comments include copyright years and project or author information, followed by “Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2”; this involves formatted comments and fixed license text.

patterns.name: English book titles and directory-style poem-title formatting
patterns.context: The article an in a book title, or a poem title surrounded by formatting markers with author, page number, and line breaks; the precise trigger differs across instances.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia bibliographic text and Gutenberg poetry collection contents/titles

patterns.name: “throbbing heart” in literary narration
patterns.context: “the throbbing heart” metaphorically describes a metropolis as the center of an empire; activation spans an intra-word fragment in throbbing and the following noun.

4_2317.concept: 英文局部词形与格式片段
4_2317.description: 激活分布在多类英语文本中：专利材料词 resistant、技术问句中 an、代码注释的 Apache 许可模板，以及书目和文学文本中的局部词语或排版。没有单一触发模式能解释全部片段。

patterns.name: 专利材料术语中的“resistant”
patterns.context: 出现在复合材料名称“Oxidation resistant cross-linked polymeric material”中，修饰材料性质；激活集中在 resistant。

patterns.name: 英文疑问帖标题中的 an
patterns.context: “an”出现在 StackExchange 问题标题中，后接技术对象或操作对象，如“an XML”“an array”“an Entry Field”；周围有 Q: 与标题换行格式。

patterns.name: 软件项目版权声明与 Apache 许可模板
patterns.context: 代码注释中出现版权年份、项目或作者信息，随后是“Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2”；涉及格式化注释及固定许可文本。
patterns.domain: GitHub 源代码注释、开源许可证

patterns.name: 英文书名与目录式诗题排版
patterns.context: 书名中的冠词 an，或诗题中被排版标记包围的标题、作者、页码与换行；具体触发点不完全相同。
patterns.domain: 百科书目文本与 Gutenberg 诗集目录/标题

patterns.name: 文学叙述中的 throbbing heart
patterns.context: “the throbbing heart”用于描写大都市作为帝国中心的比喻；激活跨越 throbbing 的词内片段及其后名词。

en.description: All segments prominently feature “an”, usually before nouns or names beginning with a vowel phoneme; most are definition sentences following titles. Some activations fall on titles, line breaks, question-and-answer markers, and sporadic proper-name fragments, which cannot be attributed to a consistent condition.

patterns.name: Indefinite article “an”
patterns.context: Immediately precedes a letter, abbreviation, or name/noun beginning with a vowel phoneme; activations often occur in title restatements or explanatory sentences
patterns.domain: Various genres, including encyclopedias, abstracts, and question-and-answer text

patterns.name: Encyclopedia definition sentence following a title
patterns.context: A title or question is followed by a brief definition, introduction, or description; this pattern overlaps with “an” itself

patterns.name: Title and line-break formatting
patterns.context: A title occupies its own line, and the body begins with the same name after a line break; activations are scattered across title characters and line breaks

patterns.name: Question-and-answer site markers and titles
patterns.context: A question title or title fragment appears before the question-and-answer body; some title words are activated

patterns.name: Specific names or title fragments
patterns.context: A few words in proper names, book titles, paper titles, or term headings are marked; no consistent semantic or morphological condition is apparent

patterns.name: Sentence-initial capitalized words and local word fragments
patterns.context: Activations are sporadically on sentence-initial words, parts of proper names, or technical identifiers, with no consistent context across segments

4_2317.description: 所有段都突出“an”，通常位于元音音素起始的名词或名称前；多数为标题后定义句。部分激活落在标题、换行、问答标记及零散专名词片段上，无法归为一致条件。

patterns.name: 不定冠词“an”
patterns.context: 紧接在字母、缩写或以元音音素开头的名称/名词之前；激活多出现在标题复述或说明性句子里
patterns.domain: 百科、摘要、问答等多种文体

patterns.name: 标题后的百科定义句
patterns.trigger: 标题后出现“is an”或“has an”，其中“an”激活最强
patterns.context: 标题或问题后接简短定义、介绍或描述；该模式与“an”本身重叠

patterns.name: 标题及换行格式
patterns.trigger: 标题后的“↵”“↵”以及标题文本在正文开头重现
patterns.context: 标题独占行，换行后正文以相同名称起句；激活散布于标题字符和换行处

patterns.name: 问答站问题标记与标题
patterns.context: 问题标题或标题片段位于问答正文之前；标题中部分词获得激活

patterns.name: 特定名称或标题片段
patterns.trigger: “I Walked with Heroes”“Development and Validation”“Hite Crossing Bridge”“Glendale Life”“DMARC”“Ophthalmotro​​pe”“Fantasy Sports Writers Association”
patterns.context: 专名、书名、论文题名或术语标题中的少数词被标记，未见统一的词义或词形条件

patterns.name: 句首大写词及局部词片段
patterns.context: 激活零散落在句首词、专名组成部分或技术标识中，跨段缺少一致上下文

en.description: Responds strongly primarily to the indefinite article an before noun phrases, often in technical or formal explanatory text; also appears in encyclopedia entries where an introduces a proper-name modifier.

patterns.name: an in patent claims/explanatory statements
patterns.context: an appears before a noun, especially a technical noun or modified noun phrase; its local syntactic position is often after a preposition or in a predicate complement
