patterns.context: Appears in academic text to connect research objects, purposes, relations, or modifiers; sometimes adjacent to mathematical or statistical terms. In passage 9, the marker is only the initial «F», which may correspond to the first letter of fertility.
patterns.domain: Math, physics, and biomedical papers; occasionally other texts

patterns.name: Preposition of
patterns.context: Occurs frequently in noun phrases, connecting concepts, possession, composition, or categories; activation often falls at phrase-structural boundaries, especially in paper titles, terminology, and formal descriptions.
patterns.domain: Papers, technical descriptions, titles, and general formal text

patterns.name: Preposition on
patterns.context: Appears in continuous English phrases to indicate an object, topic, or locative relation; passage 1 uses “crackdown on,” and passage 2 uses “on our way.”

patterns.name: Preposition at
patterns.context: Introduces a location, followed by Fort Hood.

patterns.name: Paragraph and heading structure markers
patterns.context: Appear near template descriptions or section headings; these may be formatting tokens rather than semantic word triggers.

patterns.name: Diverse and hard-to-connect vocabulary
patterns.context: These markers occur in different syntactic positions and show no stable shared semantics or contextual conditions; some may simply co-occur with prepositions or heading structures.
patterns.domain: News, garbled text, technical and academic text, general narrative

4_2407.concept: 英语功能词及短语边界
4_2407.description: 激活以英语介词 of 和 for 为主，常见于学术或正式名词短语；也零星响应 on、at 及换行、标题格式。另有多处离散词汇标记，缺乏统一解释。

patterns.name: 介词 for
patterns.context: 出现在学术文本中，连接研究对象、目的、关系或修饰成分；有时紧邻数学或统计术语。第9段的标记仅为词首 «F»，可能对应 fertility 的首字母。
patterns.domain: 数学、物理、生物医学论文；偶见其他文本

patterns.name: 介词 of
patterns.context: 大量出现在名词短语中，连接概念、所属、组成或类别；触发位置常位于短语结构边界，尤其在论文标题、术语和正式说明中。
patterns.domain: 论文、技术说明、标题及一般正式文本

patterns.name: 介词 on
patterns.context: 出现在连续的英语短语中，表示对象、主题或位置关系；第1段用于“crackdown on”，第2段用于“on our way”。

patterns.name: 介词 at
patterns.context: 引出地点，后接 Fort Hood。

patterns.name: 段落与标题结构标记
patterns.context: 出现在模板说明或章节标题附近；这些可能是格式 token，而非语义词触发。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、学术论文排版

patterns.name: 多样且难以连贯的词汇
patterns.context: 这些标记分布于不同句法位置，彼此未显示稳定的共同语义或上下文条件；部分可能只是与介词或标题结构共现。
patterns.domain: 新闻、乱码式文本、技术与学术文本、一般叙述

en.description: Activates primarily when “study” denotes a research activity in NIH research applications; it also activates on the fixed phrase “basis” in business emails, “them both” in personal narratives, and “cell” in two biomedical contexts. See also statements about the prospects of immunotherapy.

patterns.name: “study” in research proposals
patterns.context: Statements of research plans or aims; “study” denotes a research activity in the sentence.

patterns.name: Phrase-final use of “basis”
patterns.context: Appears at the end of a sentence or phrase in a fixed expression; preceding text may discuss fee calculations or scheduling rules.

patterns.name: “both” and emotional expression
patterns.context: The speaker expresses affection for both and mentions sadness as a father.

patterns.name: Red blood cells and deformability
patterns.context: Discusses red blood cell deformability and blood rheology.

patterns.name: Vascular smooth muscle cells
patterns.context: Introduces vascular smooth muscle cells and their function.

patterns.name: Unexplained research-abstract wording
patterns.context: Discusses the prospects and rationale for cancer immunotherapy; the “study” wording from the research-proposal sentences above is absent.

4_2552.description: 主要在NIH研究申请中“study”作为研究活动出现时激活；另对商务邮件固定短语“basis”、个人叙述“them both”及两种生物医学语境中的“cell”激活。另见免疫治疗前景表述。

patterns.name: 研究方案中的“study”
patterns.context: 研究计划或目标的陈述；“study”在句中作为研究活动出现。

patterns.name: “basis”结尾用法
patterns.context: 在固定短语中作为句尾或短语结尾出现；前文可涉及费用计算或安排规则。

patterns.name: “both”及情感表达
patterns.context: 说话者表达对两者的喜爱，并提及作为父亲的悲伤。

patterns.name: 红细胞与变形能力
patterns.context: 讨论红细胞的变形能力及血液流变学。

patterns.name: 血管平滑肌细胞
patterns.context: 介绍血管平滑肌细胞及其功能。

patterns.name: 未解释的研究摘要措辞
patterns.context: 讨论癌症免疫治疗的前景与依据；未见上述研究方案句式中的“study”。

en.concept: High-frequency word triggers in research text
en.description: Activation is concentrated on study in research-plan contexts and cell in biomedical contexts; promise and state in solid-state also show high activation, without a confirmed shared semantic pattern.

patterns.name: study in research plans
patterns.context: Appears in statements of research plans or aims, often in structures such as “The proposed study …” or “To study …”; activation centers on the word study.

patterns.name: Cells and cell-related terms
patterns.context: Appears in cell and biomedical research contexts; activation falls on cell, either as a word or as a component of a compound.

patterns.name: Specific high-activation words or phrases
patterns.context: Appear respectively in an evaluative sentence about cancer immunotherapy and in a paper title about solid-state fermentation of pectinase; beyond the words themselves, no shared context is apparent.
patterns.domain: Biomedical research projects; microbiology paper abstracts

4_2552.concept: 研究文本中的高频词触发
4_2552.description: 激活主要落在研究计划语境的 study，以及生物医学语境中的 cell；另有 promise 和 solid-state 中的 state 两处高激活，缺少可确认的共同语义模式。

patterns.name: 研究计划中的 study
patterns.context: 出现在研究计划或目标的陈述中，常见结构为“The proposed study …”或“To study …”；触发点集中在 study 一词。
patterns.domain: NIH ExPorter 的研究项目摘要

patterns.name: 细胞及细胞相关术语
patterns.context: 出现在细胞、生物医学研究语境中；激活落在 cell 上，或落在其组成词 cell 上。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要与项目描述

patterns.name: 特定高频词或短语
patterns.context: 分别出现在癌症免疫治疗的评价性句子、果胶酶固态发酵的论文题名中；除词面触发外，看不出共同语境。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究项目；微生物学论文摘要

en.concept: Biomedical cell vocabulary with sporadic triggers
en.description: Primarily responds to cell and vascular terminology in biomedical contexts, especially sentence-initial medical statements; additional sporadic triggers include cancer immunotherapy, ApoE genetics, ethical argumentation, expressions of sadness, code error messages, and political proper nouns.

patterns.name: cell in cell names
patterns.context: cell appears in cell types or biomedical terms, often with nearby modifiers; paragraph 10 contains “Red cell deformability”.

patterns.name: Vascular terminology
patterns.context: Technical descriptions of blood vessels, vessel walls, and their cells; some trigger words are split into subword fragments.

patterns.name: The as an article
patterns.context: Begins a sentence with The; seen in several paper-like statements, but cell is not prominent in every paragraph containing The.
patterns.domain: Medical papers and general expository prose

patterns.name: Subword cell in technical terms
patterns.context: cell appears as a complete word or as part of a technical compound, not limited to vascular cells.

patterns.name: Immunotherapy and cancer
patterns.context: Statements about cancer immunotherapy; activation also falls on the initial “The” and several subsequent common words. This differs from the cell pattern.

patterns.name: Specific genetic variant name
patterns.context: Mentions the E4 allele of ApoE at the beginning of an incomplete sentence.

patterns.name: basis in ethical argumentation
patterns.context: Discusses utilitarianism, sentience-based positions, and environmental concern; basis means grounds or foundation.

patterns.name: Emotion word sad
patterns.context: A father talks about his love for two people and his sadness about the current situation.

patterns.name: Permission term in a Thai error message
patterns.context: Code maps a database error to a Thai message; activation includes an English error identifier and Thai character fragments.
patterns.domain: Software code, error handling, and Thai localization

patterns.name: Proper noun Obamacons
patterns.context: The short title or phrase “The rise of the Obamacons”, followed by a line break and a new sentence.
patterns.domain: Political commentary or general article title

4_2552.concept: 生物医学细胞词汇，兼有零散触发
4_2552.description: 主要对生物医学语境中的 cell 及血管相关术语反应，尤其是句首医学陈述；另有癌症免疫治疗、ApoE遗传学、伦理论证、悲伤表达、代码错误消息和政治专名等零散触发。

patterns.name: 细胞名称中的 cell
patterns.context: cell 出现在细胞类型或生物医学术语中，附近常有修饰语；第10段为“Red cell deformability”。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、血管与血液学

patterns.name: 血管相关术语
patterns.context: 关于血管、血管壁及其细胞的专业描述；部分触发词被切分为子词。

patterns.name: 冠词 The
patterns.context: 句首以 The 开始；见于若干论文式陈述，但不是所有含 The 的段落都突出 cell。
patterns.domain: 医学论文及一般说明文

patterns.name: 专业词中的子词 cell
patterns.context: cell 作为完整词或专业复合术语组成部分出现，不限于血管相关细胞。

patterns.name: 免疫治疗与癌症
patterns.context: 癌症免疫治疗的陈述，触发也落在句首“The”及后续多个普通词上；与 cell 模式不同。

patterns.name: 特定遗传变体名称
patterns.context: 提及 ApoE 的 E4 等位基因，位于未完句的开头。

patterns.name: 伦理论证中的 basis
patterns.context: 讨论效用主义、感知能力立场与环境关怀，basis 表示论据或基础。

patterns.name: 情绪词 sad
patterns.context: 父亲谈及对两人的爱及在当前处境中的悲伤。

patterns.name: 泰语错误消息中的权限词
patterns.context: 代码映射数据库错误到泰语消息；激活包括英文错误标识和泰语字符片段。
patterns.domain: 软件代码、错误处理与泰语本地化

patterns.name: 专名 Obamacons
patterns.context: 短标题或短语“The rise of the Obamacons”，随后换行并开始新句。
patterns.domain: 政治评论或一般文章标题

en.concept: Academic paper structure markers and proper-noun fragments
en.description: Primarily responds to the Introduction heading/anchor “intro” and its section formatting; it also responds to front-matter bibliographic metadata and LaTeX math markup. Other triggers include proper-name fragments such as CAPRISA and medical E4, as well as title words from quantum physics and astrophysics.

patterns.name: Introduction heading anchor
patterns.context: The Introduction section heading in academic documents and its Markdown-style underline; the heading anchor contains intro.

patterns.name: Academic bibliographic metadata and reference fields
patterns.context: Front-matter metadata or bibliography entries, often adjacent to the title and section text.
patterns.domain: ArXiv documents and YAML/Markdown-style front matter

patterns.name: Annotations and environment syntax in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: LaTeX formulas, norms, inequalities, and section labels in mathematical papers or proofs.

patterns.name: High response to the intro section anchor
patterns.context: Appears as part of a sec:... anchor or equation label; this substring repeatedly triggers across multiple paper excerpts.

patterns.name: Letter sequence in the name CAPRISA
patterns.context: Proper-name abbreviation for a clinical trials unit within an organization’s full name.

patterns.name: T letter and split medical terms
patterns.context: Disease names AIDS/Tuberculosis appear together, with words split into subword tokens.

patterns.name: APOE allele name
patterns.context: E4 denotes an ApoE gene variant, followed by allele and protein names.

patterns.name: Quantum reactivity title phrase
patterns.context: Quantum Reactivity appears in a paper’s title metadata, near terms such as many-body states.

patterns.name: Netzer and AGN astrophysics title
patterns.context: A bibliographic paper title and its abstract-like title wording about active galactic nuclei and dust.

4_2552.concept: 学术论文结构标记与专名片段
4_2552.description: 主要响应论文 Introduction 标题/锚点“intro”及其章节格式，也响应论文前置书目元数据和 LaTeX 数学标记；另有 CAPRISA、医学 E4 等专名片段及量子、天体物理标题词。

patterns.name: Introduction 标题锚点
patterns.context: 学术文档中 Introduction 章节标题及其 Markdown 风格下划线；标题锚点含 intro。

patterns.name: 学术文献元数据与书目字段
patterns.context: 论文前置元数据区或书目文件条目，常紧邻标题与章节正文。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 文档、YAML/Markdown 风格前置区

patterns.name: 数学公式中的标注与环境语法
patterns.context: 数学论文正文或证明中出现 LaTeX 公式、范数、不等式及章节标签。

patterns.name: 章节锚点 intro 的高响应
patterns.context: 作为 sec:... 锚点或公式标签的一部分出现；该子串在多个论文片段中反复触发。
patterns.domain: 学术论文交叉引用与章节标记

patterns.name: CAPRISA 名称中的字母序列
patterns.context: 机构全称中临床试验单位的专名缩写。

patterns.name: T 字母及医学词拆分
patterns.context: AIDS/Tuberculosis 并列疾病名称中，词被分成子词 token。
patterns.domain: NIH 医学研究机构名称

patterns.name: APOE 等位基因名称
patterns.context: 以 E4 指称 ApoE 基因变体，后接 allele 与蛋白名称。

patterns.name: 量子反应性标题短语
patterns.context: 论文元数据标题中出现 Quantum Reactivity，附近有多体态等术语。

patterns.name: Netzer 与 AGN 天体物理标题
patterns.context: 论文书目标题及其关于活动星系核、尘埃的摘要式标题语句。

en.description: Activation occurs in various proper nouns, identifiers, and structured strings: percentages, monetary amounts, legal risk terms, mathematical terminology and formulas, and class paths and constants in code. Movie names and biographical names and dates also appear. The excerpts have no clear unified semantics.

patterns.name: Percentage statistics
patterns.context: Percentages occur near discussion of website traffic statistics; numbers, percent signs, and surrounding metric expressions may trigger together.

patterns.name: Legal disclaimers and risk wording
patterns.context: Website terms or disclaimers describe liability and risks that may result from using information or trading products.

patterns.name: Ideals and set notation in mathematics
patterns.context: Discusses ideals satisfying the Fubini property and mathematical examples, alongside LaTeX notation.

patterns.name: Monetary amounts and monthly pricing
patterns.context: A dollar amount is followed by a per-month pricing expression; truncated context leaves the specific item unclear.

patterns.name: Component and object class names
patterns.context: Explains when to use a class and compares class names in a framework; activation centers on namespace fragments in class names.

patterns.name: PHP framework namespace code
patterns.context: A PHP controller implementation example contains namespaces, class names, and backslash separators.

patterns.name: Film figures’ names and work descriptions
patterns.context: In a film description, directors’, actors’, and characters’ names appear as proper nouns.
patterns.domain: Film reviews or film reference text

patterns.name: Operating-system constant identifiers
patterns.context: Go code lists address-family constants from the syscall package and their hexadecimal values.

patterns.name: Names and birth/death dates
patterns.context: An encyclopedia entry opens with a name, followed by a birth date in parentheses.

patterns.name: PHP class paths and model documentation
patterns.context: Laravel-style class names, interface paths, and return-type comments appear in code documentation.

4_2552.description: 激活出现在多种专名、标识符和结构化字符串中：百分比、金额、法律风险词、数学术语与公式，以及代码中的类路径、常量；另见电影姓名和人物传记姓名日期。各段缺少统一的明确语义。

patterns.name: 百分比统计指标
patterns.context: 百分比紧邻网站流量统计的讨论；数字、百分号及其周围的指标表达可能共同触发。

patterns.name: 法律免责声明与风险措辞
patterns.context: 网站条款或免责声明中，说明使用信息、交易产品可能带来的责任和风险。
patterns.domain: 金融交易网站法律文本

patterns.name: 数学中的理想与集合记号
patterns.context: 讨论满足 Fubini 性质的理想及其数学例子，伴随 LaTeX 数学符号。

patterns.name: 金额和月度计价
patterns.context: 美元金额后接按月计价表达；截断上下文使具体对象不明。

patterns.name: 组件与对象类名
patterns.context: 说明何时使用某个类，并比较框架中的类名；激活集中于类名中的命名空间片段。

patterns.name: PHP框架命名空间代码
patterns.context: PHP控制器实现示例中，出现命名空间、类名及反斜线分隔符。

patterns.name: 影视人物姓名与作品介绍
patterns.context: 电影介绍中，导演、演员和角色姓名以专名形式出现。

patterns.name: 操作系统常量标识符
patterns.context: Go代码中，列举 syscall 包的地址族常量及其十六进制值。

patterns.name: 人名与生卒日期
patterns.context: 百科条目以姓名开篇，随后给出括号中的出生日期。

patterns.name: PHP类路径与模型文档
patterns.context: Laravel风格的类名、接口路径和返回类型注释出现在代码文档中。

en.description: Activation mainly falls on uppercase BI and the word-initial fragment Municip-, and also appears in uppercase block formatting, line-break whitespace, and email-header numbers. These forms are spread across different domains and cannot be explained by a single semantic theme.

patterns.name: BI subword
patterns.context: BI appears as an independent uppercase abbreviation or word-initial fragment; its meaning varies by context and may refer to BI in research or business, or be part of a word tokenized into subwords.
patterns.domain: Medical research, business emails, online discussions, etc.

patterns.name: Municipalities subword
patterns.context: Municip- is the initial substring of municipalities or municipality, appearing in place names, organizations, and discussions of municipal services.

patterns.name: Uppercase block-formatted text
patterns.context: Uppercase words are split into multiple tokens; there is no clear shared lexical trigger condition.
patterns.domain: Historical book headings, academic conference notices

patterns.name: Line-break or whitespace formatting
patterns.context: Weak activation appears near blank lines, indentation, or line breaks; other patterns co-occur in several excerpts, making its independence hard to determine.

patterns.name: Split numbers and formatted dates
patterns.context: Date and time numbers in email headers are split into tokens; seen only in this email-format excerpt.

4_2552.concept: 特定词首片段与排版形式
4_2552.description: 激活主要落在大写 BI 与 Municip- 词首片段，也见于大写分块排版、换行空白及邮件头数字；这些形式分散于不同领域，不能由单一语义主题解释。

patterns.name: BI 子词
patterns.context: BI 作为独立大写缩写或词首片段出现；含义随语境变化，可能指研究或商业中的 BI，也可能是被分词成子词的词的一部分。
patterns.domain: 医学研究、商业邮件、网络讨论等

patterns.name: Municipalities 子词
patterns.context: Municip- 作为 municipalities 或 municipality 的词首子串，出现在地名、机构及讨论市政服务的语境中。
patterns.domain: 新闻、邮件、百科、网络讨论

patterns.name: 大写分块的排版文本
patterns.context: 大写词被拆成多个 token；没有明显的共同词义触发条件。
patterns.domain: 历史书籍题头、学术会议通知

patterns.name: 换行或空白排版
patterns.context: 空行、缩进或换行附近出现较弱激活；在若干段中伴随其他模式，难以确定其独立性。
patterns.domain: 邮件、书籍排版、网页文本

patterns.name: 拆分数字与格式化日期
patterns.context: 邮件头中的日期和时间数字被拆分为 token；仅见于该邮件格式片段。

en.description: The strongest and recurring trigger is DEVELOPMENT in various capitalization and tokenization forms, often in ENRON_DEVELOPMENT email or organization identifiers, and also in body text and legal organization names. Sporadic activation also appears for Metropolitan, OP/DOT in addresses, ed in Forwarded, and email-format tokens.

patterns.name: DEVELOPMENT string
patterns.context: Any continuous spelling of DEVELOPMENT triggers, regardless of capitalization or tokenization; it may occur in an organization name, email address/username, ordinary body text, or a subject heading.
patterns.domain: Legal documents, emails and forwarded email headers, news/subject summaries, personal résumés

patterns.name: Tokenized spelling of METROPOLITAN
patterns.context: The organization name Metropolitan Development Commission in a court case title; it occurs with Development in an organization name, but activation primarily falls on the Development string.

patterns.name: Substring in COMOPAQ email address
patterns.context: OP appears in the COMOPAQ spelling between the email username and domain; this is an isolated local trigger, not a DEVELOPMENT string.

patterns.name: DOT tokenization in an address
patterns.context: DOT is split and marked in an anti-spam address format using square brackets; activation is weaker than the main DEVELOPMENT pattern.
patterns.domain: Email addresses in StackExchange support replies

patterns.name: ED tokenization in a forwarding marker
patterns.context: Forwarded in an email forwarding header is split into two tokens, with only ed marked; activation is weaker.

patterns.name: Introducer and header formatting
patterns.context: Line breaks and time fields near email headers or forwarding blocks show sporadic low-level activation; these positions are also adjacent to DEVELOPMENT email identifiers, so independent triggering cannot be confirmed.

4_2552.concept: DEVELOPMENT 字符串及邮件标识
4_2552.description: 最强且反复的触发是 DEVELOPMENT 的各种大小写与分词写法，常出现在 ENRON_DEVELOPMENT 邮箱/机构标识，也见正文及法律机构名。另有零星的 Metropolitan、地址中的 OP/DOT、Forwarded 的 ed 和邮件格式 token 激活。

patterns.name: DEVELOPMENT 字符串
patterns.context: 不论大小写和 token 切分，只要出现 DEVELOPMENT 的连续拼写；可处于机构名、邮箱/用户名、普通正文或主题标题中。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、邮件及邮件转发头、新闻/主题摘要、个人履历

patterns.name: METROPOLITAN 的分词拼写
patterns.context: 法庭案件标题中的机构名称 Metropolitan Development Commission；与 Development 同在机构名中，但神经元激活主要落在 Development 字符串上。

patterns.name: COMOPAQ 邮箱地址内的子串
patterns.context: 邮箱用户名和域名之间、COMOPAQ 拼写中出现 OP；这是孤立的局部触发，不是 DEVELOPMENT 字符串。

patterns.name: 地址中 DOT 的切分
patterns.context: 以方括号括住的反垃圾邮件地址写法中，DOT 被拆分并标记；强度低于 DEVELOPMENT 主模式。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 支持回复中的邮箱地址

patterns.name: ED 在转发标记中的切分
patterns.context: 邮件转发头的 Forwarded 被分成两个 token，只有 ed 被标记，强度较低。

patterns.name: 引导符及头部格式
patterns.context: 邮件头或转发块附近的换行、时间字段有零星低强度激活；这些位置同时邻接 DEVELOPMENT 邮箱标识，无法确认是独立触发。

en.description: Primarily responds to split word fragments beginning with uppercase PE in English, including PEake, PEARLS, PEACE, and PE Teacher; local activation also appears in Polish, numbers, Craft, and sporadic body words, which do not all fit a single rule.

patterns.name: PE English spelling fragments
patterns.context: Uppercase words are split into tokens; they appear in titles or occupational descriptions following names.

patterns.name: PEAK name spelling fragment
patterns.context: An uppercase name is split into multiple tokens, forming the surname PEake.

patterns.name: PEARL internal word fragment
patterns.context: In uppercase or title-style formatting, PE is followed by AR to form pearls; the word may also continue across a line break.

patterns.name: PEACE internal word fragment
patterns.context: The uppercase word PEACE in a chapter heading is split, preceded by LONG.

patterns.name: PEACE semantically related spelling
patterns.context: Uppercase PEACE is split in a sentence for emphasis; the following text describes the meaning of Islam as peace.

patterns.name: Shared prefix in PEAKE / PEARLS / PEACE
patterns.context: Activation centers on word fragments beginning with PE in uppercase English strings; the continuations and meanings vary.

patterns.name: Other letter fragments and split numbers
patterns.context: Stronger activation falls on an internal fragment of a Polish word or on historical contents-page numbers; neither has a clear correspondence to the PE fragments.

patterns.name: Token in the form Craft
patterns.context: Craft is marked on its own in the ordinary proper name Craft Arts; Craft Partners shows only weaker activation elsewhere.

patterns.name: Special word fragments and names
patterns.context: Fragment 1 also shows several sporadic activations without a consistent orthographic or semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Residual weak activations
patterns.context: Words or fragments scattered through general prose; available examples do not support a shared trigger condition.

4_2552.description: 主要响应大写英文中以 PE 开始的拆分词片段，涵盖 PEake、PEARLS、PEACE、PE Teacher；也有波兰语、数字、Craft 及零散正文词的局部激活，不能完全归入同一规则。

patterns.name: PE 英文拼写片段
patterns.context: 大写单词被拆分成 token；出现在标题或姓名后的职业说明中。
patterns.domain: 书籍标题、学校人员简介

patterns.name: PEAK 姓名拼写片段
patterns.context: 大写姓名被拆分为多个 token，构成姓氏 PEake。
patterns.domain: 电影宣传或人物署名文本

patterns.name: PEARL 词内片段
patterns.context: 大写或标题式排版中，PE 后续接 AR，组成 pearls；也可能跨行续接。

patterns.name: PEACE 词内片段
patterns.context: 章节标题中的大写单词 PEACE 被拆分，前接 LONG。

patterns.name: PEACE 语义相关拼写
patterns.context: 句中大写强调的 PEACE 被拆分，后文将 Islam 的含义说成 peace。
patterns.domain: 网络评论或政治宗教论述

patterns.name: PEAKE / PEARLS / PEACE 的共享前缀
patterns.context: 激活集中于大写英文串中以 PE 开始的词片段；具体后续词和含义不一。

patterns.name: 其他字母片段与数字拆分
patterns.context: 较强激活落在波兰语单词内部片段或历史目录数字上；与 PE 片段无明确对应。
patterns.domain: 欧盟立法文本、历史书籍目录

patterns.name: Craft 词形中的 token
patterns.context: 普通英文专名 Craft Arts 中，Craft 被单独标记；另处 Craft Partners 仅较弱激活。

patterns.name: 特殊词片段及姓名
patterns.context: 片段 1 还出现若干零散激活，未形成一致的词形或语义模式。
patterns.domain: 电影相关文本、人物署名

patterns.name: 余项弱激活
patterns.context: 一般正文中散在的词或词片段，难以从现有样例归纳为共同触发条件。

en.description: Activation is distributed across patent operation descriptions, mathematical physics formulas, corporate news and emails, literary quotations, and numeric records. No stable cross-domain lexical or syntactic trigger is evident; activation appears more tied to local words, symbols, and formatting in each excerpt.

patterns.name: Touch-operation descriptions in patents
patterns.context: Activation appears when describing fingers touching buttons, swipe gestures on touchscreens, and device structures; the specific words also include common function words.

patterns.name: Feed supply and mounting structures in patents
patterns.context: Patent sentences describe bag feeding and a rotary dispensing-spout mounting mechanism; “spout” is split into multiple fragments.

patterns.name: Mathematical formulas and variable formatting
patterns.context: The body of a mathematical paper introduces measures and variables, followed by a LaTeX math environment; activation covers formula symbols and some text.

patterns.name: Symbols and formatting in physics formulas
patterns.context: The body shifts to a formula for a partonic cross section, with variables, subscripts and superscripts, and an alignment environment in LaTeX.

patterns.name: Variables and special functions in formulas
patterns.context: Symbols, functions, and parentheses in a LaTeX formula; similar to the adjacent physics formula, but this is a separate formula excerpt.
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematical or theoretical physics papers

patterns.name: Corporate news headlines and workforce reductions
patterns.context: A news-style headline and body mention oil fields, a company, and workforce reductions in the UK; activation falls on proper nouns, topic words, and common words.

patterns.name: Repeated calls and celestial imagery in literary narration
patterns.context: The quotation repeatedly urges someone to continue, then shifts to narration describing celestial bodies resuming their eternal motion.

patterns.name: Email quoted header and amount
patterns.context: After confirming in the email body, a fee amount appears, followed by the quoted original email header and sender information.

patterns.name: Scheduling and signature in an email
patterns.context: An informal email discusses a purchase and Monday/Tuesday arrangements, followed by a signature; it also contains punctuation and word fragments.

patterns.name: Comma-separated ascending numeric records
patterns.context: Multiline comma-separated numeric records with roughly ascending values, with carriage returns and line feeds between lines.

4_2552.description: 激活分布于专利操作描述、数学物理公式、企业新闻与邮件、文学引语及数字记录；未见跨领域稳定的词义或句法触发，更多是各段局部词语、符号与格式。

patterns.name: 专利中的触摸操作表述
patterns.trigger: « touched»、« the»、« performed»、« within»、« operating region»、« provided»
patterns.context: 描述手指触碰按钮、触摸屏上的滑动操作及设备结构时激活；具体词语还包括常见功能词。

patterns.name: 专利中的供料与安装结构
patterns.trigger: « by»、« it»、« a pouch»、« sequentially»、« provided»、« spout»、« installation»、« heads»
patterns.context: 专利句子描述袋体供料和旋转式出液口安装机构；「spout」被拆分成多个片段。

patterns.name: 数学公式与变量排版
patterns.trigger: « ensure»、« comes»、« a»、« measure»、« psi»、« z»、« _»、« ,»
patterns.context: 数学论文正文引出测度与变量，紧接 LaTeX 数学环境；激活覆盖公式符号及部分文字。

patterns.name: 物理学公式中的符号与排版
patterns.trigger: « DIS»、« given»、« sigma»、« I»、« (»、« z»、« q»、« mu»、« R»
patterns.context: 正文转入 partonic cross section 的公式，LaTeX 中含变量、上下标及对齐环境。

patterns.name: 公式中的变量与特殊函数
patterns.context: LaTeX 数学公式的符号、函数与括号；与相邻物理公式类似，但此段是独立公式片段。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学或理论物理论文

patterns.name: 企业新闻标题与人员缩减
patterns.trigger: « wells»、« offshore»、« Red»、« UK»、« Workforce»、« reduce»、« based»
patterns.context: 新闻式标题和正文提及油田、公司及英国员工缩减；激活落在专名、主题词和常见词上。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的新闻剪报

patterns.name: 文学叙述中的重复呼喊与星体意象
patterns.context: 引语中反复催促继续，随后转为叙事，描写星体重新开始永恒运行。

patterns.name: 邮件引用头与金额
patterns.trigger: « Sure»、« cost»、« $»、« 100»、« Original»、« Message»、« From:»、« Sent»
patterns.context: 邮件正文确认后出现费用金额，并转入原始邮件的引用头和发件人信息。

patterns.name: 邮件中的日期安排与签名
patterns.trigger: « for»、« one»、« don't»、« buy»、« Monday»、« Tuesday»、« COOL»、« Veselack»
patterns.context: 口语邮件讨论购买及周一、周二安排，随后出现署名；也包含标点和词片段。

patterns.name: 逗号分隔的递增数字记录
patterns.context: 多行逗号分隔数字记录，数值大致递增，行间有回车和换行。

en.description: Activation is scattered across heterogeneous corpora, often falling on internal tokens in number strings, proper nouns, or terminology; it also appears around line-break formatting, Portuguese technical words, and pornographic category labels. No single stable semantic theme is evident.

patterns.name: Numbers and numeric fields
patterns.context: Activation falls on part of a number string, often in amounts, years, lists, integers or identifiers in code; surrounding text types vary.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, parliamentary texts, code, business emails, etc.

patterns.name: Internal fragments in proper nouns and rare words
patterns.context: Activation occurs in names, terminology, or identifiers split into multiple tokens, especially rare internal fragments; contextual conditions are unstable.

patterns.name: Local fragments in English vocabulary
patterns.context: Sporadic occurrences in narrative or pornographic text, with no consistent semantic or syntactic condition; “filled” in paragraph 5 occurs in the expression “filled with a burning desire”.
patterns.domain: Literary narrative, pornographic text, sports reporting

patterns.name: Portuguese technical expressions and code identifiers
patterns.context: Around SMTP/SSL configuration instructions and code variables, activation centers on internal fragments of Portuguese words and protocol identifiers.

patterns.name: Explicit line breaks and indentation formatting
patterns.context: A few paragraphs show activation near line breaks, sometimes followed by numbering or large aligned spaces; not all line breaks trigger.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, parliamentary lists, code, email formatting

patterns.name: Sexual vocabulary and category labels in pornographic text
patterns.context: Appears in adult-video-style descriptions and their category labels; “Teens” in the labels shows strong activation.

4_2552.description: 激活分散在异质语料中，常落于数字串、专名或术语的内部 token，也见换行排版、葡萄牙语技术词及色情分类标签；未见单一稳定语义主题。

patterns.name: 数字与数值字段
patterns.context: 激活落在数字串的一部分，常见于金额、年份、列表、代码中的整数或编号；周围文本类型不固定。
patterns.domain: 百科、议会文本、代码、商务邮件等

patterns.name: 专名与罕见词内部片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在被拆分为多个 token 的名称、术语或标识符中，尤其是词内罕见片段；上下文条件不稳定。
patterns.domain: 百科、体育报道、代码、邮件

patterns.name: 英语词汇中的局部片段
patterns.context: 零散出现在叙述或色情文本中，没有一致的语义或句法条件；第5段的“filled”处于“filled with a burning desire”表达中。
patterns.domain: 文学叙述、色情文本、体育报道

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语技术表达及代码标识符
patterns.context: 在 SMTP/SSL 配置说明及代码变量周围，激活集中于葡萄牙语词内部片段和协议标识符片段。

patterns.name: 显式换行与缩进排版
patterns.trigger: “↵”以及其后的空白或缩进区域
patterns.context: 少数段落的换行附近有激活，且换行后可能出现序号或大段对齐空格；并非所有换行都触发。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、议会列表、代码、邮件格式

patterns.name: 色情文本中的性词汇与分类标签
patterns.context: 出现在成人视频式描述及其分类标签中；标签中的“Teens”有很强激活。

en.concept: Sensitive to formatting and subword boundaries
en.description: Activations are distributed across code and structured lists, proper names and subword boundaries, email signatures and abbreviations, colloquial Portuguese, teen word forms, product quantities, and date scheduling; there is no single semantic trigger, and the feature may favor formatting, word-form fragments, and proper names.

patterns.name: Structured tables, lists, and fields
patterns.context: In code declarations or line-by-line tables, rankings, and numbered data, types/fields, labels, or values appear consecutively in a fixed format.
patterns.domain: Code, sports league records, numerical data

patterns.name: Proper names and case/tokenization boundaries
patterns.context: Proper names, brands, personal names, or words cross tokenizer subword boundaries; activation falls on subwords within names.

patterns.name: Price/U... in software fields and identifiers
patterns.context: Compound identifiers appear in code properties or comments, especially field names such as `Price`, `Unit`, and `UPD`.
patterns.domain: Github code and Japanese-English mixed comments

patterns.name: English abbreviations and email signatures/addresses
patterns.context: At the end of email bodies or in address-book-style signatures, abbreviations, email domains, names, and organizations appear next to one another.

patterns.name: Colloquial Portuguese expressions and word segmentation
patterns.context: Portuguese sentences discuss the word `fixe` and its usage, with colloquial expressions and subword segmentation.

patterns.name: Adult content and teen/Teens word forms
patterns.context: Texts about adult website categories or young performers/music include teen-related words and variants in capitalization or subword segmentation.

patterns.name: Quantity and product shipment expressions
patterns.context: In news reports about product manufacturing and shipment forecasts, quantity phrases appear next to pluralized model names.

patterns.name: Dates, weekdays, and scheduling
patterns.context: Emails compare or schedule matters for different dates and time slots.

4_2552.description: 激活分散于代码与结构化列表、专名和子词边界、邮件签名及缩写、葡语口语、teen词形、产品数量和日期安排；没有单一语义触发条件，可能偏向格式/词形片段与专名。

patterns.name: 结构化表格、列表与字段
patterns.trigger: `struct Animal *const`、`static const ... {`、`Division Two West`、`champions`、`2001–02`、重复的逗号分隔数字和换行
patterns.context: 在代码声明或按行排列的表格、榜单、编号数据中，类型/字段、标签或数值以固定格式连续出现。
patterns.domain: 代码、体育联赛记录、数字数据

patterns.name: 专名与大小写/分词边界
patterns.trigger: `Virgin Films`、`Veselack`、`Bentley`、`Rochester`、`Teen`、`Athlon 64s`，以及片段中的大小写和词内切分
patterns.context: 专名、品牌、人名或词语跨 tokenizer 子词边界出现；激活落在名称内部的子词上。
patterns.domain: 网页文本、邮件、新闻、百科

patterns.name: 软件字段与标识符中的 Price/U...
patterns.context: 代码属性或注释中出现复合标识符，尤其含 `Price`、`Unit`、`UPD` 等字段名。
patterns.domain: Github 代码及日英混合注释

patterns.name: 英语缩写与邮件签名/地址
patterns.context: 邮件正文末尾或通讯录式签名中，缩写、邮箱域、姓名和组织名相邻。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语口语表达与词形切分
patterns.context: 葡语句子讨论 `fixe` 一词及其用法，出现口语表达和子词切分。

patterns.name: 成人内容与 teen/Teens 词形
patterns.context: 涉及成人网站分类或年轻艺人/音乐的文本中，出现 teen 相关词及其大小写或子词变体。
patterns.domain: 网页成人内容、娱乐宣传

patterns.name: 数量及产品出货表达
patterns.context: 新闻报道产品生产、出货预期时，数量短语与型号复数相邻。

patterns.name: 日期、星期与时间安排
patterns.context: 邮件中比较或安排不同日期、时段的事项。

en.concept: Local word fragments in heterogeneous text
en.description: Activations span news, legal and financial material, engineering, code, multilingual text, and glossary entries, often falling on proper names, intraword subword fragments, numbers, or structured identifiers; there is no consistent semantic, language, or syntactic pattern.

patterns.name: Fragments within proper names
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments within proper names or common words; these examples show no unified meaning or fixed position.
patterns.domain: Different genres, including news, Wikipedia, email, and glossary entries

patterns.name: Financial figures and amounts
patterns.context: Appears in company financial statements or text about stock buybacks, involving amounts, years, and financial terminology.

patterns.name: Structured fields and symbols
patterns.context: Near local parameter declarations and macro-like identifiers in code, and near equations; activation concentrates on identifier fragments and operators.

patterns.name: Distribution, control, and constraints
patterns.context: Technical descriptions of vehicle power distribution and clutch control discuss force distribution and control conditions.

patterns.name: Intraword fragments in Hungarian
patterns.context: Fragments occur inside concatenated Hungarian word forms; no single meaning explains them.

patterns.name: Colloquial Portuguese expressions
patterns.context: When Portuguese examples list colloquial expressions found through search, activation hits fragments within words.

patterns.name: List and category entries
patterns.context: Proper names, titles, and category items are listed one by one in lists or disambiguation entries.

patterns.name: Proper names in police reports
patterns.context: In a news account of police searching for villagers, the fragment occurs within a place name; it has no clear connection to policing semantics.

patterns.name: Garbled or nonstandard spelling fragments
patterns.context: Colloquial spellings, variants, or text noise occur together; activation falls within non-English word forms.

4_2552.concept: 异质文本中的局部词片段
4_2552.description: 激活跨新闻、法律财务、工程、代码、多语种和词条文本，常落在专名、词内子词片段、数字或结构化标识符上；没有一致的语义、语种或句法模式。

patterns.name: 专名内部片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专名或普通词内部的子词片段；这些例子看不出统一词义或固定位置。
patterns.domain: 新闻、Wikipedia、邮件、词条等不同文体

en.description: Activations most prominently fall on Profit, Stake, and monetary amounts/numbers and units; other sporadic patterns involve code identifiers, Lithuanian word fragments, headlines, and colloquial words. Overall, the pattern favors intraword segmentation and numbers, but domains and triggers are not unified.

patterns.name: Character fragments in Profit
patterns.context: Substrings within English text words or across tokens; activation centers on Profit and capitalization or tokenization variants of Stake.

patterns.name: Grouping of monetary figures
patterns.context: When digits and thousands separators are adjacent to currency units in financial amounts; activation falls on numeric fragments and Million/billion.

patterns.name: Numbers and quantified values such as percentages
patterns.context: Near numbers and units in percentages, growth rates, or financial values; not necessarily large amounts.

patterns.name: Intraword boundaries and case segmentation
patterns.context: Some English words are split into multiple tokens, with activation distributed across intraword fragments or adjacent words; these examples have no consistent semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Code identifiers and formatting symbols
patterns.context: Activation appears near identifiers, code indentation, or punctuation in Go code snippets.

patterns.name: Lithuanian word endings and parliamentary formulae
patterns.context: In Lithuanian speeches, segmented word-form fragments and the formula “representing ... group” activate.

patterns.name: Capitalized word fragments in headlines
patterns.context: In English title-case text, activation falls on segmented headline word fragments; this occurs alongside monetary headlines, but a single trigger cannot be established.

patterns.name: Colloquial words in accounts of competition experience
patterns.context: The latter part of the colloquial word “stoked” in a first-person quotation; the same passage also mentions sponsorships, challenges, contests, and competition.

patterns.name: Time and business-word fragments in news sentences
patterns.context: In business performance news, fragments near quarters, sales, and company/product names show moderate activation, but no stable specific meaning pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: Residual amount and profitability fragments
patterns.context: Multiple word fragments activate in business narratives about company revenue, long-term profitability, cash, and valuation.

patterns.name: Scandinavian language fragments
patterns.context: Activation occurs in Swedish word fragments such as språ(k), in sentences discussing language use; the pattern appears only once.

patterns.name: Sporadic activations near proper names or brands
patterns.context: Activations fall separately on an intraword fragment in stoked and a fragment in the brand name Beats, amid esports/sponsorship and Apple acquisition news; no stable shared semantics are evident.

patterns.name: Market term bull and intraword fragments
patterns.context: The same market-assessment word bullish appears in contexts about economic growth and stock trends; activation favors the suffix ish rather than the whole word.

4_2552.concept: 不稳定的词内子词片段激活

patterns.name: profitability 内的 profit 片段

patterns.name: 数字及词内子词片段

en.description: Activations are distributed across numbers and scientific notation, formulas, and English function words; they also cover Lithuanian and Swedish subword fragments and football proper names. Overall, there is no stable single semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Numbers, dimensions, and formatted values
patterns.context: Numbers embedded in measurements, years, astronomical quantities, formulas, or math problems; often accompanied by punctuation, units, or LaTeX formatting.
patterns.domain: Scientific text, investment discussions, math problems

patterns.name: Astronomical and physical quantity symbols
patterns.context: Numbers and scientific symbols interleave in expressions of celestial observations, star formation, galaxies, or astronomical mass and luminosity.

patterns.name: Relational and function words in sentences
patterns.context: Connects noun phrases, prepositional phrases, or clauses in continuous English prose; not a fixed individual word.
patterns.domain: Papers, forum discussions, and academic prose

patterns.name: English intraword segmentation and word-form continuation
patterns.context: English words are split into multiple subword tokens, with activation falling on intraword fragments and adjacent words.

patterns.name: Lithuanian parliamentary titles and endings
patterns.context: In Lithuanian parliamentary speeches, names, party-group titles, and inflectional endings are split into subwords.

patterns.name: Swedish word-form fragments
patterns.context: In Swedish parliamentary text, common grammatical words, endings, and intraword fragments activate after segmentation.

patterns.name: Football player and club proper names
patterns.context: Names, teams, or places in biographies and club-career sections.

patterns.name: LaTeX mathematical expressions and operators
patterns.context: Variables, equations, and arithmetic expressions alternate, with values presented as text problems.

4_2552.description: 激活分散在数字与科学记号、公式及英文功能词中，也覆盖立陶宛语和瑞典语的子词片段、足球专名；整体没有稳定的单一语义触发模式。

patterns.name: 数字、量纲与格式化数值

patterns.name: 天文与物理量符号
patterns.context: 天体观测、恒星形成、星系或天文质量与光度的表达式中，数字和科学符号交错出现

patterns.name: 句中关系词和功能词

patterns.context: 英文连续行文中连接名词短语、介词结构或从句；并非固定单一词项
patterns.domain: 论文、论坛讨论与学术论述

patterns.name: 英语词内拆分与词形延续
patterns.context: 英语词被切成多个子词 token，激活落在词内片段及其相邻词上

patterns.name: 立陶宛语议会称谓与词尾
patterns.context: 立陶宛语议会发言中，人名、党团称谓及屈折词尾被拆分成子词

patterns.name: 瑞典语词形片段
patterns.context: 瑞典语议会文本中，常见语法词、词尾和词内片段分词激活

patterns.name: 足球运动员与俱乐部专名
patterns.context: 人物简介及俱乐部生涯段落中的姓名、球队或地名
patterns.domain: 英文 Wikipedia 体育条目

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学表达式与运算符
patterns.context: 变量、等式和算术表达式交替出现，且数值以文本题目形式给出

en.concept: Local importance expressions and structured symbols
en.description: Primarily responds to the Swedish parliamentary-text emphasis words “viktigt/viktig,” especially “är viktigt” and subsequent explanations; it also responds independently to astronomical spectral values, solar-mass table headers, and JSON key structure.

patterns.name: Swedish “important” word forms
patterns.context: Occurs in “är v-ikt-igt/-ig”; often introduced by “det är” or “ska ... viktigt att,” emphasizing the importance of something; sometimes followed by “för oss alla” or an “att” clause.
patterns.domain: Swedish European Parliament speeches, resolutions, and policy discussions

patterns.name: Numbers and units in astronomical spectra
patterns.context: Values are adjacent to the Å wavelength unit in spectral processing descriptions; the same passage also includes signal-to-noise ratio, resolution, and HARPS.

patterns.name: Solar-mass notation in astronomical tables
patterns.context: A table header uses solar masses as the unit, with masses and their differences listed nearby.

patterns.name: JSON device-reading key names
patterns.context: Field names, quotation marks, and punctuation appear densely in nested JSON device-information/reading objects.
patterns.domain: StackExchange technical data or code snippets

4_2552.concept: 局部重要性表达及结构化符号
4_2552.description: 主要响应瑞典语议会文本中强调重要性的“viktigt/viktig”，尤其“är viktigt”及其后续说明；另对天文光谱数值、太阳质量表头和 JSON 键名结构有独立响应。

patterns.name: 瑞典语“重要”词形
patterns.context: 出现在“är v-ikt-igt/-ig”中；常由“det är”“ska ... viktigt att”引出，强调某事重要；有时后接“för oss alla”或“att”从句。
patterns.domain: 瑞典语欧洲议会发言、决议与政策讨论

patterns.name: 天文光谱中的数字与单位
patterns.context: 光谱处理说明中，数值与 Å 波长单位相邻；同段还出现信噪比、分辨率和 HARPS。

patterns.name: 天文表格中的太阳质量符号
patterns.context: 表格表头以太阳质量为单位，附近列出质量及其差值。

patterns.name: JSON设备读数键名
patterns.context: 嵌套 JSON 设备信息/读数对象中，字段名、引号与标点密集出现。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术数据或代码片段

en.description: Activations cover several unrelated text types: patent connecting rods, quantitative medical diagnosis, baseball teams, cellular microenvironments, a Gaza project, 35 mm cameras, code Visualization, and prime factorization problem templates. Apart from local terms in each passage, no unified semantic or stylistic trigger pattern is evident.

patterns.name: Connecting-rod terminology in patents
patterns.context: Patent background descriptions of engines, pistons, and connecting components; activation falls on stem fragments of “connecting” and “reciprocating”

patterns.name: Quantitative wording in medical diagnosis
patterns.context: A cardiology paper title describing a new objective, quantitative criterion for functional diagnosis

patterns.name: Baseball team names
patterns.context: Sports reporting with a team as the subject, followed by its season record

patterns.name: Cell differentiation and microenvironmental signals
patterns.context: Discusses cell differentiation, external stimuli, and microenvironmental factors; the sentence emphasizes signals provided by the surrounding microenvironment

patterns.name: Place name Gaza
patterns.context: An email mentions an ongoing power project, with Gaza as the project location

patterns.name: 35 mm in camera specifications
patterns.context: Introduces the specifications of the Nikon F-401 entry-level autofocus SLR camera

patterns.name: Visualization in code comments
patterns.context: A C-style comment header identifying the program as Visualization Toolkit

patterns.name: Los Angeles Angels team name
patterns.context: A sports ticketing phrase mentions the team Los Angeles Angels alongside Kansas City Royals

patterns.name: Prime factorization problem template
patterns.context: A sequence of integer prime factorization questions and answers or exercises; prompts alternate with numeric answers

4_2839.description: 激活覆盖多类不相干文本：专利连杆、医学定量诊断、棒球队、细胞微环境、Gaza 项目、相机 35 mm、代码 Visualization，以及质因数题模板。除各段局部词项外，未见统一语义或文体触发规律。

patterns.name: 专利中的连杆术语
patterns.context: 发动机、活塞与连接部件的专利背景描述；激活落在“connecting”及“reciprocating”的词干片段

patterns.name: 医学诊断量化表述
patterns.context: 心脏病学论文标题中描述一种新的客观、定量功能诊断标准

patterns.name: 棒球队名称
patterns.context: 体育报道中以球队为主语，后接赛季战绩

patterns.name: 细胞分化与微环境信号
patterns.context: 讨论细胞分化、外部刺激及微环境因素；句子强调信号由周围微环境提供

patterns.name: 地名 Gaza
patterns.context: 邮件提及正在参与的电力项目，Gaza 是项目地点

patterns.name: 相机规格中的 35 mm
patterns.context: 介绍 Nikon F-401 的入门级自动对焦单反相机规格

patterns.name: 代码注释中的 Visualization
patterns.context: C 风格注释头部，标明程序名为 Visualization Toolkit

patterns.name: 洛杉矶天使队名称
patterns.context: 体育票务短语中出现球队 Los Angeles Angels，与 Kansas City Royals 并列

patterns.name: 质因数题目模板
patterns.trigger: «prime»…« factors»；«What» are the prime factors of…、«List» the prime factors of…
patterns.context: 连续列出整数的质因数分解问答或练习题；题干与数字答案交替出现

en.description: Activations are scattered across subword fragments, proper nouns, titles, and technical or medical terms. The clearest repeated cues are “Visual” and “reciprocating”; most others occur in isolated contexts and are difficult to group under a single meaning.

patterns.name: The in-word fragment “Visual”
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of the longer word Visualization; also occurs in a module name in code comments.
patterns.domain: Medical imaging titles, GitHub code comments

patterns.name: The in-word fragment “reciprocating”
patterns.context: Appears in technical contexts describing reciprocating pistons or pumps; activation falls on a split word fragment.

patterns.name: Baseball team names and event text
patterns.context: Proper nouns and years in team names, scores, or event titles; activation positions are not consistent.

patterns.name: Fungal genus “Clausenomyces”
patterns.context: The genus name is split into multiple subword fragments that recur.

patterns.name: Prominent formatting in titles or keywords
patterns.context: A title word or year receives activation in a paragraph-opening heading or event title; its relation to other trigger patterns is unclear.

patterns.name: Left ventricle and cardiomyopathy terminology
patterns.context: A medical paper title describes left ventricular rotation and cardiomyopathy; activation concentrates on terminology and quantitative words.

patterns.name: Stem cell differentiation
patterns.context: Paper text describes stem cells maintaining an undifferentiated state and beginning to differentiate after receiving signals.

patterns.name: Comment separators and toolkit names in code
patterns.context: Comment blocks, separators, and module names at the top of code files.

4_2839.description: 激活分散于拆分词片段、专名、标题和技术或医学术语；较明确的重复线索是“Visual”与“reciprocating”，其余多为孤立语境，难以归为单一语义。

patterns.name: 词内片段“Visual”
patterns.context: 在较长单词 Visualization 的词首出现；也见于代码注释中的模块名。
patterns.domain: 医学影像标题、GitHub 代码注释

patterns.name: “reciprocating”词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在描述往复活塞或泵的技术语境中，激活落在被拆分的单词片段上。

patterns.name: 棒球队名与赛事文本
patterns.context: 体育队名、比分或赛事标题中的专名和年份；激活位置并不统一。

patterns.name: 真菌属名“Clausenomyces”
patterns.context: 属名被拆成多个子词片段重复出现。
patterns.domain: 维基百科生物分类条目

patterns.name: 标题或关键词的显著排版
patterns.context: 段首标题或赛事标题中，标题词或年份获得激活；与其他触发模式的关系不明。

patterns.name: 左心室与心肌病术语
patterns.context: 医学论文标题中，左心室旋转及心肌病相关描述；激活集中在术语和定量性词汇。

patterns.name: 干细胞分化过程
patterns.context: 介绍干细胞保持未分化状态、接收信号后开始分化的论文正文。

patterns.name: 代码注释分隔线与工具包名
patterns.context: 代码文件头部的注释块、分隔线和模块名称。

en.description: Activations concentrate in DM Mathematics symbolic-operation text: expansion, polynomial products, differentiation, and rearrangement into a specified form. They also cover expressions, powers, coefficients, and short answer fragments in these tasks; it is difficult to fully distinguish activation to local expressions from activation to instructions.

patterns.name: Expand-expression instructions
patterns.context: An instruction to expand a product or polynomial appears near variables with powers, coefficients, or products; both the instruction words and nearby expressions may contribute to activation.

patterns.name: Differentiation instructions and variable definitions
patterns.context: Requests differentiation with respect to a given variable or a specified-order derivative, typically adjacent to polynomials and variable names; activation may also fall near derivative expressions.

patterns.name: Rearrangement into a specified form
patterns.context: Requests rewriting a variable expression into a specified form, often with a subtask such as “and give” a coefficient.

patterns.name: Polynomial products and expansion-result fragments
patterns.context: Local expressions from product or polynomial calculations; some activations occur outside instructions, in answers or problems, and may not be triggered by a specific instruction.

patterns.name: Isolated activations near short answers and line breaks
patterns.context: Near short expressions or answers at the start of a passage or after a line break, with insufficient context to identify a distinct semantic trigger.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics problem and answer fragments

4_2839.description: 激活集中于 DM 数学符号运算语料：展开、多项式乘积、求导及重排成指定形式，也覆盖这些任务中的算式、幂、系数和短答案片段；难以将局部算式激活与指令触发完全区分。

patterns.name: 展开代数式指令
patterns.context: 出现要求展开乘积或多项式的指令，邻近内容含变量幂、系数或乘积；指令词本身及其局部算式均可能参与触发。

patterns.name: 求导指令及变量说明
patterns.context: 要求对给定变量求导或求指定阶导数，通常紧邻多项式和变量名；激活也可能落在导数算式附近。

patterns.name: 重排成指定形式
patterns.context: 要求把含变量的表达式改写成指定形式，常附带“and give”某系数等子任务。

patterns.name: 多项式乘积与展开结果片段
patterns.context: 乘积或多项式计算的算式局部；部分激活出现在指令以外、答案或题目中，未必由特定指令触发。

patterns.name: 短答案及换行附近的孤立激活
patterns.context: 段首或换行后的短算式/答案附近，缺乏足够上下文辨认出独立语义触发条件。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 题目与答案片段

en.description: Responds strongly primarily to clinical in medical contexts, including abstracts, plans, and case reports. There are also sporadic high activations in patent phrases, children’s titles, team names, and numerical math problems, which the primary pattern does not fully explain.

patterns.name: clinical
patterns.context: Occurs in medical abstracts, research plans, or case descriptions, often alongside words such as evaluation, examination, data, problems, trial, and features

patterns.name: Specific words in names or titles
patterns.context: Local trigger words are scattered across a patent phrase, a medical title, and a sports team name, with no consistent contextual condition

patterns.name: Numbers and math problem text
patterns.context: Digit strings and the operators, punctuation, or problem text between them; no context resembling the clinical pattern is evident

4_2839.description: 主要对医学语境中的 clinical 强烈响应，见于摘要、计划及病例；另有专利短语、儿童标题、球队名称和数字数学题中的零散高响应，不能由主模式充分解释。

patterns.name: clinical
patterns.context: 出现在医学摘要、研究计划或病例描述中，常与 evaluation、examination、data、problems、trial、features 等词共现

patterns.name: 名称或标题中的特定词
patterns.context: 局部触发词分散，分别处在专利短语、医学标题、体育队名中，没有一致的上下文条件
patterns.domain: 专利、医学标题、体育票务

patterns.name: 数字与数学题文本
patterns.context: 数字串及其间的运算符、标点或题目文字；未见与临床模式相同的语境

en.concept: clinical and formatting cues in specialized text
en.description: Activations concentrate on clinical terminology and medical/biological contexts; other patterns include polynomial expansion in mathematics and several stylistic formats (dates, case citations, person entries, and experiment titles). Not all triggers can be grouped under a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: The word clinical
patterns.context: clinical appears in academic or professional contexts; [1] concerns educational background, [6] drug monitoring, and [10] medical testing.

patterns.name: Mathematical expansion problem format
patterns.context: Algebraic expressions and stepwise operations, often with asterisks indicating multiplication, variable powers, and line breaks.
patterns.domain: Math exercises or automatically generated solution text

patterns.name: Algebraic expressions with multiple asterisks
patterns.context: Dense symbolic polynomial calculations; a command word is not required.

patterns.name: English date and time format
patterns.context: Dates and times appear together in the form of a press release or webpage timestamp.

patterns.name: U.S. appellate court case heading
patterns.context: A legal case title composed of parties, docket number, court, and decision date.

patterns.name: Drug interactions and monitoring
patterns.context: Discusses clinical monitoring of patients after starting or stopping medication.

patterns.name: Physiology experiment title
patterns.context: A title-style phrase describing an experiment on an isolated animal organ.

patterns.name: Person biography list
patterns.context: An entry composed of a name, position, institution, and brief identifying information.

patterns.name: High-throughput clinical testing context
patterns.context: Describes the application of test-site selection and rapid identification.

4_2839.concept: 专业文本中的临床与格式线索
4_2839.description: 激活集中于临床相关用语和医学/生物专业语境；另有数学多项式展开及若干文体格式模式（日期、判例、人物条目、实验标题）。各触发并非都能归为同一语义模式。

patterns.name: 临床一词
patterns.context: clinical 出现在学术或专业语境中；[1]为教育背景，[6]为药物监测，[10]为医疗检测。

patterns.name: 数学展开题格式
patterns.context: 代数表达式及逐步运算中，常伴有星号表示乘法、变量幂次、换行。
patterns.domain: 数学练习或自动生成的解题文本

patterns.name: 多星号代数表达式
patterns.context: 密集的符号化多项式计算；不要求出现命令词。

patterns.name: 英文日期时间格式
patterns.context: 日期和时刻以新闻稿或网页时间戳的形式连写。
patterns.domain: 网页元数据或发布信息

patterns.name: 美国上诉法院案头信息
patterns.context: 当事人、案号、法院与判决日期构成的法律案件标题。

patterns.name: 药物相互作用与监测
patterns.context: 讨论药物开始或停用后，对患者进行临床监测。

patterns.name: 生理实验标题
patterns.context: 以标题式短语描述离体动物器官的实验研究。

patterns.name: 人物履历列表
patterns.context: 以姓名、职位、机构及简短身份说明组成条目。

patterns.name: 高产临床检测语境
patterns.context: 描述检测站点选择及快速识别的应用场景。

en.concept: certiorari procedural marker in legal text
en.description: The strongest recurring trigger is certiorari in legal text (petition, grant, or denial), especially in U.S. case titles and procedural records. Other localized triggers include the legal phrase well settled, the name Sherman, El Khairy in a medical citation, and Judge Graham in a judge disambiguation entry.

patterns.name: Certiorari terminology
patterns.context: In Supreme Court case titles, procedural histories, or judicial opinions, certiorari appears as a petition, grant, or denial; the word triggers strongly regardless of capitalization.
patterns.domain: U.S. judicial opinions and case records

patterns.name: settled in legal opinions
patterns.context: In legal reasoning, “well settled” introduces an established rule of law.

patterns.name: The name Sherman
patterns.context: The name Sherman appears in criminal case fact summaries, especially near references to defendants, accomplices, and charges.

patterns.name: The cited name El Khairy
patterns.context: The author surname El Khairy appears in a biomedical paper’s reference citation.

patterns.name: Judge Graham entry
patterns.context: A person disambiguation entry lists a judge’s name; the same passage also mentions other judges and court positions.

4_2839.concept: 法律文本中的 certiorari 程序标记
4_2839.description: 最强而反复的触发是法律文本中的 certiorari（申请、受理或拒绝），尤其出现在美国案件标题和程序记录。另有法律固定语 well settled、Sherman 人名、医学引用中的 El Khairy，以及法官消歧词条中的 Judge Graham 等局部触发。

patterns.name: Certiorari 术语
patterns.context: 最高法院案件标题、程序经过或司法意见中，出现 certiorari 的申请、批准或拒绝；该词无论大小写均强烈触发。
patterns.domain: 美国司法判决与案件记录

patterns.name: 法律判决中的 settled
patterns.context: 法律论证中以“well settled”引出已确立的法律规则。

patterns.name: Sherman 人名
patterns.context: 刑事案件事实叙述中出现 Sherman 姓名，尤其与被告、共犯及指控相邻。

patterns.name: El Khairy 引文姓名
patterns.context: 医学论文的参考文献标记中出现作者姓氏 El Khairy。

patterns.name: Graham 法官词条
patterns.context: 人物消歧条目中列出法官姓名；同段还出现多位法官及法院职务。

en.description: Responds to proper nouns and components of institutional names across domains, and often appears in structured lists, titles, statutes, tables, and news summaries. Legal opinions, corporate and institutional names, and research organizations all trigger; no single stable word sense is evident.

patterns.name: Military legal provisions and charge lists
patterns.context: Military justice opinions list charges, offenses, specifications, and provisions of the Uniform Code of Military Justice, often with line breaks and section numbers.

patterns.name: Generic terms in institutional or organizational names
patterns.context: A type of institution or name component in proper nouns, such as a company, research institution, religious organization, record label, or bank; some triggers occur at the end or within a name.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain proper nouns, including encyclopedia, research, email, and legal text

patterns.name: Legal proceedings and judgment language
patterns.context: Civil litigation describes judgments, motions, liability, or bankruptcy provisions, commonly in court opinions.
patterns.domain: FreeLaw, civil opinions and bankruptcy law

patterns.name: Place names and numbered records in tables
patterns.context: List entries separated by tabs and line breaks, with a numeric identifier following a place name or category.
patterns.domain: Tables or administrative data in Enron emails

patterns.name: Place-related religious organizations and practices
patterns.context: Introduces Buddhist or Taoist institutions, branches, or practices in a particular place.

patterns.name: Methods-section heading in research papers
patterns.context: A paper transitions from earlier material to materials and methods, experimental design, and descriptions of research institutions.

patterns.name: News-style business contract reporting
patterns.context: Company news or email summaries report contract awards or agreements, interspersed with company and place names.
patterns.domain: Business news summaries in Enron emails

patterns.name: Record production information in encyclopedia entries
patterns.context: A musician or album entry describes an album’s release region, record label, and producer.

patterns.name: Companies and positions in legal text
patterns.context: Case background describes a deceased person’s or party’s company ownership, position, and other corporate relationships.

patterns.name: Resource project news in Enron emails
patterns.context: Reports that an environmental organization has filed a lawsuit over an oil and gas project, then shifts to other business news.

4_2839.concept: 专名与结构化文本标记
4_2839.description: 响应跨领域的专名与机构名称成分，也常出现在结构化列举、标题、条文、表格和新闻摘要中；法律判决、企业机构名、科研组织等均有触发，未见单一稳定词义。

patterns.name: Military 法律条文与罪名列举
patterns.context: 军事司法判决中列出指控、罪名、规格及《统一军事司法法典》条款，常伴随换行和条款编号。

patterns.name: 机构或组织名称中的泛称词
patterns.context: 专名中的机构类型或名称组成部分，如公司、研究机构、宗教组织、唱片公司或银行；部分触发位于名称末尾或名称内部。
patterns.domain: 跨领域专名，包括百科、科研、邮件和法律文本

patterns.name: 法律程序与判决表达
patterns.context: 民事诉讼叙述判决、动议、责任或破产法条款，常见于法院裁判文本。

patterns.name: 表格中的地名与编号记录
patterns.context: 以制表符和换行分隔的清单条目，地名或类别后接数字识别码。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的表格或行政数据

patterns.name: 地点相关的宗教组织与实践
patterns.context: 介绍某地的佛教、道教机构、分支或实践。

patterns.name: 科研论文的方法部分标题
patterns.context: 论文从前文转入材料与方法、实验设计及研究机构介绍。

patterns.name: 新闻式商业合同报道
patterns.context: 公司新闻或邮件摘要报道授予合同、达成协议，夹杂公司与地点名称。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的商业新闻摘要

patterns.name: 百科条目中的唱片制作信息
patterns.context: 音乐人或专辑条目叙述专辑发行地区、唱片公司和制作人。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的企业与职务叙述
patterns.context: 案件背景介绍死者或当事人的公司所有权、职务及其他企业关系。

patterns.name: Enron 邮件中的资源项目新闻
patterns.context: 报道环保组织针对油气项目提起诉讼，随后转入其他商业新闻。

en.concept: judge titles in U.S. judicial documents
en.description: Responds primarily to Judge and to court positions, institutions, and opinion formats in U.S. legal contexts, especially judge titles. A few isolated word fragments also occur: Helicobacter, theorised, and Geophysics.

patterns.name: Judge titles
patterns.context: Judge is the core trigger after a judge’s name or within a title; preceding titles and judicial role names vary.
patterns.domain: U.S. court opinions, legal documents, and judge biographies; passage [3] also contains an adjacent academic-position context

patterns.name: Judicial institutions and legal-document formats
patterns.context: Occurs in fixed formats such as U.S. judicial institutions, judge signatures, or opinion headings; in some passages this pattern co-occurs with the “Judge” title.
patterns.domain: U.S. legal documents and judiciary-related biographies

patterns.name: Helicobacter name fragment
patterns.context: Activation falls within the bacterial genus name Helicobacter, in a paper title about a new species; it has no clear relation to the judicial theme.

patterns.name: Ending of theorised
patterns.context: Triggered at the ending of the British English verb theorised, in an abstract sentence about galaxy clusters and star formation; it has no clear relation to the judicial theme.

patterns.name: Geophysics position-word ending
patterns.context: Activation occurs in the middle and at the end of Geophysics, in a person’s academic biography and position list; this is not an explicit judicial context.
patterns.domain: Scientific institutions and academic positions in biographies

4_2839.concept: 美国司法文书中的法官头衔
4_2839.description: 主要响应美国司法语境中的 Judge 及法院职务、机构和判决文书格式，尤其是法官头衔；另有少数孤立词片段：Helicobacter、theorised、Geophysics。

patterns.name: 法官头衔
patterns.context: 法官姓名之后或职务称谓中，Judge 是核心触发词；前置头衔与司法职务名称有所不同。
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决、法律文书及法官传记；段 [3] 也出现相邻的学术职务语境

patterns.name: 司法机构与法律文书格式
patterns.context: 出现在美国司法机关、法官署名或判决标题等固定格式中；本模式在部分段落与“Judge”头衔同时出现。
patterns.domain: 美国法律文书及司法相关传记

patterns.name: Helicobacter 学名片段
patterns.context: 触发落在细菌属名 Helicobacter 的词内，位于研究新物种的论文标题中；与司法主题无明显关系。

patterns.name: theorised 词尾
patterns.context: 触发于英国英语动词 theorised 的词尾，出现在关于星系团及恒星形成的摘要句中；与司法主题无明显关系。

patterns.name: 地球物理职务词尾
patterns.context: Geophysics 一词中部及词尾出现激活，处于人物学术履历和职务列表里；并非明确的法官语境。
patterns.domain: 人物传记中的科学机构与学术职务

en.description: The most stable cue is the ending of theorised/theorized in academic contexts; other activations are scattered across the endings of professional or disciplinary names, company names and legal abbreviations, letters in opinion headings, and patent plural endings. They do not form a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Ending of theorised/theorized
patterns.context: Activation falls on the endings of theorise/theorize and their past participles; contexts involve views, mechanisms, or phenomena being proposed or given a theoretical explanation.
patterns.domain: Academic writing, including physics, philosophy, and astrophysics

patterns.name: Endings of professions and disciplines
patterns.context: Activation occurs near endings of words denoting professional identities, disciplines, or research fields; they do not all share the same morphology or fixed meaning.
patterns.domain: Medical history, biographies, and academic introductions

patterns.name: Endings and punctuation in company names
patterns.context: Activation is located at the ends of company names or abbreviations in legal text, often near capital letters, periods, or plural markers.

patterns.name: Letter fragments in opinion headings
patterns.context: Activation falls on individual letters in all-caps headings; available examples are insufficient to determine whether there is a stable meaning.

patterns.name: Plural endings of patent-related words
patterns.context: Activation falls on the plural ending of patent, in a business and intellectual-property promotional context.

4_2839.description: 最稳定的线索是学术语境中 theorised/theorized 的词尾；其余激活零散落在专业或学科名称词尾、公司与法律缩写、判决标题字母及专利复数词尾，无法归为单一语义模式。

patterns.name: theorised/theorized 的词尾
patterns.context: 激活落在 theorise/theorize 及其过去分词的词尾；上下文涉及观点、机制或现象被提出或形成理论解释。
patterns.domain: 学术写作，涵盖物理、哲学、天体物理

patterns.name: 职业与学科名称词尾
patterns.context: 激活出现在表示专业身份、学科或研究领域的词尾附近；并非都属于同一词形或固定语义。
patterns.domain: 医学史、传记与学术介绍

patterns.name: 公司名称中的词尾及标点
patterns.context: 激活位于公司名称或法律文本缩写中的词尾，周围常有大写字母、句点或复数标记。

patterns.name: 判决标题中的字母片段
patterns.context: 激活落在全大写标题中单个字母位置；现有例子不足以判断是否有稳定语义。

patterns.name: 专利相关词的复数词尾
patterns.context: 激活落在专利一词的复数词尾，处于商业与知识产权宣传语境。

en.description: The clearest pattern is the ending of theorized/theorised; it also responds to the military abbreviation Gen. and to punctuation such as periods and commas. Other activations mostly occur in scattered subwords within proper nouns, conjunctions, and isolated words, and are difficult to group; 9 has no clear correspondence.

patterns.name: Participial suffix in theorised
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on the -ized/-ised ending after theor-; the word can occur in passive constructions or academic statements with that-clauses.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, philosophical discussion, encyclopedia history

patterns.name: Periods and abbreviation punctuation
patterns.context: Periods often follow initials, titles, or legal citations; commas occur after names, titles, or coordinated elements. Sometimes the activation marker falls on the punctuation token.

patterns.name: Gen. abbreviation
patterns.context: Gen. is an abbreviation for a military rank or formal title, usually before a person’s name; it also occurs in narratives mentioning generals.
patterns.domain: Legal documents, military-related narratives, film and television cast lists

patterns.name: Subwords within proper nouns
patterns.context: Activation falls within subwords of proper nouns or common words, with meanings unrelated to theorised or punctuation patterns.
patterns.domain: Legal case titles, name lists, news headlines

patterns.name: Conjunctions in lists and titles
patterns.context: Activation follows conjunctions such as and and of in titles or fixed names.

patterns.name: Scattered high-frequency words and symbols
patterns.context: These activations occur in different syntactic environments, with no clear shared local condition in the current sample.
patterns.domain: Academic text, email, encyclopedia prose, etc.

4_2839.concept: 理论化词尾与缩写标点
4_2839.description: 最清楚的模式是 theorized/theorised 的词尾；另对 Gen. 军衔缩写及句点、逗号等标点有反应。其余多为分散的专名内部子词、连接词和零散词，难以归并；9 无清晰对应。

patterns.name: theorised 的分词后缀
patterns.context: 激活集中在 theor- 后接的 -ized/-ised 词尾；词可出现在被动或带 that 从句的学术陈述中。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、哲学论述、百科历史

patterns.name: 句号与缩写标点
patterns.context: 句点常紧跟姓名首字母缩写、头衔或法律引注；逗号出现于姓名、称谓或并列成分之后。激活标记有时落在标点 token。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、人物介绍、叙述性文字

patterns.name: Gen. 缩写
patterns.context: Gen. 作为军衔或正式称谓缩写，通常出现在人名之前；也见于提及将领的叙述。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、军事相关叙述、影视人物表

patterns.name: 专名内部的词尾或子词
patterns.context: 激活落在专名或普通词的内部子词，语义与 theorised 或标点模式并不一致。
patterns.domain: 法律案件标题、人物名单、新闻标题

patterns.name: 列表及标题中的连接成分
patterns.trigger: Cast« and»4 characters、« Supreme» Court« of» Nevada
patterns.context: 标题或固定名称中的 and、of 等连接词后出现激活。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、法律判决标题

patterns.name: 零散高频词与符号
patterns.trigger: « time»、« have»、« long»、« sent»、«>»、« small»、« discovered»
patterns.context: 这些激活分布于不同句法环境，当前样本中没有明确共享的局部条件。
patterns.domain: 学术文本、邮件、百科叙述等

en.description: The most stable cue is the abbreviation “Gen.”, found in military-rank descriptions and various documents. Occupational suffixes and legal titles also activate, but trigger locations vary, and some local word instances cannot be explained consistently.

patterns.name: Military-rank abbreviation Gen.
patterns.context: Appears before a name or military rank, or in the titles and quotations of legal documents; usually abbreviated, often followed by a name or position
patterns.domain: Military narratives, legal cases, cast lists, and quotations

patterns.name: Occupational and title suffixes
patterns.context: Appears in descriptions of a person’s identity, occupation, or formal position; trigger locations are inconsistent and may reflect suffix morphology or a local pattern related to titles
patterns.domain: Research projects, academic biographies, news commentary, and hospital narratives

patterns.name: Legal case titles and formal forms of address
patterns.context: Lists of parties, case numbers, and court names in legal cases; this pattern overlaps with the abbreviation “Gen.”

patterns.name: Gen. Sam Worden cast listings
patterns.context: Military-rank abbreviation before a character name in a cast list
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, film and television cast lists

patterns.name: Nearby words around particular names or quotations
patterns.context: Local neighboring words vary across passages, with no common condition supported by the examples
patterns.domain: Emails, project applications, historical narratives, and scientific papers

4_2839.description: 最稳定的线索是缩写“Gen.”，见于军衔叙述与多种文书；另有职业词尾及法律标题周边激活，但触发位置不一，部分局部词例无法统一解释。

patterns.name: 军衔缩写 Gen.
patterns.trigger: “Gen.”，尤其是“Gen”后接句点；强激活落在缩写内部或其后，如 “Gen«.»10” 和 “Gen«.»9”
patterns.context: 出现在人名或军衔前，或法律文书的标题、引文中；多为缩写形式，常接姓名或职务
patterns.domain: 军事叙述、法律判例、演员表及引文

patterns.name: 职业与头衔词尾
patterns.context: 出现于人物身份、职业或正式职务的描述中；但触发位置并不一致，可能是词尾形态或与头衔相关的局部模式
patterns.domain: 科研项目、学术简介、新闻评论、医院叙述

patterns.name: 法律案件标题与正式称谓
patterns.context: 法律判例中的当事人列举、案件编号和法院名称；本模式与“Gen.”缩写重叠

patterns.name: Gen. Sam Worden演员表
patterns.context: 演员表中角色名之前的军衔缩写

patterns.name: 特定姓名或引文邻近词
patterns.context: 各段局部邻近词各异，未形成可由样例支持的共同条件
patterns.domain: 邮件、项目申请、历史叙述、科学论文

en.description: Activation is scattered across text from many domains, mainly on subword fragments or boundaries within English words. Common forms include medical, technical, and proper-name terms, but there is no stable semantic theme; email quotation markers also activate.

patterns.name: -ic fragments within or at word boundaries
patterns.context: Activation often falls within English words split by BPE, especially on word-final or internal fragments; not all fragments can be traced to the same word or meaning.

patterns.name: Spelling fragments in proper names, book titles, or quotations
patterns.context: Appears in split spellings of proper names, headings, book titles, or common words; activation locations are not fixed and semantic relationships are weak.
patterns.domain: Paper titles, legal citations, technical bibliographies, email quotations, and web text

patterns.name: Medical and biomedical subword fragments
patterns.context: Located in terms such as cell types, research projects, and medical roles, usually as within-word subwords rather than standalone concepts.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers and research funding applications

patterns.name: Helper in code comments
patterns.context: Code comments describe helper methods; activation is on a word fragment within an identifier.

patterns.name: Formatting symbols and quotation markers
patterns.context: Appears at the start of lines in quoted email text, unrelated to the body’s semantics.

4_2839.description: 激活分散在多领域文本中，主要落于英文词的子词片段或边界；常见医学、技术及专名词形，但无稳定语义主题，邮件引用符号也有激活。

patterns.name: 词内或词边界处的 -ic 片段
patterns.trigger: «ic»，另有«Inter»vention、«gr»oup 等可能相邻的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活常落在被 BPE 拆分的英文词内部，尤见于词尾或词中片段；并非所有片段都能归结为同一个词或语义。
patterns.domain: 跨领域英语文本及代码

patterns.name: 专名、书名或引文中的拼写片段
patterns.context: 在专名、标题、书名或普通词的拆分拼写中出现；激活位置不固定，语义关系弱。
patterns.domain: 论文标题、法律引证、技术书目、邮件引文及网页文本

patterns.name: 医学与生物医学专业词片段
patterns.context: 位于细胞类型、研究项目、医学角色等术语中，通常是词内子词而非独立概念。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文及研究资助申请

patterns.name: 代码注释中的 Helper
patterns.context: 代码注释描述辅助方法，激活的是标识符中的词片段。

patterns.name: 格式符号与引用标记
patterns.context: 出现在邮件引用文本的行首，与正文语义无关。

en.description: Activation mainly falls on within-word fragments split by tokenization or on subwords in proper names, often in academic bibliography titles, institution names, book titles, and common words. The fragment in “Principle” recurs, but other triggers are scattered, with no stable semantic or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Word-final or internal fragments in proper names
patterns.context: Activation falls within proper names, compounds, or words split by tokenization, often on a word-final or subword fragment; there is no obvious shared semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Legal entity names, news commentary, technical literature, sports reporting, book titles, and more

patterns.name: Within-word fragment in Principle
patterns.context: Appears in “Principle”; instances occur in a TCP/IP book title, a mathematics paper title, and references to a fundamental theorem in mathematical literature.
patterns.domain: Technical bibliographies, mathematics papers, and academic discussion

patterns.name: Truncated word fragments in academic titles or bibliographies
patterns.context: Highlights fall on subwords in technical terms or scholars’ names, near references or paper titles; overlaps with the “Principle” pattern.
patterns.domain: Computer networking and mathematical academic texts

patterns.name: Grants in administrative or institutional names
patterns.context: Appears at the end of the NIH funding project name “Pilot Intervention and Services Research Grants”.

patterns.name: Review Committee in an institutional committee name
patterns.context: Appears in the formal name of a clinical research review body, followed by the abbreviation CCRRC.

patterns.name: Occupational title in literary text
patterns.context: The word “British clergyman” activates internally, describing the historical figure Morgan Godwyn; it is not obviously connected to the other patterns.

patterns.name: Morphological fragment -ing
patterns.context: Activation is on the latter part of the verb “Unraveling” in a book title, especially the suffix ing; the passage also contains the split form “Lobsters”.
patterns.domain: Book title quoted in a HackerNews comment

4_2839.description: 激活主要落在被分词切开的词内部片段或专名子词，常见于学术书目标题、机构名称、书名及普通词；“Principle”片段重复出现，但其余触发分散，未见稳定语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 专名中的词尾或词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专名、复合词或被分词切开的单词内部，常是词尾或子词片段；没有明显统一语义条件。
patterns.domain: 法律实体名、新闻评论、技术文献、体育报道、书名等

patterns.name: Principle 的词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在“Principle”一词中；分别位于 TCP/IP 书名、数学论文标题及数学文献中对基本定理的称呼。
patterns.domain: 技术书目、数学论文及学术论述

patterns.name: 学术标题或书目中的截断词片段
patterns.context: 高亮落在技术术语或学者姓名的子词片段中，且处于参考书目或论文标题附近；与“Principle”模式重叠。
patterns.domain: 计算机网络与数学学术文本

patterns.name: 行政或机构名称中的 Grants
patterns.context: 出现在 NIH 资助项目名称“Pilot Intervention and Services Research Grants”中，位于申请项目名称末尾。

patterns.name: 机构委员会名称中的 Review Committee
patterns.context: 出现在临床研究审查机构的正式名称中，后接缩写 CCRRC。
patterns.domain: NIH 临床研究行政文本

patterns.name: 文学文本中的职业称谓
patterns.context: “British clergyman”一词内部被激活，描述历史人物 Morgan Godwyn；不显然与其他模式相连。
patterns.domain: 历史叙述或古典非虚构文本

patterns.name: 词尾 ing 的形态片段
patterns.context: 激活位于书名中动词“Unraveling”的后半部分，尤其是词尾 ing；段内还有被拆分的“Lobsters”。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 评论中的书名引用

en.concept: Helper spelling fragment and word fragments
en.description: The most prominent cue is the Helper spelling fragment, found in code comments, object names, and citations of paper authors. Other activations fall within or at the ends of various unrelated words, with no consistent semantic or contextual pattern.

patterns.name: helper string
patterns.context: Activation centers on the Helper spelling fragment in code identifiers or text; in code, it often occurs in descriptions of a Helper object/method.
patterns.domain: Scala, PHP code, and academic paper author citations

patterns.name: Within-word or word-final fragments
patterns.context: Trigger locations are scattered, often falling within or at the end of longer words; there is no stable shared semantic or syntactic context.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, code, forums, legal texts, academic papers, and sports text

4_2839.concept: Helper 拼写片段及词语片段
4_2839.description: 最突出的线索是 Helper 拼写片段，见于代码注释、对象名及论文作者引文；其余激活落在多种互不相关词语的内部或词尾，未显出一致的语义或上下文模式。

patterns.name: helper 字符串
patterns.context: 激活集中在代码标识符或文本中的 Helper 拼写片段；代码中常见于 Helper object/method 的说明。
patterns.domain: Scala、PHP 代码及学术论文引用姓名

patterns.name: 词语内部或词尾片段
patterns.context: 触发位置分散，常落在较长单词的词内或词尾；没有稳定的共同语义或句法环境。
patterns.domain: 百科、代码、论坛、法律、学术论文及体育文本

en.concept: Local fragments in long words, skewed toward legal documents
en.description: The clearest signal is court-martial in military rulings. There are also scattered activations on legal and procedural headings, institution names, and fragments within various long words; meanings and domains vary, and a few activations fall on punctuation or layout.

patterns.name: court-martial language in rulings
patterns.context: Describes a case or defendant in military appellate rulings, often near court, appellant, convicted, and similar terms; ial within the word is especially prominent.

patterns.name: ial / ial-like endings within long words
patterns.context: Activation falls on internal fragments of different long or compound words, with no stable shared meaning; examples include loanwords, proper names, and common words.

patterns.name: Procedural vocabulary in uppercase headings
patterns.context: Within-word fragments activate in all-caps rule, procedure, or document headings.

patterns.name: Support-related words in headings or institution names
patterns.context: Local fragments in office, child, support, and enforcement are marked in all-caps headings in court citations or institution names.

patterns.name: Ruling summaries and document formatting
patterns.context: Near summary headings, judge signatures, or divider lines in rulings; activation falls on heading words or punctuation and whitespace formatting fragments.

patterns.name: Punctuation and layout in formal legal documents
patterns.context: Scattered activations appear near names, colons, conjunctions, or indentation whitespace in ruling text, with no consistent semantic trigger.

4_2839.concept: 长词局部片段，偏法律文书
4_2839.description: 最明确的信号是军事判决中的 court-martial；另有法律与操作标题、机构名及多种长词内部片段的零散激活，词义和领域并不一致，少量激活落在标点或版式上。

patterns.name: court-martial 判决用语
patterns.context: 军事上诉判决叙述案件或被告，常与 court、appellant、convicted 等相邻；该词内部的 ial 特别突出。

patterns.name: 长词内部的 ial / ial 类结尾
patterns.context: 激活落在不同长词或复合词的内部片段，未见稳定共同词义；包括外来词、专名及普通词。

patterns.name: 大写标题中的程序性词汇
patterns.context: 全大写的规则、程序或文件标题中，词内片段激活。
patterns.domain: 法律标题、业务操作文件

patterns.name: 标题或机构名称中的支持相关词
patterns.context: 法院引用或机构名称的全大写标题中，office、child、support、enforcement 的局部片段被标记。
patterns.domain: 法律引用、行政机构名称

patterns.name: 判决摘要及文书格式
patterns.context: 判决书的摘要标题、法官署名或分隔线附近；激活落在标题词或标点、空白格式片段上。

patterns.name: 正式法律文书中的标点与版式
patterns.context: 判决正文的人名、冒号、连接词或缩进空白附近出现零散激活，未显示统一语义触发条件。

en.description: Primarily responds to abbreviations and citation punctuation in legal rulings and case citations, especially Services, Ass’n, and case names with v. It also responds sporadically to judicial procedure terms. One fragment in congratulations activates in an online comment, which cannot be explained by the legal pattern.
