patterns.name: Services abbreviations in judicial opinions
patterns.context: Appears at the end of institution or organization names, usually as an abbreviation of Services, followed by a period, comma, or citation punctuation; not every ordinary plural s triggers.

patterns.name: Ass’n abbreviation in organization names
patterns.context: Abbreviation of Association in organization names; the apostrophe and n are each marked, often near legal citation punctuation.
patterns.domain: Legal rulings, organization names, and citations

patterns.name: v. marker in legal citations
patterns.context: Appears in case names, usually followed by a court or institution name; activation centers on the period rather than v itself.

patterns.name: Fine-grained punctuation in legal citations
patterns.context: Commas, periods, parentheses, and apostrophes within citations, abbreviations, or case names; often adjacent to court or institution abbreviations.
patterns.domain: Legal rulings and formal legal citations

patterns.name: Citations and procedural terminology in legal style
patterns.context: Describes procedure, standards of review, legal claims, or case rules in judicial discussion; these words are marked only in individual passages, with no single stable trigger word.

patterns.name: grats in congratulations
patterns.context: Expresses congratulations on a team release or project progress in an informal comment; activation falls on a split fragment of congratulations.

4_2839.concept: 法律引文与机构名称格式
4_2839.description: 主要响应法律判决与判例引文中的缩写、引文标点，尤其 Services、Ass’n 和案名 v.；也零星响应司法程序词语。另有一次网络评论中 congratulations 的片段激活，无法与法律模式统一解释。

patterns.name: 司法意见中的 Services 缩写
patterns.trigger: «s»10 或 «s»9，常见于 “Human Serv«s».”、“Legal Serv«s».”、“Technical Serv«s».”
patterns.context: 出现在机构或组织名称末尾，通常是 Services 的缩写，后接句点、逗号或引文标点；并非所有普通复数 s 都触发。

patterns.name: 协会名称缩写 Ass’n
patterns.context: 组织名称中的 Association 缩写，撇号和 n 分别被标记；名称附近常有法律引文标点。
patterns.domain: 法律判决、组织名称及引文

patterns.name: 法律引文中的 v. 标记
patterns.trigger: “v«.»5/6”，即案件双方名称之间的 v. 句点
patterns.context: 出现在判例名称中，通常随后是法院或机构名称；激活集中于句点而非 v 本身。

patterns.name: 法律引文中的精细标点
patterns.context: 引文、缩写或案名内部的逗号、句点、括号和撇号；常与法院、机构缩写相邻。
patterns.domain: 法律判决及正式法律引文

patterns.name: 法律文体中的引文与程序术语
patterns.trigger: “« motion»”、“« review»”、“« must»”、“« cases»”、“« under»”、“« framework»”等
patterns.context: 司法论述中描述程序、审查标准、法律主张或判例规则；这些词只在个别段落被标记，未见单一稳定触发词。

patterns.name: 祝贺语中的 grats
patterns.context: 非正式评论中对团队发布或项目进展表示祝贺；激活落在 congratulations 的拆分片段上。

en.description: The most stable pattern is ANALYSIS in legal-document headings. Other activations include the final n in legal citation abbreviations, v. in case titles, and analysis and parentheses in a medical title. Triggers may also involve layout or punctuation features.

patterns.name: ANALYSIS heading in legal documents
patterns.context: Section heading in a legal opinion or ruling, often uppercase and on a separate line, with page breaks, indentation, or line breaks; may also appear in a table of contents.
patterns.domain: U.S. court rulings, legal opinions, and their tables of contents

patterns.name: Letter n in legal documents
patterns.context: In possessive abbreviations or organization names, n after an apostrophe is a high-activation point; it appears in legal citations and attorney lists.

patterns.name: v. marker in ruling text
patterns.context: Adversarial case marker between party names; this instance appears in the title on the first page of a ruling.

patterns.name: IS in a medical paper
patterns.context: Appears in a research project title, as part of the phrase “functional analysis”; not a legal section heading.

patterns.name: H in the abbreviation CGH
patterns.context: The closing parenthesis of the genomic hybridization abbreviation CGH is also highlighted; the same sentence discusses DNA copy-number changes.

4_2839.concept: 法律文书分析标题（兼有标点模式）
4_2839.description: 最稳定的模式是法律文书标题中的 ANALYSIS；另有法律引文缩写的词尾 n、案件标题 v.，以及医学题名中的 analysis 和 CGH 括号。触发可能兼有版式或标点特征。

patterns.name: 法律文书的 ANALYSIS 标题
patterns.context: 法律意见或判决中的章节标题，常为大写、独立成行，并伴随分页、缩进或换行；也可出现在目录标题中。
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决、法律意见及其目录

patterns.name: 法律文书中的 n 字母
patterns.context: 缩写所有格或组织名称时，撇号后的 n 是高激活点；法律引文、律师名单中均有出现。

patterns.name: 判决正文的 v. 标记
patterns.context: 案件当事人名称之间的对抗式案件标记；此例位于判决首页标题中。

patterns.name: 医学论文中的 IS
patterns.context: 出现在研究项目题名中，属于 “functional analysis” 一词；并非法律章节标题。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究项目标题

patterns.name: CGH 缩写的 H
patterns.context: 基因组比较杂交缩写 CGH 的右括号也高亮；同句还谈 DNA 拷贝数变化。

en.description: Prominent activation cues include “carried out” in academic research, genomic research terminology and abbreviations, and a few financial nouns and within-word fragments in internet text; these cues span domains and vary in form.

patterns.name: carried out in past-participle phrases
patterns.context: Appears in passive or perfect constructions about research or analysis, preceded by is/been/first, etc., and followed by the research subject, method, or a for construction

patterns.name: Measurement and characterization terms
patterns.context: Describes phenotypic measurements of CNV carriers, existing cohorts, and follow-up studies

patterns.name: Genomic testing method abbreviations
patterns.context: Describes methods for detecting DNA copy-number changes; activation centers on the end of the method abbreviation

patterns.name: Homologous recombination abbreviation
patterns.context: First defines a biological term abbreviation in an introduction

patterns.name: Plural financial product nouns
patterns.context: Listed alongside stocks, bonds, insurance policies, and annuities as items not covered by the FDIC

patterns.name: Word-final fragments in colloquial internet spelling
patterns.context: Embedded in informal HackerNews comment text, appearing as within-word subword fragments; no clear shared semantic condition

patterns.name: Startup-related suffixes and evaluative expressions
patterns.context: Personal accounts discuss starting a business and use evaluative adjectives to describe the reading experience

4_2839.description: 激活较突出的线索包括学术研究中的“carried out”、基因组研究术语与缩写，以及少量金融名词和互联网文本中的词内片段；这些线索跨领域且形态不一。

patterns.name: 过去分词短语中的 carried out
patterns.trigger: “carried out”，尤以 out 激活最强
patterns.context: 出现在研究或分析的被动/完成式表达中，前接 is/been/first 等，后接研究对象、方法或 for 结构

patterns.name: 测量与表征相关词语
patterns.context: 描述 CNV 携带者的表型测量、既有队列及后续研究

patterns.name: 基因组检测方法缩写
patterns.trigger: “comparative genomic hybridization (CGH)”及“CGH”的结束括号 token
patterns.context: 描述 DNA 拷贝数变化的检测方法；激活集中在方法缩写的末尾

patterns.name: 同源重组缩写
patterns.context: 引言中首次定义生物学术语缩写

patterns.name: 复数金融产品名词
patterns.context: 与 stocks、bonds、insurance policies、annuities 并列，列举不受 FDIC 保障的项目

patterns.name: 口语化互联网拼写中的词尾
patterns.context: 嵌在 HackerNews 评论的非正式文本中，表现为词内子词片段，未见清晰共同语义条件

patterns.name: 创业词尾及评价性表达
patterns.context: 个人经验分享中谈创业，并以评价性形容词描述阅读体验

en.description: Most passages activate on technical abbreviations in parentheses, such as HR, WGS, CGH, HTM, EM, and NGS, often after a full name or technical explanation. Other activations occur on a comparison word, 0, and a question mark in a math problem, and on a time point and unit in an experimental description.

patterns.name: Abbreviations or short forms in parentheses
patterns.context: Abbreviations in parentheses following the full name of a technical term; activation falls within or at the end of the abbreviation. The abbreviations vary in length, and marked positions inside or outside the parentheses are not identical across examples.
patterns.domain: Biomedical research, genomics, microscopy, patent technology text

patterns.name: Numbers and punctuation in a math problem
patterns.context: A short multiple-choice question asks “Which is the closest to 0?”; activation falls on the comparison target, number, and question mark, rather than biomedical terminology.

patterns.name: Time points and units
patterns.context: Time points and the unit hour are marked when describing nucleotide coverage in an experiment or change over time; the same passage also has activations related to abbreviations in parentheses.
patterns.domain: Experimental results or supplementary material in biomedical papers

4_2839.description: 多数段落在括号中的专业缩写处激活，如HR、WGS、CGH、HTM、EM、NGS，常位于全称或技术说明之后；另见数学题的比较词、0与问号，以及一段实验描述中的时间点和单位。

patterns.name: 括号中的缩写或简称
patterns.context: 技术或术语全称之后，以括号形式出现的缩写；激活集中在缩写内部或末尾。各例缩写长度、括号内外标记位置不完全相同。
patterns.domain: 生物医学科研、基因组学、显微成像、专利技术文本

patterns.name: 数学题中的数字与标点
patterns.context: 简短选择题提问“Which is the closest to 0?”，激活落在比较对象、数值及问号上，而非生物医学术语。

patterns.name: 时间点与时间单位
patterns.context: 在描述实验核苷酸覆盖或随时间变化时，时间点及小时单位被标记；但同段还有括号缩写相关激活。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文的实验结果或补充材料说明

en.description: Primarily sensitive to boundary markers around terms, abbreviations, and proper names, especially closing parentheses and hyphens. Also appears in cohort names, URL title paths, and document section formatting, suggesting a general tendency to detect boundaries and separators in structured text.

patterns.name: End markers for terms or abbreviations
patterns.context: At the first definition, closing parenthesis, or compound-term separator of a scientific term or abbreviation; activation is concentrated near term boundaries

patterns.name: Cohort and survey study names
patterns.context: Sequences of names for longitudinal surveys, cohorts, or child research projects
patterns.domain: Social science, public health data catalogs

patterns.name: Hyphens and path fragments in URLs
patterns.context: Web link paths connect title words with hyphens and contain URLs mixing words and punctuation

patterns.name: Document titles and section separators
patterns.context: Section headings, anchors, and separators in Markdown or web dumps

4_2839.description: 主要对术语、缩写及专名的边界标记（尤其括号闭合、连字符）敏感；也出现在队列名称、URL标题路径和文档章节格式中，整体偏向识别结构化文本中的边界与分隔。

patterns.name: 术语或缩写结束标记
patterns.trigger: 缩写或专名末尾的右括号，如“(WGS)”中的“)”（10）、“(CGH)”中的“)”（10）、“(EM)”中的“)”（10）、“(HR)”中的“)”（9）、“(NGS)”中的“)”（9）；另有“cry-o-EM”中的连字符（9）
patterns.context: 科学术语或缩写在首次定义、括号闭合或复合术语分隔处；激活集中在术语边界附近
patterns.domain: 生物医学、遗传学、科研文本

patterns.name: 队列与调查研究名称
patterns.context: 成串出现的纵向调查、队列或儿童研究项目名称
patterns.domain: 社会科学、公共卫生数据目录

patterns.name: URL中的连字符与路径片段
patterns.trigger: URL中的“-”，如“Economic-History-At-what-point-did-the-US-”和“the-rise-of-functional-programming-f-scala-haskell-and”（连字符强度最高为9）
patterns.context: 网页链接路径将标题词以连字符连接，包含单词与标点混合的URL

patterns.name: 文档标题与章节分隔
patterns.context: Markdown或网页转储中的章节标题、锚点和分隔符

en.concept: English content-word triggers with inconsistent semantics
en.description: Strong activation appears across multiple content words: fit (meaning either model fitting or capacity to hold), signature, currency, Significance, and infinity. Apart from fit, there is no clear shared semantics or stable context.

patterns.name: fit and model fitting
patterns.context: Discusses fitting difficulties, curve fitting, or whether a method calls fit in relation to models, algorithms, or data; the trigger word appears in different syntactic positions.
patterns.domain: StackExchange: machine learning, data analysis, software libraries

patterns.name: fit meaning capacity to hold
patterns.context: Indicates whether a value can fit within a finite bit width, not model fitting.

patterns.name: Fixed phrases with signature
patterns.context: Appears in “signature model” (a flagship model) and “clinical signature” (clinical characteristics); the meanings differ by context.
patterns.domain: Pile-CC product copy; NIH biomedical text

patterns.name: currency
patterns.context: Asks about the data type for currency in Kotlin; the word occurs in a title-style question.

patterns.name: Significance as a title word
patterns.context: “Significance” appears at the beginning of a title, followed by a topic about proton tunneling.

patterns.name: infinity norm phrase
patterns.context: Appears in the mathematical term “squared infinity norm.”

4_2863.concept: 英文内容词触发，语义不统一
4_2863.description: 强激活跨多种内容词出现：fit（含拟合与容量容纳义）、signature、currency、Significance、infinity；除 fit 外没有明显统一语义或稳定语境。

patterns.name: fit及拟合
patterns.context: 围绕模型、算法或数据讨论拟合困难、曲线拟合，或某方法是否调用 fit；触发词在不同句法位置均出现。
patterns.domain: StackExchange：机器学习、数据分析、软件库

patterns.name: fit 作容量容纳义
patterns.context: 表示某个数值能否容纳在有限位宽中，非模型拟合义。

patterns.name: signature 固定搭配
patterns.context: 分别出现在“signature model”（标志性型号）和“clinical signature”（临床特征）中；语境义不同。
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 产品文案；NIH 生物医学文本

patterns.name: currency
patterns.context: 询问 Kotlin 中货币的数据类型；该词处于标题式问题中。

patterns.name: Significance 标题词
patterns.context: 标题开头的“Significance”，后接质子隧穿主题。

patterns.name: infinity norm 短语
patterns.context: 出现在“squared infinity norm”这一数学术语中。

en.concept: Triggers from terms such as fit, signature, and infinity
en.description: Strong responses are distributed across fit in StackExchange titles/questions, signature in noun phrases across different fields, and infinity in mathematical contexts; there is also one instance of fit meaning that a value can fit within a number of bits. The commonality is weak and mainly reflects specific lexical triggers.

patterns.name: fit in StackExchange question titles
patterns.context: “fit” appears in StackExchange question titles or technical descriptions asking how to fit a model, curve, or algorithm, or why an object does not call fit; nearby wording often includes “Why,” “how to,” or “curve.”
patterns.domain: StackExchange technical Q&A covering machine learning, programming, and data analysis

patterns.name: The word signature
patterns.context: The term occurs in noun phrases referring to characteristics, a hallmark, or a style: clinical characteristics, product style, or gene expression characteristics; it is not limited to one field.

patterns.name: Near infinity
patterns.context: Mathematical contexts discussing the infinity norm or the behavior of a sequence at infinity.
patterns.domain: Mathematics and theoretical computer science Q&A

patterns.name: Describing whether a value can fit
patterns.context: Used as a verb to describe whether a value or data can fit in a finite number of bits; not model fitting.

4_2863.description: 强响应分布在 StackExchange 标题/问题中的 fit、不同领域名词短语中的 signature，以及数学语境的 infinity；另有一次 fit 表示数值可装入位数。共同点较弱，主要是特定词项触发。

patterns.name: StackExchange 问题标题中的 fit
patterns.context: “fit”出现在 StackExchange 问题标题或技术问题描述中，询问如何拟合模型、曲线或算法，或某个对象为何不调用 fit；前后常有 “Why”“how to”“curve”等表述。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答，涉及机器学习、编程和数据分析

patterns.name: signature 一词
patterns.context: 术语出现在名词短语中，指特征、标志或风格：临床特征、产品风格或基因表达特征；不是固定单一领域。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文摘要与音乐/乐器介绍

patterns.name: infinity 附近
patterns.context: 数学语境中讨论无穷范数或序列在无穷处的行为。
patterns.domain: 数学与理论计算机科学问答

patterns.name: 描述数值能否 fit
patterns.context: 作为动词，描述数值或数据能否装入有限位数的表示中；并非拟合模型。

en.description: The most stable local cue is the ending -zed, found in fuzzed, analyzed, catalyzed, razed, and decolourized. There is also activation on signature, technical/mathematical terms, and occasional split fragments of long words; sources and semantics vary widely.

patterns.name: The -zed ending
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated in past participles or adjectives spelled with the ending zed; stems and meanings vary widely.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain text, including technology discussions, structured data, academic papers, legal texts, and narrative writing

patterns.name: signature and nearby contexts
patterns.context: Appears in “clinical signature,” referring to clinical characteristics, and “signature model”/“signature style,” referring to a musician’s style or a product model; nearby unmarked parts of the same word may also activate.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts; music and product descriptions

patterns.name: Integer and mathematics question formats
patterns.context: Code/data-structure key-value fragments or math expressions posed in Q&A format; includes technical terms and structured symbols.
patterns.domain: StackExchange technical Q&A and code snippets

patterns.name: Subword fragments in organ terms or proper names
patterns.context: Activation falls on fragments of split long words; the former is a medical term, while the latter is the name Mark Tremonti. Their relation to other patterns is unclear.

4_2863.concept: 含 -zed 词尾及若干词汇偶发响应
4_2863.description: 最稳定的局部线索是词尾 -zed，见 fuzzed、analyzed、catalyzed、razed、decolourized。另有 signature、技术/数学术语及少数拆分长词片段激活；来源和语义跨度较大。

patterns.name: 词尾 -zed
patterns.context: 激活集中在拼写以 zed 结尾的过去分词或形容词中；词干和语义差异很大。
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本，包括科技讨论、结构化数据、学术论文、法律及叙述性文章

patterns.name: signature 及相邻语境
patterns.context: 分别出现在临床特征表述“clinical signature”和音乐家风格、型号表述“signature model”“signature style”中；未标记的同词相邻部分也可能有激活。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要；音乐与产品介绍

patterns.name: 整数与数学问题格式
patterns.context: 代码/数据结构键值片段，或以问答形式提出数学表达式；包含技术术语与结构化符号。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答及代码片段

patterns.name: 器官或专名中的分词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分的长词片段上；前者为医学术语，后者为人名 Mark Tremonti，是否与其他模式有关不明确。

en.concept: Split word endings in scientific terminology
en.description: High activation often falls on the endings of split words, especially -zed in hydrolyzed, catalyzed, and analyzed; there are also responses to scientific terms such as thermonuclear, homonuclear, decolourized, PTFE names, and ferritin.

patterns.name: Hydrolysis and related enzymatic processes
patterns.context: Verbs are split into tokens, especially in past participles or academic prose; hydrolyzed occurs in descriptions of chemical conversion, polymer/drug or membrane-protein processing; catalyzed occurs in enzymatic reactions; analyzed occurs in results analysis.
patterns.domain: Biochemistry, medicinal chemistry, materials science, experimental papers

patterns.name: Homonnuclear molecule-related terms
patterns.context: Describes homonuclear molecules and their infrared activity in an astrophysical context; activation falls on the latter part of the split word.

patterns.name: Thermonuclear explosion terminology
patterns.context: Describes thermonuclear explosions as a possible origin of hydrogen-free supernovae in accreting or merging systems; activation falls on the latter part of the split word.

patterns.name: Decolorization treatment
patterns.context: In an experimental method involving H₂O₂ treatment of a polysaccharide sample, the latter part of the past participle activates strongly.

patterns.name: Fluoropolymer names
patterns.context: Patent background on electrodes, membranes, and copolymer compositions; the PTFE name is split, and hydrolyzed also appears in the same passage.

patterns.name: Ferritin-related terms
patterns.context: Biochemical research on the release of non-heme, non-ferritin iron in liver microsomes; activation falls within the split word ferritin.

4_2863.concept: 科学术语中的拆分词尾
4_2863.description: 高激活常落在拆分词的词尾，尤以 -zed 的 hydrolyzed、catalyzed、analyzed 为主；另对 thermonuclear、homonuclear、decolourized、PTFE名称及 ferritin 等科学术语有反应。

patterns.name: hydrolysis及其相关酶促过程
patterns.context: 动词被拆分为 token，尤其在过去分词或论文叙述中；hydrolyzed出现在化学转化、聚合物/药物或膜蛋白处理中，catalyzed出现在酶促反应中，analyzed出现在结果分析中。
patterns.domain: 生物化学、药物化学、材料科学、实验论文

patterns.name: 同核分子相关术语
patterns.context: 天体物理语境中描述同核分子及其红外活性；激活落在拆分词的后半部分。

patterns.name: 热核爆炸术语
patterns.context: 描述无氢超新星可能起源于吸积或并合系统的热核爆炸；激活落在拆分词的后半部分。

patterns.name: 脱色处理
patterns.context: 多糖样品经H₂O₂处理的实验方法中，过去分词后半部分强激活。
patterns.domain: 生物材料/多糖研究摘要

patterns.name: 含氟聚合物名称
patterns.context: 电极、膜及共聚物组成的专利背景；PTFE名称被切分，且同段也出现hydrolyzed。

patterns.name: 铁蛋白相关词项
patterns.context: 肝微粒体中非血红素、非铁蛋白铁释放的生化研究；激活落在拆分的ferritin词内。

en.description: Activation is scattered across heterogeneous corpora: some falls on the letter sequence th, while other instances involve the km distance unit, HTML form markup, and submitted in research-data or creative-work contexts. There is no unified semantic pattern covering all examples.

patterns.name: Unicode character sequence th in scientific papers
patterns.context: Activation falls within words containing the letter sequence th, often appearing as a standalone subword fragment; nearby words and semantics vary widely across examples.
patterns.domain: Mostly ArXiv or biomedical research texts; also NIH records

patterns.name: Distance unit km with a comma
patterns.context: Geographic entries give distances between two places in kilometers; values and nearby place names vary.

patterns.name: HTML form tag attributes
patterns.context: File-input and submit-button tags in an HTML form, followed by PHP file-submission handling code.

patterns.name: Biology data submission term
patterns.context: A sentence states that raw sequencing data have been submitted to the NCBI SRA database.

patterns.name: submitted in a congratulatory message
patterns.context: A congratulatory message to participants mentions that they submitted their entries.

4_2863.description: 激活分散在异质语料中：部分落在 th 字母片段，另有 km 距离单位、HTML 表单标记，以及科研数据或作品语境中的 submitted；没有覆盖全部例子的统一语义模式。

patterns.name: 科学论文中的 Unicode 字符 th
patterns.trigger: «th»9（见 “therm«onuclear»” 所在词跨 token 分段处、「70 «th»ousand」、「(«as»th«ma»)」及 «th»ias）
patterns.context: 激活落在含 th 字母序列的词内，且常以独立子词片段出现；各例中附近的词和语义差异很大。
patterns.domain: 多为 ArXiv 或医学科研文本；也有 NIH 记录

patterns.name: 带逗号的距离单位 km
patterns.trigger: «km»4，前面是距离数值、后面常接地名方位或地点
patterns.context: 地理条目按公里给出两个地点间的距离；数值和周边地点名各异。

patterns.name: HTML 表单标签属性
patterns.context: HTML 表单中的文件输入与提交按钮标签，后接 PHP 文件提交处理代码。

patterns.name: 生物学数据提交词
patterns.context: 句中说明原始测序数据已提交至 NCBI SRA 数据库。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 生物医学论文

patterns.name: 祝贺语中的 submitted
patterns.context: 面向参赛者的祝贺文字中，提及大家提交了参赛作品。

en.description: The most stable feature is the ordinal suffix “th” after numbers, appearing across dates, rankings, and mathematical indexing; several passages also contain calendar dates, while a few involve physics/mathematical symbols or sports rankings.

patterns.name: Ordinal suffix th
patterns.context: The ordinal suffix after a number, especially in dates, rankings, or mathematical indices; activation is concentrated on th itself, not the corresponding number.
patterns.domain: Email, academic papers, Q&A, sports commentary, IRC

patterns.name: Dates and scheduling information
patterns.context: Calendar dates, event dates, or deadlines; often accompanied by weekdays, months, years, times, and scheduling terms such as deadline and Date.
patterns.domain: Corporate email, conference notices, event invitations, academic CVs

patterns.name: The kth/jth object in mathematics or physics
patterns.context: A symbol or variable with an ordinal suffix refers to an indexed object, measurement interval, or repeated trial; a natural-language date context is not required.

patterns.name: Places and rankings
patterns.context: Describes rankings or placements in sports discussions; in addition to 4th, top 10 may also be a related ranking expression.

patterns.name: Date fields in formatted records
patterns.context: Date fields in metadata lists containing authors, dates, titles, and similar information.
patterns.domain: Academic paper author information or CVs

4_2863.description: 最稳定特征是数字后的序数后缀“th”，跨日期、排名及数学编号出现；多段还含日程日期，少数为物理/数学符号或体育名次语境。

patterns.name: 序数词后缀 th
patterns.context: 数字之后的序数后缀，尤其日期、排名或数学指标中的序数；激活集中在 th 本身，而非对应的数字。
patterns.domain: 邮件、学术论文、问答、体育评论、IRC

patterns.name: 日期与日程信息
patterns.context: 日历日期、活动日期或截止日期；常伴随星期、月份、年份、时间及 deadline、Date 等日程词。
patterns.domain: 企业邮件、会议通知、活动邀请、学术履历

patterns.name: 数学或物理中的第 k/j 个对象
patterns.context: 符号或变量加序数后缀，指某个编号对象、测量区间或重复试验；不要求自然语言日期语境。

patterns.name: 名次与排名
patterns.context: 体育讨论中描述排名或名次；除 4th 外，top 10 也可能是相关的排名表达。

patterns.name: 格式化记录中的日期字段
patterns.context: 作者、日期、标题等元数据列表中的日期字段。
patterns.domain: 学术论文作者信息或履历

en.concept: Numbers, proper names, and structured text fragments
en.description: Activation is scattered across numbers and their subwords, proper-name fragments, hardware models, code fields, and table symbols; there are also sporadic common function words and quoted text. No unified semantics or stable syntactic trigger conditions are apparent across corpora.

patterns.name: Numbers and unit/identifier formats
patterns.context: Numbers occur in parameters, serial numbers, floors, dates, or technical specifications with units; in many cases, activation falls on subword fragments of numbers.
patterns.domain: Technical documentation, astronomy papers, hardware tables, encyclopedias, event names

patterns.name: Proper names and internal subword fragments
patterns.context: Activation often falls on proper names, author surnames, institution names, or their split fragments, with no unified word meaning or syntactic environment.

patterns.name: Hardware models and product names
patterns.context: Occurs in processor specification tables or code class names, often alongside generation, model, process node, or structured fields.

patterns.name: Short function words and common collocations
patterns.context: Occasional activation in continuous text, including grammatical function words and common collocations; no stable local syntactic condition is apparent.
patterns.domain: Email, academic papers, encyclopedias, and medical web text

patterns.name: Structured code and table symbols
patterns.context: Occurs in semicolon-separated record-like data or code structures such as class definitions and field declarations.

patterns.name: Quoted words and quotation marks
patterns.context: Words are quoted in a sentence explaining the symbolic meaning of floor numbers; activation also appears on scattered word fragments and numbers.

patterns.name: Medical event titles and ordinal numbers
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated in a formal event title following website information; the title includes an ordinal and title-style capitalization.

4_2863.concept: 数字、专名与结构化文本片段
4_2863.description: 激活分散于数字及其子词、专名片段、硬件型号、代码字段与表格符号；另有零散普通功能词和引号内文本。不同语料中未见统一语义或稳定句法触发条件。

patterns.name: 数字与单位、编号格式
patterns.context: 数字出现在参数、序号、楼层、日期或带单位的技术规格中；多处激活落在数字的子词片段上。
patterns.domain: 技术文档、天文学论文、硬件表格、百科、活动名称

patterns.name: 专名和词内子词片段
patterns.context: 激活常落在专有名词、作者姓氏、机构名或其分词片段上，且没有统一的词义或句法环境。
patterns.domain: 邮件、学术论文及参考文献

patterns.name: 硬件型号与产品名
patterns.context: 出现在处理器规格表或代码类名中，常与代际、型号、制程或结构化字段并列。

patterns.name: 短功能词及常见搭配
patterns.context: 在连续文本中偶有激活，包含普通语法功能词和常见搭配；未见稳定的局部句法条件。
patterns.domain: 邮件、学术论文、百科及医学网页文本

patterns.name: 结构化代码与表格符号
patterns.context: 出现在分号分隔的类似记录数据，或类定义、字段声明等代码结构内。

patterns.name: 引号内词语与引号标点
patterns.context: 词语被引号标出，且处于解释楼层数字寓意的句子中；同时激活散落在词内分片和数字上。

patterns.name: 医学活动标题与序数词
patterns.context: 激活集中在网站信息后的正式活动标题，包含序数词和标题式大小写。

en.concept: Mixed features of subword fragments and formatting boundaries
en.description: Activation is scattered across common English words, internal word substrings, code and markup syntax, proper names and numbers, and newline boundaries; there is no stable single semantic or domain theme, and some behavior may reflect subword fragments and formatting.

patterns.name: Split suffixes or internal word fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments inside complete words or identifiers, rather than on stable whole words; some fragments may be word endings near tokenization boundaries.
patterns.domain: Mixed text including code, names, and URLs; segments 1, 5, and 10

patterns.name: English word forms and common phrases
patterns.context: Occurs in natural English sentences, involving demonstratives, common words, word endings, or letters in abbreviations; collocations vary across segments.

patterns.name: Technical terms and code syntax
patterns.context: Embedded in JavaScript event-handler code or patent technical prose, involving window resizing, image sensors, and frequency limits.

patterns.name: Specific internal substrings and terminology
patterns.context: Occurs in biomedical sentences describing mechanisms of interaction between labels; trigger locations include term endings and complete terms.

patterns.name: Fragments near proper names, dates, and values
patterns.context: Located in descriptions of drug transaction timelines and journal impact-factor rankings; words are adjacent to numbers/ordinals but lack a shared semantic theme.

patterns.name: List formatting and newline characters
patterns.context: Activation occurs at the end of code or at newline positions in author-address lists, possibly reflecting formatting boundaries.

patterns.name: MVC-related terminology
patterns.context: In sentences discussing micro-views, macro-view, and typical MVC, activation falls on several common function words.

patterns.name: Name and place fragments
patterns.context: Names, cities, or countries in author and institutional address text; trigger fragments do not form a consistent type of proper name.

patterns.name: XML/configuration field fragments
patterns.context: Occurs in XML attributes, paths, and string content; markers fall on tag names or domain fragments.

4_2863.concept: 词片段与格式边界混合特征
4_2863.description: 激活分散于英语常见词、词内子串、代码与标记语法、专名数字及换行边界；未见稳定的单一语义或领域主题，部分表现可能来自分词片段与格式。

patterns.name: 拆分后缀或词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在完整词或标识符内部的子词片段上，而非稳定的完整词；部分片段可能是分词边界附近的词尾。
patterns.domain: 代码、姓名、网址等混合文本；段1、5、10

patterns.name: 英语词形与常见短语
patterns.context: 出现在自然英语句子中，涉及指示词、常见词、词尾或缩写中的字母；各段中的搭配并不一致。

patterns.name: 技术术语及代码语法
patterns.context: 嵌在 JavaScript 事件处理代码或专利技术叙述中，涉及窗口调整大小、图像传感器和频率限制。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 代码、专利技术文本

patterns.name: 特定词内子串与术语
patterns.context: 出现在描述标签相互作用机制的生物医学句子中，触发位置包括术语词尾及完整术语。

patterns.name: 专名、日期及数值附近片段
patterns.context: 位于药物交易时间线、期刊影响因子排名等叙述中，词语与数字/序数相邻，但缺少共同语义主题。

patterns.name: 列表格式与换行符
patterns.context: 激活出现在代码末尾或作者地址列表中的换行位置，可能反映格式边界。

patterns.name: MVC相关用语
patterns.context: 谈论 micro-views、macro-view 及典型 MVC 的句子中，激活落在若干常见功能词上。

patterns.name: 人名及地名片段
patterns.context: 作者及其机构所在地的姓名、城市或国家文本；触发片段不构成一致的专名类型。

patterns.name: XML/配置字段片段
patterns.context: 出现在 XML 属性、路径和字符串内容中，标记落在标签名或域名片段上。

en.description: Primarily responds to the th suffix in ordinal expressions and the up to structure indicating a quantity limit; the former occurs in dates, rankings, editions, and grades, while the latter occurs in quantity limits in technical text.

patterns.name: Ordinal suffix th
patterns.context: The -th suffix in ordinal numbers or words; occurs in dates, editions, rankings, and grade expressions
patterns.domain: Competitions, dates, academic and patent texts

patterns.name: up to quantity structure
patterns.context: Indicates an upper bound or maximum quantity, followed by a number, quantity phrase, or quantified object

4_2863.description: 主要响应序数表达中的 th 后缀，以及表示数量上限的 up to 结构；前者见于日期、名次、届次和年级，后者见于技术文本中的数量限定。

patterns.name: 序数词后缀 th
patterns.context: 序数数字或词语的 -th 后缀；出现在日期、届次、名次、年级等表达中
patterns.domain: 赛事、日期、学术与专利文本

patterns.name: up to 数量结构
patterns.trigger: «up»« to»，以及后续数量，如 «up»« to»10« three»、«up»« to»9
patterns.context: 表示上限或最大数量，后接数词、数量短语或量化对象
patterns.domain: 专利、科研项目、技术说明

en.concept: Ordinal suffix and heterogeneous text patterns
en.description: Primarily activates on the ordinal suffix th and expressions involving years, grades, and dates; additional local patterns include a paper rank title, copyright templates, medical results and fifth-grade research, military narration, and colloquial rhetorical questions.

patterns.name: Ordinal suffix th
patterns.context: A number is directly followed by th, commonly forming dates, grades, years, or ordinals; activation falls on the suffix th
patterns.domain: Papers, medical abstracts, promotional copy, encyclopedias, and general text

patterns.name: rank in a title or proper name
patterns.context: higher appears next to rank in a paper title or filename

patterns.name: Copyright declaration template words
patterns.context: License and copyright declarations in comments at the beginning of source files; activation spans multiple template words

patterns.name: Low values and reduction-result statements
patterns.context: Describes a reduced metric in an intervention group compared with a control group or previous data, accompanied by comparisons and results wording

patterns.name: School-grade participants
patterns.context: Recruitment or description of fifth-grade students in a school study, involving consent to participate and research aims

patterns.name: Specific historical date format
patterns.context: An observation date composed of a day, ordinal suffix, and month

patterns.name: Military equipment and action words
patterns.context: Describes an aircraft and its close flyby over a warship; this segment does not show the preceding ordinal or title pattern

patterns.name: Function words in rhetorical questions
patterns.context: Informal dialogue asks how replacing the battery would solve the problem and expresses doubt in a hedging tone

4_2863.concept: 序数后缀与异质文本模式
4_2863.description: 主要对序数 th 后缀及其所在的年份、年级、日期等表达激活；另有论文 rank 标题、版权模板、医学结果与五年级研究、军事叙述及口语反问等局部模式。

patterns.name: 序数后缀 th
patterns.context: 数字后直接接 th，常构成日期、年级、年度或序数；激活落在后缀 th 上
patterns.domain: 论文、医学摘要、宣传文案、百科及一般文本

patterns.name: 标题或专名中的 rank
patterns.context: higher 与 rank 相邻，出现在论文标题或文件名中

patterns.name: 版权声明模板词
patterns.trigger: « *»3 @license«↵»2« *»2 Copyright« (»1c«)»1« 2012»2 VM«ware»2,« Inc»2«.»3 All Rights« Reserved»4
patterns.context: 源代码文件开头的注释式许可证与版权声明，激活覆盖多个模板词

patterns.name: 低值及降低结果表述
patterns.trigger: « lower»、« lower»3« prevalence»、« lower»2 mean total cholesterol
patterns.context: 描述干预组相较对照或既往数据的降低指标，并伴随比较、结果表述

patterns.name: 学校年级受试者
patterns.context: 学校研究招募或描述五年级学生，涉及同意参与及研究目的

patterns.name: 特定历史日期格式
patterns.context: 日、序数后缀和月份组成的观测日期

patterns.name: 军事装备及动作词
patterns.trigger: «24»2« that»3 bu«z»1«zed»9« the»1 USS Donald Cook
patterns.context: 描述军机及其对军舰的近距离飞越；该片段未呈现前述序数或标题模式

patterns.name: 反问句中的功能词
patterns.trigger: How« would»6« that»9 help? Not doub«ting»2 you
patterns.context: 口语化对话中询问电池更换如何解决问题，并以缓和语气表达怀疑

en.concept: Numerical and formatting fragments in scientific text
en.description: Primarily responds to comparative thresholds, ranges, and unit expressions near numbers, and also to the ordinal suffix “th”; sporadic activations also occur in statistical terminology, methodological phrasing, and fixed phrases.

patterns.name: Threshold and numerical range expressions
patterns.context: Activations cluster around numerical expressions of comparative thresholds, bounds, or limits; numbers are split into multiple tokens, with units or following nouns immediately after them.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, patents, medical statistics, and mathematical explanations

patterns.name: Ordinal suffixes in ordinal numbers
patterns.context: Occurs in ordinals formed from numbers, indicating conference editions, months, or sequence numbers; activation falls on the ordinal suffix.
patterns.domain: Technical references, forum names, mathematical/financial explanations

patterns.name: Magnitude or unit fragments in measurement units
patterns.context: A physical unit follows a number or magnitude expression; activation falls on the unit word or one of its components.

patterns.name: Word-form fragments in statistical terminology
patterns.context: The term appears in explanations of methods, statistical results, or analytical workflows, without clear dependence on a numerical threshold.

patterns.name: Method- or operation-related phrasing
patterns.context: Occurs when introducing methods for applying materials or describing computer program execution; its relationship to the main numerical formatting pattern is unclear.
patterns.domain: Patent background sections, computer architecture papers

patterns.name: Phrase fragments in fixed terminology
patterns.context: Occurs as part of the fixed term “fit-for-purpose validation,” without clear numerical or ordinal conditions.

4_2863.concept: 科学文本中的数值与格式片段
4_2863.description: 主要响应数字附近的比较阈值、范围和单位表达，也响应序数词后缀“th”；另见统计术语、方法措辞及固定短语中的零散激活。

patterns.name: 阈值和数值范围表达
patterns.context: 激活集中在比较阈值、上下界或限制范围的数值表述中；数字被拆成多个 token，单位或后续名词紧随其后。
patterns.domain: 科学论文、专利、医学统计及数学说明

patterns.name: 序数词中的序数后缀
patterns.context: 出现在数字构成的序数词中，表示论文届次、月份或序号；激活落在序数后缀上。
patterns.domain: 技术参考文献、论坛名称、数学/金融说明

patterns.name: 度量单位中的数量级或单位片段
patterns.context: 数字或数量级表达后接物理单位；激活落在单位词或其组成部分上。

patterns.name: 统计术语中的词形片段
patterns.context: 术语处于方法、统计结果或分析流程的说明中，未明显依赖数值阈值。

patterns.name: 方法/操作相关措辞
patterns.context: 在介绍材料应用方法或计算机程序执行时出现；与主要数值格式模式关系不明。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、计算机体系结构论文

patterns.name: 固定术语中的短语片段
patterns.context: 作为“fit-for-purpose validation”固定术语的一部分出现，未见明确数值或序数条件。
patterns.domain: 生物分析方法与监管术语

en.description: The most stable feature is the ordinal suffix th (across all segments), with occasional st and nd; commonly found in dates, centuries, sequence numbers, and medical location expressions. Several local word activations do not fit this pattern.

patterns.name: Ordinal suffix th
patterns.context: The ordinal suffix th is highlighted on its own; the number can indicate a date, month, century, rank, or sequence number, often followed by a noun or date element.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain; paper citations, medicine, astronomical observations, history, finance, email, and dates in mathematical literature

patterns.name: Other ordinal suffixes
patterns.context: Numerical ordinals ending in st or nd; as with the th pattern, they indicate order or dates.
patterns.domain: Financial text, dates in mathematical papers

patterns.name: Date/sequence expressions around th
patterns.context: The ordinal is embedded in expressions for date ranges, days of gestation, or anatomical locations; adjacent function words also activate in addition to the suffix.

patterns.name: Century expressions with th century
patterns.context: The ordinal suffix th is followed by century to indicate a century; preceded by a definite article or century-related context.

patterns.name: Ordinal months/dates and date phrasing
patterns.context: An ordinal number is combined with a month name, or of introduces the month; expresses an observation date or paper submission date.
patterns.domain: Astronomical observation records, history of mathematical papers

patterns.name: Local accompanying activations that do not fit the ordinal pattern
patterns.context: These words are highlighted in their respective contexts, but have no clear connection to the shared pattern of ordinal suffixes th/st/nd; they may be local co-activations or independent activations.
patterns.domain: Patent citations, historical narratives, financial formulas, mathematical notation

4_2863.description: 最稳定的特征是序数数字后缀 th（覆盖全部段），少数出现 st、nd；常见于日期、世纪、序号及医学位置表达。另有若干无法由此模式解释的局部词语激活。

patterns.name: 序数词后缀 th
patterns.context: 序数数字后缀 th 被单独标出；数字可表示日期、月份、世纪、排名或序号，后面常接名词或日期成分。
patterns.domain: 跨领域；论文引文、医学、天文观测、历史、金融、邮件及数学文献日期

patterns.name: 其他序数后缀
patterns.context: 数字序数后缀以 st 或 nd 结尾；与 th 模式相同，表示次序或日期。
patterns.domain: 金融文本、数学论文日期

patterns.name: th 前后的日期/序号表达
patterns.trigger: 如“on»1« the»1 11«th»10 through 14«th»6« day»2« of»2 gestation”“between« the»1 5«th»9 and 6«th»6 vertebra”
patterns.context: 序数词嵌在日期范围、孕期日数或解剖位置等表达中；除后缀外，相邻功能词也有激活。

patterns.name: th century 世纪表达
patterns.context: 序数后缀 th 后接 century，表示世纪；前有定冠词或世纪主题语境。

patterns.name: 序数月份/日期与日期措辞
patterns.trigger: “25«th»8« November»1”“20«th»9« April»2”“12«th»9« of»4« May»3”“2«nd»7« of»5« June»2”
patterns.context: 序数数字与月份名称组合，或用 of 引出月份；表达观测日期或论文提交日期。
patterns.domain: 天文学观测记录、数学论文史

patterns.name: 不符合序数模式的局部伴随激活
patterns.trigger: “« workers»1”“« preventing»1« this»1”“returns« of»3« your»2”“«{»2G«}_»1«2»2”“« Compressed»2« Programs»2”
patterns.context: 这些词在各自语境中被标记，但与序数后缀 th/st/nd 的共同模式没有清楚联系；可能是局部伴随或独立激活。
patterns.domain: 专利引文、历史叙述、金融公式、数学符号

en.description: Primarily responds to ordinal suffixes st (especially 1st) and th after English numbers, appearing widely in dates, editions, and academic numbering. Additional accompanying patterns include medical paper titles, patient grouping, and date/number formats; some fragments are not adequately explained by the ordinal pattern.

patterns.name: Ordinal suffix st
patterns.context: Functions as an ordinal suffix, usually following a number; especially 1st, but also appears in 21st.
patterns.domain: Various styles, including academic papers, medical texts, legal records, patents, and event promotions

patterns.name: Ordinal suffix th
patterns.context: Functions as an ordinal suffix after a number, indicating dates, order, or editions, such as 12th, dates near 31st, and 25th.
patterns.domain: Academic history, education, patents, and conference materials

patterns.name: Patient section formatting in medical papers
patterns.context: Occurs in section headings, patient subheadings, or Markdown/HTML-style heading markers; nearby text often mentions patient counts, study groups, and case criteria.

patterns.name: Group and treatment descriptions in medical research
patterns.context: Describes patient or subject groups, medication regimens, and study participants; the trigger is not always adjacent to an ordinal.

patterns.name: Journal/conference formatting in English citations
patterns.context: Located in references or conference names, often alongside volume and issue numbers, edition numbers, and publication information; co-occurs here with 25th.

patterns.name: Local formatting cues in numbers and dates
patterns.context: Occurs near number formats such as dates and amounts; activation may be driven by an adjacent ordinal spelling or numerical text structure, but these fragments themselves are not clear ordinals.

4_2863.description: 主要响应英文数字后的序数词后缀 st（尤其 1st）及 th，并广泛出现在日期、届数和学术编号中。另有医学论文标题、患者分组，以及日期/数字格式等伴随模式；个别片段无法由序数词模式充分解释。

patterns.name: 序数词后缀 st
patterns.context: 作为序数词后缀，通常跟在数字后；尤其是 1st，也出现在 21st。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、医学文本、法律记录、专利、活动宣传等多种文体

patterns.name: 序数词后缀 th
patterns.context: 作为序数词后缀，跟在数字后，表示日期、次序或届数，如 12th、31st 附近的日期以及 25th。
patterns.domain: 学术史、教育、专利与会议资料

patterns.name: 医学论文的患者章节格式
patterns.context: 出现在论文分节标题、患者小标题或 Markdown/HTML 风格的标题标记中；附近常有患者数量、研究分组与病例标准。

patterns.name: 医学研究中的分组与治疗描述
patterns.context: 描述患者或受试者分组、用药方案及研究对象；触发词本身并不总与序数词相邻。

patterns.name: 英文文献引用中的期刊/会议格式
patterns.context: 位于参考文献或会议名称中，常与卷期、届数及出版信息并列；此处与 25th 同现。
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术中的文献引用

patterns.name: 数字和日期中的局部格式线索
patterns.context: 日期、金额等数字格式附近出现；激活可能由相邻序数写法或数字文本结构带动，但这些片段本身不是明确序数词。
patterns.domain: 活动信息、法律庭审记录

en.description: Primarily activates on the ordinal suffixes rd and th after numbers, covering paper numbering, dates, cases, and race placements. Sporadic activations also occur in technical quantity expressions, percentages, months and years, and intraword fragments, with uncertain connections.

patterns.name: Ordinal suffix -rd
patterns.context: Occurs after a number to form an ordinal; segments mostly contain 23rd, including forms such as 23rd/23rd race.
patterns.domain: Papers, medicine, scientific text, and sports reporting

patterns.name: Ordinal suffix -th
patterns.context: Occurs after a number to form an ordinal such as a date or placement, e.g. 25th, 12th, and 20th.
patterns.domain: Dates, application deadlines, observation records, and sports reporting

patterns.name: Numerical expressions of magnitude or range
patterns.context: In technical descriptions, numbers combine with units or magnitudes to describe parameters such as angles and frequencies.

patterns.name: Percentage and decimal expressions
patterns.context: Numbers represent proportions or percentage statistics, especially prevalence statements below 1%.

patterns.name: Months and years in dates
patterns.context: A month and year follow an ordinal date to record when an observation occurred.

patterns.name: Word fragments in English words
patterns.context: These fragments occur in names, anatomical terms, or ordinary words; no stable shared contextual condition is apparent.
patterns.domain: Academic, medical, and application announcement texts

4_2863.description: 主要对数字后的序数词后缀 rd、th 激活，涵盖论文编号、日期、病例与赛事名次。另有零散的技术数量表达、百分比、月份年份及词内片段激活，彼此关联不确定。

patterns.name: 序数词后缀 -rd
patterns.context: 出现在数字之后，构成序数词；段中多为 23rd，也有 23rd/23rd race 等形式。
patterns.domain: 论文、医学、科学文本及体育赛事记述

patterns.name: 序数词后缀 -th
patterns.context: 出现在数字之后，构成日期或名次等序数词，如 25th、12th、20th。
patterns.domain: 日期、申请截止信息、观测记录及体育赛事记述

patterns.name: 数量级或范围中的数字表达
patterns.context: 技术描述中，数字与单位或数量级搭配，描述角度、频率等参数。

patterns.name: 百分比及小数数字表达
patterns.context: 数字用于比例或百分比统计，尤其是小于 1% 的患病率表述。

patterns.name: 日期中的月份与年份
patterns.context: 在序数日期之后补充月份和年份，记录观测发生时间。

patterns.name: 英语词内部的分词片段
patterns.context: 这些片段分别出现在人名、解剖术语或普通词中；未见稳定的共同上下文条件。
patterns.domain: 学术、医学及申请公告文本

en.description: All segments activate on “th” in numerical ordinals, covering dates, centuries, editions, and medical references to ribs, percentiles, and postoperative days; nearby nouns occasionally activate more weakly.

patterns.name: th in ordinals
patterns.context: Occurs after a number to form an ordinal; the number and following noun vary by context. Includes dates, centuries, conference editions, as well as medical references to age, ribs, percentiles, and postoperative days.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain text, including patents, medical papers, conference bibliographies, and academic papers

patterns.name: Nouns or punctuation after ordinal th
patterns.context: The ordinal is followed by a word describing an edition, date, century, anatomical structure, or statistical position; activation primarily marks the ordinal suffix, though neighboring tokens are sometimes also marked.

4_2863.description: 所有片段均在数字序数的“th”处激活，涵盖日期、世纪、届次及医学中的肋骨、百分位、术后日等；邻近名词偶有较弱激活。

patterns.name: 序数词中的 th
patterns.context: 出现在数字之后，构成序数；数字及后续名词随语境变化。既包括日期、世纪、会议届次，也包括医学中的年龄、肋骨、百分位和术后天数等。
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本，包括专利、医学论文、会议书目和学术论文

patterns.name: 序数 th 后的名词或标点
patterns.trigger: 如 “25«th»« Annual»”, “12«th»« rib»”, “10«th»« percentile»”, “25«th»« November»”, “19«th»« century»”
patterns.context: 序数词后接描述届次、日期、世纪、解剖结构或统计位置的词；激活主要标记序数后缀，邻近 token 有时也被标记。

en.description: Activations span various word-internal fragments, word endings, and common words, and also occur on numbers, degrees, and variables in mathematical formulas; across scientific papers, novels, book titles, encyclopedia categories, and philosophical discussions, no single stable semantic or domain-specific pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: Numbers and symbols in degree notation
patterns.context: In mathematical or scientific text, numbers are adjacent to superscripts, degree symbols, variables, or formula fragments; activation falls on numbers, symbols, and some mathematical notation.

patterns.name: Phrase boundaries in stories or narratives
patterns.context: In narrative prose, common words are split into marked fragments or occur at phrase boundaries and points of syntactic transition.

patterns.name: Intraword fragments in titles
patterns.context: In capitalized book titles, headings, or publication locations, internal word fragments are marked; surrounding text includes line breaks and publication information.

patterns.name: Irish proper nouns and category endings
patterns.context: In proper nouns and category entries for people, political offices, or place names, activation occurs on internal syllables or word endings.

patterns.name: Mathematical terminology and intraword fragments
patterns.context: In mathematical papers, set theory terms, scholars’ names, or compound terms are split into marked fragments; angle notation is not required.

patterns.name: Common function words in philosophical discussion
patterns.context: In philosophical argumentative prose, activation falls on common words such as articles, prepositions, pronouns, and discourse-related nouns.

4_2863.description: 激活覆盖多种词内片段、词尾和常见词，也出现于数学公式中的数字、度数及变量；各段跨越科学论文、小说、书籍标题、百科分类和哲学论述，未显示单一稳定语义或领域。

patterns.name: 度数标记中的数字与符号
patterns.trigger: 角度、参数或数学标记中的数字和符号，如“$19«^»1«circ»10«$»5”、“$60«^»3«circ»10«$»7”、“$\theta\«sim»1 1«^»1«circ»9”
patterns.context: 数学或科学文本中，数字紧邻上标、度数符号、变量或公式片段；激活落在数字、符号及部分数学记号上。

patterns.name: 故事或叙述中的短语边界
patterns.context: 叙述性 prose 中，常见词被拆分标记，或词语处于短语边界和句法衔接位置。

patterns.name: 标题中的词内片段
patterns.context: 大写书名、标题或出版地中，词的内部片段被标记；周围有排版换行和出版信息。
patterns.domain: Gutenberg 书籍扉页/目录式文本

patterns.name: 爱尔兰专名与分类词尾
patterns.context: 人物类别、政治职务或地名等专名与分类条目中，激活出现在词内音节或词尾。

patterns.name: 数学术语及词内片段
patterns.context: 数学论文中，集合论术语、学者姓名或复合术语被拆分标记；不要求出现角度记号。

patterns.name: 哲学论述中的常见虚词
patterns.trigger: “being« as» the”“«question» still remains”“at« all»”“«in»« my» concept”
patterns.context: 哲学论证 prose 中，激活落在冠词、介词、代词或论述性名词等常见词上。

en.description: Primarily responds to the emphatic negative phrase “not at all” and “as yet” meaning up to now; several other scattered highlighted words are difficult to group into the same pattern.

patterns.name: Fixed expression “not at all”
patterns.context: Forms the emphatic phrase “not at all” in negative sentences; punctuation or token boundaries may occur between words.
patterns.domain: Various styles, including Q&A, literature, law, and forums

patterns.name: “as yet” temporal phrase
patterns.context: Means up to now or not yet; other words may sometimes appear between its components.

patterns.name: Other scattered highlighted words
patterns.context: These words are highlighted in their respective contexts, but no shared local syntactic or semantic condition is apparent.
patterns.domain: Physics Q&A, medical papers, literature, encyclopedias, patents

4_2863.description: 主要响应强调否定短语“not at all”和表示截至目前的“as yet”；另有若干分散高亮词，难以归为同一模式。

patterns.name: 固定搭配“not at all”
patterns.context: 否定句中形成强调性短语“not at all”；词间可有标点或 token 边界。
patterns.domain: 问答、文学、法律、论坛等多种文体

patterns.name: “as yet”时间短语
patterns.context: 表示截至目前、尚未；有时中间夹有其他词。

patterns.name: 其他分散的高亮词
patterns.context: 这些词在各自上下文中被标亮，但未见共同的局部句法或语义条件。
patterns.domain: 物理问答、医学论文、文学、百科、专利

en.concept: Local word forms and subword boundaries
en.description: Activations span several types of local forms: ordinal centuries and numbers, Wikipedia category labels, split place names and proper nouns, English function words and word endings, as well as medical terminology, poetry, and filenames; there is no single semantic trigger condition.

patterns.name: Ordinal centuries and hyphens
patterns.context: Ordinal century terms and century ranges, commonly found in biographical category headings; can also activate in year/period expressions in body text.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia categories, historical or academic texts

patterns.name: Colons and demonyms in category headings
patterns.context: In Category headings, a colon is followed by a demonym, a people category, or a related entry; category labels recur in this form.

patterns.name: Word fragments at the ends of place names
patterns.context: Place names are split at subword boundaries, especially on syllables or letter fragments within or at the end of a place name; trigger positions vary.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, papers, forums, or historical prose

patterns.name: Number fragments in identifiers and years
patterns.context: Numbers occur in centuries, years, dates, or identifiers, often near ordinals, dates, or historical narratives.

patterns.name: English conjunctions and common phrases
patterns.context: Function words or phrase fragments such as then, in, of, and against in ordinary English phrases, with varying semantics and syntactic positions.

patterns.name: English plural or derivational endings
patterns.context: Noun endings or derivational suffixes are tokenized separately, commonly in people-category nouns, but also in body text.

patterns.name: Fragments of proper nouns and abbreviations
patterns.context: Proper nouns, company names, personal names, or abbreviations are split into multiple tokens; trigger fragments have no stable shared meaning.

patterns.name: Biomedical experimental and formulation contexts
patterns.context: Biomedical content about animal experiment materials, vaccines, or diarrhea prevention; activation falls on terms or adjacent ordinary words.

patterns.name: Local words in poetry
patterns.context: Local tokens in poetry titles, lines, or formatted text; no stable poetry-specific trigger feature is apparent.

patterns.name: Filenames and command-style text in forums
patterns.context: Filename/path-like strings in forum text, including before, numbers, hyphens, and extensions.

patterns.name: Time expressions in academic introductions
patterns.context: Introductions begin with a year and recount research history, activating the year and temporal connective expressions.

4_2863.description: 激活分布在多类局部形式：世纪序数与数字、维基百科分类标签、被拆分的地名和专名、英语功能词及词尾，也见医学术语、诗歌和文件名；没有单一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 序数世纪与连字符
patterns.context: 世纪序数词及世纪范围，常见于人物分类标题；也可激活在正文中的年份/时期表达。
patterns.domain: 维基百科分类、历史或学术文本

patterns.name: 分类标题中的冒号与国别形容词
patterns.context: Category 标题中冒号后接国别、人物类别或相关条目；类别标签形式重复出现。

patterns.name: 地名末尾的分词片段
patterns.context: 地名被分词边界拆开，尤其是地名内部或末尾的音节/字母片段；触发位置并不统一。
patterns.domain: 百科、论文、论坛或历史散文

patterns.name: 编号与年份中的数字片段
patterns.context: 数字出现在世纪、年份、日期或编号中；常与序数、日期或历史叙述相邻。
patterns.domain: 维基百科、学术论文、历史文本

patterns.name: 英文连接词及常见短语
patterns.context: 普通英语短语中的 then、in、of、against 等功能词或搭配片段，语义与句法位置各异。
patterns.domain: 诗歌、学术论文、医学论文

patterns.name: 英文复数或派生词尾
patterns.context: 名词词尾或派生后缀被单独分词，常见于人物类别名词，也见于正文。
patterns.domain: 维基百科分类、学术文本

patterns.name: 专名与缩写的碎片
patterns.context: 专名、公司名、姓名或缩写被拆成多个 token；触发片段没有稳定的共同语义。
patterns.domain: 论文、诗歌标题、医学论文

patterns.name: 生物医学实验与制剂语境
patterns.context: 动物实验材料、疫苗或腹泻预防等生物医学内容，激活落在术语或相邻普通词上。

patterns.name: 诗歌文本中的局部词语
patterns.context: 诗歌标题、诗行或排版文本中的局部 token；未显示出稳定的诗歌专属触发特征。

patterns.name: 论坛文件名与命令样式文本
patterns.context: 论坛文本中的文件名/路径样式字符串，含 before、数字、连字符及扩展名。

patterns.name: 学术引言中的时间表达
patterns.context: 引言中以年份开篇并叙述研究发展史，激活年份及时间连接表达。

en.concept: Local word fragments and formatting markers
en.description: Activations are scattered across common English words, time expressions, numbers and punctuation, units, and intraword fragments. Temporal sequence expressions recur somewhat, but do not explain the numerical, proper-noun, and technical fragments; some triggers may simply reflect local token forms.

patterns.name: Specific short words or suffix fragments
patterns.context: Trigger positions and collocations vary; some are words themselves, while others appear to be subword fragments within words or units. No shared syntactic condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Numbers, punctuation, and formatted values
patterns.context: Numbers or symbols appear in structures such as concentrations, coordinate arrays, dates, and astronomical redshifts; activation often covers only part of a numerical expression.

patterns.name: English intraword fragments and proper nouns
patterns.context: Activation falls inside words or on fragments of proper nouns such as personal names and titles, without depending on consistent semantics or word forms.

patterns.name: Temporal and sequential expressions
patterns.context: Occurs in expressions of temporal order, time spans, or narrative progression; some activations fall only on general prepositions or adverbs.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, political commentary, narrative text

patterns.name: Structural units or geometric terms in technical text
patterns.context: Local fragments in units, symbols, or geometric descriptions; the same term does not occur in every technical segment.

patterns.name: Tokenization or word-form fragments
patterns.context: Activation occurs on parts of longer words, with varying forms and meanings.
patterns.domain: News commentary, medical papers, literature, and astronomy abstracts

4_2863.concept: 局部词片段与格式标记
4_2863.description: 激活散布于常见英语词、时间表达、数字与标点、单位及单词内部片段。时间顺序表达略有复现，但不足以解释数值、专名和技术片段；部分触发可能只是局部 token 形式。

patterns.name: 特定短词或后缀片段
patterns.context: 触发位置和搭配不统一；有些是词本身，有些似乎是词或单位中的子词片段，暂无共同句法条件

patterns.name: 数字、标点及格式化数值
patterns.context: 数字或符号嵌在浓度、坐标数组、日期、天文红移等结构中；激活常只覆盖数值的一部分

patterns.name: 英文词内片段与专名
patterns.context: 激活落在单词内部或人名、职衔等专名片段，不依赖一致语义或词形
patterns.domain: 论坛、实验论文、人物年表

patterns.name: 时间与先后关系表达
patterns.trigger: «before»、«at that point»、«By then»、«time»、«same time period»、«at that moment»、«yet»
patterns.context: 出现在时间顺序、时间段或叙述进展的表达中；部分只激活通用介词或副词
patterns.domain: 科学论文、政治评论、叙事文本

patterns.name: 技术文本中的结构性单位或几何术语
patterns.context: 单位、符号或几何描述中的局部片段；并非每段技术文本都出现同一术语
patterns.domain: 生物医学与物理学论文

patterns.name: 分词或词形片段
patterns.context: 激活位于较长单词的一部分，词形和含义各异
patterns.domain: 新闻评论、医学论文、文学及天文学摘要

en.concept: Heterogeneous text structures and subword fragments
en.description: Activations span numerical and punctuation formats, scientific measurements, mathematical notation, and technical word fragments, as well as discourse connectives, philosophical discussion, communications terminology, catalog proper nouns, and filenames; no single stable semantic trigger condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Numerical and decimal formats
patterns.context: Numbers, decimal values, ranges, or measurement units, especially structures separated by punctuation; activation may fall on numbers, punctuation, or adjacent units.
patterns.domain: Numerical values in mixed corpora, tables, scientific measurements, and technical data

patterns.name: Inter-sentence contrast and demonstrative expressions
patterns.context: Discourse connectives or demonstratives appear in contexts of inter-sentence contrast, addition, categorization, or reference; activations are scattered across these common function words and neighboring words.

patterns.name: Word endings or internal fragments in technical terms
patterns.context: Long technical words, proper nouns, or abbreviations are split into subword tokens; activation concentrates on intraword fragments or endings, with no unified semantic condition apparent.
patterns.domain: Medicine, bibliographic catalogs, and general technical texts

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and variable notation
patterns.context: Variables, subscripts, square brackets, and commas form formulas or numerical vectors.

patterns.name: Biomedical experiments and research descriptions
patterns.context: Medical research describes cells, experimental conditions, observations, or clinical presentations; activation does not consistently fall on the same biomedical term.

patterns.name: Wireless communications terminology
patterns.context: Descriptions of communications systems involving multiple devices, base stations, and links; activation occurs on general technical terms and multiword phrases.

patterns.name: Abstract concepts in philosophical discussion
patterns.context: Abstract argument discussing categories, causality, quantity, and ontological levels.

patterns.name: Proper nouns in catalog layouts and headings
patterns.context: Capitalized catalog entries, names, or book titles appear alongside page numbers and line-break formatting.
patterns.domain: Novel tables of contents or book text

patterns.name: Filenames and tokenized strings
patterns.context: Isolated filenames or file-path-like alphanumeric strings containing hyphens, numbers, and extensions.

4_2863.concept: 异质文本结构与子词片段
4_2863.description: 激活分布于数字与标点格式、科学计量、数学记号及专业词片段，也见于篇章连接词、哲学论述、通信术语、目录专名和文件名；未见稳定的单一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 数字与小数格式
patterns.context: 数字、带小数的数值、范围或测量单位，尤其是由标点分隔的结构；激活可落在数字、标点或相邻单位上。
patterns.domain: 混合语料中的数值、表格、科学计量与技术数据

patterns.name: 句间转折与指示表达
patterns.context: 篇章连接或指示性词语出现在句间对比、补充、归类或回指的语境中；激活分散在这些常见功能词及邻近词上。
patterns.domain: 学术论文与论述性文本

patterns.name: 专业词中的词尾或内部片段
patterns.context: 较长专业词、专名或缩写被拆分为子词 token；激活集中在词内片段或词尾，未显示统一语义条件。
patterns.domain: 医学、书目目录及一般专业文本

patterns.name: 数学符号与变量记号
patterns.context: 变量、下标、方括号及逗号等组成公式或数值向量。

patterns.name: 生物医学实验与研究描述
patterns.context: 医学研究中描述细胞、实验条件、观察结果或临床表现；激活并非稳定落在同一生物医学术语上。

patterns.name: 无线通信术语
patterns.trigger: “wireless multiple-access communication systems”、“base stations”、“forward and reverse links”
patterns.context: 通信系统描述多个设备、基站及链路；激活出现在一般技术术语及多词短语中。

patterns.name: 哲学论述中的抽象概念
patterns.context: 讨论范畴、因果、数量及本体论层级的抽象论证。

patterns.name: 目录排版与标题中的专名
patterns.trigger: “LAURENCE BRADDON”、“THOMASINE BONAVENTURA”、“THE MURDER OF NEVILL NORWAY”
patterns.context: 大写目录条目、姓名或书名与页码、换行排版相邻。

patterns.name: 文件名与标记化字符串
patterns.context: 孤立文件名或类似文件路径的混合字母数字字符串，包含连字符、数字和扩展名。

en.description: The most prominent shared pattern is a strong response to the Greek-letter term delta (including hyphenated compounds) in text across multiple domains. Two isolated high activations—dot in a URL and successively in a patent context about paper feeding—do not fit this pattern.

patterns.name: Greek-letter delta terms
patterns.context: delta appears as a standalone word or term prefix, followed by items such as numbers, virus, hedging, or receptor; capitalization varies.
patterns.domain: Technical texts across biomedicine, geography, finance, engineering, and other fields

patterns.name: Hyphenated delta compounds
patterns.context: delta forms a term with a following word via a hyphen, such as delta-10 endotoxin or delta-doping; activation is concentrated on delta.

patterns.name: dot substring in URLs
patterns.context: dot appears after a slash in a URL path, especially in hardware-related domain links; it has no clear semantic connection to delta terms.

patterns.name: successively in an automatic paper-feeding description
patterns.context: A patent sentence describes paper being fed successively into a device; delta is not marked in this passage.

4_2898.description: 最显著的共同模式是在多领域文本中对希腊字母词项 delta（含连字符复合词）强烈响应；另有网址中的 dot 和专利送纸语境中的 successively 两个孤立高激活，无法归入该模式。

patterns.name: 希腊字母 delta 词项
patterns.context: 出现 delta 作为独立词或词项前缀，后接数字、virus、hedging、receptor 等；大小写不一。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、地理、金融、工程等多领域技术文本

patterns.name: delta 连字符复合词
patterns.context: delta 与后续词通过连字符组成术语，如 delta-10 endotoxin、delta-doping；激活集中在 delta。

patterns.name: 网址中的 dot 子串
patterns.context: URL 路径中的 slash 后出现 dot，尤其域名硬件相关链接；与 delta 词项无明显语义关联。

patterns.name: 自动送纸描述中的 successively
patterns.context: 专利句子描述纸张连续送入设备内部；本段未标记 delta。

en.concept: Greek letter delta and its terms
en.description: Primarily sensitive to the Greek letter delta and its technical compounds, covering time steps, molecular biology, financial hedging, semiconductor doping, and toxin naming; it also matches river deltas. Other activations involve split subwords and material-name fragments that cannot be explained by delta.

patterns.name: Greek letter delta (including mathematical variables)
patterns.context: delta appears as a Greek letter or technical symbol, often adjacent to a following noun, a hyphenated compound, or mathematical notation; in several passages the delta token is marked on its own.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: mathematics, finance, semiconductors, geography, pharmacology, and toxicology

patterns.name: Expressions related to delta time
patterns.context: delta denotes a time step or time quantity; it appears in time delta for game-motion updates and in questions about duration-format conversions.
patterns.domain: StackExchange; game development and programming Q&A

patterns.name: delta in molecular biology
patterns.context: delta is part of a biological term or symbol involving mRNA/sequences, steroids, and receptor-mediated synaptic effects; it is sometimes followed by a number or hyphen.

patterns.name: River delta in geography
patterns.context: delta is an ordinary geographical landform term referring to a delta formed by a river.

patterns.name: Greek-letter name split across adjacent tokens
patterns.context: Activation falls on split string fragments: in passage 4, the delta in timedelta is split into « timed» and «elta»; passage 8 contains multiple subword fragments of the material name Nanocrystal/Metal-Organic Framework, with no clear delta.
patterns.domain: Variables and format strings in programming Q&A; biomedical material names

patterns.name: Semiconductor delta-doping
patterns.context: delta is part of the specialized term delta-doping, describing Si doping density.

patterns.name: Financial options delta hedging
patterns.context: delta is used in a hedging argument in a Black–Scholes context.

patterns.name: Chemical/toxicological delta-endotoxin
patterns.context: delta is a Greek-letter modifier in toxin names such as beta-exotoxin.
patterns.domain: Patent background sections; toxins and toxicology

4_2898.concept: 希腊字母 delta 及其术语
4_2898.description: 主要对希腊字母 delta 及其专业复合词敏感，涵盖时间步长、分子生物学、金融对冲、半导体掺杂和毒素命名；也命中河流三角洲。另有拆分子词激活及材料名称片段，无法由 delta 解释。

patterns.name: 希腊字母 delta（含数学变量）
patterns.trigger: « delta»；也包括 « delta» hedging argument、« delta»-d«oping»、« delta»-endotoxin
patterns.context: delta 作为希腊字母或专业符号出现，常与后续名词、连字符复合词或数学记号相邻；在若干段中独立标记 delta token。
patterns.domain: 跨领域；数学、金融、半导体、地理、药理、毒理

patterns.name: delta time 相关表达
patterns.trigger: « delta» in « delta»10；« delta» time（原文中分为 time« delta»）
patterns.context: delta 表示时间步长或时间量；出现在游戏运动更新的 time delta、时长格式转换问题中。

patterns.name: 分子生物学中的 delta
patterns.trigger: « delta» 60%；« delta» 5-3 beta-«hydroxy»；mu-« and»…« delta» receptor-mediated LTD
patterns.context: delta 是生物学名词或符号的一部分，涉及 mRNA/序列、甾体以及受体介导的突触效应；有时后接数字或连字符。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、NIH 项目摘要

patterns.name: 地理地貌中的河流三角洲
patterns.trigger: « delta» formed by the Sevier River
patterns.context: delta 是普通地理地貌名词，指河流形成的三角洲。

patterns.name: 希腊字母名称被拆分到相邻 token
patterns.context: 激活落在被切分的字符串片段中：第4段的 timedelta 拼写中，delta 字样被拆成 « timed» 与 «elta»；第8段则是材料名称 Nanocrystal/Metal-Organic Framework 的多个子词片段，并未出现明显的 delta。
patterns.domain: 编程问答中的变量/格式字符串；生物医学材料名称

patterns.name: 半导体 delta 掺杂
patterns.context: delta 与 doping 连成专门术语 delta-doping，描述 Si 掺杂密度。

patterns.name: 金融期权 delta 对冲
patterns.context: delta 用于 Black–Scholes 语境中的对冲论证。

patterns.name: 化学/毒理学 delta-endotoxin
patterns.context: delta 是 beta-exotoxin 等毒素名称旁的希腊字母修饰语。

en.concept: Load lexical form and varied local patterns
en.description: The most consistent lexical signal is capitalized Load (including Load followed by different suffixes), but other activations are scattered across Japanese honorific expressions, news headlines, email attachment wording, code-documentation fields, and Spanish names; no unified semantic or stylistic condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial or standalone Load stem
patterns.context: Capitalized Load is followed by different suffixes or boundaries, such as «Load»er, «Load» Class, «Load»-and, and «Load»Students; activation is mainly on Load.
patterns.domain: Code, product copy, and general English

patterns.name: Honorific expressions in Japanese emails
patterns.context: Automated replies or customer-service notices explain that an email address is for sending only, cannot receive replies, and should be used for inquiries.

patterns.name: Determiner and store topic in a headline
patterns.context: A news-link headline with the structure “X is not the only online store.”

patterns.name: Attachment note in email body
patterns.context: After a brief all-caps opening, the message says that the attachment contains the final materials.

patterns.name: Package metadata in documentation comments
patterns.context: In a multiline code documentation comment, the @package or @subpackage field introduces the package name and configuration class.

patterns.name: Fragments in personal and place names
patterns.context: The Spanish name colonia Díaz appears repeatedly in an encyclopedia entry title and its opening text.

patterns.name: Quantity and robots in a news headline
patterns.context: A headline reports that Foxconn will hire a large number of robots, followed by a news link.

4_2898.concept: Load 词面及多种局部模式
4_2898.description: 最一致的词面信号是大小写 Load（含 Load 后接不同后缀），但其余激活分散于日语敬语、新闻标题、邮件附件措辞、代码文档字段及西语人名等局部片段；未见统一语义或文体条件。

patterns.name: 句首或独立的 Load 词干
patterns.context: 大小写 Load 后接不同后缀或边界：如 «Load»er、«Load» Class、«Load»-and、«Load»Students；激活主要落在 Load 上。
patterns.domain: 代码、产品文案及一般英语

patterns.name: 日语邮件中的敬语表达
patterns.context: 自动回复或客服通知，说明邮箱仅用于发送、不能接收回复及咨询。

patterns.name: 标题中的限定词与商店话题
patterns.context: 新闻链接标题，句式为“某某并非唯一的线上商店”。

patterns.name: 邮件正文中的附件说明
patterns.context: 全大写简短开场后，说明附件包含最终材料。

patterns.name: 文档注释中的 package 元数据
patterns.context: 多行代码文档注释里，@package 或 @subpackage 字段介绍包名和配置类。

patterns.name: 人名与地点名中的片段
patterns.context: 西语姓名 colonia Díaz 在百科条目标题与正文开头重复出现。

patterns.name: 新闻标题中的数量与机器人
patterns.context: 标题报道富士康将雇用大量机器人，后接新闻链接。

en.description: High activations mainly fall on Load in code identifiers, the generic closing symbol >, and At; another occurs on vulnerable in a vulnerability description. The remaining code and paper contexts differ substantially, so a shared trigger mechanism cannot be confirmed.

patterns.name: Load prefix in Load/loading terms
patterns.context: Appears in identifiers or compounds such as LoadAllTilesAction, Config Load Class, and WebFont Loader; it is not a complete word in ordinary sentences.
patterns.domain: Code identifiers, class names, and file descriptions

patterns.name: Generic type closing symbol
patterns.context: Appears after a generic type declaration or type parameter, as in tuple<Integer,Real>, Set<Student>, List<Integer>, and Class<T>.

patterns.name: At prefix
patterns.context: At precedes an Atom Feed metadata description or appears in the sentence-initial phrase “At the same time”.

patterns.name: Other local tokens in code
patterns.context: Appears near local algorithm variables; activation is weaker and absent from other passages.

patterns.name: vulnerable in a vulnerability report
patterns.context: Describes an overlooked code review and vulnerabilities that remain; the word is split into subwords.

patterns.name: Other code fragments without a clear shared trigger
patterns.context: Embedded in different code structures; the excerpts provided do not establish a unified trigger condition.

patterns.name: Paper fragments without a clear shared trigger
patterns.context: In biomedical paper text, At introduces a time or contrast context; its shared mechanism with the other high-activation fragments is unclear.

4_2898.concept: 代码结构与 Load 词首
4_2898.description: 高激活主要落在代码标识符中的 Load、泛型闭合符 > 及 At；另有漏洞描述中的 vulnerable。其余代码与论文语境差异较大，无法确认共享触发机制。

patterns.name: Load/加载词首 Load
patterns.context: 出现在标识符或复合词中，如 LoadAllTilesAction、Config Load Class、WebFont Loader；并非普通句子里的完整词
patterns.domain: 代码标识符、类名与文件说明

patterns.name: 泛型类型闭合符
patterns.context: 出现在泛型类型声明或类型参数之后，如 tuple<Integer,Real>、Set<Student>、List<Integer>、Class<T>

patterns.name: At 词首
patterns.context: At 后接 Atom Feed 元数据描述，或句首“At the same time”

patterns.name: 其他代码中的局部 token
patterns.context: 出现在算法局部变量附近；触发较弱且未见于其他段

patterns.name: 漏洞报道中的 vulnerable
patterns.context: 描述代码审查遗漏和仍存在的漏洞，词被拆分为子词

patterns.name: 未见明确共同触发的其他代码片段
patterns.context: 各自嵌于不同代码结构中，无法从所给片段确认统一触发条件

patterns.name: 未见明确共同触发的论文片段
patterns.context: 医学论文正文中 At 引出时间或转折语境；与其他高激活片段的共同机制不明

en.description: The most stable cue is “>” in HTML/XML closing tags. Activations also occur in type angle brackets, HTML attributes and text, code comment headers, and code in multiple languages; there is also an isolated medical word-initial “Un”.

patterns.name: At closing HTML/XML tags
patterns.context: In HTML/CSS examples or Android XML, the closing-tag angle bracket “>” is often a strong trigger; many nearby markup-syntax tokens are unmarked.
patterns.domain: Web code, StackExchange examples, Android XML

patterns.name: C/C++ pointer type closing symbol
patterns.context: At the closing position of type-parameter or pointer-type angle-bracket expressions; these examples are not ordinary HTML tags.
patterns.domain: Python/C++ mixed code; Java generic code

patterns.name: Word-initial Un- and biomedical terminology
patterns.context: A medical term at the beginning of an abstract sentence, with the complete phrase “Unilateral agenesis”; there is no clear code or markup-syntax condition.

patterns.name: Specific HTML attributes and text fragments
patterns.context: Activation appears near HTML attributes, article titles, or option text; trigger locations are scattered, with no single shared local token.

patterns.name: Code comments and file-header metadata
patterns.context: Appears in comments, license headers, author/copyright information, or API documentation blocks; activation spans multiple comment formats.

patterns.name: Other markup symbols in code and configuration
patterns.context: Scattered activations also appear in ordinary code or configuration content, distributed across identifiers, attributes, and numeric values without forming a stable subpattern.

4_2898.description: 最稳定的线索是 HTML/XML 结束标签的“>”，另在类型尖括号、HTML 属性与文本、代码注释头及多种语言代码中有激活；还包括孤立的医学词首“Un”。

patterns.name: 闭合 HTML/XML 标签处
patterns.context: HTML、CSS 示例片段或 Android XML 中，结束标签的尖括号“>”常是强触发点；附近也有不少未标记的标记语法 token。
patterns.domain: 网页代码、StackExchange 示例、Android XML

patterns.name: C/C++ 指针类型闭合符
patterns.context: 类型参数或指针类型尖括号表达式的闭合位置；例子并非普通 HTML 标签。
patterns.domain: Python/C++ 混合代码、Java 泛型代码

patterns.name: 词首 Un- 与生物医学术语
patterns.context: 摘要句首的医学术语，完整词为“Unilateral agenesis”；没有明显代码或标记语法条件。

patterns.name: 特定 HTML 属性及文本片段
patterns.context: HTML 属性、文章标题或选项文本附近激活；触发位置分散，未见共同的单一局部 token。

patterns.name: 代码注释与文件头元数据
patterns.context: 注释、许可证头、作者/版权信息或 API 文档块中出现；激活跨越多种注释格式。

patterns.name: 代码与配置中的其他标记符号
patterns.context: 普通代码或配置内容中也有零散激活，触发点分布在标识符、属性和数值等位置，未形成稳定子模式。

en.description: Strong activations mainly fall on within-word subword fragments in multilingual European Parliament texts, especially Polish, Slovenian, and Latvian; they also cover English prose fragments and technical filename suffixes. Triggers depend on language and tokenization boundaries, with no single stable word meaning apparent.

patterns.name: Within-word fragments in Latvian
patterns.context: Appears in continuous Latvian prose, with words split into multiple tokens; commas, periods, and other punctuation also occur.

patterns.name: Within-word fragments in Slovenian
patterns.context: Appears in continuous Slovenian prose, often alongside vocabulary about parliament, member states, and committees.

patterns.name: Within-word fragments in Polish
patterns.context: Appears in Polish parliamentary prose or meeting records; some passages include speaker labels, agenda items, and line-break formatting.
patterns.domain: EuroParl, Polish parliamentary speeches and meeting records

patterns.name: English word fragments and tokenization boundaries
patterns.context: Appears in continuous English prose sentences and punctuation; there is no parliamentary formatting here.

patterns.name: Filename-extension style
patterns.context: Short sequences of dot-separated file extensions, with prefixes such as «har», «vm», and «ac».

4_2898.concept: 多语种词片段/分词特征
4_2898.description: 强激活主要落在多语种欧洲议会文本的词内子词片段，尤其波兰语、斯洛文尼亚语和拉脱维亚语；也覆盖英语散文词片段及技术文件后缀。触发受语言与分词边界影响，未见单一稳定词义。

patterns.name: 拉脱维亚语词内片段
patterns.trigger: 如 «ņ», «ā», «ē», «ī», «ū» 等带变音符号的字母片段，以及 «p»、«z» 等相邻子词片段
patterns.context: 出现在拉脱维亚语连续正文中，词被拆成多个 token；同时有逗号、句号等标点

patterns.name: 斯洛文尼亚语词内片段
patterns.trigger: 如 «č»、«ž»、«š» 及 «član»、«držav»、«vpraš» 等拆分词片段
patterns.context: 出现在斯洛文尼亚语连续正文中，常与议会、成员国、委员会等词汇共现
patterns.domain: EuroParl，斯洛文尼亚语议会发言

patterns.name: 波兰语词内片段
patterns.trigger: 如 «Deleg»、«jest»、«ności»、«Przewod»、«punk»、«sprawoz»，以及波兰语变音字母片段
patterns.context: 出现在波兰语议会正文或会议记录中；部分段落有发言人标签、议程和换行格式
patterns.domain: EuroParl，波兰语议会发言与会议记录

patterns.name: 英语词片段与分词边界
patterns.context: 英语叙述句中出现连续正文及标点；此处没有议会格式
patterns.domain: Gutenberg 历史传记/叙述散文

patterns.name: 文件扩展名样式
patterns.context: 短小的点分隔文件后缀序列；前缀为 «har»、«vm»、«ac» 等片段
patterns.domain: ArXiv 文本或技术性文件名

en.description: Activations are scattered across internal fragments of proper nouns, foreign words, and transliterations; they also occur in the .html extension, the relational verb relates, the title-final word Ballads, and letters within cremation. There is no stable shared semantic or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Within-word fragments in proper nouns/loanwords
patterns.context: Activation falls on within-word fragments of proper nouns, foreign words, or transliterations; word forms are often marked as split, and need not share a language or affix.

patterns.name: Word-final forms in album/song titles
patterns.context: Appears in discography or song-title lists arranged by year; activation marks a plural word at the end of a complete title.

patterns.name: Webpage file extension in URL paths
patterns.context: A webpage address path ends in .html, with activation concentrated on the extension and period.

patterns.name: Relational verb in noun phrases
patterns.context: When describing an entity's relationship to a country or discussing how a topic relates to some content, the verb relates is followed by to introducing the object of the relationship.

patterns.name: Syllable fragments in proper nouns
patterns.context: Activation appears on local letter/syllable fragments within personal names, country names, or Latin honorific phrases, without a consistent semantic or syntactic environment.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries about people and companies; academic terminology

patterns.name: Within-word fragment in cremation
patterns.context: Appears in an account of ancient Egyptian beliefs about the soul's passage and taboos around cremation; activation marks a single-letter fragment within the word.

4_2898.concept: 词内片段与特殊字符串
4_2898.description: 激活分散于专名、外语或转写词的内部片段，也见于 .html 扩展名、关系动词 relates、标题词尾 Ballads 和 cremation 的词内字母；没有稳定的共同语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 专名/外来词的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专名、外语或转写词的词内片段；词形常被拆分标注，未必是同一语言或同一词缀。
patterns.domain: 多语种政治文本、百科条目

patterns.name: 专辑/歌曲名中的词尾
patterns.context: 出现在按年份罗列的唱片或歌曲标题中，激活完整标题末尾的复数词。

patterns.name: URL 路径中的网页文件扩展名
patterns.context: 网页地址路径末尾出现 .html，激活集中在扩展名及句点。

patterns.name: 名词短语中的关系词
patterns.context: 在描述实体与国家的关联，或讨论某议题与某内容的关联时，动词 relates 后接 to 引出关系对象。
patterns.domain: 学术规范说明、政治邮件

patterns.name: 专名中的音节片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在人名、国名或拉丁荣誉短语内部的局部字母/音节，缺少一致的语义或句法环境。
patterns.domain: 百科人物与企业条目、学术用语

patterns.name: cremation 词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在关于古埃及迁魂观念及火葬禁忌的叙述中，激活词中部的单字母片段。

en.description: Activations broadly fall on letters or subword fragments within words across multiple languages; they also occur in place names, personal names, word endings, titles, English prose, and code identifiers. The positions are morphologically similar, but no stable semantic or grammatical trigger condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Within-word subwords/grapheme fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on characters or subword fragments inside words, often with surrounding unmarked characters; it occurs across languages and styles.
patterns.domain: Multilingual text, encyclopedias, code, and papers

patterns.name: Slavic case endings and place-name suffixes
patterns.context: Embedded in Slavic place names, personal names, or inflected words; the activated fragment may correspond to a stem, place-name suffix, or inflectional ending.
patterns.domain: Russian, Czech, and other Slavic-language texts

patterns.name: Inflectional and derivational word fragments
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated at word endings or near internal morphological boundaries, involving inflection, derivation, or word-form variation across languages; the specific fragments show no unified grammatical function.
patterns.domain: Latvian, Spanish, and other European languages

patterns.name: Internal fragments in titles, bibliographies, and proper nouns
patterns.context: In lists, titles, or bibliographic text, activation falls on internal fragments of proper nouns or common words and on word endings; no syntactic context is required.

patterns.name: Local fragments in common English words
patterns.context: In English prose, a segment inside a common short or longer word is marked; the same fragment may recur in a passage, but there is no stable semantic category.

patterns.name: Internal fragments in code identifiers
patterns.context: In code lines, fragments inside identifiers, parentheses, or separators activate, particularly in underscore-separated names and function names.

patterns.name: Surname letter fragments in cited references
patterns.context: In recommended citation formats for papers, internal fragments near author names, diacritics, or hyphens activate.

patterns.name: Cross-lingual within-word fragments in EuroParl text
patterns.context: In Russian, Czech, Latvian, and Spanish parliamentary passages, activation falls inside multilingual words; the specific fragments vary substantially across passages.

4_2898.description: 激活广泛落在多语种词内部的字母或子词片段，也见于地名、人名、词尾、标题、英语散文和代码标识符；位置形态相似，但尚无稳定语义或语法触发条件。

patterns.name: 词内部子词/字素片段
